boss:adula--liurnia-of-the-lakes.name: Glintstone Dragon Adula (Liurnia of the Lakes)

stats.Status resist: Poison 252 · Scarlet Rot 252 · Bleed 252 · Sleep 999 · Madness 999 · Curse 999

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Glintstone Dragon Adula is an optional boss in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: A devourer of sorcerers, whose body became corrupted by glintstone. The Glintstone Dragon Adula was once bested by Ranni the Witch and subsequently swore a knightly oath to her Dark Moon. Adula is first encountered outside Ranni's Rise in the Three Sisters, north of Caria Manor. After a brief fight, it disappears, only to reappear at the Moonlight Altar outside the Cathedral of Manus Celes.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Glintstone Dragon Adula is encountered in two areas. It first defends Ranni's Rise in the Three Sisters area outside Caria Manor, located in northern Liurnia of the Lakes. It teleports away when sufficiently injured. The second is on the Moonlight Altar just outside the Cathedral of Manus Celes. This second battle is a fight to the death.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Adula can use magic breath, much like Smarag. However, it can also utilize Adula's Moonblade, conjuring a magic blade in its maw mid-flight and unleashing a wave that inflicts Frostbite.

sections.text: Ancestor Spirit is found in an isolated arena accessible from Siofra River. To access it, you must light all eight obelisks by the stairs to the Hallowhorn Grounds east of the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace. sections.heading: Elden Ring Black Blade Kindred Boss Guide
sections.text: Black Blade Kindred Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Black Blade Kindred: Use the Stone of Gurranq spell, awarded by giving Gurranq his 6th Deathroot. This spell comes out decently fast, deals good amounts of damage, and can be used in succession. It also usually aims for the Kindred's head and can even break its poise while doing so. Lightning Spear and Frenzied Burst can work well as ranged offensive spells. For Intelligence players, Glintstone Cometshard or even just Great Glintstone Shard can work wonders.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Black Knife Assassin Boss Guide
sections.text: Black Knife Assassin Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Black Knife Assassin: Use the Lone Wolvesor Godrick Soldiers. Magic Glintblade can make this boss laughably easy, as it tends to dodge while the spell is casted, meaning that it does not dodge the projectile itself. MELEE USERS The Assassin can be easily staggered, and the Lone Wolves Ashes can distract her, deal a lot of damage, and leave openings to land some free hits. boss:black-knife-assassin.description: Scions of the Eternal Cities, the Black Knife Assassins were a group of women with close ties to Queen Marika the Eternal. Led by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader, they were coconspirators of Ranni the Witch, who robbed the Rune of Death from Maliketh, the Black Blade. She imbued it into Blades of Calling, fashioning a set of god-slaying Black Knives. The Assassins carried out the Night of Black Knives, carving Cursemarks of Death into Ranni and Godwyn the Golden. They wore silent, silver scale armor and used Concealing Veils to mask their presence, rendering them effectively invisible.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and are known to be unshakable trackers. Without language, they choose their own master whom they will stay loyal to for the rest of their life. They wield a Bloodhound's Fang alongside a Bloodhound Claw that allows them to slip past an enemy's guard. They use the Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step to either move out of harm's way or to close the gap between them and their opponent quickly. Lesser variants can be found as non-respawning enemies guarding corpses in the overworld.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Cleanrot Knight Boss Guide
sections.text: Cleanrot Knight Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Cleanrot Knight: Don't just keep attacking over and over—once it uses Spear Guard, back off or it'll counter-attack. Use Fire Pots. It's very weak to fire and has low health to begin with, so a single pot will do a lot of damage even at low levels Long windups and attack animations leave it very vulnerable to backstabs Melee Users Baiting: Stay close and towards its left to tempt it into using Spear Stab, Impale, or Sacred Phalanx. When it starts winding up one of these slow attacks, circle around behind it and get a backstab critical.

sections.heading: Cleanrot Knight Combat information
sections.text: Health: 1,980 HP Defense: 107 This Cleanrot Knight wields a Cleanrot Spear This variant can buff itself when it lands multiple consequetive hits, increasing its damage for a short while. For example, if a resistance is 100 you must deal 100 points of the given buildup to trigger it.

boss:cleanrot-knight.description: The Cleanrot Knights were fierce warriors who remained devoted to Malenia, Blade of Miquella, even as her scarlet rot consumed their bodies. Their winged helms and sword insignias embodied the unyielding resolve of their Empyrean master. They stood in arms with Miquella's followers within Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: Most of the room is full of poisonous water, so it's advisable to quickly run to the small island of safety just left of the boss, in the middle left to far left section of the room. Since this boss is the spear-wielding variant and this fight will most likely happen early in the game, it's critical to avoid its Scarlet Rot-inducing, charging grab attack (signified by its spear glowing a bright gold). This is most easily accomplished by rolling diagonally forward to reach the other side of the boss. Since the boss is vulnerable to backstabs

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: As the fight starts, only the spear-wielder is present, with the scythe-wielding commander rising from the rot pool to the left within 12 seconds of starting the battle. As such, it is best to spend that opening either summoning a Spirit or rushing down the spear knight to try and at least severely wound it before the scythe knight can join the fray. Of the two combatants, the spear knight is more aggressive and will try to restrict player movement with its Sacred Phalanx and inflict Scarlet Rot with its charge.

sections.heading: Notes

sections.heading: Elden Ring Crucible Knight Ordovis Boss Guide
sections.text: Crucible Knight Ordovis Fight Strategy Melee Users Spearfishing: Focus on killing the Crucible Knight with the spear first, since it has the best reach and is best at covering distance and disrupting your attacks on the other one. Try to draw it away from Ordovis, and keep pillars between you and Ordovis when you're attacking the spear knight. Don't get greedy: if you get in more than a hit or two at a time, Ordovis will catch up to you and make you regret it.

sections.heading: Crucible Knight Ordovis Notes & Other Trivia
sections.text: Like his counterpart Siluria, Ordovis appears to have been named after an ancient Celtic tribe: the Ordovices, who lived in present-day Wales, and shared a border with the Silures. The ruins of an ancient Thracian fortress named Urdovisa (also Urdoviza) lie near the present-day town of Kiten in Bulgaria. May also be named after the Ordovician Period, a prehistoric epoch of life on Earth, much like the Crucible.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Death Rite Birds are optional recurring bosses in Elden Ring. They only appear at night and are a more powerful version of the deathbirds.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Death Rite Birds are gigantic decaying birds with incrusted corpses over their body, partially covered in ghostflame and guarded by the spirits of the servants of death inside their wings. All Deathbirds are said to be the offspring of an entity called the twinbird, which is an envoy of an outer god. Their purpose was to tend the ghostflame by raking out the ashen remains of the death from their kiln. Because of this, they were called graveyard fire keepers and used to be widely active before the Erdtree existed, although regarded as malevolent deities by some.

sections.heading: Combat Overview
sections.text: The Death Rite Bird often spawns from a giant ball of Ghostflame up in the sky. It is possible to lock onto either the boss's head or the spine. It takes extra damage when hit in the head, but due to how much it moves, it can disorienting and result in getting dead-angled when blocking, so it's usually safer to lock into the spine or not at all. While it is possible to fight this boss on horseback, it is not recommended. The safest place to be in melee range is behind its legs, where neither the weapon swings, nor the beak can hit you.

sections.text: The Deathbird is a recurring boss in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: All Deathbirds are said to be the offspring of an entity called the twinbird, which is an envoy of an outer god of Death. In the time when there was no Erdtree, Death was burned in ghostflame, and the Deathbirds were the keepers of that fire. They were graveyard fire keepers and were said to rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kiln. From the cinders of the dead burned with ghostflame arose vengeful spirits. The Deathbirds were regarded as malevolent deities by some.

Ash of War: Sacred Blade and Holy Water Pots are valuable tools to make short work of these enemies, even if the user doesn't have a lot of Faith.

sections.text: Dragonkin Soldier Boss Video Guide https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sxEAktrJFV4 Dragonkin Soldier Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Dragonkin Soldier: At the start of the fight, the boss is slow to get up, which can allow one to get multiple hard hits in. sections.heading: Dragonkin Soldier Location
sections.text: Head south from the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace to a collapsed pillar with an Ancestral Follower archer perched on it. Follower the pillar up to its base, where you'll see the Siofra River East waygate. Map Link This waygate will transport you to the plateau in the center of Siofra River. When you arrive, head northwest to the open plain of shallow water, where you'll find the Dragonkin Soldier collapsed in a heap. As you approach, it will rise up and the fight will begin. Map Link You can also reach this boss from the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace by carefully dropping down from above.

sections.text: Dragonkin Soldier is a reoccurring boss in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Draconic beings born from Gravel Stone in the Eternal City, Dragonkin Soldiers never knew true sky or true lightning, and so they wielded ice lightning as their weapon. They never achieved immortality, and perished as decrepit imitations of true Ancient Dragons. They have humanoid bodies, with lanky arms and legs, and their chests have large, gaping cavities. They wear minimal armour, and red-and-black capes with golden embroidery. Spectral Dragonkin Soldiers appear in the Consecrated Snowfield. They will disappear if the player gets too far away, and spawn continuously.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Elder Dragon Greyoll is an unmarked boss in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Greyoll is revered as the mother of many lesser dragons. She appears as a colossal, immobile dragon in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, just south of Fort Faroth. Her body is bent with age, her scales are grey, and silver hairs grow from her jaw like a wizened beard. Though incapable of movement, she lets loose fearsome roars that damage nearby foes. Greyoll depends on her brood for protection and will perish if they are slain.

sections.heading: Locations
sections.text: - Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, just south of Fort Faroth.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - While the intended method of defeating her is by killing the surrounding lesser dragons, killing Greyoll herself directly through another method, such as Blood Loss, will also kill these smaller dragons. - This method will grant all 67,350 Runes at once, making this an excellent place to use a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot for more Runes early on. - Defeating Elder Dragon Greyoll unlocks Greyoll's Roar, which can be obtained at the altar in the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for three Dragon Hearts.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Elemer of the Briar Location
sections.text: Elemer of the Briar is at the very top of The Shaded Castle in Altus Plateau. From the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace, head north along the passage, turn west at the fork, and climb the ladder to a balcony with two Rotten Strays. Head east through the building, across the bridge, and into the next building. Climb the stairs and head south into another courtyard. Go into the door that a Cleanrot Knight emerges from, ride the elevator up, and head straight forward to find Elemer of the Briar.

If you hit a Watchdog with several Crystal Darts, it will go berserk and attack the closest thing, whether it be friend or foe. Use ashes that deal elemental damage, like the Twinsage Sorcerer or Latenna. Use Hoarfrost Stomp as an easy source of magic damage. sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Fallingstar Beasts are creatures formed of shiny black rock. They have spiky tails, patches of white fur, and insect-like mandibles. They are found in craters, likely indicating that they plummeted onto the Lands Between from a great distance. The more mature Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast have greater magical abilities, able to control gravity in their vicinity and unleash great magical beams akin to Comet Azur. They can use Gravity-based abilities, much like other enemies associated with meteors and fallen stars such as Alabaster Lords, Onyx Lords, and Withered Astel.

boss:gideon.name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing

stats.Status resist: Poison 100 · Scarlet Rot 100 · Bleed 100 · Sleep 999 · Madness 0 · Curse 999

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gideon Ofnir is the Tarnished leader of Roundtable Hold and the adoptive father of Nepheli Loux. Called to the Lands Between by the guidance of Grace, Gideon wishes to become Elden Lord. To this end he accumulates information on the Shardbearers, employing a network of spies to aid in his hunt for knowledge. Initially, he is apprehensive of the Tarnished, but after they have claimed a Great Rune he becomes willing to share his knowledge of the remaining shardbearers.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The Omenkiller in the Village of the Albinaurics is implied by Nepheli to be one of Gideon's agents. Due to the connection between Omenkillers and perfumers, the Depraved Perfumer in the village may be working with the Omenkiller. - Recusant Henricus, an invader in Limgrave, wears the Eye Surcoat which is said to be worn by Gideon's "eyes and ears". The Eye Surcoat can be looted from a corpse in Rykard's boss arena, indicating another agent of Gideon.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing Boss Guide
sections.text: Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing: Use the Eternal Darkness spell to redirect nearly all his spells Use the Inescapable Frenzy spell to deal major damage during his monologue. Alternatively, Frenzied Burst can prove useful due to long range. Recommended weapon: Erdtree Greatshield Use Spirit Ashes that can quickly close the distance and harass Gideon such as Black Knife Tiche. Use heavy jump attacks to disrupt Gideon's more powerful spells as he channels them.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* If you visit Roundtable Hold before defeating a shardbearer, Gideon can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold. After exhausting his dialogue he will move to his study.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After defeating a shardbearer and speaking to Finger Reader Enia, Gideon will welcome you as a member of Roundtable Hold, and will offer you information on Godrick the Grafted, Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, Starscourge Radahn, Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, and Morgott, the Omen King. He can also discuss Nepheli Loux if you have spoken to her.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* If you obtain either half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, Ensha will ambush you the next time you return to Roundtable Hold. After defeating him, speak to Gideon to learn the location of the other half. *(Optional)* If you have obtained Seluvis's Potion, you may give it to Gideon to dispose of it. This will remove it from your inventory, preventing you from obtaining Nepheli Loux Puppet or Dung Eater Puppet.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Resting at any Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital will cause Gideon to receive new dialogue about the unlocated Demigods.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Gideon will now offer rewards in exchange for meeting certain requirements: Black Flame's Protection: activate a Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree. Lord's Divine Fortification: defeat Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Fevor's Cookbook 3: activate a Site of Grace in Mohgwyn Palace. Law of Causality: defeat Mohg, Lord of Blood.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
questSteps.text: Gideon will be present in the Erdtree Sanctuary as a boss encounter after you have defeated Maliketh, the Black Blade. Any previous parts of his questline will now be locked, however the rewards from the previous step can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Hoarah Loux, Warrior, also known as Godfrey, First Elden Lord and the Lord of the Battlefield, is a mandatory boss in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Godfrey is a former consort of Queen Marika the Eternal and the first Elden Lord of the Golden Order. Although his actions directly shaped much of the history of the Lands Between, Queen Marika stole his grace and banished him to the badlands. Both encounters with Godfrey are mandatory boss fights: 1. The first encounter, Godfrey, First Elden Lord, is a golden phantom from the past that ambushes the player at Leyndell, Royal Capital. Defeating this Great Enemy boss unlocks the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace and grants a Talisman Pouch and access to Marika's Bedchamber. 1.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Defeating the golden Godfrey, First Elden Lord at Leyndell, Royal Capital for the first time unlocks the "Godfrey, First Elden Lord" achievement. - Defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior at Leyndell, Ashen Capital for the first time unlocks the "Hoarah Loux, Warrior" achievement. - Godfrey wears the Elden Lord Set (Elden Lord Crown, Elden Lord Armor, Elden Lord Bracers, Elden Lord Greaves). - Godfrey's lordly posture is maintained by Serosh, whose teeth sink into his left shoulder for the fight. These actions help suppress Godfrey's bloodlust.

sections.heading: Acquisition

sections.text: Godfrey, First Elden Lord (Golden Shade) Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Godfrey, First Elden Lord (Golden Shade): Use any durable spirit that will distract the boss The fight can begin with the boss lunging towards the player, so it is best not to summon immediately upon entering the boss room. Using lightning spells / incantations or a weapon enchanted with a lightning Ash of War ( Lightning Slash, Lightning Ram, or Thunderbolt ) will allow you to deal more damage. The boss has a deceptively large range, frequently swinging with his axe fully extended.

sections.text: Godskin Apostle Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Godskin Apostle: Use sleep pots with a strong spirit summon such as Lhutel the Headless +4 to bait the Apostle to provide an opening for the pot to land. If the pot is a direct hit and he stays in the cloud, 1 pot will put him to sleep. If he exits the cloud, a second pot will put him to sleep (doesn't work with online players summoned). sections.text: Grafted Scion Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Grafted Scion: Avoid guarding as much as possible, focus on rolling instead. Use quick to cast spells like Glintstone Pebble. Vagabound and Samurai classes are the best to kill him during 1st encounter due to their stance-breaking skills. Don't get greedy: it will often use Scream after being damaged, and you don't want to be nearby for that.

sections.text: Grave Warden Duelists, Frenzied Duelists, and Putrid Grave Warden Duelists are recurring enemies and bosses in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Duelists are muscular warriors lightly accoutered in bronze armor adorned with serpent effigies, which represent a traitor to the Erdtree. Whether armed with a Duelist Greataxe and iron ball or twin Battle Hammers, they are unrelenting fighters blessed with boundless stamina. During the time of Lord Godfrey, these champions honored the Erdtree by participating in gladiatorial combat at colosseums. Their excited spectators were delighted to see the serpents on their armor get battered and broken. However, the gladiators were banished when the colosseums closed during the age of Lord Radagon.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Duelists wear armor corroded with Verdigris, an element associated with Outer Gods. The armor worn by Putrid Duelists has advanced, and festers with scarlet rot.

sections.text: Guardian Golem Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Guardian Golem: Stay just behind its legs. Most of its attacks aim forward or just in front of its feet. Melee Users Charge and Crit: Two charged heavy attacks from most weapons are enough to stagger Guardian Golem. Once it falls to the ground, you have a chance a chance for a critical hit on its chest which will do a massive amount of damage. stats.Status resist: Poison 112 · Scarlet Rot 112 · Bleed 84 · Sleep 154 · Madness 999 · Curse 999

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Mad Pumpkin Head is an enemy in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gigantic humanoids with brawny physiques, known for their distinct oval helmets. They are former gladiators, broken and driven mad. Their helmets are pitch black inside, intended to keep the warriors from panicking, and to alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia. They typically wield hammers with crude, stone heads, or spiky Chainlink Flails. Sometimes they can be seen carrying standards, which they will drive into the ground or throw at foes when initiating combat. Their heads heavily reduce the damage of any attack that hits it. Flail=

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text: The room isn't very big but the boss also isn't that quick or good at turning. If you are about to be boxed into a corner, try to run around it to recover or to hit it from behind so that the head's heavy damage reduction isn't applied. Astrologers will most likely want to be extra careful since their FP and its recovery will most likely be very low by this point, as will the variety in Sorceries.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text: The left Pumpkin Head will be sitting with its back as you enter, so make sure to attack it quickly to try and reduce this 1v2 to a 1v1. It's possible to use Torrent in this fight, though it's unlikely to be useful due to how small the room is. |-|

The second is found in the Dragon's Pit minor dungeon in Gravesite Plain, found by progressing normally through the dungeon, and going up the stairs through a cave opening.

boss:magma-wyrm-makar.description: Magma Wyrms are quadrupedal draconic beings with torn, vestigial wings and broad heads. They were once human heroes who partook in Dragon Communion, for which they were cursed to crawl the earth as flightless imitations of Dragons, losing their humanity in the process. They wield scaly greatswords that resemble the jawbones of dragons, and can spew magma from their mouths.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Silver Tears are formless, arcane creatures of mimicry that can reshape and harden their liquid metal bodies at will, becoming weapons and even other living organisms. The Nox of the Eternal Cities sought to forge a Lord, and thus the Mimic Tear was born. It immediately assumes the form of the player as they enter the room, complete with their equipped weapons, armor, and spells. Its Stats and Attributes, such as HP, shall also reflect the player's.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Moonrithyll, Carian Knight is a hostile character in Shadow of the Erdtree. She is an unmarked optional boss encountered in Castle Ensis.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Moonrithyll was one of the enchanted Carian Knights who serve the Carian Royal Family, annointed by the Lunar Queen. As her chamberlain, she followed Rellana, Twin Moon Knight into the Realm of Shadow at the start of Messmer's Crusade against the Hornsent. She was charged with managing Rellana's estate at Castle Ensis. Like her comrades, she has been trapped here since before the Shattering by the treacherous Queen Marika the Eternal. Moonrithyll wields her favored Moonrithyll's Knight Sword, a greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. She is unwavering, protected by her Carian Knight Armor.

sections.heading: Location

questSteps.title: Meet Leda at the Three-Path Cross
questSteps.text: Gravesite Plain. Leda, Hornsent and Freyja wait at the first Miquella’s Cross; Thiollier is nearby.

questSteps.title: Clear Castle Ensis and meet them at the Highroad Cross
questSteps.text: The next Miquella’s Cross sits past Rellana. Freyja and Thiollier have their own words there.

questSteps.title: Enter the Shadow Keep and free Ansbach
questSteps.text: The Specimen Storehouse holds Sir Ansbach. He once served Mohg and knows Miquella’s charm.

questSteps.title: Clear the Shadow Keep invitations
questSteps.text: Leda offers an invitation on the storehouse floor. Which allies you keep decides the Enir-Ilim assault.

questSteps.title: Defeat Messmer the Impaler
questSteps.text: The Shadow Keep’s lord. His flame is the key to burning the Sealing Tree.

questSteps.title: Burn the Sealing Tree
questSteps.text: The last window. Crossing it locks every unfinished Keep invitation and freezes the alliance choices.

questSteps.title: Side with your allies at Enir-Ilim
questSteps.text: Defeat both Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood. Then rest on the nearest Site of Grace. Leda will appear in front of Miquella's cocoon at Mohgywn Dynasty Mausoleum and urge to interact with it.

questSteps.title: Promised Consort Radahn
questSteps.text: Miquella’s consort at the top of Enir-Ilim. Bring the allies you kept.

sections.heading: Night's Cavalry Combat information
sections.text: Stance: 80 Stance damage reduction: 80% Stance cannot be broken while on horseback Is vulnerable to a critical hit after being stance broken or knocked out of horse The horse and rider have separate health bars, and only the rider needs to be killed to end the fight. Killing the horse causes the rider to fall to the ground and become vulnerable to a dismount critical. After some time, the rider will resummon the horse with its Remount attack. It's much more likely to remount quickly if you move far away from it, so stay close to maximize the amount of time it's in a weakened state.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Night's Cavalry Boss Guide
sections.text: Night's Cavalry Boss Video Guide Night's Cavalry Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Night's Cavalry: Use Lightning Spear to whittle down its health from afar Use Glintstone Arc to hit both the horse and its rider at once Use a weapon with long reach that deals Pierce Damage, such as a Spear or Halberd Knights met at Dragonbarrow and Forbidden Lands can be - with precise maneuvering - tricked into falling from the cliff. Melee Users Fighting on foot is recommended. They're fast enough to match your pace on Torrent, and the extra maneuverability and ability to dodge on foot will help a lot.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk Location
sections.text: In the very northwest of Sellia, Town of Sorcery in eastern Caelid. Their chamber is initially sealed with a barrier which can be dispelled by jumping across rooftops to light a brazier in northwest Sellia. Map Link From the golden tree just south of the Sellia Backstreets Site of Grace Map Link, face the southern edge of the platform and drop down onto the root below. Follow the root and jump onto the building on your right using the mutated growth as a stepping stone. There should be another ladder here that leads to the brazier that will remove the barrier.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk Boss Guide
sections.text: Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk: Use the Glintstone Arc Spell Melee Strategy Avoid attacking one of the bosses while the other is nearby, as they both have very long range. Separate the bosses with ranged attacks – they are likely to dodge away, so if you attack them while they are close together, they may dodge in separate directions. Both stagger quite easily and will dodge right after. Heavy attacks are a good idea to do maximum damage in the short window available.

sections.heading: Summary

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Omenkillers are stoic court Perfumers who continue the grisly work of Rollo, a famed chemist of antiquity, who slaughtered accursed Omen with brutal efficiency after imbibing a physick that stripped him of emotion. They wear thick yellow aprons with front pouches and green masks with twisted horns, carved to resemble the malevolent, smirking elder spirits that torment Omen in their nightmares. Their accessories include red cloth collars, golden chainlink necklaces, and brooches with overlapping rings that likely portray the Elden Ring.

sections.text: - At least one Omenkiller worked for Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Mad Pumpkin Head is an enemy in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Gigantic humanoids with brawny physiques, known for their distinct oval helmets. They are former gladiators, broken and driven mad. Their helmets are pitch black inside, intended to keep the warriors from panicking, and to alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia. They typically wield hammers with crude, stone heads, or spiky Chainlink Flails. Sometimes they can be seen carrying standards, which they will drive into the ground or throw at foes when initiating combat. Their heads heavily reduce the damage of any attack that hits it. Flail=

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text: The room isn't very big but the boss also isn't that quick or good at turning. If you are about to be boxed into a corner, try to run around it to recover or to hit it from behind so that the head's heavy damage reduction isn't applied. Astrologers will most likely want to be extra careful since their FP and its recovery will most likely be very low by this point, as will the variety in Sorceries.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text: The left Pumpkin Head will be sitting with its back as you enter, so make sure to attack it quickly to try and reduce this 1v2 to a 1v1. It's possible to use Torrent in this fight, though it's unlikely to be useful due to how small the room is. |-|

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Duelists are muscular warriors lightly accoutered in bronze armor adorned with serpent effigies, which represent a traitor to the Erdtree. Whether armed with a Duelist Greataxe and iron ball or twin Battle Hammers, they are unrelenting fighters blessed with boundless stamina. Their excited spectators were delighted to see the serpents on their armor get battered and broken. However, the gladiators were banished when the colosseums closed during the age of Lord Radagon.

sections.heading: Starscourge Radahn Notes & Trivia
sections.text: Upon release, Radahn's boss fight was substantially critized by fans, who took issue with his huge hitboxes, high damage, and the speed of his moveset; many deemed Radahn as an unfair boss. As a result Radahn was nerfed in Patch 1.03, with his hitboxes corrected but also lowering his damage. The nerf was partially reversed in Patch 1.03.03, with the damage restored but his hitboxes remaining corrected. His military rank is "General". According to the game files, his horse's name is Leonard.

sections.text: From the beginning of Gelmir Hero's Grave, head down the first chariot hall and fall of the ledge after passing a Skeletal Archer to your right. Keep to the corner as you're falling to land safely on a wooden plank, then wait for the chariot to pass beneath you and drop down on top of it. Ride it to the bottom of the lava-filled pathway, then jump off and duck into the alcove to the north that contains a dead body with an item. Climb the ladder in this alcove, then head north to the fog gate leading to the Red Wolf of the Champion. Map Link

sections.heading: Crucible Knight Siluria Notes & Other Trivia
sections.text: Siluria seems to have been named after the Silures, an ancient Celcic tribe that lived in present-day Wales. The Silures lived south of the Ordovices, which in turn may have inspired the name of Siluria's counterpart Ordovis. Her name also may reference the Silurian Period, a prehistoic epoch of life that occurred after the end of the Ordovician, much like the Crucible.

sections.heading: Stonedigger Troll Boss Guide for Elden Ring
sections.text: Stonedigger Troll Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Stonedigger Troll: Use the Kaiden Sellsword Ashes for an easier fight or Spirit Jellyfish Ashes as a distraction. The Troll is extremely weak to Sleep. A single Sleep Pot will put it to sleep no matter how low your Arcane or how many times it's already slept. Melee Strategy The Troll has high Hardness, so most one-handed melee attacks will rebound off it preventing you from landing chain attacks. You can prevent this by two-handing your weapon or using a weapon with higher Hardness.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Tibia Mariner Boss Guide
sections.text: Tibia Mariner Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Tibia Mariner: Stay on Torrent throughout the battle to more easily follow the Tibia Mariner when it teleports. Use a spirit ash that can help you distract the Skeletons, like the Lone Wolf Ashes. Melee Users Yee Haw: Stay mounted on Torrent, run in for a few hits, then run away again. The Skeletons are slow enough that you won't need to worry about them, and the Tibia Mariner's attacks are slow enough that you probably won't get hit often.

sections.heading: Tree Sentinel Boss Guide for Elden Ring
sections.text: Video Guide for Tree Sentinel Boss Tree Sentinel Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Tree Sentinel: Fighting on horseback is a great option for extra mobility and ease of escaping the Sentinel's combos. sections.text: Ulcerated Tree Spirit DLC Boss Video Guide Ulcerated Tree Spirit Fight Strategy Melee Users "Don't Panic" is the motto of the Ulcerated Tree Spirit fight. They slam their claws and tails in combat and can generate searing golden fire. Commonly found near the Erdtree and its roots, they usually drop Golden Seeds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The Ulcerated Tree Spirit encountered in the sewage pond in Belurat, Tower Settlement appears green because its body is coated in poisonous liquid. It is not a unique variant beyond its immunity to Poison effects. - Ulcerated Tree Spirits are not mentioned by any character or item description.

sections.heading: Valiant Gargoyle Combat information
sections.text: Stance: 110 Parryable: No Is vulnerable to a critical hit after being stance broken Damage: Standard (Halberd), Standard, Slash, Holy (Greatsword), Standard, Pierce (Twinblade) Weak spot: head Negations (or Absorptions) Standard: 10 Slash: 35 Strike: 0 Pierce: 35 Magic: 20 Fire: 40 Lightning: 40 Holy: 40 The negation numbers are the % of your damage that gets blocked. For example, if a negation is 60, 40% of that damage by that type will go through and 60% will be negated. Bigger number = less damage.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Valiant Gargoyle Boss Guide
sections.text: Valiant Gargoyle Boss Video Guide Valiant Gargoyle Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Valiant Gargoyle: Use the Spirit Jellyfish, Ancestral Follower, or any other ashes able to draw aggression away from you. Use Pest Threads, as their large size means they can be hit multiple times for larger damage. Lightning Spear or Great Glintstone Shard are other ranged alternatives. Use Incantation Flame, Cleanse Me or Cure Poison to cure yourself of poison buildup. Melee users: Dodge roll to directly underneath/behind the gargoyle where it's attacks more seldom connect.

sections.heading: Valiant Gargoyles Location
sections.text: From the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace off the Hallowhorn Grounds, head east through a tunnel and along the ridge, then jump down onto the buttress just below the edge. Walk along the buttress until you hit a wall, then jump down again onto the platform below. Continue northeast up two sets of stairs, then go through the first door on your right and continue north along the waterlogged passageway. Head northeast out to the balcony and up the stairs to the northwest.

build:azur.name: Comet Azur glass
build:azur.description: One-shot setups for dragons and late bosses if you can stand still. Terra Magicus + Graven-Mass + Magic Scorpion.

build:blackflame.name: Black Flame Godslayer
build:blackflame.description: Black Flame burns a percentage of max HP on hit, so it keeps pace with boss health pools where flat-AR incantations fall off. The real faith caster build that is not Blasphemous Blade.

build:blasphemous.name: Blasphemous Blade
build:blasphemous.description: Taker’s Flames heals on every wave. Facetanks most of base game. Falls off vs holy resist in SotE.

build:bloodfiends-arm.name: Bloodfiend's Arm
build:bloodfiends-arm.description: The Bloodfiend’s Arm builds Hemorrhage on a big arcane-scaled strike, so each opening both procs bleed and heals you back.

build:bolt-gransax.name: Bolt of Gransax sniper
build:bolt-gransax.description: Ancient Lightning Spear is a long-range nuke with a charged window, so Godfrey Icon and Shard of Alexander both apply. Pair it with a Lightning Nagakiba for the melee.

build:dark-moon.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
build:dark-moon.description: The Moonlight Greatsword beam on the charged heavy is ranged frost damage; Godfrey Icon, Magic Scorpion and Shard of Alexander all stack it. Frostbite then a heavy trade.

build:deaths-poker.name: Death's Poker frost
build:deaths-poker.description: Ghostflame Ignition leaves a patch that keeps ticking, and the charged R2 beam is a safe ranged punish on anything that respects frost.

build:dragon-communion.name: Dragon Communion
build:dragon-communion.location: Dragon Communion Seal scales off Arcane, so one stat feeds every breath. Dragonmaw deletes anything that lets you stand still; Rotten Breath rots the rest. SotE-friendly.
build:dragon-communion.description: In the distant past, the lord of the ancient dragons, Placidusax, was attacked by the great drake, Bayle the Dread.

build:eleonora.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
build:eleonora.description: Bloodblade Dance chains fast Hemorrhage on a dex-arcane twinblade, and the two Winged Insignia talismans ramp the damage as the combo lands.

build:frost-bleed.name: Frost-bleed twinblade
build:frost-bleed.description: Twinblade jump L1s build bleed and frost at once; Rotten Winged Sword Insignia and Millicent’s Prosthesis ramp attack power as the chain lands. A dex status build that is not Rivers of Blood.

build:giant-crusher-jump.name: Giant-Crusher jump attack
build:giant-crusher-jump.description: A jump attack from a colossal greathammer does huge stance damage, and Claw plus Axe Talisman both reward the same jumping R2.

build:great-stars-crag.name: Great Stars Cragblade
build:great-stars-crag.description: Cragblade adds stamina damage against guards and poise damage in the open, which a heavy Great Stars turns into constant staggers.

build:greatshield-poke.name: Fingerprint poke
build:greatshield-poke.description: Block with the highest-stability greatshield in the game and poke with a thrusting sword. Safe, boring, and one of the strongest PvE setups there is. Antspur adds Scarlet Rot through the shield.

build:greatsword-lions-claw.name: Greatsword Lion’s Claw
build:greatsword-lions-claw.description: Lion’s Claw is unparryable, has hyper armour, and does real stance damage — on a colossal sword it breaks most bosses in two casts. Pure Strength, no casting stat tax.

build:heavy-bonk.name: Heavy Knight bonk
build:heavy-bonk.description: The pack’s Heavy Knight already has the poise. Giant-Crusher or Anvil Hammer, lion’s claw / cragblade.

build:helphens.name: Helphen's Steeple
build:helphens.description: Helphen’s Steeple buffs itself with ghostflame on the skill, so a strength-int spread gets frostbite pressure and a real melee threat on one weapon.

build:leontiel.name: Leontiel matador
build:leontiel.description: Pack invader weapon. Reach + stance. Pairs with Heavy Knight or a dex hybrid after Radahn.

build:marais.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
build:marais.description: Eochaid’s Dancing Blade spins the sword into a buzzsaw that scales off Arcane, so the arcane-bleed talisman stack lifts the whole skill.

build:meteoric-ore.name: Meteoric Ore arcane
build:meteoric-ore.description: The Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword scales off Arcane as well as Strength, so one spread feeds both the weapon and a bleed-heavy talisman set.

build:mimic-status.name: Mimic Tear bleed
build:mimic-status.description: The Mimic copies your bleed kit and doubles the Hemorrhage pressure, so the fight ends before either of you runs out of flasks.

build:moonveil.name: Moonveil Shinobi
build:moonveil.description: Transient Moonlight is a fast ranged slash that staggers at range. Powerstance with a Cold Uchigatana to stack Hemorrhage and Frostbite off the same L1 chain.

build:night-comet.name: Night Comet Sellia
related: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
build:night-comet.description: Enemies barely dodge it. Staff of Loss in offhand. Best “I hate lock-on” sorcery.

build:pest-threads-plus.name: Pest-Thread Spears faith
build:pest-threads-plus.description: Pest-Thread Spears hits many times through a big body, and the Dragon Communion Seal turns Arcane into incantation scaling on the same spread.

build:ripple-arc.name: Ripple arcane
build:ripple-arc.description: The Ripple Crescent Halberd scales purely on Arcane, so the whole stat line goes into bleed buildup and Lord of Blood’s Exultation uptime.

build:rivers.name: Rivers of Blood
build:rivers.description: Still deletes most of the Lands Between. Weak to high bleed resist (Malenia is the joke).

build:starscourge.name: Starscourge pull
build:starscourge.description: Starcaller Cry pulls a whole pack into one swing, so the Starscourge Greatsword clears groups and stance-breaks single targets at the same time.

build:sword-night-flame.name: Sword of Night and Flame
build:sword-night-flame.description: Night and Flame stance still gives a ranged magic beam and a close flame sweep, so one weapon covers both ranges without a second catalyst.

build:wing-of-astel.name: Wing of Astel
build:wing-of-astel.description: Nebula is a free ranged burst on a light curved sword, and the weapon still keeps normal dex scaling for the melee you actually land.

dungeon:giant-conquering-hero-s-grave.description: A complex dungeon filled with invulnerable enemies and strange golden floor seals.

dungeon:giants-mountaintop-catacombs.description: A vast, labyrinthine grave in the southern Mountaintops of the Giants, south of the narrow bridge leading to the northern area of the region.

dungeon:hidden-path-to-the-haligtree.description: The secret passage leading to Miquella's Haligtree has been polluted by Those Who Live in Dead

dungeon:highroad-cave.description: A cave that houses a tomb, deep within. It is situated at the northmost part of Limgrave. It has been inhabited by a pack of Wolves, Land Octopuses, and Giant Bats

dungeon:impaler-s-catacombs.description: The Impaler's Catacombs are found in the east side of the Weeping Peninsula. Once used to store the bodies of the dead, it is now crawling with Imps.

dungeon:kingsrealm-ruins.description: A ruined area, only seemingly bare.

dungeon:lamenter-s-gaol.description: The Lamenter's Gaol is a cold, underground gaol that contains a truth hidden by the hornsent.

dungeon:lord-contender-s-evergaol.description: An Evergaol south of the frozen lake in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

enemy:sentry-stone.name: Sentry Stone
enemy:sentry-stone.description:
Sentry Stone are enemies in Elden Ring and Shadow of the Erdtree. ==Overview== 
The stone sentries are bizarre, ominous creatures made from living rock. Their cylindrical, tube-like bodies are long chains of rounded stones bound together by gravitational energy. A crater in the topmost rock bears a single eye. They enjoy crawling around like earthworms, and are typically passive. At night, their eyes beam bright purple light as they keep active watch over the Evergaols in silence.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Abductor Virgins Location
sections.text: The Abductor Virgins guard a passageway between Volcano Manor and Altus Plateau. From the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Site of Grace, jump along the pillars to the south and enter a cave. At the end of the cave, the floor will give out and drop you to a lower level. Continue southwards and you'll reach the boss door for the Abductor Virgins. Map Link There are two ways to reach the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Site of Grace: From Raya Lucaria Academy From the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace in Raya Lucaria Academy, head west out the door and around the corner.

sections.heading: Abductor Virgin Combat information
sections.text: Health: 3,811 HP each Defense: 110 Stance: 65 Parryable: No Is vulnerable to a critical hit after being stance broken Damage: Standard Drops 10,000, Inquisitor's Girandole Negations (or Absorptions) Standard: 10 Slash: 10 Strike: 0 Pierce: 10 Magic: 0 Fire: 20 Lightning: -20 Holy: 20 The negation numbers are the % of your damage that gets blocked. For example, if a negation is 60, 40% of that damage by that type will go through and 60% will be negated. Bigger number = less damage.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Abductor Virgins Boss Guide
sections.text: Abductor Virgins Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Abductor Virgins: Use the Lone Wolf Ashes Ash Summons Use items with Lightning Use Glintstone Shard Great / Swift Spell Bring Rune Arc Item Suggested weapons: Dragon Halberd (STR/DEX) Note: It's possible to cheese this boss by standing on an outcropped ledge where the bosses cannot hit you. Takes extra stance damage from lightning damage. 5 casts of Thunderboltare sufficient to stance break them, but repeated casts are unlikely to hit the innards as the head usually blocks the innards from the thunderbolt.

sections.text: Abductor Virgins, also known as Iron Virgins, are Bosses and Enemies in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Adan, Thief of Fire Location
sections.text: Adan, Thief of Fire is imprisoned within the Malefactor's Evergaol in southern Liurnia of the Lakes, at the peak of a cliff. From the Scenic Isle Site of Grace, head southwest onto the land and then follow the path east up the cliff until you reach the evergaol. Map Link

sections.heading: Adan, Thief of Fire Combat information
sections.text: Health: 3,758 HP Poise: 86 Flask charges: 1 Parryable: No Is vulnerable to a backstab critical Damage: Strike, Fire Weapons: Flail with Wild Strikes (right), Giant's Seal with No Skill (left) Armor: Fire Monk Hood, Fire Prelate Armor (Altered), Fire Prelate Gauntlets, Fire Prelate Greaves Spells: O, Flame!, Flame of the Fell God Drops 3,800, Flame of the Fell God Defenses Physical: 92 Magic: 91 Fire: 103 Lightning: 87 Holy: 93 The defense numbers are compared to the incoming attack power to determine how much to scale down the damage.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Adan, Thief of Fire Boss Guide
sections.text: Adan, Thief of Fire Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Adan, Thief of Fire Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Adan, Thief of Fire: Magic Glintblade can be used to bait out his rolls, but otherwise any spell can work against him. Equip the Flamedrake Talisman found in the Groveside Cave to reduce Fire Damage taken. Melee Users The biggest challenge for melee players is keeping out of range of Adan's fire spells. Always watch out for the telegraphs. Each fire spell he uses flashes a red circular rune briefly before they are cast, signaling when you should dodge away.

sections.heading: Summary

sections.text: The Azula beastmen are anthropomorphic, bestial creatures who reside in Crumbling Farum Azula. They fight using heavy, curved weapons forged from dull iron, and some use shields made from earthenware jars, which are created to make shields. sections.text: The Dancer of Ranah is found in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum on the Cerulean Coast, situated on an island in the sea. You can also summon Spirit Ashes like Black Knife Tiche.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Ghostflame Dragons are optional bosses in Shadow of the Erdtree. They are weak to both Holy damage and anti-dragon effects.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Ghostflame Dragons are undead drakes with the innate ability to wield Ghostflame, a trait they share with the Deathbirds. Their skeletal frames are cloaked in tattered funerary cloth, their wings sparsely feathered, and scraps of decaying flesh cling loosely to their bones. These dragons are the remains of fallen drakes that drifted into the Realm of Shadow. They possessed such vivacity that they could not fully die, becoming Those Who Live in Death.

sections.heading: Locations
sections.text: There are three Ghostflame Dragons in the Realm of Shadow: - Gravesite Plain - Location: Near the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace. - Details: Found asleep in the center of a swamp upon first encounter. During phase 2, it gains the ability to summon Skeletons to assist it in battle. - Scadu Altus - Location: In a clearing near the Moorth Highway Site of Grace. - Details: This Ghostflame Dragon is engaged in a skirmish with a battalion of Messmer Soldiers, Messmer Foot Soldiers, and Black Knights. - Cerulean Coast - Location: South of the Cerulean Coast Site of Grace.

sections.heading: Drops
sections.text: All Ghostflame Dragons drop a Dragon Heart and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

sections.text: From the Darklight Catacombs Site of Grace, continue straight into the dark tunnels and take the first right turn down the stairs. hunt:patches.name: Patches

stats.Status resist: Poison 100 · Scarlet Rot 100 · Bleed 100 · Sleep 999 · Madness 0 · Curse 999

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Patches is an NPC and boss in Elden Ring. He surrenders if you reduce his HP to 50% or less. From then on, he acts as a merchant and gives helpful advice to players.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Patches is a Tarnished who leads a group of bandits, operating out of Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. He is a nomadic and free-spirited individual with a proclivity for tricking people and robbing them of their possessions. If the Tarnished opens the treasure chest in Murkwater Cave, Patches accosts them with accusations of theft. After a brief fight, Patches surrenders and offers his services as a merchant. He reveals that the bandits he leads are former foot soldiers from a defeated army. Later, Patches moves to Liurnia of the Lakes, setting up camp on the Scenic Isle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Patches is a reoccurring character in From Software's games, having appeared in *Armored Core: For Answer*, *Demon's Souls*, *Dark Souls*, *Bloodborne*, and *Dark Souls III*. Many of his recognisable traits, such as his physical appearance, use of a spear, and proclivity for tricking the player have been retained for his appearance in *Elden Ring*. - Patches can be summoned during the boss fight against Starscourge Radahn, however he will return to his world after a few seconds.

sections.heading: Questline (9 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Murkwater Cave] Survive Patches’s ambush in Murkwater Cave 2. [Volcano Manor] Forgive Patches and open his shop 3. Find Patches again at Volcano Manor 4. Finish the Volcano Manor contracts 5. [Shaded Castle] Find Patches wounded at the Shaded Castle 6. Take Patches’s Dancer’s Castanets 7. [*(Optional)* Liurnia of the Lakes] Patches — *(Optional)* Liurnia of the Lakes 8. [*(Optional)* Mt. Gelmir] Patches — *(Optional)* Mt. Gelmir 9. [Murkwater Cave] Patches — Murkwater Cave

hunt:patches.strategy: - Patches is a reoccurring character in From Software's games, having appeared in *Armored Core: For Answer*, *Demon's Souls*, *Dark Souls*, *Bloodborne*, and *Dark Souls III*. Many of his recognisable traits, such as his physical appearance, use of a spear, and proclivity for tricking the player have been retained for his appearance in *Elden Ring*. - Patches can be summoned during the boss fight against Starscourge Radahn, however he will return to his world after a few seconds.

questSteps.title: Survive Patches’s ambush in Murkwater Cave
questSteps.text: Pass through the golden fog into the boss room and loot the Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers from the treasure chest to trigger Patches to jump down from above. After reducing his health to 50%, he will stop attacking and grant the Grovel for Mercy gesture. He will now become available as a merchant after reloading the area. Continuing to attack him will cause him to become hostile again. If he gets your health low enough, he will grant the Extreme Repentance gesture. Using this will cause him to stop attacking again. *(Optional)* There will be another chest in his room after returning.

questSteps.title: Forgive Patches and open his shop
questSteps.text: Patches can be found in the entrance corridor after entering Tanith's service. After completing Tanith's first request, Patches will give you a request to kill Great-Horned Tragoth. Tragoth can be found in the Magma Wyrm Makar boss room in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Kill him and then return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue, then rest at a Site of Grace and speak to him again to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue.

questSteps.title: Find Patches again at Volcano Manor
questSteps.text: After you join the manor he relocates there as a vendor.

questSteps.title: Finish the Volcano Manor contracts
questSteps.text: The named contract targets must be done before Rykard; Patches’s own arc needs them complete.

questSteps.title: Find Patches wounded at the Shaded Castle
questSteps.text: Patches can be found in the hallway leading to Elemer of the Briar. Talk to him to receive the Dancer's Castanets. Offer the Dancer's Castanets to Tanith in Rykard's boss room. She will refuse them, however they will be removed from your inventory.

questSteps.title: Take Patches’s Dancer’s Castanets
questSteps.text: He asks you to carry them back to Lady Tanith at the manor.

questSteps.title: Patches — *(Optional)* Liurnia of the Lakes
questSteps.text: Patches can be found near the Scenic Isle Site of Grace. He will discuss Rya and the Abductor Virgin below the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Clearing the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber and returning to Patches will unlock new dialogue, as well as the Calm Down! gesture if not received in the previous step.

questSteps.title: Patches — *(Optional)* Mt. Gelmir
questSteps.text: From the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, go west past the siege tower and then north. Patches will advise you to follow a path of Glowstones leading to a ledge, which Patches will then kick you off.

questSteps.title: Patches — Murkwater Cave
questSteps.text: Return to Murkwater Cave and enter the boss room. Open the chest to trigger another fight with Patches. Attack him once to make him stop attacking, and he will give the Patches' Crouch gesture.

sections.text: Putrid Tree Spirit Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Putrid Tree Spirit: If possible, bring Scarlet Rot Talismans such as Kindred of Rot's Exultation which can increase attack power or Immunizing Horn Charm which raises Immunity Use Meteorite Spell to cause it to stagger Summon Black Knife Tiche Use Bloodhound's Step to help with the boss's quick movements Be ready upon entering the fog gates, as it approaches for an attack almost immediately. If considering Summons, call them after this initial action Use pillars in the arena if available but be wary because they can be destroyed.

sections.heading: Putrid Tree Spirit Location
sections.text: From the War-Dead Catacombs Site of Grace, head down the stairs and straight ahead through the double doors once you've pulled the level to open them. Map Link To open this door, move past the spirits fighting one another and head up the second flight of stairs on the north, jog east, and then head north again through the tunnel past the room with two spirits. Turn east at the corner, run through the next room, then turn south at the next corner. In this room, you'll see a knight sitting at the other end, but instead of running up to it, jump through the window to the west onto a ledge below.

They typically have red fur and golden hair.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: The Dung Eater is an character in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: A self-described "scourge upon the living," the loathesome Dung Eater is a Tarnished who revels in murder and defilement. He places the Seedbed Curse on his victims to sever their souls from the Erdtree and its grace, trapping them in eternal torment. The Dung Eater has the heart of an Omen without the body to match. He wears a malformed set of hefty red armor with tufts of red hair emerging from the bleeding stumps of its severed Omen horns. His helmet has no opening except for a deep gash over the right eye.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Roderika cautions the spiritual harm done by the Dung Eater's Seedbed Curse is worse than Godrick's grafting. - The Dung Eater possesses a fate. - During the intro cinematic, the Dung Eater is hung by an iron chain in a gallows, silhouetted against the bright Erdtree or sun. A faint golden Grace near his chest illuminates the sun medallion, visually linking it to the haloed backdrop. - He was confined to the same prison as nobleborn Omen beneath the streets of Leyndell. Like the Omen, his body also contains cursed spirits.

sections.heading: Questline (11 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Roundtable Hold] Talk to Dung Eater at the Roundtable Hold 2. [Leyndell, Royal Capital (Underground Roadside)] Open his cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds 3. [Leyndell, Royal Capital (Outer Wall Battleground)] Defeat him at the Leyndell moat invasion 4. [Leyndell, Royal Capital (Underground Roadside)] Collect five Seedbed Curses 5. Give him the Seedbed Curses for the Mending Rune 6. Or pour Seluvis’s potion into him 7. [Leyndell, Royal Capital (Forsaken Depth)] Use the Fell Curse rune after the Elden Beast 8.

A faint golden Grace near his chest illuminates the sun medallion, visually linking it to the haloed backdrop. - He was confined to the same prison as nobleborn Omen beneath the streets of Leyndell. Like the Omen, his body also contains cursed spirits.

questSteps.title: Talk to Dung Eater at the Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After touching any Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, the Dung Eater will appear in the western quarter of the Roundtable Hold, past Gideon's study. Talk to him with at least one Seedbed Curse in inventory to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "There's something you should know" to warn you of the danger of the new arrival.

questSteps.title: Open his cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
questSteps.text: (Optional) If you don't intend to follow his questline, you can select Administer Seluvis' Potion to turn the Dung Eater into a puppet. After his screams have ceased, you're free to kill him to collect his loot without failing the Preceptor's questline. After collecting all five Seedbed Curses, return to him and select Use the Seedbed Curse, then collect the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse from his body. Reloading the area, you'll be able to collect the Omen Set too.

questSteps.title: Defeat him at the Leyndell moat invasion
questSteps.text: Visit the moat to the south-east below the capital's ramparts to meet again with Boggart, who now sells an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs too. Talk to him and select About the Dung Eater. Reload the area to find Boggart moribund and, after talking to him, collect Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball, and Blackguard's Iron Mask from his cadaver. Shortly after, the Dung Eater will invade you and, once defeated, will drop his Sword of Milos.

questSteps.title: Collect five Seedbed Curses
questSteps.text: Drop down the open grate to the left exiting the room and follow the path past the Miranda Flowers to reach the Dung Eater's cell, which is guarded by a Large Fingercreeper hidden underground and some smaller ones hanging from the ceiling. Open the cell and talk to him, selecting Leave your gaol!.

questSteps.title: Give him the Seedbed Curses for the Mending Rune
questSteps.text: Hand over five curses and he relents, giving the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.

questSteps.title: Or pour Seluvis’s potion into him
questSteps.text: The puppet fork. It forecloses the Fell Curse rune but yields the Dung Eater puppet.

questSteps.title: Use the Fell Curse rune after the Elden Beast
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* The Dung Eater can now be summoned to aid you against Mohg, the Omen.

questSteps.title: Dung Eater — Liurnia of the Lakes (Laskyar Ruins)
questSteps.text: Head north-west from the Site of Grace to find Rya the Scout inside a gazebo and talk to her. Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select Give me the necklace and then Deal to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. After purchasing the item, he'll start selling an infinite supply of Boiled Prawns.

questSteps.title: Dung Eater — Leyndell, Royal Capital (Queen's Bed Chamber)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Alongside Melina, the Dung Eater can now be summoned to aid you against Morgott, the Omen King.

questSteps.title: Dung Eater — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* The Dung Eater has disappeared from the Hold, leaving behind on his spot a message that reads: "I'll defile you next. Come to the outer moat." *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "About the spirits' voices" to express her relief for the Dung Eater's departure.

questSteps.title: Dung Eater — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: The Dung Eater will have now returned to the Hold. Talking to him, he'll instruct you to defile his corpse with the Seedbed Curse. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "About the spirits' voices".

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: The Revenger was an unseen character in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The nameless revenger was a champion who lived during the Age of the Erdtree, when Godfrey reigned as Elden Lord. After the golden armies of the Erdtree decimated his clan, he vowed vengeance and returned to Castle Morne. There, he collected the swords of his fallen kin and forged them into a single massive blade—the Grafted Blade Greatsword. He challenged Lord Godfrey during the Siege of Castle Morne, but was slain by Queen Marika's Grace-given champion.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The revenger likely belonged to the Stormveil faction that once controlled Limgrave and the Weeping Peninsula. They may be the rebellion-starting laborer-turned-champion whose Brick Hammer is found at Stormveil Castle. They were said to have had the strength of a giant. - Serosh, Lord of Beasts appears on the Grafted Blade Greatsword's hilt. - Castellan Edgar, a Banished Knight in Godrick's service, refuses to abandon Castle Morne until the Grafted Blade Greatsword is reclaimed from the Leonine Misbegotten.

sections.text: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger is an NPC invader in *Elden Ring*.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Hailing from the Land of Reeds, Eleonora is the deadliest Bloody Finger and a partaker of Dragon Communion. She's a proud swordstress who felled many old hands, but now her legacy has been tainted by corrupted blood. Yura has been tracking Eleonora for a long time hoping of cleansing the knight of her cessblood.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Altus Plateau (Altus Highway Junction) Invades inside the Second Church of Marika, north-west of the Site of Grace.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - If the player enters the church before Yura moves inside, instead of Eleonora, they'll find a Sanguine Noble. - If Morgott, the Omen King is defeated before Yura reaches the Second Church of Marika, he'll die leaving behind his Nagakiba at the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace in Limgrave and Shabriri will possess his body, moving at the Zamor Ruins Site of Grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants: at this point, Eleonora will invade regardless, at her usual location.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Ensha of the Royal Remains is an NPC in *Elden Ring*.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Ensha is the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon Ofnir, typically found leaning on the wall outside his master's study in Roundtable Hold. Ensha wears armour graced with golden human bones, which are said to have belonged to a soulless king, the lord of the lost and desperate, known as Ensha. After the Tarnished obtains one half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, Ensha invades them in Roundtable Hold. After killing Ensha, the Tarnished confronts Gideon, who claims that Ensha got ahead of himself.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Clad in the giant horns of a bull-goat, mighty Tragoth is a silent knight famed for aiding many Tarnished against great adversities across the Lands Between.

sections.heading: Notes

sections.text: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood is a hostile NPC in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Juno Hoslow is Diallos' older brother and the head of their illustrious house. A successful, stern and self-possessed man of a few words, Juno inherited the legacy of the Hoslow family to protect his inept brother, whom he loved dearly. Despite drenching himself in blood time and time again, he refused the invitation to the Volcano Manor. Later, he became their target. His sign can be found in the Mountaintops of the Giants, outside the Shack of the Lofty.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Maleigh Marais is the Lord of the Shaded Castle, a location that has been overseen by executioners for generations. He was once a private worshipper of scarlet rot, and would later become obsessed with Malenia. This is partly due to his own sickly bloodline, fueling an admiration of Malenia for remaining strong despite her own affliction. The state of the Shaded Castle reflects this shift in fixation, as the Castellan's Hall is filled with prostheses, Cleanrot armor, and a large portrait of Malenia.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Millicent is an NPC cooperator in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Millicent is a red-haired woman afflicted by Scarlet Rot. She and her sisters were found in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid by Sage Gowry, who raised them as his daughters. Her four sisters travelled to Miquella's Haligtree under Gowry's guidance, however Millicent alone remained behind. At Gowry's behest, the Tarnished obtains an Unalloyed Gold Needle and brings it to the Church of the Plague, where Millicent is slowly succumbing to the Rot. She inserts the needle to stall the Rot, regaining her strength.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Millicent's questline can still be started even after defeating Malenia. - The Valkyrie's Prosthesis links Millicent and Malenia through the symbolic loss of the right arm. Statues of Malenia at Haligtree Town depict her in her youth without a right arm. None of Millicent's Sisters meet this criteria.

invader:millicents-sisters.name: Millicent's Sisters

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Millicent's sisters are adopted daughters of Sage Gowry and siblings of Millicent. These red haired girls once sprouted as buds from the Scarlet Aeonia found within the heart of Caelid. They all wear the Traveler's Set and use weapons and skills associated with either aspects of their inadvertent mother Malenia, both her role as the unalloyed blade of Miquella and her looming transformation into the goddess of rot. They all seek to aid their adoptive father in cultivating Millicent into a Scarlet Valkyrie. __TOC__

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: All sisters can be found in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree towards the end of Millicent's questline. To reach them the player needs to: - 1. Retrieve the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle by defeating Commander O'Neil in the Heart of Aeonia. - Optional: Polyanna, Adopted Daughter can be summoned as a cooperator to assist in this fight. - 2. Give the snapped needle to Sage Gowry at Gowry's Shack so that he may repair it. - 3. Reload the area by either: - A. Resting at/teleporting to a Site of Grace - B. Exit to the Main Menu and then enter back into the game. - 4.

sections.heading: Notes

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Preceptor Miriam is a hostile character in Elden Ring. Miriam can be fought twice in the Carian Study Hall, once before placing the Carian Inverted Statue and once after.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Preceptor Miriam, as indicated by the name, is a teacher of sorcery at the Carian Study Hall. She served the Carian royals in the past and now guards the hall from intruders.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - She rather predictably wears the Preceptor Set, using the standard chest and head pieces. - Wields an Academy Glintstone Staff which she uses to cast Carian Slicer, Greatblade Phalanx, Loretta's Greatbow, and Magic Downpour, of which the Greatbow spell is usually the most used. - Can teleport to the next spot in her area upon taking sufficient damage, though she may skip over a spot in the Standard Study Hall if enough damage is taken at one spot. This cannot happen in the Inverted Study Hall unless killed in the first spot, as she only has two spots there.

sections.heading: Drops

sections.heading: Elden Ring Sanguine Noble Boss Guide
sections.text: Sanguine Noble Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Sanguine Noble: Bring Stanching Boluses Item Melee Users For melee users, be wary as the Sanguine Noble's swings are very fast, so it's recommended that you use a fast one-hand weapon like a straight sword or an axe. sections.text: Vargram the Raging Wolf is an NPC in *Elden Ring*.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Vargram was one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold. He earned his nickname from the white wolf pelt that adorns his helm. Vargram aspired to attain the status of a wolf, based on the old legend that wolves are shadows of the Empyreans. Vargram was a friend of Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, however guidance led the two into confrontation with one another, and Wilhelm was taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold. The Tarnished encounters Vargram and Wilhelm together in the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, during a joint mission with Knight Bernahl on behalf of the Volcano Manor.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: White Mask Varré (白面のヴァレー) is an NPC in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Varré is an enigmatic man who dresses as a war surgeon. War Surgeons, despite their name, are not surgeons or doctors. They act as mercy killers on battlefields, putting dying soldiers out of their misery as quickly as possible by delivering final blows. Varré was a war surgeon prior to his association with Mohg. Varré was abducted by Mohg against his will along with various other war surgeons, however it was noted that Varré was particularly talented with blood incantations, and that of all the war surgeons abducted he was the only one able to "tame" Mohg's cursed blood.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Limgrave (The First Step) Just past the Site of Grace. Will leave a message in his spot after talking with Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold. - Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake) At the entrance of the Rose Church, to the west of the Site of Grace. - Mohgwyn Palace (Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance) His invasion sign is located in the hallway before the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. After defeating him, Varré will be found laying on the floor close to where the sign previously was.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Vyke the Dragonspear, also known as Roundtable Knight Vyke and Festering Fingerprint Vyke, is a character in Elden Ring. He acts as an Invader and a Boss.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Vyke was a Tarnished champion better known for being the closest to becoming Elden Lord before the arrival of the player protagonist. He was a member of Leyndell's Ancient Dragon Cult, through which he met Lansseax. She shared with him Ancient Dragon incantations and he soon became her most beloved knight. Vyke's mastery grew and he developed his own incantation—Vyke's Dragonbolt, a signature move that electrified his body and lance—earning him the nickname *Vyke the Dragonspear*. Vyke went on to join the Roundtable Hold, where he was known as the *Roundtable Knight*.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Vyke has no dialogue. - Finger Reader Enia mentions that "Only once before [has she] seen two Great Runes together". This is probably a reference to Vyke, since he is the only one who ever got close to be Elden Lord. Nevertheless, not any other details are given about the situation and Vyke isn't ever mentioned anywhere as having had runes. -

Florissax assumed this spirit form to offer her service to a new lord. Uses her own dragonbolt to increase all damage negation (including physical) for herself and nearby allies. Strikes foes with the Flowerstone Gavel's dragonbolt to reduce enemy lightning damage negation. Long ago, Florissax assumed human form to share Dragon Communion with the world. Now, she has acquired a human heart.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax

item:ancient-dragon-florissax.location: - Give Dragon Communion Priestess Thiollier's Concoction.

After the First Defense of Leyndell, Kristoff earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial for the feat of capturing Godefroy the Grafted.

item:ancient-dragon-knight-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques of the ancient dragon knight who followed Godwyn's golden knights into the realm of shadow. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Red Lightning Pot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire
