A record of crafting techniques of the ancient dragon knight who followed Godwyn's golden knights into the realm of shadow. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Dragonbolt Grease
- Drawstring Dragonbolt Grease

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:ancient-dragon-s-blessing.name: Ancient Dragon's Blessing
item:ancient-dragon-s-blessing.description: Favor bestowed by the Dragon Communion priestess in the name of the dragon lord Placidusax. Consume FP to increase all forms of damage negation (including physical). This also increases damage negation while guarding as an additional effect. Each night, the priestess offers her own sleep to her lord, and in turn receives the power of His favor.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to increase all damage negation

item:ancient-dragon-s-blessing.location: Received from the Dragon Communion Priestess if Bayle the Dread hasn't been defeated. Can be obtained again after used as long as Bayle is still alive.

item:ancient-dragon-smithing-stone.name: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
item:ancient-dragon-smithing-stone.description: Smithing stone made polishing a golden Gravel Stone. A scale of the Ancient Dragonlord, and hidden treasure of Farum Azula

stats.Effect: Reinforce armamanets to +25

related: Finish the Deathroot and face him

item:ancient-dragonbolt-pot.name: Ancient Dragonbolt Pot
item:ancient-dragonbolt-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Engraved with the crest of the ancient dragon. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy lightning damage. Allows one to wield ancient drake lightning regardless of faith. The residual power of relics is a purely natural phenomenon.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict heavy lightning damage

item:ancient-dragons-lightning-spear.name: Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear
item:ancient-dragons-lightning-spear.description: A secret incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

stats.Effect: Stabs with red lightning spear from above

item:ancient-dragons-lightning-spear.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Ancient Dragon Prayerbook

item:ancient-dragons-lightning-strike.name: Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike
item:ancient-dragons-lightning-strike.description: A secret incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

stats.Effect: Summons red lightning that spreads from impact

item:ancient-dragons-lightning-strike.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Ancient Dragon Prayerbook

item:ancient-meteoric-ore-greatsword.name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:ancient-meteoric-ore-greatsword.location: SotE greatsword found in the Realm of Shadow.
item:ancient-meteoric-ore-greatsword.description: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point. Fashioned from an excavated shard of an arrowhead that once was a part of the old gods' arsenal. A capable piercing weapon that excels at thrusting attacks.

item:ancient-ruins-cross-message.name: Ancient Ruins Cross Message
item:ancient-ruins-cross-message.description: Message left by Dryleaf Dane, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail. "We've found the sealing tree just ahead. But if we are to burn it, we need the proper kindling. That of Sir Messmer."

stats.Effect:
Message left for the author's compatriots
Examine using

item:ansbach-s-attire.name: Ansbach's Attire
item:ansbach-s-attire.description: Attire of Sir Ansbach. The embroidered crest of the Pureblood Knights has now all but faded away. Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills. Ansbach understood that keeping his oath to his old master was not an act of logic, nor would it bear any justice, but it was for these very reasons he was unable to let go.

item:ansbach-s-attire-altered.name: Ansbach's Attire (Altered)
item:ansbach-s-attire-altered.description: Attire of Sir Ansbach. Black cloth adorned with gold embroidery. Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

item:ansbach-s-boots.name: Ansbach's Boots
item:ansbach-s-boots.description: Boots of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery. Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

item:ansbach-s-longbow.name: Ansbach's Longbow
item:ansbach-s-longbow.description: Weapon of Sir Ansbach. A longbow consisting of two bow bodies and two strings. Unusually for a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a light bow—provided that the wielder has the extraordinary dexterity demanded.

item:ansbach-s-manchettes.name: Ansbach's Manchettes
item:ansbach-s-manchettes.description: Manchettes of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery. Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

item:ant-s-skull-plate.name: Ant's Skull Plate
item:ant-s-skull-plate.description: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repeling enemy attacks. Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding the shield.

item:antiquity-scholar-s-cookbook-1.name: Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [1]
item:antiquity-scholar-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by the hornsent academics who studied the ancient ruins of Rauh. Details techniques for working with sprites thought lost to antiquity. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Fire Spritestone

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:antiquity-scholar-s-cookbook-2.name: Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [2]
item:antiquity-scholar-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques left by the hornsent academics who studied the ancient ruins of Rauh. Details techniques for working with sprites thought lost to antiquity. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Spritestone

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:antspur-rapier.name: Antspur Rapier
item:antspur-rapier.description: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot. Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.
item:antspur-rapier.location: The Antspur Rapier is dropped by Maleigh Marais (Shaded Castle Castellan), a hostile NPC found in the rocky fields west of The Shaded Castle.

item:anvil-hammer.name: Anvil Hammer

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Int E · Fai D

item:anvil-hammer.location: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past — Tarnished Pack / SotE forge puzzle.
item:anvil-hammer.description: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. A tremendous hammer that incorporates as its head the red-hot anvil of the forge. It is said that the anvil's shape is inspired by that of an altar, and that long ago, it was indeed used as such in rite and ritual.

item:arbalest.name: Arbalest
item:arbalest.description: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt.firing devices. Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even forged of steel.
item:arbalest.location: The Arbalest is located in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave).

item:archer-ashes.name: Archer Ashes
item:archer-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon three archer spirits.

stats.Effect: Summons three archer spirits

item:archer-ashes.location: Found in Nokstella, Eternal City, behind a building.

item:aristocrat-boots.name: Aristocrat Boots
item:aristocrat-boots.description: Boots made from tanned leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Abandoning their birthplace after the shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:aristocrat-boots.location: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. The Sorcerer variant and the variant that carries the torch or the Noble's Slender Sword all wear them.

item:aristocrat-coat.name: Aristocrat Coat
item:aristocrat-coat.description: Tanned leather coat adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:aristocrat-coat.location: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. There are two immediately north of the Mistwood Ouksirts Sites of Grace, following a torch bearer.

item:aristocrat-garb.name: Aristocrat Garb
item:aristocrat-garb.description: High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 8 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 6

item:aristocrat-garb-altered.name: Aristocrat Garb (altered)
item:aristocrat-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Aristocrat Garb.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 8 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 6

item:aristocrat-garb-altered.location: Chance to drop from the Wandering Noble enemies that wear it.

item:aristocrat-hat.name: Aristocrat Hat
item:aristocrat-hat.description: Leather hat decorated with a withered feather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:aristocrat-headband.name: Aristocrat Headband

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:aristocrat-headband.location: Two can be found in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South

item:armor-of-night.name: Armor of Night
item:armor-of-night.description: Bottomless black chest armor, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark. Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

item:armor-of-solitude.name: Armor of Solitude
item:armor-of-solitude.description: Steel chest armor of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel, and bedecked with a black cloak. The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

item:armor-of-solitude-altered.name: Armor of Solitude (Altered)
item:armor-of-solitude-altered.description: Steel chest armor of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel. The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.
item:armor-of-solitude-altered.location: Crafted: modify the Armor of Solitude.

item:armorer-s-cookbook-1.description: Record of crafting techniques left by an armorer who served the great general Radahn. Contains knowledge of dealing with decay; the application of fire in particular.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:armorer-s-cookbook-1.location: Kaiden Sellswords south-southwest of the Murkwater Coast

item:arrow.name: Arrow
item:arrow.description: Arrows used with small and long bows. Unremarkable in any way, shape or form.

stats.Effect: Standard arrow used with bows and light bows

item:arrow-s-reach-talisman.name: Arrow's Reach Talisman
item:arrow-s-reach-talisman.description: A talisman depicting three arrows. Carried by hunters of beasts.

stats.Effect: Increases bow effective range.

item:arrow-s-reach-talisman.location: - Found in a chest along the bridge over Stormgate's entrance. To access it, go to the southwest tower, kill the guards here, and then you can enter the area.

item:arrow-s-soaring-sting-talisman.name: Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman
item:arrow-s-soaring-sting-talisman.description: Increases the effective range of bows and raises attack power of arrows and bolts
item:arrow-s-soaring-sting-talisman.location: - Can be found on the top of a tower at Fog Rift Fort. From within the door of the tower where Black Knight Garrew was, go through a gap between the tower and the rock wall to the east of the doorway. Hop down onto the wooden pathway and follow it until you see a ladder on your right. Take it up, after which you'll see another ladder on your left. Take it to the uppermost level of the tower. Here you can find the treasure chest containing the Talisman.

stats.Effect: Increases the effective range of bows and raises attack power of arrows and bolts

item:arrow-s-sting-talisman.name: Arrow's Sting Talisman
item:arrow-s-sting-talisman.description: A talisman depicting three iron arrows. Carried by soldiers long ago.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power of arrows and bolts

item:arrow-s-sting-talisman.location: - Obtained from a chest, atop the wooden siege tower, next to Impassable Greatbridge, in Caelid, near Redmane Castle.

item:arsenal-charm.name: Arsenal Charm
item:arsenal-charm.description: An iron charm that resembles a mass of weaponry. Boosts maximum equipment load. This talisman was derived from an unusual greatsword, once wielded by a hero hungry for vengeance.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum equipment load

item:arsenal-charm-1.name: Arsenal Charm +1
item:arsenal-charm-1.location: - Found in Altus Tunnel, looted from a corpse upon a wooden balcony overlooking a pit, where a monster fires rocks at you from above, with gravity magic. From the entrance to this area, drop to an overgrown root, and climb it to jump to an upper balcony, where the corpse lies.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises maximum equipment load

item:arteria-leaf.name: Arteria Leaf
item:arteria-leaf.description: Dark red leaves with thick, swollen veins. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A faint pulse can be felt in the veins. Stirs the blood, providing an enlivening effect.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:arteria-leaf.location: Sold by Isolated Merchant - Weeping Peninsula

item:as-you-wish.name: As You Wish
item:as-you-wish.location: Shabriri Grape near the Lake-Facing Cliffs
item:as-you-wish.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:ascetic-s-ankle-guards.name: Ascetic's Ankle Guards
item:ascetic-s-ankle-guards.description: Ankle guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control. In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.
item:ascetic-s-ankle-guards.location: - The Ascetic's Ankle Guards have a 3.00% chance to drop from Curseblades.

item:ascetic-s-loincloth.name: Ascetic's Loincloth
item:ascetic-s-loincloth.description: Attire of the tower's ascetics, embodying their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control. In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.
item:ascetic-s-loincloth.location: - The Ascetic's Loincloth have a 3.00% chance to drop from Curseblades.

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-bloom.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-bloom.description: Aspect of the Crucible discovered in the ancient ruins. Creates a miranda flower on one's chest before calling down a rain of light. Charging increases potency. In an age long past, before this land was enshrouded in shadow, the vitality of the Crucible flourished.

stats.Effect: Creates a miranda flower on chest to summon rain of light

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-breath.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Breath
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-breath.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

stats.Effect: Creates throat pouch to spew fire while walking

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-breath.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Breath is acquired upon defeating Tanith's Knight, which can be fought after killing Tanith in Rykard's arena in the Volcano Manor, at the end of her questline.

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-horns.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Horns
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-horns.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

stats.Effect: creates shoulder horn to gore foes from a low stance.

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-tail.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Tail
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-tail.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

stats.Effect: Creates supple tail to sweep area before caster

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-tail.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Tail is acquired by defeating the Crucible Knight trapped in the Stormhill Evergaol, located in Stormhill.

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-thorns.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-thorns.location: Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns is acquired by defeating the Golden Hippopotamus boss found just inside the main gate of Shadow Keep on Scadu Altus.
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-thorns.description: Aspect of the Crucible that manifested in golden hippopotami. Creates a bristling mass of thorn-like fur on the caster's back before scouring the area by rolling around on the ground. Charging increases number of rolls and range of attack. In an age long past, before this land was enshrouded in shadow, the vitality of the Crucible flourished. Remains of this can be seen in the ancient ruins.

stats.Effect: Creates a mass of bristling thorns on back to scour the area

item:aspects-of-the-crucible-wings.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings
item:aspects-of-the-crucible-wings.description: Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings This skill originates from the lifeforms of the Crucible. Grow a golden pair of wings and take to the air before diving down at the foe, weapon first. A spinning attack is performed when wielding a twinblade.

item:assassin-s-approach.name: Assassin's Approach
item:assassin-s-approach.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Assassin's Prayerbook
item:assassin-s-approach.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the assassins of the Roundtable Hold. Completely silences the footsteps of the caster. Additionally, reduces fall damage and the sound produced by falling. This incantation can be cast while in motion or crouching. The assassins were charged with eliminating Tarnished who had strayed from guidance.

stats.Effect: Silences footsteps, reduces fall damage/sound

item:assassin-s-cerulean-dagger.name: Assassin's Cerulean Dagger
item:assassin-s-cerulean-dagger.description: An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in cerulean. Critical hits restore FP.

stats.Effect: Critical hits restore FP

item:assassin-s-cerulean-dagger.location: - Obtained from defeating the Black Knife Assassin in Black Knife Catacombs in northeast Liurnia of the Lakes

item:assassin-s-crimson-dagger.name: Assassin's Crimson Dagger
item:assassin-s-crimson-dagger.description: An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in crimson. Critical hits restore HP.

stats.Effect: Critical hits restore HP

item:assassin-s-crimson-dagger.location: - Obtained by defeating the Black Knife Assassin in Deathtouched Catacombs, in northern Limgrave

item:assassin-s-gambit.name: Assassin's Gambit
item:assassin-s-gambit.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"Assassin's Gambit: Skill that masks the user's presence at the cost of a self-inflicted wound. Grants near-invisibility and silences footsteps."Usable on small and medium straight swords and thrusting swords.

stats.Effect: ash

item:astrologer-gloves.name: Astrologer Gloves
item:astrologer-gloves.description: Gloves fashioned from fine, supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

item:astrologer-s-staff.name: Astrologer's Staff
item:astrologer-s-staff.description: Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries. Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
item:astrologer-s-staff.location: The Astrologer's Staff in Elden Ring can be obtained by starting as the Astrologer Class or buying it from the Nomadic Merchant at South Liurnia Lake Shore for 800 runes.

item:astrologer-trousers.name: Astrologer Trousers
item:astrologer-trousers.description: Trousers worn inside a robe. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

item:avionette-soldier-ashes.name: Avionette Soldier Ashes
item:avionette-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers. Spirits of marionette soldiers with avian features that were created to serve a sorcerer. Equipped with long-hafted scythes, they also attack from the skies by lobbing fire pots. Can sometimes malfunction when damaged.

stats.Effect: Summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers

item:axe-of-godfrey.name: Axe of Godfrey
item:axe-of-godfrey.description: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.
item:axe-of-godfrey.location: Remembrance of Hoarah Loux (Godfrey, First Elden Lord)

item:axe-of-godrick.name: Axe of Godrick
item:axe-of-godrick.description: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"
item:axe-of-godrick.location: Remembrance of the Grafted (Godrick the Grafted)

item:axe-talisman.name: Axe Talisman
item:axe-talisman.description: A talisman depicting an axe and a warrior. Enhances charge attacks.

stats.Effect: Enhances charge attacks.

item:axe-talisman.location: Cellar beneath the Mistwood Ruins in eastern Limgrave.

item:azula-beastman-ashes.name: Azula Beastman Ashes
item:azula-beastman-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Azula beastmen. Spirits of beastmen from doomed Farum Azula, the slowly crumbling ruins in the skies. These ruins are said to be the remains of a giant mausoleum enshrining an ancient dragon, guarded by chosen beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning.

stats.Effect: Summons two Azula beastman spirits

item:azula-beastman-ashes.location: Found in a room guarded by a Banished Knight, with another Banished Knight patrolling nearby, in the Dragon Temple before the Godskin Duo.

item:azur-s-glintstone-crown.name: Azur's Glintstone Crown
item:azur-s-glintstone-crown.description: Crown of Azur, primeval current sorcerer, set with a prominent blue-green glintstone.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:azur-s-glintstone-robe.name: Azur's Glintstone Robe
item:azur-s-glintstone-robe.description: A robe reserved for grant masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue-green glintstones.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 15 · Fire 12 · Light 13 · Holy 13

item:azur-s-glintstone-robe.location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.

item:azur-s-glintstone-staff.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
item:azur-s-glintstone-staff.description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it. Reduces casting time of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
item:azur-s-glintstone-staff.location: Azur's Glintstone Staff is located on the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy, Liurnia.

item:azur-s-manchettes.location: - Azur's Manchettes are obtained by completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the location of Primeval Sorcerer Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur's Set.

item:backhand-blade.name: Backhand Blade
item:backhand-blade.description: Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations. Wielding this weapon resembles a deadly dance.

item:bandit-s-curved-sword.description: Curved sword with a light, crescent-shaped blade. Used by the bandits who ran rampant in the wake of the Shattering. Most of the blade is now darkened and covered in rust, but with enough dexterity this weapon may still stand up to some use.

item:banished-knight-armor.name: Banished Knight Armor
item:banished-knight-armor.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

Despite his banishment, he rejected the invitation of the Grace-Given Lord, instead keeping watch over a masterless castle for many years, gaining renown as a hero of the fringes.

item:banished-knight-s-greatsword.name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
item:banished-knight-s-greatsword.description: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
item:banished-knight-s-greatsword.location: The Banished Knight's Greatsword doesn't have a guaranteed fixed spawn; instead, it is acquired by farming Banished Knights who wield it.

item:banished-knight-s-halberd.name: Banished Knight's Halberd
item:banished-knight-s-halberd.description: A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
item:banished-knight-s-halberd.location: In Elden Ring, you can get a guaranteed Banished Knight's Halberd (+8) by defeating Edgar at the Revenger's Shack in West Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:banished-knight-s-shield.name: Banished Knight's Shield
item:banished-knight-s-shield.description: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
item:banished-knight-s-shield.location: - 4% chance to drop from various shield-wielding Banished Knights.

item:barbaric-roar.name: Barbaric Roar
item:barbaric-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Barbaric Roar: Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks."Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Fai C

item:barbed-staff-spear.location: - Guaranteed drop from Jori, Elder Inquisitor, found at the end of the Darklight Catacombs.
item:barbed-staff-spear.description: Greatstaff of Jori, elder inquisitor. The tip bristles with golden barbs symbolic of the inquisition's torture, allowing one to wield the staff as a greatspear. Attacks deal holy damage, and potency increases with faith.

item:barrage.name: Barrage
item:barrage.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Barrage: Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see."Usable on light bows.
item:barrage.location: Drops from a Scarab north of the Seethewater River

stats.Effect: Ash

item:barricade-shield.name: Barricade Shield
item:barricade-shield.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Barricade Shield: Skill made famous by Sir Neidhardt. Focus your energy into the shield, temporarily hardening it to deflect greater blows."Usable on all shields.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:barrier-of-gold.name: Barrier of Gold
item:barrier-of-gold.description: One of the incantations of Erdtree Worship.

stats.Effect: Greatly increases magic damage negation for self & allies

item:bastard-s-stars.name: Bastard's Stars
item:bastard-s-stars.description: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int C

item:bastard-s-stars.location: To get the Bastard's Stars flail in Elden Ring, defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, take his remembrance to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold, and trade it for the weapon.

item:bastard-sword.name: Bastard Sword
item:bastard-sword.description: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.
item:bastard-sword.location: You can purchase the Bastard Sword in Elden Ring from the Nomadic Merchant near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:battle-axe.name: Battle Axe
item:battle-axe.description: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.
item:battle-axe.location: The Battle Axe can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

item:battle-hammer.name: Battle Hammer
item:battle-hammer.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
item:battle-hammer.location: Battle Hammer: Dropped by the hammer-wielding Duelist enemies wandering near the colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital (accessible from the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace).

item:battlefield-priest-s-cookbook-1.name: Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1]
item:battlefield-priest-s-cookbook-1.description:
A record of crafting techniques left by the devout battlefield priests. These keepers of the faith fought bitterly to spread their gospel in the realm of shadow, where there was no Erdtree to gaze upon. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Golden Grease
- Drawstring Golden Grease

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:battlemage-hugues.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Battlemage Hugues. Hugues came from Sellia to study the Haima Conspectus at the academy, where he became a battlemage. Haima scholars seek to quell conflict with cannon fire and the gavel, but Hugues developed a longing for it.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Battlemage Hugues

item:bayle-s-flame-lightning.name: Bayle's Flame Lightning
item:bayle-s-flame-lightning.description: One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread. Channels the form of the dread dragon in right arm to smash foes with an exposed talon bone coursing with flame lightning. Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.

stats.Effect: Channels dread dragon to strike with flame-lightning-infused talon bone

item:bayle-s-tyranny.name: Bayle's Tyranny
item:bayle-s-tyranny.description: One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread. Channels the form of the dread dragon to emit a mighty roar accompanied by a heatwave burst, causing violent eruptions of fire in the area. Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.

stats.Effect: Channels dread dragon to roar with a heatwave blast

item:beast-blood.description: Fresh beast blood, glinting with gold. Material used for crafting items.

item:beast-champion-armor.description: Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was. Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

item:beast-claw-weapon.name: Beast Claw (weapon)
item:beast-claw-weapon.location: Church of Consolation from the Gravesite Plain

item:beast-crest-heater-shield.name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
item:beast-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. Features a beast as its crest, serving to remind warriors not to succumb to the arousal of battle. Fight with passion, but become nor its prisoner.
item:beast-crest-heater-shield.location: - In a chest at a Godrick Knight's camp northeast of the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill.

item:beast-eye.name: Beast Eye
item:beast-eye.description: Claw-marked stone eye received from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman.

stats.Effect: Said to tremble when close to Deathroot

item:beast-horn.name: Beast Horn
item:beast-horn.description: Horn suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting horned beasts of the realm of shadow. The Crucible has a particularly strong influence on the beasts of the realm of shadow, causing many to grow horns despite the characteristics of their species.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:beast-horn.location: - Dropped by horned beasts in the Realm of Shadow.

item:beast-liver.name: Beast Liver
item:beast-liver.description: The fresh liver of a beast; a luscious fruit of life. Material used for crating items. Found by hunting herbivorous beast. Dried liver boost damage negation.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:beast-repellent-torch.name: Beast-Repellent Torch
item:beast-repellent-torch.description: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.
item:beast-repellent-torch.location: The Beast-Repellent Torch can be purchased for 1,200 Runes from the Isolated Merchant in his shack, located at the northwestern edge of the Dragonbarrow region in northern Caelid

item:beast-s-roar.name: Beast's Roar
item:beast-s-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Beast's Roar: Unleash a beastly roar, rending the air as a forward-travelling projectile."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: ash

item:beastclaw-greathammer.name: Beastclaw Greathammer
item:beastclaw-greathammer.description: Greathammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws. The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went to become King Godfrey's Regent.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:beastclaw-greathammer.location: You can get the Beastclaw Greathammer by trading seven Deathroot items to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum in Dragonbarrow.

item:beastlure-pot.name: Beastlure Pot
item:beastlure-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted with assassin incantations. Consumes FP. Throw to create a red shadow. The illusion lures in beasts into attacking it. This effect does not change even during combat.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Lures beasts only.

item:beastman-s-cleaver.name: Beastman's Cleaver
item:beastman-s-cleaver.description: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.
item:beastman-s-cleaver.location: The Beastman's Cleaver is a rare drop from Azula Beastmen who wield this specific weapon in the Crumbling Farum Azula legacy dungeon.

item:beastman-s-curved-sword.name: Beastman's Curved Sword
item:beastman-s-curved-sword.description: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.
item:beastman-s-curved-sword.location: The Beastman's Curved Sword is a rare drop from Azula Beastman enemies in Crumbling Farum Azula.

item:beastman-s-jar-shield.name: Beastman's Jar-Shield
item:beastman-s-jar-shield.description: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it. The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.
item:beastman-s-jar-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding beastmen in Crumbling Farum Azula.

item:beckon.name: Beckon
item:beckon.location: Available from the start of the game.
item:beckon.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:beloved-stardust.name: Beloved Stardust
item:beloved-stardust.description: Shortens casting speed for sorcery and incantations by the utmost, but increases damage taken

item:bernahl-s-bell-bearing.name: Bernahl's Bell Bearing
item:bernahl-s-bell-bearing.description: Knight Bernahl's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:bernahl-s-bell-bearing.location: Dropped by Knight Bernahl if killed at Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave.

item:bestial-constitution.name: Bestial Constitution
item:bestial-constitution.description: Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

stats.Effect: Alleviates blood loss and frost buildup

item:bestial-sling.name: Bestial Sling
item:bestial-sling.description: Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. Swiftly flings a number of sharp rock shards. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action. It is said that in the time before the Erdtree, stones were the first weapons of the beasts who had gained intelligence.

stats.Effect: Swiftly flings numerous sharp rock shards

item:bestial-vitality.name: Bestial Vitality
item:bestial-vitality.description: Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

stats.Effect: Heals HP over a period of time

item:bewitching-branch.name: Bewitching Branch
item:bewitching-branch.description: Tree branch blessed with an incantation of unalloyed gold. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to charm pierced enemy

item:bigmouth-imp-ashes.name: Bigmouth Imp Ashes
item:bigmouth-imp-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a large-mouthed imp. The spirit of this old imp, said to be fashioned after a dragon, has a big mouth that serves as a cannon and allows it to fire shells from the rear of the battlefield.

stats.Effect: Summons bigmouth imp spirit

item:black-blade.name: Black Blade
item:black-blade.description: Power gleaned from the remembrance of Maliketh.

stats.Effect: Black blade spinning slash that emits wave of light.

item:black-bow.name: Black Bow
item:black-bow.description: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master. The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.
item:black-bow.location: The Black Bow is located on a corpse on a rooftop in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:black-dumpling.name: Black Dumpling
item:black-dumpling.description: Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty. It magnifies one's fears and make them acutely aware of all forms of pain Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness. When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:black-flame-blade.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

item:black-knife.name: Black Knife
item:black-knife.description: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.

item:black-knife-armor.description: Scale armor used by the Black Knife Assassins, forged to make no sound. Traces of power yet remain in its concealing veil, which muffles the sound of footsteps. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

item:black-knight-armor.name: Black Knight Armor
item:black-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Though the engraving above the heart is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.
item:black-knight-armor.location: - Black Knights have a 3.00% chance to drop the Black Knight Armor.

item:black-knight-captain-huw.name: Black Knight Captain Huw
item:black-knight-captain-huw.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Huw, Knight-Captain of the Black Knights. The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Second to their first Knight-Commander was Huw, a man with agile command of both twinblade techniques and the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells. Though a champion of the divine beast hunt, he followed his father, Andreas, into rebellion against Messmer, and like his father, he too was imprisoned in an underground tomb. Messmer mourned the loss of a brother-in-arms.

Their first leader was Andreas, a man endowed with great strength and command over the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells. Though he remained a devout follower of Messmer after his flight from the Erdtree, he would rebel after learning of his liege's serpentine nature. item:black-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it. Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.
item:black-knight-gauntlets.location: - Black Knights have a 3.00% chance to drop the Black Knight Gauntlets.

item:black-leather-shield.description: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.
item:black-leather-shield.location: Bought for 2,500 Runes from Pidia, Carian Servant or by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Pidia's Bell Bearing.

item:black-pyrefly.name: Black Pyrefly
item:black-pyrefly.description: Fiery butterfly with black cinder wings. Material used for crafting items. Flies in war-torn lands that have been scoured by Messmer's flame. They burn in dark and slender ribbons of fire.

item:black-steel-greatshield.name: Black Steel Greatshield
item:black-steel-greatshield.description: Weighty shields carried by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Made of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Symbolic of their iron conviction in their crusade, the Black Knights will never yield. Nor will they ever doubt their purpose.

item:black-syrup.name: Black Syrup

item:blood-blade.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:"Blood Blade: Wound self to coat the armament with blood, then unleash an airborne blood blade that causes hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on small and medium swords.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:blood-grease.name: Blood Grease
item:blood-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of blood-red materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting blood loss

item:blood-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Bloodrose x1

item:blood-tainted-excrement.name: Blood-Tainted Excrement
item:blood-tainted-excrement.description: The bloody excrement of a carnivorous beast. Material used for crafting items. Found in the land of the new dynasty. Mixed inside with half-digested flesh are dense colonies of tiny eggs of unknown but assuredly revolting origin.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:blood-tax.name: Blood Tax
item:blood-tax.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:"Blood Tax: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts that rob the target of both their blood and their HP."Usable on armaments capable of thrusting(colossal weapons excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:bloodboil-aromatic.name: Bloodboil Aromatic
item:bloodboil-aromatic.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor, raising maximum attack power and stamina while also increasing damage received. "Even upon the battlefield, do you fear being wounded? Take a good look. Your limbs are frozen stiff."

stats.Effect: Uses FP to enter a temporary state of fervor.

item:bloodboil-aromatic.location: Can be crafted after acquiring the Perfumer's Cookbook 2 from The Shaded Castle. Head north from the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace and climb up a ladder, then enter the dark room and take the ladder inside to a small rooftop with a body on a chair holding the item.

item:bloodbone-arrow.name: Bloodbone Arrow
item:bloodbone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow with blood tincture tip

item:bloodbone-arrow-fletched.name: Bloodbone Arrow (Fletched)
item:bloodbone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched bone arrow with blood tincture tip
item:bloodbone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not static loot or dropped by enemies.

item:bloodbone-bolt.name: Bloodbone Bolt
item:bloodbone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt with blood tincture tip

item:bloodboon.name: Bloodboon
item:bloodboon.description: Sacred incantation of Mohg, Lord of Blood.

stats.Effect: Scatters bloodflame before caster to set area aflame.

item:bloodfiend-hexer-s-ashes.name: Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes
item:bloodfiend-hexer-s-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a bloodfiend hexer. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. This spirit conducts bloodboon rituals with a sacred spear, casts bloodflame hexes, and takes a singular pleasure in letting the blood of foes. Long ago, a subjugated tribe discovered a twisted deity amongst the ravages of war, and they were transformed into bloodfiends. The mother of truth was their savior.

stats.Effect: Summons bloodfiend hexer spirit

item:bloodfiend-hexer-s-ashes.location: - Defeat the Chief Bloodfiend at Rivermouth Cave.

item:bloodfiend-s-arm.name: Bloodfiend's Arm

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:bloodfiend-s-arm.location: SotE bloodfiend weapon dropped in the Realm of Shadow.
item:bloodfiend-s-arm.description: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. An arm pulled from the corpse of one of their kin, and wielded as a makeshift weapon. Having been sanctified by a blood ritual, this armament is capable of spraying blood stored within when executing a strong attack.

item:bloodfiend-s-fork.name: Bloodfiend's Fork

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:bloodfiend-s-fork.location: 3% chance to be dropped by various Bloodfiends who wield it.
item:bloodfiend-s-fork.description: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss. A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks.

item:bloodfiend-s-sacred-spear.name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Arc C

item:bloodfiend-s-sacred-spear.location: Guaranteed drop from a Bloodfiend Hexer in Rauh Base. It can be found in a shallow pond to the west of Taylew's Ruined Forge.
item:bloodfiend-s-sacred-spear.description: Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals. Sacred spears of blood are the instruments of communion with an outer god. The mother of truth desires a wound.

item:bloodflame-blade.name: Bloodflame Blade
item:bloodflame-blade.description: A Blood Oath incantation, granted by the Lord of Blood. Engulfs armament held in the right hand with bloodflame. This incantation can be cast while in motion. After dealing damage, bloodflame continues to build up onset of blood loss for a very short time.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with bloodflame

item:bloodflame-blade.location: Dropped by the scarab west of Rose Church after talking to Varre.

item:bloodflame-talons.name: Bloodflame Talons
item:bloodflame-talons.description: A Blood Oath incantation, granted by the Lord of Blood.

stats.Effect: Creates bloodflame lacerations that then explode

item:bloodhound-claws.name: Bloodhound Claws
item:bloodhound-claws.description: Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights. The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.
item:bloodhound-claws.location: The Bloodhound Claws are dropped by a Lesser Bloodhound Knight in the basement of Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

item:bloodhound-knight-armor.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor
item:bloodhound-knight-armor.description: Metal armor with a jutting breastplate. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 7 · Holy 10

item:bloodhound-knight-armor.location: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the Merciless Chariot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight Set.

item:bloodhound-knight-armor-altered.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor (altered)
item:bloodhound-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Bloodhound Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 9 · Fire 9 · Lightning 6 · Holy 9

item:bloodhound-knight-armor-altered.location: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

item:bloodhound-knight-floh.name: Bloodhound Knight Floh
item:bloodhound-knight-floh.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Floh, the Bloodhound Knight.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Bloodhound Knight Floh

item:bloodhound-knight-floh.location: Defeat the Red Wolf of the Champion boss in Gelmir Hero's Grave.

upgradeLevels.name: Bloodhound Knight Floh +1
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Bloodhound Knight Floh

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Bloodhound Knight Floh

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Bloodhound Knight Floh

item:bloodhound-knight-gauntlets.name: Bloodhound Knight Gauntlets
item:bloodhound-knight-gauntlets.description: Metal gauntlets of the Bloodhound Knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:bloodhound-knight-greaves.name: Bloodhound Knight Greaves
item:bloodhound-knight-greaves.description: Metal greaves of the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made the knight stays loyal for life.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:bloodhound-knight-greaves.location: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

item:bloodhound-knight-helm.name: Bloodhound Knight Helm
item:bloodhound-knight-helm.description: Metal helm with a pointed beak. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · VS 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:bloodhound-s-fang.name: Bloodhound's Fang
item:bloodhound-s-fang.description: Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights. A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.
item:bloodhound-s-fang.location: Reward for defeating Bloodhound Knight Darriwil

item:bloodhound-s-step.name: Bloodhound's Step
item:bloodhound-s-step.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Bloodhound's Step: Skill that allows the user to become temporarily invisible while dodging at high speed. Moves faster and travels farther than a regular quickstep. This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:bloodrose.name: Bloodrose
item:bloodrose.description: Blood-slick roses that bloom in festering blood. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:bloodsoaked-manchettes.name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes
item:bloodsoaked-manchettes.description: Manchettes formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Any protection is welcome for the festering arms beneath.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:bloodsoaked-mask.name: Bloodsoaked Mask
item:bloodsoaked-mask.description: Mask formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Even the most ghastly cover is more inviting than the festering face beneath.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 2 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:bloodsoaked-mask.location: Mask is found on a corpse near the Underground Roadside

item:bloodsoaked-tabard.name: Bloodsoaked Tabard
item:bloodsoaked-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with indelible bloodstains around the neck. Worn by headless foot soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 12 · Holy 11

item:bloodsoaked-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Mausoleum Foot Soldier enemies.

item:bloodstained-dagger.name: Bloodstained Dagger
item:bloodstained-dagger.description: Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss. As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.
item:bloodstained-dagger.location: The Bloodstained Dagger is a rare drop from Fierce Demi-Humans and Demi-Human Chiefs.

item:bloodsucking-cracked-tear.name: Bloodsucking Cracked Tear
item:bloodsucking-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily increases attack power but drains HP over time.

stats.Effect: Enhances attacks at the cost of HP in mixed physick

item:bloodsucking-cracked-tear.location: Defeat the Furnace Golem in Ruins of Unte.

item:bloody-finger.name: Bloody Finger
item:bloody-finger.description: Item for online play. Attempts an invasion of another player's world. If successful, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. The nail of this finger is shot through with streaks of fresh, glistening blood. The finger's sickly pale skin feels nothing now, but the nail still aches with sweetest pain.

stats.Effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world.

item:bloody-helice.name: Bloody Helice
item:bloody-helice.description: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:bloody-helice.location: The Bloody Helice is a Heavy Thrusting Sword located at the Writheblood Ruins in the northern Altus Plateau.

item:bloody-slash.name: Bloody Slash
item:bloody-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:"Bloody Slash: Bloody Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. From a low stance, coat the blade in your own blood to unleash a rending blood slash in a wide arc."Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted)

stats.Effect: ash

item:blue-cipher-ring.name: Blue Cipher Ring
item:blue-cipher-ring.description: Item for online play. Puts the wearer in ready state to answer should someone in another world call for rescue. You will be summoned to their world as a hunter. When summoned to rescue another player, your objective will be to defeat the invader.

stats.Effect: Enables the wearer to answer calls for rescue

item:blue-cipher-ring.location: - The Blue Cipher Ring is purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 runes.

item:blue-cloth-cowl.name: Blue Cloth Cowl
item:blue-cloth-cowl.description: Cowl of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever-drifting.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 2

item:blue-cloth-cowl.location: Sold by Merchant - Academy of Raya Lucaria

item:blue-cloth-vest.name: Blue Cloth Vest
item:blue-cloth-vest.description: Vest of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 9

item:blue-cloth-vest.location: Sold by Merchant - Academy of Raya Lucaria

item:blue-crest-heater-shield.name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
item:blue-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.

item:blue-dancer-charm.name: Blue Dancer Charm
item:blue-dancer-charm.description: A cloth doll depicting a dancer garbed in blue. An ancient heirloom of some sort.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power with lower equipment load

item:blue-dancer-charm.location: - The Blue Dancer Charm is obtained by defeating the Guardian Golem in Highroad Cave in northern Limgrave.

item:blue-feathered-branchsword.name: Blue-Feathered Branchsword
item:blue-feathered-branchsword.description: A talisman adorned with blue feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.

stats.Effect: Raises defense when HP is low.

item:blue-festive-garb.name: Blue Festive Garb
item:blue-festive-garb.description: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Use of this garb, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:blue-festive-garb.location: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

item:blue-festive-hood.name: Blue Festive Hood
item:blue-festive-hood.description: Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:blue-festive-hood.location: - The Blue Festive Hood has a 1.50% chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wear it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. The enemies always wield the Celebrant's Sickle.

item:blue-gold-kite-shield.name: Blue-Gold Kite Shield
item:blue-gold-kite-shield.description: A standard medium-sized shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foreground against a blue sky.
item:blue-gold-kite-shield.location: Purchased for 1,000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave south of the Minor Erdtree or from the Twin Maiden Husks upon giving them his Bell Bearing.

item:blue-silver-bracelets.name: Blue Silver Bracelets
item:blue-silver-bracelets.description: Bracelets crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 1 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:blue-silver-bracelets.location: - The Blue Silver Bracelets have a 2.00% chance to drop from Albinauric Archer enemies.

item:blue-silver-mail-armor.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor
item:blue-silver-mail-armor.description: Chainmail armor crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers. Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:blue-silver-mail-armor.location: - Chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

item:blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor (altered)
item:blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Blue Silver Mail Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 9 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.location: - Armor Adjustment of Blue Silver Mail Armor

item:blue-silver-mail-hood.name: Blue Silver Mail Hood
item:blue-silver-mail-hood.description: Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:blue-silver-mail-hood.location: - The Blue Silver Mail Hood has a 2.00% chance to drop from Albinauric Archers.

item:blue-silver-mail-skirt.name: Blue Silver Mail Skirt
item:blue-silver-mail-skirt.description: Chainmail skirt crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:blue-silver-mail-skirt.location: -?.??% chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

item:blue-white-wooden-shield.name: Blue-White Wooden Shield
item:blue-white-wooden-shield.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design is said to represent the stars of the night sky, portending fate.
item:blue-white-wooden-shield.location: Found behind a building in Academy Gate Town, in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:boiled-crab.name: Boiled Crab
item:boiled-crab.description: Boiled crab meat. A prime specimen of plump and moist meat. True connoisseurs know how to keep from over-salting. Greatly boosts physical damage negation for a certain duration. Unlike the "prawn" sold, this truly is crab. Not that it matters, it's delicious all the same.

stats.Effect: Greatly boosts physical damage negation for a time

item:boiled-prawn.name: Boiled Prawn
item:boiled-prawn.description: Boiled prawn meat. A prime specimen of plump and moist meat. True connoisseurs know how to keep from over-salting.

stats.Effect: Boosts physical damage negation for a time

item:bolt.name: Bolt
item:bolt.description: Ammunition used for crossbows. A widespread, common type of bolt.

item:bolt-of-gransax.name: Bolt of Gransax
item:bolt-of-gransax.description: Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments. A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyendell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against dragons.
item:bolt-of-gransax.location: Found on the giant bolt (drop down to the ledge)
related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:boltdrake-talisman.name: Boltdrake Talisman
item:boltdrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a yellow ancient dragon. Boosts lightning damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts lightning damage negation.
Greatly boosts lightning damage negation

item:boltdrake-talisman-2.name: Boltdrake Talisman +2
item:boltdrake-talisman-2.location: Obtained from a corpse near the Dragon Temple Rooftop

stats.Effect: Vastly boosts lightning damage negation

item:boltdrake-talisman-3.name: Boltdrake Talisman +3
item:boltdrake-talisman-3.description: Boosts lightning damage negation by the utmost

stats.Effect: Reduces lightning damage

item:bondstone.name: Bondstone
item:bondstone.description: A large burrowstone studded with a perfectly white gem, said to be the polished form of a special kind of crystal. A ritual implement made to control explosions of spiritual power. Use to cause a spiritual explosion, consuming the sprite dwelling within spritestone. Bonds with the sprites were made to be broken.

stats.Effect: Causes a spiritual explosion, consuming sprite dwelling within spritestone

item:bondstone.location: Found behind an illusory wall in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, close to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace.

item:bone-arrow.name: Bone Arrow
item:bone-arrow.description: Arrow whittled from thin animal bone
item:bone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

item:bone-arrow-fletched.name: Bone Arrow (Fletched)
item:bone-arrow-fletched.description: Thin, whittled animal bone with feather fletchings
item:bone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

item:bone-ballista-bolt.name: Bone Ballista Bolt
item:bone-ballista-bolt.description: Thick, whittled bone bolt, large as a spear

stats.Effect: Thick, whittled bone bolt, large as a spear

item:bone-bow.name: Bone Bow
item:bone-bow.description: A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone. A medium for spirit-calling, and a product of the ancient hexing arts of the tower.

item:bone-dart.name: Bone Dart
item:bone-dart.description: Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage

item:bone-great-arrow.name: Bone Great Arrow
item:bone-great-arrow.description: Thick, whittled animal bone arrow, large as a spear
item:bone-great-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Thick, whittled animal bone arrow, large as a spear
