item:bone-great-arrow-fletched.description: Thick, whittled bone arrow with feather fletchings
item:bone-great-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Thick, whittled bone arrow with feather fletchings

item:bone-peddler-s-bell-bearing.name: Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing
item:bone-peddler-s-bell-bearing.description:
Bell bearing of an unfortunate bone peddler who was slain by the Bell Bearing Hunter. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Thin Animal Bones
- Hefty Beast Bone

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:bonny-butchering-knife.name: Bonny Butchering Knife
item:bonny-butchering-knife.location: The weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house, near the broken bridge.
item:bonny-butchering-knife.description: Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

stats.Effect: Spews icy breath of Borealis from above

item:bow.name: Bow

stats.Effect: A bow

item:bow.location: Available from the start of the game.

item:braggart-s-roar.name: Braggart's Roar
item:braggart-s-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Braggart's Roar: Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed."Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted ).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:braided-arm-wraps.name: Braided Arm Wraps
item:braided-arm-wraps.description: Ragged black cloth tied with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent.

item:braided-cord-robe.name: Braided Cord Robe
item:braided-cord-robe.description: Ragged black cloth overlaid with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent. The braided cord ties together the vow of the revenger with the victims' grudges. It must never come undone. Enhances both watchful spirits and the vengeful spirits summoned by horned bairns.

item:brass-shield.name: Brass Shield
item:brass-shield.description: On the larger side for medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

item:brave-s-battlewear.name: Brave's Battlewear
item:brave-s-battlewear.description: Battlewear fashioned from leather armor adorned with a large sheet of cloth. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands The red cloth signifies participation in the Long March long, long ago and this ceremonial garb beseeches the favor of the Warrior King who led them.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:brave-s-battlewear.location: - The Brave's Battlewear is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-battlewear-altered.name: Brave's Battlewear (altered)
item:brave-s-battlewear-altered.description: Lighter version of the Brave's Battlewear

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:brave-s-battlewear-altered.location: - The Brave's Battlewear (Altered) is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-bracer.name: Brave's Bracer
item:brave-s-bracer.description: Gauntlets wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.
item:brave-s-bracer.location: - The Brave's Bracer is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-cord-circlet.name: Brave's Cord Circlet
item:brave-s-cord-circlet.description: Warrior's headband of woven leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. The small flags, white cloths and sheaves of wheat often found hung from these headbands are prayers of farewell from the people of their home. In bidding farewell t warriors departing on a journey from which they aren't like to return, this small act offers only meager relief.
item:brave-s-cord-circlet.location: - The Brave's Cord Circlet is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-leather-helm.name: Brave's Leather Helm
item:brave-s-leather-helm.description: Battlewear wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:brave-s-leather-helm.location: - The Brave's Leather Helm is unused content and cannot be acquired through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:brave-s-legwraps.name: Brave's Legwraps
item:brave-s-legwraps.description: Greaves wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:brave-s-legwraps.location: - The Brave's Legwraps are unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:bravo.name: Bravo!
item:bravo.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:briar-armor.name: Briar Armor
item:briar-armor.description: Battered iron armor from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 10

item:briar-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

item:briar-armor-altered.name: Briar Armor (altered)
item:briar-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Briar Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 7 · Holy 9

item:briar-gauntlets.name: Briar Gauntlets
item:briar-gauntlets.description: Battered iron gauntlets from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:briar-gauntlets.location: - The Briar Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar at the Shaded Castle.

item:briar-greatshield.name: Briar Greatshield
item:briar-greatshield.description: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame. Originates from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics.
item:briar-greatshield.location: Defeat Elemer of the Briar in the Shaded Castle.

item:briar-greaves.name: Briar Greaves
item:briar-greaves.description: Battered iron greaves from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:briar-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

item:briar-helm.name: Briar Helm
item:briar-helm.description: Battered iron helm from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of he Brair.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:briar-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar at The Shaded Castle.

item:briars-of-punishment.name: Briars of Punishment
item:briars-of-punishment.description: An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals. Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy. Wounds the caster with thorns of sin, sending a trail of bloodthorns running over the ground to impale enemies from below. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The guilty, their eyes gouged by thorns, lived in eternal darkness. There, they discovered the blood star.

stats.Effect: Wounds caster to unleash trail of bloodthrorns

item:briars-of-sin.name: Briars of Sin
item:briars-of-sin.description: An aberrant sorcery, discovered along with red glintstone by those exiled to the north for their crimes. Summons large thorns from a whorl of blood shed by one's own hand in penance for sins. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The Academy reviles this sorcery, which draws its power from faith.

stats.Effect: Summons thorns from a whorl of your own blood.

item:briars-of-sin-spell.name: Briars of Sin (spell)
item:briars-of-sin-spell.description: It is one of the thorn sorceries.

stats.Effect: Summons thorns from a whorl of your own Blood Loss

item:brick-hammer.name: Brick Hammer
item:brick-hammer.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
item:brick-hammer.location: The Brick Hammer is located in Stormveil Castle.

item:broadsword.name: Broadsword
item:broadsword.description: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.
item:broadsword.location: The Broadsword is the starting weapon for the Confessor class.

item:broken-finger-stalker-contract.name: Broken Finger Stalker Contract
item:broken-finger-stalker-contract.description: Be summoned to worlds invaded by Broken Fingers

item:broken-gold-mask.name: Broken Gold Mask
item:broken-gold-mask.description: A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo, though a piece is now broken off. The attire of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Enhances incantations and skills that harness Causality. Upon the splintering of the Golden Order, so too did these companions part ways. One kept the faith, though the faith itself was broken, while the other fell completely to his own doubts.

item:broken-rune.name: Broken Rune
item:broken-rune.description: Golden traces of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 500 runes. Broken and faded, threatening to dissipate entirely.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 500 runes

item:broken-rune.location: - Found throughout the Realm of Shadow.

item:buckler.name: Buckler
item:buckler.description: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.
item:buckler.location: Bought from Patches after his cave, Limgrave.

item:buckshot-crossbow.name: Buckshot Crossbow
item:buckshot-crossbow.description: A weapon that combines two crossbows to scatter bolts in a wide arc. A crude and inaccurate weapon, yet carries considerable might for those who might wield it.

item:budding-cave-moss.name: Budding Cave Moss
item:budding-cave-moss.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, speckled with tiny, yellow flowers. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:budding-cave-moss.location: Gives off pale light in dark caves

item:budding-horn.name: Budding Horn
item:budding-horn.description: A rarely-seen specimen of a young, budding horn. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting herbivorous beasts.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:bull-goat-armor.name: Bull-Goat Armor
item:bull-goat-armor.description: Great Horned Tragoth's armor. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 20 · Strike 20 · Slash 18 · Pierce 18 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 12

item:bull-goat-armor.location: Found in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:bull-goat-gauntlets.name: Bull-Goat Gauntlets
item:bull-goat-gauntlets.description: Great Horned Tragoth's gauntlets. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:bull-goat-gauntlets.location: - The Bull-Goat Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Great Horned Tragoth at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice after receiving the Letter to Patches.

item:bull-goat-greaves.name: Bull-Goat Greaves
item:bull-goat-greaves.description: Great Horned Tragoth's greaves. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 11 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 8 · Holy 7

item:bull-goat-helm.name: Bull-Goat Helm
item:bull-goat-helm.description: Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 5 · Holy 4

item:bull-goat-helm.location: - Obtained by defeating Great Horned Tragoth during Patches' assassination request in the arena of Magma Wyrm Makar at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

item:bull-goat-s-talisman.name: Bull-Goat's Talisman
item:bull-goat-s-talisman.description: A talisman depicting the horns of a bull-goat. Raises poise.

stats.Effect: Raises Poise

item:bull-goat-s-talisman.location: Found in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:burial-axe.name: Burial Axe
item:burial-axe.description:
Axe of rotted bronze. A burial gift devoted to the deaths of heroes. Pieces of meat clinging to the blade have
begun to form into mortuary wax.

item:burial-crow-s-letter.name: Burial Crow's Letter
item:burial-crow-s-letter.description: A letter affixed to a graveyard crow's leg. Sought after by Kalé.

stats.Effect: Letter affixed to a graveyard crow's leg

item:burn-o-flame.name: Burn, O Flame!
item:burn-o-flame.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the

stats.Effect: Raises a series of flame pillars around caster

item:burred-bolt.name: Burred Bolt
item:burred-bolt.description: Bolt covered in thorns. One of the most horrific weapons used in the Shattering. Afflicts target with blood loss. Difficult to remove once buried in flesh, causing appalling damage to the body.
item:burred-bolt.location: - Sold by the Imprisoned Merchant of Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum for 200 Runes.

item:butchering-knife.name: Butchering Knife
item:butchering-knife.description: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
item:butchering-knife.location: The Butchering Knife is dropped by the NPC invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater.

stats.Effect: Pledge on one's sword

item:caestus.name: Caestus
item:caestus.description: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
item:caestus.location: Purchase the standard Caestus from Gatekeeper Gostoc at Stormveil Castle or the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

item:call-of-tibia.name: Call of Tibia
item:call-of-tibia.description: An ancient ceremonial tool that uses a grave keeper's skull as a catalyst. Craftable item. Uses FP to summon one lost in death at the spot that it is thrown. The creature spins and mows down foes in the vicinity three times before dissipating. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to summon one lost in death

item:calm-down.name: Calm Down!
item:calm-down.location: Confronting Patches by the Scenic Isle
item:calm-down.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:candletree-wooden-shield.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
item:candletree-wooden-shield.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Thought to represent a surreptitious prophecy of cardinal sin, the lit candle-tree design was forbidden.

item:cane-sword.name: Cane Sword
item:cane-sword.description: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn. Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.
item:cane-sword.location: The Cane Sword is located in Leyndell, Royal Capital (or Leyndell, Ashen Capital in the late game).

item:cannon-of-haima.name: Cannon of Haima
item:cannon-of-haima.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Lobs an explosive magic projectile that flies in an arc. Charging enhances potency. Drawn from the conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.

stats.Effect: Lobs an explosive magic projectile in an arc

item:carian-filigreed-crest.name: Carian Filigreed Crest
item:carian-filigreed-crest.description: A talisman adorned with the royal crest.

stats.Effect: Lowers FP consumed by skills

item:carian-filigreed-crest.location: Bought from Iji, or found at the Kingsrealm Ruins.

item:carian-glintblade-staff.name: Carian Glintblade Staff
item:carian-glintblade-staff.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int C

item:carian-glintblade-staff.location: The Carian Glintblade Staff is found on a corpse atop the Highway Lookout Tower in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:carian-glintstone-staff.name: Carian Glintstone Staff
item:carian-glintstone-staff.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.
item:carian-glintstone-staff.location: The Carian Glintstone Staff is located inside the Carian Study Hall in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:carian-grandeur.name: Carian Grandeur
item:carian-grandeur.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Carian Grandeur: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power by up to two levels."Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:carian-greatsword.name: Carian Greatsword
item:carian-greatsword.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.

stats.Effect: Performs sweeping slash using magical greatsword

item:carian-greatsword.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold

item:carian-inverted.name: Carian Inverted Statue
item:carian-inverted.description: Statuette of a scholar, with ground and sky inverted.

stats.Effect: Key revealing the hidden form of Carian Study Hall

item:carian-knight-armor.name: Carian Knight Armor
item:carian-knight-armor.description: Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 11

item:carian-knight-armor.location: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

item:carian-knight-armor-altered.name: Carian Knight Armor (altered)
item:carian-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Carian Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 11

item:carian-knight-gauntlets.name: Carian Knight Gauntlets
item:carian-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:carian-knight-greaves.name: Carian Knight Greaves
item:carian-knight-greaves.description: Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all decorated heroes, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:carian-knight-greaves.location: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

item:carian-knight-helm.name: Carian Knight Helm
item:carian-knight-helm.description: Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:carian-knight-s-shield.name: Carian Knight's Shield
item:carian-knight-s-shield.description: A teardrop-shaped shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family. Excels when facing magic or holy attacks. Just who were these knights preparing to fight?

item:carian-knight-s-sword.name: Carian Knight's Sword
item:carian-knight-s-sword.description: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:carian-knight-s-sword.location: The Carian Knight's Sword is located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:carian-phalanx.name: Carian Phalanx
item:carian-phalanx.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

stats.Effect: Forms a defensive arch of numerous magic glintblades

item:carian-phalanx.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold

item:carian-piercer.name: Carian Piercer
item:carian-piercer.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

stats.Effect: Impales foes with magical greatsword

item:carian-piercer.location: Living Jars south of the Royal Moongazing Grounds

item:carian-regal-scepter.name: Carian Regal Scepter
item:carian-regal-scepter.description: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int B

item:carian-regal-scepter.location: To get the Carian Regal Scepter, you must defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library in Liurnia of the Lakes.
related: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen

item:carian-retaliation.name: Carian Retaliation
item:carian-retaliation.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

stats.Effect: Dispels enemy spells and retaliates with glintblades

item:carian-retaliation.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold

item:carian-slicer.name: Carian Slicer
item:carian-slicer.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

stats.Effect: Performs swift sweeping slash using magical sword

item:carian-slicer.location: Sold by Sellen, or her corpse if her line is finished.

item:carian-sorcery-sword.name: Carian Sorcery Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:carian-sorcery-sword.location: This item can be found in a chest in Castle Ensis after dropping down from Scadu Altus.
item:carian-sorcery-sword.description: One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords. A smaller piercing sword with a slender blade. Formerly used by the Carian knights of old before the full refinement of their sorcerous combat techniques, this armament functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.

item:carian-sovereignty.name: Carian Sovereignty
item:carian-sovereignty.description: Skill: Carian Sovereignty Skill passed down the Carian royal family. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and bring it down. Additional input follows up with a horizontal sweep. Charge either attack to enhance potency.

item:carian-thrusting-shield.name: Carian Thrusting Shield

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:carian-thrusting-shield.location: Found on a corpse in the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse's back section, reached from the Church District. The shield is found by going past the tall ladder. It is guarded by a Fire Knight.
item:carian-thrusting-shield.description: Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combat—a demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree.

item:carian-troll-greatsword.name: Carian Troll Greatsword
item:carian-troll-greatsword.description: The Carian Troll Greatsword was a Colossal Sword that was.

item:carrier-pigeon-letter-1.name: Carrier Pigeon Letter [1]
item:carrier-pigeon-letter-1.description:
Letter addressed to someone: Confirmed traces of silvery slime in the
ruins in front of Stormgate. Found on the soldiers' camp supplies.

stats.Effect: Letter concerning traces of silvery slime found

item:carrier-pigeon-letter-1.location: This item is cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:carrier-pigeon-letter-2.name: Carrier Pigeon Letter [2]
item:carrier-pigeon-letter-2.description:
Letter addressed to someone: Traces of silvery slime found on
Godwyn's Highroad. Just after until the procession with the
big coffin passed by.

stats.Effect: Letter concerning traces of silvery slime found

item:carrier-pigeon-letter-2.location: This item is cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:castle-cross-message.name: Castle Cross Message
item:castle-cross-message.description:
Message left by Needle Knight Leda, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail. "Kind Miquella seeks the tower sealed by shadow,
and the Gate of Divinity found there. If we are to reach him,
we must burn the tree that seals the path. And for that we require a flame."

stats.Effect:
Message left for the author's compatriots
Examine using

item:castle-cross-message.location: Miquella's Cross near the Castle Ensis

item:casual-greeting.name: Casual Greeting
item:casual-greeting.location: Received from Great Horned Tragoth when summoning him as a Co-operator against Magma Wyrm Makar, Draconic Tree Sentinel or Starscourge Radahn.
item:casual-greeting.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:catch-flame.name: Catch Flame
item:catch-flame.description: Incantation originating from a sinister prophecy. Momentarily sparks flame from the caster's hand. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action. The flame of ruin is anathema to the Erdtree. But prophets sometimes glimpse it within the faith all the same. Sadly when this occurs their sole reward is banishment.

stats.Effect: Momentarily sparks flame from hand

item:caterpillar-mask.name: Caterpillar Mask
item:caterpillar-mask.description: Grotesque mask constructed from countless solidified caterpillars. A ritual implement of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. Used to ward off thoughts of impurity, doubt, temptation, and other wickednesses one is vulnerable to while absorbed in divine ritual.

item:cave-moss.name: Cave Moss
item:cave-moss.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves. Material used in crafting items. A fundamental ingredient for medicinal boluses.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:cave-moss.location: Gives off pale light in dark caves

item:celebrant-s-cleaver.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
item:celebrant-s-cleaver.description: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-cleaver.location: The Celebrant's Cleaver is obtained by farming dancing celebrating women enemies in Dominula, Windmill Village located at the northern edge of the Altus Plateau.

item:celebrant-s-rib-rake.name: Celebrant's Rib-Rake
item:celebrant-s-rib-rake.description: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-rib-rake.location: The Celebrant's Rib-Rake is a rare drop found by defeating specific dancing celebrant enemies in Windmill Village (Dominula) located in the northern Altus Plateau.

item:celebrant-s-sickle.name: Celebrant's Sickle
item:celebrant-s-sickle.description: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-sickle.location: You can get the Celebrant's Sickle in Elden Ring as a rare drop from blue-garbed dancing enemies at Dominula, Windmill Village on the northern Altus Plateau.

item:celebrant-s-skull.name: Celebrant's Skull
item:celebrant-s-skull.description: Large bludgeon ecorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
item:celebrant-s-skull.location: The Celebrant's Skull in Elden Ring is found on a corpse at Dominula, Windmill Village in the Altus Plateau.

item:celestial-dew.name: Celestial Dew
item:celestial-dew.description: A hidden Tear found in the Eternal City. Also known as a Night Tear.

stats.Effect: Carry out Absolution at the Church of Vows

item:cerulean-amber-medallion.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
item:cerulean-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with cerulean amber inlaid. Boosts maximum FP.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum FP

item:cerulean-amber-medallion.location: - Obtained by defeating the Bloodhound Knight in Lakeside Crystal Cave in southern Liurnia of the Lakes

item:cerulean-amber-medallion-1.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +1
item:cerulean-amber-medallion-1.location: - Obtained from a corpse hanging from a wooden platform attached to the southern wall of Castle Sol, in Mountaintops of the Giants. From Church of the Eclipse, head left to the front of the church, left through a door, right, up a ladder, southwest to a tower, which can be circled around, via a wooden platform, and down a ladder, to the wall in question. The corpse is guarded by a phantom knight, wielding dual swords.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises maximum FP

item:cerulean-amber-medallion-2.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +2
item:cerulean-amber-medallion-2.location: - Obtained from a chest, in the cellar of Lunar Estate Ruins, in southern Liurnia of the Lakes. This area of Liurnia can only be accessed from underground, after progressing through Grand Cloister. The cellar is hidden beneath an illusory floor, and locked behind an imp statue that requires one Stonesword Key to open.

stats.Effect: Vastly raises maximum FP

item:cerulean-amber-medallion-3.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +3
item:cerulean-amber-medallion-3.description: Boosts maximum FP by the utmost
item:cerulean-amber-medallion-3.location: - Obtained as a reward after defeating the Death Knight in Scorpion River Catacombs.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum FP

item:cerulean-crystal-tear.name: Cerulean Crystal Tear
item:cerulean-crystal-tear.description: A special crystallization formed over the course of many moons within a tear of life, a blessing of the Erdtree. Can be mixed in a flask of wondrous physick. The resulting concoction restores 20 half of one's max FP.

stats.Effect: Restores half of total FP in mixed physick.

item:cerulean-hidden-tear.name: Cerulean Hidden Tear
item:cerulean-hidden-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Eliminates all FP consumption in mixed physick

item:cerulean-hidden-tear.location: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit at the Minor Erdtree on Mt. Gelmir.

item:cerulean-sapping-cracked-tear.name: Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear
item:cerulean-sapping-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily restores FP upon landing attacks.

stats.Effect: Grants attacks FP-restoring effect in mixed physick

item:cerulean-sapping-cracked-tear.location: Defeat the Furnace Golem in Scadu Altus.

item:cerulean-seed-talisman.name: Cerulean Seed Talisman
item:cerulean-seed-talisman.description: A cerulean-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Boosts FP restoration from the Flask of Cerulean Tears.

stats.Effect: Boosts FP restoration from Flask of Cerulean Tears

item:cerulean-seed-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Carian Study Hall, in easter Liurnia of the Lakes, without the Carian Inverted Statue placed on the altar. The corpse can be found on the upper-most level of rafters in the tower, which you can climb to with ladders.

item:cerulean-seed-talisman-1.name: Cerulean Seed Talisman +1
item:cerulean-seed-talisman-1.description: Greatly boosts FP restoration from Flask of Cerulean Tears

stats.Effect: Boosts FP restoration from the Flask of Cerulean Tears

item:cerulean-tear-scarab.name: Cerulean Tear Scarab
item:cerulean-tear-scarab.description: Blue scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.

stats.Negation: Physical -5 · Strike -5 · Slash -5 · Pierce -5 · Magic -4 · Fire -4 · Lightning -4 · Holy -5

item:chain-armor.name: Chain Armor
item:chain-armor.description: Armor made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 7 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:chain-coif.name: Chain Coif
item:chain-coif.description: Coif made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:chain-draped-tabard.name: Chain-Draped Tabard
item:chain-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:chain-draped-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

item:chain-gauntlets.name: Chain Gauntlets
item:chain-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:chain-gauntlets.location: - The Chain Gauntlets can be purchased from Merchant Kalé for 1,000 runes.

item:chain-leggings.name: Chain Leggings
item:chain-leggings.description: Leggings made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:chainlink-flail.name: Chainlink Flail
item:chainlink-flail.description: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.
item:chainlink-flail.location: The Chainlink Flail drops from Lesser Mad Pumpkin Head enemies who wield it.

item:champion-bracers.name: Champion Bracers
item:champion-bracers.description: Bracers reserved for the bandlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:champion-gaiters.name: Champion Gaiters
item:champion-gaiters.description: Gaiters formed only of leather straps

item:champion-gauntlets.name: Champion Gauntlets
item:champion-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 1 · Fire 1 · Lightning 1 · Holy 1

item:champion-gauntlets.location: Starting armwear of the Hero origin; also sold by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Caelid.

item:champion-headband.name: Champion Headband
item:champion-headband.description: Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:champion-pauldron.name: Champion Pauldron
item:champion-pauldron.description: Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 8 · Slash 6 · Pierce 7 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 9 · Holy 8

item:champion-s-song-painting.name: "Champion's Song" Painting
item:champion-s-song-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Champion's Song." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "Champion's Song"
Examine using

item:charge-forth.name: Charge Forth
item:charge-forth.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Charge Forth: Quickly charge forward with the armament at the hip, carrying the momentum into a thrust. Hold to cover a greater distance."Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.
item:charge-forth.location: North of the Fallen Ruins of the Lake

stats.Effect: ash

item:charming-branch.name: Charming Branch
item:charming-branch.description: Branch blessed with an incantation of unalloyed gold. Craftable item. Uses FP to stab an enemy, charming it and the surrounding enemies. Charmed enemies act as your allies for a short while. Those who would otherwise be at each other's throats are united in service to Miquella—as long as the charm that binds them remains intact.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to charm stabbed enemy and surrounding enemies

item:cherishing-fingers.name: Cherishing Fingers
item:cherishing-fingers.description: A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, aspiring mother of fingers. Surrounds the caster with a mesh of hefty fingers that wards all manner of projectiles, whether magical or physical in nature, away from the caster. Charging enhances potency. The dear fingers look after their mother, or perhaps that is merely what the mother wishes to believe.

stats.Effect: Surrounds the caster with a mesh of hefty fingers

item:chilling-mist.name: Chilling Mist
item:chilling-mist.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:"Chilling Mist: Coat armament in frost, and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards. The armament retains its frost for a while."Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:chilling-perfume-bottle.name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
item:chilling-perfume-bottle.location: Found on a corpse inside the Lamenter's Gaol.
item:chilling-perfume-bottle.description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing an icy chill. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.

item:chrysalids-memento.name: Chrysalids' Memento
item:chrysalids-memento.description: Memento left by the chrysalids sacrificed for grafting. A brooch wrapped in red velvet. Traces of blood are visible.

stats.Effect: Broach wrapped in red velvet

item:cinquedea.name: Cinquedea
item:cinquedea.description: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.
item:cinquedea.location: The Cinquedea is located on a broken statue at the bottom of the exterior cliffs behind the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.

item:cipher-pata.name: Cipher Pata
item:cipher-pata.description: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.
item:cipher-pata.location: The Cipher Pata is located in the Roundtable Hold.

item:circlet-of-light.name: Circlet of Light
item:circlet-of-light.description: The circlet of light which adorned Miquella's head as he returned in divine aspect. It has begun to fade into nothingness. Slightly boosts intelligence, faith, and arcane, while also boosting the power of Miquella's light. This circle was to be the very foundation upon which Miquella's age of compassion would be built, should it have ever come to pass.

item:clarifying-boluses.name: Clarifying Boluses
item:clarifying-boluses.description: Yellow boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates madness buildup. Madness accumulates slowly, inflicting heavy damage and reducing FP once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such events.

stats.Effect: Alleviates madness buildup

item:clarifying-boluses.location: Craftable — Dewkissed Herba x2, Crystal Cave Moss x1, Eye of Yelough x1

item:clarifying-cured-meat.name: Clarifying Cured Meat
item:clarifying-cured-meat.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a purple medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts focus. Higher focus helps to mitigate the buildup of sleep and madness.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts focus

item:clarifying-cured-meat.location: Craftable — Rimed Rowa x5, Sliver of Meat x1, Slumbering Egg x1, Eye of Yelough x1

item:clarifying-horn-charm.name: Clarifying Horn Charm
item:clarifying-horn-charm.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Raises focus. (Focus governs resistance to sleep and madness.)

stats.Effect: Raises Focus

item:clarifying-horn-charm.location: - Obtained from a corpse, lying on the stairs in northern Siofra River, near the Beneath the Well Sites of Grace (this is the entrance area to the region if using the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid).

item:clarifying-horn-charm-1.name: Clarifying Horn Charm +1
item:clarifying-horn-charm-1.location: - Obtained from a corpse, in Siofra River, accessed from Nokron, Eternal City. From Mimic Tear, head northeast along the aqueduct, to the spot where it collapses to the left, onto the field below. Head down here, and northeast again, to drop down to the lower level of the aqueduct. Continue to the end of the aqueduct, and drop down several levels of broken floor, to the bottom of the building below, where the corpse can be found.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises focus

item:clarifying-horn-charm-2.name: Clarifying Horn Charm +2
item:clarifying-horn-charm-2.location: - Clarifying Horn Charm +2 is found in the Lamenter's Gaol. Drop down into a rat-infested area and take the straight path forward. The talisman is located in the next area on a corpse along the right side.

stats.Effect: Raises Focus by +180

item:clarifying-white-cured-meat.name: Clarifying White Cured Meat
item:clarifying-white-cured-meat.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a purple medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts focus

item:claw-talisman.name: Claw Talisman
item:claw-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a claw and an assassin. Enhances jump attacks.

stats.Effect: Enhances jump attacks.

item:claw-talisman.location: Found on a corpse on the Stormveil cliffside route.

item:clawmark-seal.name: Clawmark Seal
item:clawmark-seal.description: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength. The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.
item:clawmark-seal.location: You get the Clawmark Seal by taking a Deathroot to Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman, located at the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.

item:claws-of-night.name: Claws of Night
item:claws-of-night.location: Dropped by Swordhand of Night Anna in the Finger Ruins of Miyr.
item:claws-of-night.description: Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night. Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against.

item:clayman-ashes.name: Clayman Ashes
item:clayman-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two claymen. Bowed with age, these spirits are sluggish but hard to stagger. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.

stats.Effect: Summons two clayman spirits

item:clayman-ashes.location: Found in the northern Uhl Palace Ruins on a corpse at the top of the waterfall.

item:clayman-s-harpoon.name: Clayman's Harpoon
item:clayman-s-harpoon.description: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:clayman-s-harpoon.location: The Clayman's Harpoon is a rare drop farmed from Clayman enemies wielding spears.

item:claymore.name: Claymore
item:claymore.description: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust making this a versatile weapon.
item:claymore.location: The Claymore is located in Castle Morne, situated at the southernmost tip of the Weeping Peninsula.

item:cleanrot-armor.name: Cleanrot Armor
item:cleanrot-armor.description: Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 13 · Slash 16 · Pierce 17 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 11 · Holy 13

item:cleanrot-armor.location: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-armor-altered.name: Cleanrot Armor (altered)
item:cleanrot-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 12 · Slash 14 · Pierce 16 · Magic 11 · Fire 12 · Lightning 10 · Holy 13

item:cleanrot-armor-altered.location: It can be altered at a

item:cleanrot-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:cleanrot-gauntlets.location: - The Cleanrot Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-greaves.name: Cleanrot Greaves
item:cleanrot-greaves.description: Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 7 · Slash 9 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:cleanrot-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-helm.name: Cleanrot Helm
item:cleanrot-helm.description: Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:cleanrot-helm.location: - The Cleanrot Helm has a 3.0% chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

item:cleanrot-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Helm

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:cleanrot-helm-altered.location: Obtained by altering the Cleanrot Helm at a

item:cleanrot-knight-finlay.name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay
item:cleanrot-knight-finlay.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of the Cleanrot Knight Finlay. Finlay was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Aeonia, who in an unimaginable act of heroism carried the slumbering demigod Malenia all the way back to the Haligtree. She managed the feat alone, fending off all manner of foes along the way.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay

item:cleanrot-knight-finlay.location: In a treasure chest at Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, guarded by a Cleanrot Knight. Located north of the Prayer Room grace on a rooftop that you need to jump down to from a rafter.

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay

She managed the feat alone, fending off all manner of foes along the way.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay

item:cleanrot-knight-finlay-ashes.location: In a treasure chest at Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, guarded by a Cleanrot Knight. Located north of the Prayer Room grace on a rooftop that you need to jump down to from a rafter.

item:cleanrot-knight-s-sword.name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
item:cleanrot-knight-s-sword.description: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.
item:cleanrot-knight-s-sword.location: The Cleanrot Knight's Sword drops from non-boss Cleanrot Knights, most notably in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid or outside the Prayer Room in Elphael.

item:cleanrot-spear.name: Cleanrot Spear
item:cleanrot-spear.description: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:cleanrot-spear.location: The Cleanrot Spear is a random drop from spear-wielding Lesser Cleanrot Knights.

item:clinging-bone.name: Clinging Bone
item:clinging-bone.description: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Arc D

item:clinging-bone.location: To get the Clinging Bone in Elden Ring, you must trigger an invasion by Ensha of the Royal Remains in the Roundtable Hold.

item:cloth-garb.name: Cloth Garb
item:cloth-garb.description: Clothing made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 2 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:cloth-garb.location: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

item:cloth-trousers.name: Cloth Trousers
item:cloth-trousers.description: Trousers made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:cloth-trousers.location: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

item:club.name: Club
item:club.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.
item:club.location: Club: Can be purchased for 600 runes from the Nomadic Merchant on the northwestern beach of West Limgrave.

item:coded-sword.name: Coded Sword
item:coded-sword.description: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.
item:coded-sword.location: The Coded Sword is located in the Leyndell, Royal Capital on the ground floor of a dark, abandoned replica of the Roundtable Hold.

item:coil-shield.name: Coil Shield
item:coil-shield.description: An extremely odd shield adorned with a coiled bronze snake. An excellent choice for attention-seekers. This Shield provides an effective defense against poison - after all, how does one poison a poisonous snake?
item:coil-shield.location: Found on a corpse within one of the tunnel rooms in Volcano Cave on Mt. Gelmir. Take the tunnel to the right of the chamber past the grace and drop down the ledge to find the tunnel to the shield.

item:coldbone-arrow.name: Coldbone Arrow
item:coldbone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow with frozen tip

stats.Effect: Animal bone arrow with frozen tip

item:coldbone-arrow-fletched.name: Coldbone Arrow (Fletched)
item:coldbone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched bone arrow with frozen tip
item:coldbone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Fletched bone arrow with frozen tip

item:coldbone-bolt.name: Coldbone Bolt
item:coldbone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt with frozen tip

stats.Effect: Animal bone bolt with frozen tip

item:collapsing-stars.name: Collapsing Stars
item:collapsing-stars.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

stats.Effect: Pulls foes toward caster with gravity projectile volley

item:comet.name: Comet
item:comet.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a great magical comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The greatest of the Karolos Conspectus's sorceries, that only a very few sorcerers have ever mastered.

stats.Effect: Fires a great magic comet

item:comet-azur.name: Comet Azur
item:comet-azur.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Azur, primeval sorcerer. Fires a tremendous comet in a torrent akin to the distant starry expanse, the place said to be the origin of glintstone. Hold to continue releasing the sorcery's power. When Azur glimpsed into the primeval current, he saw darkness. He was left both bewitched and fearful of the abyss.

stats.Effect: Fires a tremendous comet within a starry torrent

item:comet-azur.location: Primeval Sorcerer Azur on the cliff after Hermit Village. Starts Sellen’s primeval ending.

item:commander-s-standard.name: Commander's Standard
item:commander-s-standard.description: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd. Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.
item:commander-s-standard.location: The Commander's Standard is dropped by Commander O'Neil, a world boss located in the heart of the Swamp of Aeonia in central Caelid.

item:common-soldier-cloth-armor.name: Common Soldier Cloth Armor
item:common-soldier-cloth-armor.description: Cloth armor of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

item:common-soldier-gauntlets.name: Common Soldier Gauntlets
item:common-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

item:common-soldier-greaves.name: Common Soldier Greaves
item:common-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

item:common-soldier-helm.name: Common Soldier Helm
item:common-soldier-helm.description: Helm of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

item:commoner-s-garb.name: Commoner's Garb
item:commoner-s-garb.description: Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:commoner-s-garb.location: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.

item:commoner-s-garb-altered.name: Commoner's Garb (altered)
item:commoner-s-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Garb

Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:cranial-vessel-candlestand.location: The Cranial Vessel Candlestand is found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave dungeon in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:crepus-s-black-key-crossbow.description: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.
item:crepus-s-black-key-crossbow.location: You can find Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow at the Roundtable Hold, behind a Stonesword Key fog wall downstairs from the blacksmith.

item:crepus-s-vial.name: Crepus's Vial
item:crepus-s-vial.description: Small mysterious bottle with a dark mist sealed within.

stats.Effect: Eliminates all sound made by the wearer during movement

item:crepus-s-vial.location: - Obtained by killing Rileigh the Idle, in Altus Plateau, after invading their world to complete the second Volcano Manor assassination.

item:crescent-moon-axe.name: Crescent Moon Axe
item:crescent-moon-axe.description: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.
item:crescent-moon-axe.location: The Crescent Moon Axe is a rare drop from the larger, axe-wielding Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle.

item:crimson-amber-medallion.name: Crimson Amber Medallion
item:crimson-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with Crimson amber inlaid. Boosts maximum HP. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside

stats.Effect: Raises maximum HP

item:crimson-amber-medallion.location: Runes from the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart

item:crimson-amber-medallion-1.name: Crimson Amber Medallion +1
item:crimson-amber-medallion-1.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Volcano Manor, in the Mt. Gelmir region. From Prison Town Church, head out the eastern door, and right. Proceed along the main path through the town, past an Iron Virgin until reaching a brick courtyard, in front of a building whose door is locked by a semi-transparent fog wall. Unlock this door by giving one Stonesword Key to the adjacent imp statue, and head up the spiral staircase inside this building. The corpse can be found on this upper landing.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises maximum HP

item:crimson-amber-medallion-2.name: Crimson Amber Medallion +2
item:crimson-amber-medallion-2.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, in the Leyndell, Royal Capital region. This corpse can only be reached after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, as the sewer hole that leads to the corpse is only uncovered in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. Once the area is available, head south from Leyndell, Capital of Ash to find the sewer hole, in a small valley where ash has not covered up the capital grounds, and drop down to find the corpse, hanging over a beam.

stats.Effect: Vastly raises maximum HP

item:crimson-amber-medallion-3.name: Crimson Amber Medallion +3
item:crimson-amber-medallion-3.description: Boosts maximum HP by the utmost

stats.Effect: Vastly raises maximum HP

The resulting concoction automatically heals one's HP in the moment before death. However, this effect only occurs once, and will expire after a certain duration.

stats.Effect: Restores HP when near death in mixed physick.

item:crimson-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction restores half of one's maximum HP.

stats.Effect: Restores half of total HP in mixed physick

stats.Effect: Converts damage received into HP in mixed physick.

Make your way to the area where two chariots ride side-by-side, up and down a slope. At the bottom of this slope is a corpse, hanging off of a ledge above a pit. Drop into the pit from where this corpse lies to land on a beam, and continue dropping down into this pit, until landing on the top of a thin stone archway. Walk to the end of this archway and climb a ladder to reach another ramp, guarded by a single chariot.

item:crucible-gauntlets.name: Crucible Gauntlets
item:crucible-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations. It is said Devonia quested in search of the Crucible's origin, and departed from the lands of the Erdtree alone.

item:crucible-hornshield.name: Crucible Hornshield
item:crucible-hornshield.description: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn. An ancient holiness dwells within. The crucible horn skewers foes when performing shield bashes.

item:crucible-knot-talisman.name: Crucible Knot Talisman
item:crucible-knot-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from a bony knot that embodies that aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.

stats.Effect: Reduces damage and impact of headshots

item:crucible-knot-talisman.location: - Obtained by killing the Omenkiller boss in Village of the Albinaurics, in southern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:crucible-scale-talisman.name: Crucible Scale Talisman
item:crucible-scale-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from a scale that embodies the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.

stats.Effect: Reduces damage taken from critical hits

item:crucible-scale-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Leyndell Catacombs, in the Leyndell, Royal Capital region. The corpse is guarded by an Omen, which can be reached by lowering a fire-breathing pillar, and riding it back upward to reach the upper-level of the room.

item:crystal-bud.description: A young plant, crystalized before it could mature. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:crystal-bud.location: - Found widely across Liurnia of the Lakes, typically near trees.

item:crystal-burst.name: Crystal Burst
item:crystal-burst.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. item:crystal-cave-moss.name: Crystal Cave Moss
item:crystal-cave-moss.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, laced with fine crystals. Material used for crafting items.

item:crystal-cave-moss.location: Gives off pale light in dark caves

item:crystal-dart.name: Crystal Dart
item:crystal-dart.description: Throwing knife chiseled from impure crystal. Craftable item. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to deal magic damage. Long ago, it is said that a golem crafter employed a similar crystal tool.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw to inflict magic damage.

item:crystal-knife.description: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners. Used as a tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.

stats.Effect: Scours area with violent rain of crystal shards

item:crystal-spear.name: Crystal Spear
item:crystal-spear.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.
