One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E

item:crystal-spear.location: The Crystal Spear is hidden in Sellia Hideaway in northeastern Caelid.

item:crystal-staff.name: Crystal Staff
item:crystal-staff.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceris. The Crystalian's faint cognition is know as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be weilded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.
item:crystal-staff.location: The standard Crystal Staff is found inside the Academy Crystal Cave in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:crystal-sword.name: Crystal Sword
item:crystal-sword.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:crystal-sword.location: The Crystal Sword is located in the Village of the Albinaurics in the southwestern area of Liurnia of the Lakes.

stats.Effect: Creates crystal mass that fires stream of crystal shards

item:crystalian-ashes.name: Crystalian Ashes
item:crystalian-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Crystalian. Spirit that wields round crystalline blades, both big and small. Its sturdy body, itself hewn from crystal long ago, is hard enough to blunt its opponent's blades, but blows from bludgeoning weapons can shatter it easily.

stats.Effect: Summons Crystalian spirit

item:crystalian-ashes.location: Found in Sellia Hideaway, in a chest guarded by Glintstone Sorcerers.

item:cuckoo-glintstone.name: Cuckoo Glintstone
item:cuckoo-glintstone.description: Lump of broken glintstone enwreathed with magic power. A "faux sorcery"used by the Knights of the Cuckoo. Craftable item. Launched straight ahead, using FP. A magic bolt springs forth from the point of impact

stats.Effect: Uses FP to produce a magic bolt

item:cuckoo-greatshield.name: Cuckoo Greatshield
item:cuckoo-greatshield.description: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself
item:cuckoo-greatshield.location: - 4% chance to be dropped by Cuckoo Knights throughout Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:cuckoo-knight-armor.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor
item:cuckoo-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 10

item:cuckoo-knight-armor.location: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-knight-armor-altered.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor (altered)
item:cuckoo-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cuckoo Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 9

item:cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.name: Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets
item:cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-knight-greaves.name: Cuckoo Knight Greaves
item:cuckoo-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:cuckoo-knight-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-knight-helm.name: Cuckoo Knight Helm
item:cuckoo-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:cuckoo-knight-helm.location: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

item:cuckoo-surcoat.name: Cuckoo Surcoat
item:cuckoo-surcoat.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. The surcoat depicts twinned cuckoos peering into a flourishing mass of glintstone. To a glintstone sorcerer, the body is a transient thing. The Cuckoo alone knows its insignificance, yet watches over it all the same.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 10 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 11 · Fire 10 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:cuckoo-surcoat.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Soldier enemies.

item:cure-poison.name: Cure Poison
item:cure-poison.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

stats.Effect: Cures Poison ailment and reduces poison build-up.

item:curseblade-mask.name: Curseblade Mask
item:curseblade-mask.description: A mask affixed with a crown of tangled horns, worn by those who would invoke divinity. Divine invocation heightens the dexterity of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this mask.
item:curseblade-mask.location: - The Curseblade Mask has a 3.00% chance to drop from Curseblades.

item:curseblade-meera.name: Curseblade Meera
item:curseblade-meera.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Curseblade Meera. Attacks immediately after being summoned. Curseblades appear to dance when they spin their shimmering circular blades. These ascetics, who failed to become tutelary deities, were a scourge for those who attempted to invade the hornsent homeland. Long ago, before the land was overshadowed by invasion, this scourge was shunned, and the curseblades were imprisoned. It was during this confinement that Meera met Labirith, and upon her death, Labirith was plunged into a devastating darkness.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Curseblade Meera

item:curseblade-meera.location: - Dropped by Curseblade Labirith at the end of Bonny Gaol.

item:curseblade-s-cirque.name: Curseblade's Cirque
item:curseblade-s-cirque.location: It has a 3% chance to be dropped when defeating a Curseblade anywhere in the Realm of Shadow, except for the one perched up on a beam inside the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, which has a 2% to drop this item instead.
item:curseblade-s-cirque.description: Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss. Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.

item:cursed-blood-pot.name: Cursed-Blood Pot
item:cursed-blood-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Decorated with the crest of the Lord of Blood. Throw at enemies to douse them in accursed blood, causing summoned spirits to assail them with a rabid fervor. A childhood memory of the Lord of Blood.

stats.Effect: Throw to douse enemy with accursed blood.

item:cursed-blood-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x2, Beast Blood x1, Bloodrose x1, Ritual Pot x1

item:cursemark-of-death.name: Cursemark of Death
item:cursemark-of-death.description: Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch. Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede.

stats.Effect: Cursemark carved into Lunar Princess Ranni's discarded flesh

item:curtsy.name: Curtsy
item:curtsy.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:curved-club.name: Curved Club
item:curved-club.description: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.
item:curved-club.location: The Curved Club is a farmable weapon dropped by Albinaurics wielding it in the Liurnia of the Lakes region.

item:curved-great-club.name: Curved Great Club
item:curved-great-club.description: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.
item:curved-great-club.location: The Curved Great Club is a farmable drop from the larger Second-Generation Albinaurics (the big gray frog-like creatures) in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:curved-sword-talisman.name: Curved Sword Talisman
item:curved-sword-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a curved sword and a swordsman. Enhances guard counters.

stats.Effect: Enhances guard counters.

item:curved-sword-talisman.location: Found on a corpse inside Stormveil Castle.

item:d-s-bell-bearing.name: D's Bell Bearing
item:d-s-bell-bearing.description: D's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:daedicar-s-woe.name: Daedicar's Woe
item:daedicar-s-woe.description: Disturbing likeness of a woman whose skin was flayed. She smiles with a serene tenderness.

stats.Effect: Increases damage taken

item:dagger.name: Dagger
item:dagger.description: A standard dagger with a straight blade. Though modest in reach and capacity fo harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.
item:dagger.location: You can purchase the basic Dagger for 400 runes from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.
related: Decide whether to hand D the Weathered Dagger

item:dagger-talisman.name: Dagger Talisman
item:dagger-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a dagger and a surgeon. Enhances critical hits.

stats.Effect: Enhances critical hits.

item:dagger-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Volcano Manor, in the Mt. Gelmir region. From the throne room, just before the waygate leading to Audience Pathway, head west up the stairs, and unlock the semi-transparent fog wall there, by inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the adjacent imp statue. Upon reaching the edge of a wooden catwalk, turn immediately right and drop onto a catwalk below. Follow the path out of this room and around it, until you re-enter the room from the opposite side. The corpse is dangling from a wooden catwalk, nearby.

item:dancer-s-bracer.name: Dancer's Bracer
item:dancer-s-bracer.description: Metal bracer of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks. Designed to protect the sword-wielding hand.

item:dancer-s-castanets.name: Dancer's Castanets
item:dancer-s-castanets.description: Castanets used by dancers from foreign lands. Received from Patches. The passionate dance comprises no seductiveness, but merely a dignified beauty.

stats.Effect: Castanets used by dancers from distant lands

item:dancer-s-dress.name: Dancer's Dress
item:dancer-s-dress.description: Bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks. The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on. To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

item:dancer-s-dress-altered.name: Dancer's Dress (Altered)
item:dancer-s-dress-altered.description: Altered form of the bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers. These are the black undergarments worn beneath. Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

item:dancer-s-hood.name: Dancer's Hood
item:dancer-s-hood.description: Bright-red hood of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks. The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on. To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

item:dancer-s-trousers.name: Dancer's Trousers
item:dancer-s-trousers.description: Long, black trousers worn underneath the bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

item:dancing-blade-of-ranah.name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
item:dancing-blade-of-ranah.location: Can be obtained when dropped by the Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.
item:dancing-blade-of-ranah.description: Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Used by the dancers of Ranah. Strikes enemies with a dancing assault when executing a strong attack.

item:dane-s-footwork.name: Dane's Footwork
item:dane-s-footwork.location: Looted from Dryleaf Dane's corpse after the battle in the Cleansing Chamber of Enir-Ilim. He lies next to the door forward.
item:dane-s-footwork.description: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques. This kick-based martial art is unique to Dane, a Dryleaf and sworn ally of Leda. He acquired these skills by training with the aid of a waterfall; letting the water beat his body, and throwing himself into its basin.

item:dane-s-hat.name: Dane's Hat
item:dane-s-hat.description: The sun-faded and lightly soiled hat of Dryleaf Dane. Worn low over the eyes, it obscures the wearer's vision. Meeting the gaze of another can overcome the senses, often leading to the downfall of those who would walk the noble and solitary seekers' path.

item:dappled-cured-meat.name: Dappled Cured Meat
item:dappled-cured-meat.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a dappled medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts Immunity, Robustness, and Focus

item:dappled-cured-meat.location: Craftable — Golden Rowa x5, Sliver of Meat x1, Budding Horn x1, Nascent Butterfly x1

item:dappled-white-cured-meat.name: Dappled White Cured Meat
item:dappled-white-cured-meat.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a dappled medicinal solution. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts immunity, robustness, and focus

item:dappled-white-cured-meat.location: Craftable — Golden Rowa x5, Strip of White Flesh x1, Budding Horn x1, Nascent Butterfly x1

item:dark-moon-greatsword.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
item:dark-moon-greatsword.description: A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int C

item:dark-moon-ring.name: Dark Moon Ring
item:dark-moon-ring.description: Ring depicting a leaden full moon. Symbolic of a cold oath, the ring is supposed to be given by Lunar Princess Ranni to her consort.

stats.Effect: Ring of Lunar Princess Ranni's cold oath

item:darkness.name: Darkness
item:darkness.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the

stats.Effect: Creates area of darkness that conceals caster

item:darkness.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Assassin's Prayerbook

item:deadly-poison-perfume-bottle.name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
item:deadly-poison-perfume-bottle.description: Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing deadly poison. There are some techniques of the perfuming arts that employ poison. Upon learning of this, Thiollier threw himself into mastering those techniques, and he made them his own.

item:death-knight-armor.name: Death Knight Armor
item:death-knight-armor.description: Golden armor of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree. Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.

item:death-knight-gauntlets.name: Death Knight Gauntlets
item:death-knight-gauntlets.description: Golden gauntlets of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree. Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.

item:death-knight-greaves.name: Death Knight Greaves
item:death-knight-greaves.description: Golden greaves of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree. Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.

item:death-knight-helm.name: Death Knight Helm
item:death-knight-helm.description: Golden helm of the Death Knights, whose own death masks served as the visards of their armor. Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The decayed golden wheel that adorns it represents their unbroken loyalty to Godwyn, he who became Prince of Death.

item:death-knight-s-longhaft-axe.name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:death-knight-s-longhaft-axe.location: This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight of the Scorpion River Catacombs.
item:death-knight-s-longhaft-axe.description: A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.

item:death-knight-s-twin-axes.name: Death Knight's Twin Axes

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:death-knight-s-twin-axes.description: Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.

item:death-lightning.name: Death Lightning
item:death-lightning.description: Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon

stats.Effect: Strikes surroundings with storm of death lightning

item:death-mask-helm.name: Death Mask Helm
item:death-mask-helm.description: Helm of Wego, elder among the Fire Knights. Two warped death masks stacked one atop the other. Reduces FP used to summon spirits. Gnawed at by loneliness, the old man turned his attention to the spirituality of Messmer's flame, using it in a rite of resurrection. Yet the soulless bodies he brought to life were no comfort to poor Wego.

item:death-ritual-spear.name: Death Ritual Spear
item:death-ritual-spear.description: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:death-ritual-spear.location: The Death Ritual Spear is dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:death-s-poker.name: Death's Poker
item:death-s-poker.description: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:death-s-poker.location: The Death's Poker is a guaranteed drop from the Death Rite Bird located in Caelid.

item:deathbed-dress.name: Deathbed Dress
item:deathbed-dress.description: Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead. Slowly replenishes the HP of nearby allies, but not that of the wearer. The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while still sharing her warmth.
item:deathbed-dress.location: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church

item:deathbed-smalls.name: Deathbed Smalls
item:deathbed-smalls.description: Skirt worn by Phia, the Deathbed Companion.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:deathbed-smalls.location: - It is Unused Content from Deathbed Set. It cannot be obtained through normal means.

item:deathroot.name: Deathroot
item:deathroot.description: A source that gives rise to Those Who Live in Death.

stats.Effect: Beast Clergyman seeks and devours these

item:deathsbane-jerky.name: Deathsbane Jerky
item:deathsbane-jerky.description:
A grey colored cured liver, dried out
after pickling in a medicinal solution. Craftable item. Boosts instant death resistance
for a short time.

stats.Effect: Boost instant death resistance for a short time

item:deathsbane-white-jerky.name: Deathsbane White Jerky
item:deathsbane-white-jerky.description:
A black-gold colored cured liver,
dried out after pickling in a medicinal solution. Craftable item. Boosts resistance to instant death
for a short time. The blood has been properly drained,
giving it a longer effect than traditional
dried meat.

stats.Effect: Boost instant death resistance for a short time

item:dectus-medallion-left.name: Dectus Medallion (Left)
item:dectus-medallion-left.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus

item:dectus-medallion-right.name: Dectus Medallion (Right)
item:dectus-medallion-right.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus

item:deep-purple-lily.name: Deep-Purple Lily
item:deep-purple-lily.description: A deep-purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting. Material used for crafting items. Grows in the blue flower field at the coast. Like a syrupy poison, its nectar lulls the imbiber into sweet, velvety sleep.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:deep-purple-lily.location: One may be harvested near the Ellac River Cave

item:deflecting-hardtear.name: Deflecting Hardtear
item:deflecting-hardtear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily enhances spontaneous guard. Damage negation and guard poise will be heightened in the moment immediately after assuming a guarding stance. Successfully executing a spontaneous guard will also strengthen guard counters.

stats.Effect: Enhances spontaneous guard in mixed physick

item:deflecting-hardtear.location: Defeat the Furnace Golem in Gravesite Plain.

item:dejection.name: Dejection

stats.Effect: Slump to the floor

item:dejection.location: Available from the start of the game.

item:demi-human-ashes.name: Demi-Human Ashes
item:demi-human-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five demi-humans.

stats.Effect: Summons five demi-human spirits

item:demi-human-ashes.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in Impaler's Catacombs.

item:demi-human-queen-s-staff.name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff
item:demi-human-queen-s-staff.description: Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence. Sneered at by fools in the academy.
item:demi-human-queen-s-staff.location: You can get the Demi-Human Queen's Staff in Elden Ring by defeating the Demi-Human Queen boss at the Demi-Human Forest Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:demi-human-swordsman-yosh.name: Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh
item:demi-human-swordsman-yosh.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Yosh, the demi-human swordsman. Onze, a master swordsman who devoted himself to the Star-Lined Sword, realized that only ruin awaited at the end of the procession of stars, and imprisoned himself in order to forestall it. However, Yosh, an apprentice who absorbed his technique, stubbornly refused to heed his master's words, and spent his entire life at his side, in defiance of his self-imposed seclusion.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh

item:demi-human-swordsman-yosh.location: Dropped by Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze at Belurat Gaol.

item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan.name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan
item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Carmaan, the depraved perfumer. Depraved perfumers practice their art for themselves alone. Carmaan was a notably formidable perfumer whose strength rivaled that of heroes, and it is said that he was in search of a secret physick of revivification.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Depraved Perfumer Carmaan

item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan.location: Found in Volcano Manor, in a room only accessible by going through the secret passage behind the illusory wall near the start of the dungeon.

item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Carmaan, the depraved perfumer. Carmaan was a notably formidable perfumer whose strength rivaled that of heroes, and it is said that he was in search of a secret physick of revivification.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Depraved Perfumer Carmaan

item:depraved-perfumer-carmaan-ashes.location: Found in Volcano Manor, in a room only accessible by going through the secret passage behind the illusory wall near the start of the dungeon.

item:depraved-perfumer-gloves.name: Depraved Perfumer Gloves

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:depraved-perfumer-gloves.location: - The Depraved Perfumer Gloves have a 3.00% chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:depraved-perfumer-headscarf.name: Depraved Perfumer Headscarf

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:depraved-perfumer-headscarf.location: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:depraved-perfumer-robe.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe
item:depraved-perfumer-robe.description: Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree. These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:depraved-perfumer-robe.location: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:depraved-perfumer-robe-altered.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe (altered)
item:depraved-perfumer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Depraved Perfumer Robe

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:depraved-perfumer-trousers.name: Depraved Perfumer Trousers

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:depraved-perfumer-trousers.location: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

item:deserter-s-cookbook-1.name: Deserter's Cookbook [1]
item:deserter-s-cookbook-1.description: A fugitive deserter's record of crafting techniques. Contains knowledge for surviving in the face of utter scarcity.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:deserter-s-cookbook-2.name: Deserter's Cookbook [2]
item:deserter-s-cookbook-2.description: A fugitive deserter's record of crafting techniques. Contains knowledge for surviving in the face of utter scarcity.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:deserter-s-cookbook-2.location: Unobtainable cut content — a Closed Network Test cookbook later split into the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbooks.

stats.Effect: A prayer borne of despair

item:determination.name: Determination
item:determination.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Determination: A knightly skill. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, powering up your next attack."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: ash

item:devonia-s-hammer.name: Devonia's Hammer

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:devonia-s-hammer.description: Great hammer wielded by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights. Weapon forged of primordial gold, marked by its reddish hue and inhabited by ancient holiness. A torrent of life is engraved upon the striking face.

item:devourer-s-scepter.name: Devourer's Scepter
item:devourer-s-scepter.description: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:dewgem.name: Dewgem
item:dewgem.description: Succulent plant that has supped on night-tinged dew. Material used for crafting items. Glows at night and blossoms mainly at the waterside. Said to have been used in the practice of sprite medicine long ago.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:dewkissed-herba.name: Dewkissed Herba
item:dewkissed-herba.description: A herb that grows in the false night in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:dewkissed-herba.location: Found in and around the Eternal City

item:dexterity-knot-crystal-tear.name: Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear
item:dexterity-knot-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts dexterity in mixed physick

item:dexterity-knot-crystal-tear.location: Found in a bowl on a small island in the southern Liurnia of the Lakes, immediately north-west of the Scenic Isle grace, not far from the southern cliffs. Guarded by some Second-Generation Albinaurics.

item:diallos-mask.name: Diallos's Mask
item:diallos-mask.description: Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments. Only, without the twin tails.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:digger-s-staff.name: Digger's Staff
item:digger-s-staff.description: Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone. Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries
item:digger-s-staff.location: The Digger's Staff drops from Glintstone Miner enemies in locations like the Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid, the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel in Liurnia, and the Altus Tunnel.

item:dirty-chainmail.name: Dirty Chainmail
item:dirty-chainmail.description: Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics. The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefits worthy of note.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:dirty-chainmail.location: -?.??% chance to drop from Young Albinaurics enemies that wear it

item:discarded-palace-key.name: Discarded Palace Key
item:discarded-palace-key.description: A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh. Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses. It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

stats.Effect: Key to treasure chest for Carian Princesses

item:discus-of-light.name: Discus of Light
item:discus-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

stats.Effect: Fires ring of light before the caster

item:dismounter.name: Dismounter
item:dismounter.description: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet. A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.
item:dismounter.location: The Dismounter is a curved greatsword dropped by Kaiden Sellswords.

item:distinguished-greatshield.name: Distinguished Greatshield
item:distinguished-greatshield.description: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

item:divine-beast-frost-stomp.name: Divine Beast Frost Stomp
item:divine-beast-frost-stomp.description: Skill: Divine Beast Frost Stomp A skill which imitates the wrath of the divine beast's dance. Lift a leg up high and stamp it down with great force. Sends a powerful wave of frost straight out along the ground. Can be charged to increase power and range.

item:divine-beast-head.name: Divine Beast Head
item:divine-beast-head.description: Ritual headwear in the form of a divine beast's head, used to perform the lion dance. Worn by the very finest of the sculpted keepers. Alas, it no longer responds to the old woman's earnest prayer. Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this headwear.

item:divine-beast-helm.name: Divine Beast Helm
item:divine-beast-helm.description: A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine beast mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine beast warriors; the chosen of the horned warriors. Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

item:divine-beast-tornado.name: Divine Beast Tornado
item:divine-beast-tornado.description: The tempest of the Dancing Lion, wielded as an incantation. A whirlwind-like twist of the body summons a storm, launching a tornado forward. Charging enhances potency. The majority of divine beasts were gored and hung upon Messmer's spears, then burned in his flame. Those who witnessed the deed likened it to a funeral pyre for the tower itself.

stats.Effect: Summons a storm that launches a tornado forward

item:divine-beast-warrior-armor.name: Divine Beast Warrior Armor
item:divine-beast-warrior-armor.description: Armor of feted horned warriors chosen to become divine beast warriors, adorned with a lion's pelt. Among the divine beast warriors, only those who truly excel at divine invocation become sculpted keepers, and are granted the honor of the lion dance.

item:divine-bird-feathers.name: Divine Bird Feathers
item:divine-bird-feathers.description: A technique of the divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, wielded as an incantation. Spread the arms wide like wings to release a flurry of feathers. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to continue releasing feathers. The divine bird warriors, and indeed this technique, are said to bear resemblance to the golden Crucible.

stats.Effect: Spreads arms like wings and releases a flurry of feathers

item:divine-bird-helm.name: Divine Bird Helm
item:divine-bird-helm.description: A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine bird mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine bird warriors; the very first of all horned warriors. Divine invocation heightens the power of divine bird feathers alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears. Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.
item:divine-bird-helm.location: - The Divine Bird Helm has a 5.00% chance to drop from Divine Bird Warriors.

item:divine-bird-warrior-armor.name: Divine Bird Warrior Armor
item:divine-bird-warrior-armor.description: Armor of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal. The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.
item:divine-bird-warrior-armor.location: - Divine Bird Warrior Armor has a 5.00% chance to drop from Divine Bird Warriors.

item:divine-bird-warrior-gauntlets.name: Divine Bird Warrior Gauntlets
item:divine-bird-warrior-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal. The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.
item:divine-bird-warrior-gauntlets.location: - The Divine Bird Warrior Gauntlets has a 5.00% chance to drop from Divine Bird Warriors.

item:divine-bird-warrior-greaves.name: Divine Bird Warrior Greaves
item:divine-bird-warrior-greaves.description: Greaves of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal. The great, sharp talons increase the force generated by kicks.
item:divine-bird-warrior-greaves.location: - The Divine Bird Warrior Greaves has a 5% chance to drop from Divine Bird Warriors.

item:divine-bird-warrior-ornis.name: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
item:divine-bird-warrior-ornis.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Ornis the divine bird warrior. Spirit of the divine bird warrior from whom the horned warriors claim descent. Clad in golden armor, and granted wings and feathers by divine invocation. Ornis succeeded in taming the divine bird and made its wings his own as he soared through the sky. When he finally fell to earth, he lived on as the guardian deity of the temple quarter.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Divine Bird Warrior Ornis

item:divine-fortification.name: Divine Fortification
item:divine-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

stats.Effect: Increases holy damage negation.

item:dolores-the-sleeping-arrow-puppet.name: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet
item:dolores-the-sleeping-arrow-puppet.description: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow. Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Solores the Sleeping Arrow

item:dolores-the-sleeping-arrow-puppet.location: Can be obtained from Preceptor Seluvis after discovering his secret room and agreeing to take Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli Loux, Warrior. If a different puppet is selected, this one can be bought for 5 Starlight Shards from Seluvis. It can later be found on Pidia's body if the potion was given to someone else.

item:domain-of-dragons-painting.name: "Domain of Dragons" Painting
item:domain-of-dragons-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Domain of Dragons." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "Domain of Dragons"
Examine using

item:double-slash.name: Double Slash
item:double-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Double Slash:Skill of superior swordsmen. Perform a crossing slash attack from a low stance. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks."Usable on swords and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons excepted).

stats.Effect: ash

item:dozing-cross-legged.name: Dozing Cross-Legged
item:dozing-cross-legged.location: Stormveil Castle south-west of the Rampart Tower
item:dozing-cross-legged.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:dragon-communion-flesh.name: Dragon Communion Flesh
item:dragon-communion-flesh.description: A lump of animal flesh with a heat that never cools. Craftable item. Boosts vigor, endurance, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss. An imitation of dragonscale flesh created by human hands, used to sate the hunger of drake warriors—if only briefly.

stats.Effect: Boosts vigor, endurance, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss

item:dragon-communion-grease.name: Dragon Communion Grease
item:dragon-communion-grease.description: Solidified knotgrease made from a sharp gravel-stone mixture. Craftable item. Coats armament, granting a potent anti-dragon effect. The effect lasts only for a short time. A tool of the old Dragon Communion warriors, who were the agents of the ancient dragons' hatred for their lowborn descendants.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, granting potent anti-dragon effect

item:dragon-communion-harpoon.name: Dragon Communion Harpoon
item:dragon-communion-harpoon.description: Harpoon bristling with sharp gravel stones. Craftable item. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy damage. Has an anti-dragon effect. A tool of the old Dragon Communion warriors, who were the agents of the ancient dragons' hatred for their lowborn descendants.

stats.Effect: Throw to inflict damage with anti-dragon effect

item:dragon-communion-seal.name: Dragon Communion Seal
item:dragon-communion-seal.description: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations. The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.
item:dragon-communion-seal.location: The Dragon Communion Seal is located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave dungeon in West Limgrave.

item:dragon-greatclaw.name: Dragon Greatclaw
item:dragon-greatclaw.description: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. The claw is enwreathed with lightning,and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.

item:dragon-halberd.name: Dragon Halberd
item:dragon-halberd.description: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
item:dragon-halberd.location: The Dragon Halberd is dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Siofra River underground region.

item:dragon-heart.name: Dragon Heart
item:dragon-heart.description: Dragon heart seized by a dragon tracker. It has a bizarre shape, mottled by gravel, and it continues to beat vivaciously. An offering used in the Dragon Communion. Consume a dragon's heart at the altar to make its power yours. While a terrible and savage-looking thing, the heart has a peculiar beauty to it.

stats.Effect: Gain power of the dragon at the Dragon Communion altar.

item:dragon-hunter-s-great-katana.name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
item:dragon-hunter-s-great-katana.description: Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect. Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One.

item:dragon-king-s-cragblade.name: Dragon King's Cragblade
item:dragon-king-s-cragblade.description: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

item:dragon-s-calorbloom.name: Dragon's Calorbloom
item:dragon-s-calorbloom.description: Flower with an uncanny shape, coursing with hot blood. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A single flower is said to blossom—only once—from the hearts of dead warriors who oft partook of the Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:dragon-s-calorbloom.location: - Dragon's Calorbloom may be found growing on the slopes of the Jagged Peak. It does not respawn after being harvested.

item:dragon-towershield.name: Dragon Towershield
item:dragon-towershield.description: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.
item:dragon-towershield.location: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula, guarded by a Banished Knight. From the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace, proceed down to the open area with the already wounded ancient dragon. Drop down a set of ledges to the dragon's left, enter the building and climb a ladder to find the chest.

item:dragonbolt-blessing.name: Dragonbolt Blessing
item:dragonbolt-blessing.description: Superior incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons lightning to bolster the caster's body. Attacks become easier to deflect and resistance to all ailments is increased. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced. Only those loved by dragons can survive the ordeal of cladding their bodies in lightning.

stats.Effect: Bolsters caster's body with lightning

item:dragonbolt-grease.name: Dragonbolt Grease
item:dragonbolt-grease.description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy lightning damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Said to have been a favored tool of the dragon-cult knights who once served the prince of gold.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy lightning damage

item:dragonbolt-of-florissax.name: Dragonbolt of Florissax
item:dragonbolt-of-florissax.description: Special incantation of the ancient dragon Florissax. Calls down red lightning to bolster the caster and nearby allies. While enrobed with red lightning, all forms of damage negation (including physical) are increased. This also increases damage negation while guarding as an additional effect. There was a time when the priestess never knew love, and thus never used this incantation herself.

stats.Effect: Calls down red lightning to bolster self and nearby allies

item:dragonclaw.name: Dragonclaw
item:dragonclaw.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to rend foes with dragon claws

item:dragonclaw-shield.name: Dragonclaw Shield
item:dragonclaw-shield.description: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Edrtree. Imbued with lightning.
item:dragonclaw-shield.location: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss in Altus Plateau, outside Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.name: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
item:dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.description: Legendary talisman of wrought iron depicting a massive ancient dragon. Enormously boosts physical damage negation.

stats.Effect: Enormously boosts physical damage negation

item:dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.location: Elphael drainage beam run. Best physical absorb in the game.

item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman.description: Wrought iron talisman depicting a trio of ancient dragons. Boosts physical damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts physical damage negation

item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse that lies on the ground, near Bestial Sanctum, in northern Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Equipping the Longtail Cat Talisman here, or using Soft Cotton is very helpful, as there are several parkour drops coming up that will deal unavoidable damage, and there are Bat enemies in the area. From the front door of the sanctum, head southwest around the side of the sanctum, until reaching a cliff that overlooks a large tree root, close enough to drop to.

item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman-1.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1
item:dragoncrest-shield-talisman-1.location: - Obtained from the Sainted Hero's Grave in central Altus Plateau. In the room with the giant falling blade traps, jump on top of the first one to ride it upwards, and jump to the ledge on the left. Follow this path to reach a room that has a pair of semi-transparent fog walls, locked by an imp statue that requires one Stonesword Key to open. The corpse can be found past this wall.

stats.Effect: Greatly boosts physical damage negation
Vastly boosts physical damage negation

item:dragonfire.name: Dragonfire
item:dragonfire.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew flame breath

item:dragonice.name: Dragonice
item:dragonice.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew icy breath

item:dragonmaw.name: Dragonmaw
item:dragonmaw.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to bite foes before caster

item:dragonmaw.location: Bought at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion with a dragon heart.

item:dragonscale-blade.name: Dragonscale Blade
item:dragonscale-blade.description: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
item:dragonscale-blade.location: The Dragonscale Blade is dropped by a Dragonkin Soldier in the Lake of Rot.

item:dragonscale-flesh.name: Dragonscale Flesh
item:dragonscale-flesh.description: A lump of hot flesh carved from beneath the inverted scales said to grow on aged dragons. When ingested as-is, boosts vigor, endurance, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss. To the drake warriors, there is no more intoxicating liquor than the heat of dragons.

stats.Effect: Boosts vigor, endurance, strength, and dexterity at the cost of gradual HP loss

item:dragonwound-grease.name: Dragonwound Grease
item:dragonwound-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of gravels stones. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, granting special dragon attacks

item:dragonwound-grease.location: Ravaged Gargoyle near the The Nameless Eternal City

item:drake-knight-armor.name: Drake Knight Armor
item:drake-knight-armor.description: Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partake of communion. The cape is crafted with dragon wing membrane.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 9 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 10

item:drake-knight-armor.location: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

item:drake-knight-armor-altered.name: Drake Knight Armor (altered)
item:drake-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Drake Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 11 · Pierce 10 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:drake-knight-gauntlets.name: Drake Knight Gauntlets
item:drake-knight-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:drake-knight-greaves.name: Drake Knight Greaves
item:drake-knight-greaves.description: Greaves wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:dreambrew.name: Dreambrew
item:dreambrew.description: The story they shared depended on which type of booze they were offered.

item:dried-bouquet.name: Dried Bouquet
item:dried-bouquet.description: Raises attack power when summoned spirit dies

stats.Effect: Raises Attack Power

item:dryleaf-arm-wraps.name: Dryleaf Arm Wraps
item:dryleaf-arm-wraps.description: Sun-faded and lightly soiled arm wraps. Wound tightly around the arms as if it might prevent them from being broken.

item:dryleaf-arts.name: Dryleaf Arts
item:dryleaf-arts.location: Dropped by Dryleaf Dane after the spar at Moorth Ruins.
item:dryleaf-arts.description: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks. The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey.

item:dryleaf-cuissardes.name: Dryleaf Cuissardes
item:dryleaf-cuissardes.description: Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. Boots made of sturdy leather.

item:dryleaf-robe.name: Dryleaf Robe
item:dryleaf-robe.description: Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. The gold necklace found under the breast belongs to a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. This sect rejects dependence on others in all matters of faith, seeking self-discipline and self-sufficiency above all else.

item:dryleaf-robe-altered.name: Dryleaf Robe (Altered)
item:dryleaf-robe-altered.description: Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. The leather satchel hanging from the shoulder is decorated with one of Miquella's emblems, a golden grass motif.

item:dryleaf-seal.name: Dryleaf Seal
item:dryleaf-seal.location: Found on a corpse near the Recluses' River Downstream
item:dryleaf-seal.description: Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations which conjure golden rings of light. Those who saw the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves long ago braced themselves for the weakening of Order, and embraced a strict faith. And then, they made to serve a new god.

item:dryleaf-whirlwind.name: Dryleaf Whirlwind
item:dryleaf-whirlwind.description: Skill: Dryleaf Whirlwind This skill represents the pinnacle of Dane's footwork-based martial artistry. Rise into the air with a series of spinning kicks before crashing down with one final strike. Imbues kicking attacks with energy, increasing their range.

item:dueling-shield.name: Dueling Shield
item:dueling-shield.description: A thrusting shield of golden ornamentation which enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. In the realm of shadow, though far away from the Erdtree, ritual combat continued to hold weight.

item:duelist-greataxe.name: Duelist Greataxe
item:duelist-greataxe.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.
item:duelist-greataxe.location: The Duelist Greataxe can be farmed from the Grave Warden Duelist wielding it in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:duelist-greaves.name: Duelist Greaves
item:duelist-greaves.description: Greaves encircles by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:duelist-greaves.location: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

item:duelist-helm.name: Duelist Helm
item:duelist-helm.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

item:duelist-s-furled-finger.name: Duelist's Furled Finger
item:duelist-s-furled-finger.description: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for competitive multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. The bronze adornments are the mark of a duelist.

stats.Effect: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

item:duelist-s-furled-finger.location: In the northernmost part of Limgrave, on a burnt corpse next to the Frustrated Spirit.

item:dung-eater-puppet.name: Dung Eater Puppet
item:dung-eater-puppet.description: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater. Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of the Dung Eater

item:dung-eater-puppet.location: Sold by Preceptor Seluvis - Dung Eater Quest

item:eclipse-crest-greatshield.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
item:eclipse-crest-greatshield.description: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights. The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay. No skill. This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.
item:eclipse-crest-greatshield.location: 4% chance to be dropped by Mausoleum Knights near Wandering Mausoleums, in the Nameless Eternal City and outside the Black Knife Catacombs.

item:eclipse-crest-heater-shield.name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
item:eclipse-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The sun in eclipse is said to be the symbol of the Wandering Mausoleum where the soulless demigods slumber.
item:eclipse-crest-heater-shield.location: - Found on a corpse atop a large stone archway protruding from a cliff northwest of the Minor Erdtree in the Weeping Peninsula.

item:eclipse-shotel.name: Eclipse Shotel
item:eclipse-shotel.description: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:eclipse-shotel.location: Found on a corpse in the chapel

item:elden-lord-armor.name: Elden Lord Armor
item:elden-lord-armor.description: Armor of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

item:elden-remembrance.description: Remembrance of the Elden Beast, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

related: Radagon of the Golden Order / Elden Beast

item:elden-stars.name: Elden Stars
item:elden-stars.description: This legendary incantation is the most ancient of those that derive from the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Creates a steam of golden shooting stars that assail the area.

item:electrify-armament.name: Electrify Armament
item:electrify-armament.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

item:electrify-armament.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Dragon Cult Prayerbook

item:electrocharge.name: Electrocharge
item:electrocharge.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Calls down lightning to charge the caster's body. While charged, electric shocks will strike the area several times. Charging increases potency. The origin of incantations that bolster the body with lightning, and now a lost art in the Lands Between.

stats.Effect: Calls down lightning to charge body with electricity

item:eleonora-s-poleblade.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
item:eleonora-s-poleblade.description: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:eleonora-s-poleblade.location: Eleonora's Poleblade is dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika in the Altus Plateau.

item:ember-of-messmer.name: Ember of Messmer
item:ember-of-messmer.description: Serpentine, cord-like ember. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found in Scadu Altus. A remnant of Messmer's flame, the symbol of the crusade, it continues to smolder as if crawling across the ground.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:ember-of-messmer.location: - Dropped by Messmerfire dogs or found on the ground in Messmer Soldier camps.

item:empyrean-blood-burgeon.name: Empyrean-Blood Burgeon
item:empyrean-blood-burgeon.description: A young shoot, heavy with Empyrean blood. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Said to burgeon forth from where the golden blood of Miquella, the wounded Empyrean, pooled.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:empyrean-blood-burgeon.location: - Empyrean-Blood Burgeons found around Miquella's Crosses in the Realm of Shadow. Once harvested, they do not respawn until the next playthrough.

item:enchanted-shot.name: Enchanted Shot
item:enchanted-shot.description: This ash of war grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Enchanted Shot: Archery skill that enlivens the arrow with spiritual essence. The resulting shot will fly faster than regular shots and change its trajectory to follow the target."Usable on light bows and longbows.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:endure.name: Endure
item:endure.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Endure: Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Ash
Raises potency of storms by 10%

item:entwining-umbilical-cord.name: Entwining Umbilical Cord
item:entwining-umbilical-cord.description: Mysterious circular object that's oddly warped. Changes the demeanour of the wearer's actions.

stats.Effect: Changes demeanour of wearer's actions

item:envoy-crown.description: The soft bundle worn on the head by Oracle Envoys. Densely wrapped in several layers of cloth. Raises the potency of bubble-based skills. No one knows what the cloth hides, but some claim to have heard a faint whimpering from inside. It must have been their imagination.

item:envoy-crown.location: Giant Oracle Envoy enemy near the Haligtree Canopy

item:envoy-s-greathorn.description: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:envoy-s-greathorn.location: To get the Envoy's Greathorn in Elden Ring, you must farm Giant Oracle Envoys located on the upper tree branches of Miquella's Haligtree.
