item:erdsteel-dagger.name: Erdsteel Dagger
item:erdsteel-dagger.description: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace. Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield. Attack power also scales with faith.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:erdsteel-dagger.location: You can obtain the Erdsteel Dagger through two different methods in a single playthrough: as a quest reward from Kenneth Haight in Limgrave or looted from a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:erdtree-bow.name: Erdtree Bow
item:erdtree-bow.description: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Fai D

item:erdtree-bow.location: The standard Erdtree Bow is located in Leyndell, Royal Capital on the Altus Plateau.

item:erdtree-codex.name: Erdtree Codex
item:erdtree-codex.description:
Scroll containing incantations. Can be given to a learned cleric
in order to learn incantations.

stats.Effect: Scroll containing incantations

item:erdtree-greatbow.name: Erdtree Greatbow
item:erdtree-greatbow.description: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Fai D

item:erdtree-greatbow.location: The Erdtree Greatbow is obtained by destroying the mechanical chariot in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave dungeon in Limgrave.

item:erdtree-greatshield.name: Erdtree Greatshield
item:erdtree-greatshield.description: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection. The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.
item:erdtree-greatshield.location: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo in Altus Plateau at the southern entrance to the Capital Outskirts.

item:erdtree-heal.name: Erdtree Heal
item:erdtree-heal.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

stats.Effect: Vastly heals HP for self and nearby allies

item:erdtree-heal.location: Erdtree Heal is located near the Queen's Bedchamber

item:erdtree-prayerbook.name: Erdtree Prayerbook
item:erdtree-prayerbook.description:
Scroll containing incantations. Can be given to a learned cleric
in order to learn incantations.

stats.Effect: Scroll containing incantations

item:erdtree-s-favor.name: Erdtree's Favor
item:erdtree-s-favor.description: A talisman depicting a special blessing of the Erdtree. Slightly raises maximum HP, stamina, and equip load.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum HP, stamina and equip load

item:erdtree-s-favor.location: - Obtained from an altar in Fringefolk Hero's Grave, in western Limgrave. This dungeon is accessed from Stranded Graveyard after inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the nearby imp statue, to unlock the semi-transparent fog wall. Proceed down the ladder and across the poison pond, to reach a ramp, patrolled by an invincible chariot. Proceed down the ramp by hiding in alcoves on the side, to avoid the chariot. When the ramp turns into a bridge, with gaps on either side, drop from either side of the highest point of the bridge, to reach a lower platform.

item:erdtree-s-favor-1.name: Erdtree's Favor +1
item:erdtree-s-favor-1.description: Raises maximum HP, stamina and equip load
item:erdtree-s-favor-1.location: - Obtained from a chest in Cathedral of the Forsaken, in the Leyndell, Royal Capital region. This chest is available after defeating Mohg, the Omen in this same room. The room can be reached from Forsaken Depths in Subterranean Shunning Grounds.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum HP, stamina, and equip load

item:erdtree-s-favor-2.name: Erdtree's Favor +2
item:erdtree-s-favor-2.description: Raises maximum HP, stamina and equip load
item:erdtree-s-favor-2.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, which can only be accessed late-game, after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. This area is only accessible when approaching from the Forbidden Lands. Head west into the capital from the Grand Lift of Rold, down the staircases, and to the south end of the ash-covered area, where the corpse can be found, hanging from the top of a tree root that juts out of the ground. Beware of the three Ulcerated Tree Spirits that guard the area. Hug the walls of the area as you head south to avoid them.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises maximum HP, stamina, and equip load

item:erdtree-seal.name: Erdtree Seal
item:erdtree-seal.description: A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between. Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.
item:erdtree-seal.location: The Erdtree Seal is located in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmer.

item:erdtree-surcoat.name: Erdtree Surcoat
item:erdtree-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. The surcoat bears a majestic likeness of the Erdtree. Its golden backing is an honor bestowed on no other soldiers.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 9

item:erdtree-surcoat.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

item:errant-sorcerer-boots.name: Errant Sorcerer Boots
item:errant-sorcerer-boots.description: Commonplace leather boots, sturdy enough to withstand a long journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:errant-sorcerer-manchettes.name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes
item:errant-sorcerer-manchettes.description: Commonplace leather manchettes. Their hands are inlaid with dulled glintstone.

item:errant-sorcerer-robe.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe
item:errant-sorcerer-robe.description: Commonplace robe made of thick cloth. Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold. A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe (altered)
item:errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Errant Sorcerer Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.location: Hermit Village near the Craftman's Shack

item:erudition.name: Erudition
item:erudition.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:eruption.name: Eruption
item:eruption.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:"Eruption: Skill of the knights who serve at Volcano Manor. Slam armament into the ground, spawning roiling lava which spouts up upon release."Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.

stats.Effect: ash

item:estoc.name: Estoc
item:estoc.description: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks. For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.
item:estoc.location: You can purchase the Estoc thrusting sword from the Nomadic Merchant in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes for 3,000 Runes.

item:eternal-darkness.name: Eternal Darkness
item:eternal-darkness.description: Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

stats.Effect: Creates a dark space that draws in spells

item:eternal-sleep-grease.name: Eternal Sleep Grease
item:eternal-sleep-grease.description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of deep-purple materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, inflicting eternal sleep. The effect lasts only for a short time. The weak are powerless to resist this velvety sleep, and will never be roused again.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting eternal sleep

item:eternal-sleep-grease.location: - Eternal Sleep Grease is not found in the game world. It may be crafted upon obtaining the St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2].

item:eternal-sleep-pot.name: Eternal Sleep Pot
item:eternal-sleep-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by the incantations of St. Trina. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of eternal sleep. The weak are powerless to resist this velvety sleep, and will never be roused again.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw to cause buildup of eternal sleep.

item:eternal-sleep-pot.location: Crafted with St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook (1).

item:euporia.name: Euporia

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:euporia.location: This armament can be found in Belurat, Tower Settlement. However, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump into the nearby window (sprinting is advised), and then go out to the balcony and follow the path to the right down the lifts, past the Inquisitors and the Divine Beast Warrior. Euporia lies at the end of this path.
item:euporia.description: Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower. Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect.

item:exalted-flesh.name: Exalted Flesh
item:exalted-flesh.description: A lump of animal pickled in a medicinal solution mixed with fiery spices. Craftable item. Temporarily Boosts physical attack Considered a delicacy in the badlands, this invigorating repast was for the exclusive benefit of those who they called heroes.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts physical attack

item:exalted-flesh.location: - Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula region): inside the chest in the shack.

item:executioner-s-greataxe.name: Executioner's Greataxe
item:executioner-s-greataxe.description: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.
item:executioner-s-greataxe.location: To get the Executioner's Greataxe, you need to farm axe-wielding skeletons.

item:exile-armor.name: Exile Armor
item:exile-armor.description: Damaged armor draped with a large deep-red cloth. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 9 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 8 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 9

item:exile-armor.location: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

item:exile-gauntlets.name: Exile Gauntlets
item:exile-gauntlets.description: Damaged iron gauntlets. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:exile-gauntlets.location: - The Exile Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

item:exile-greaves.name: Exile Greaves
item:exile-greaves.description: Damaged iron greaves. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 3 · Holy 5

item:exile-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

item:exile-hood.name: Exile Hood
item:exile-hood.description: Deep red hood that covers the whole head. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were required to keep their faces hidden.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:exile-hood.location: - The Exile Hood has a 1.5% chance to drop from Exile Soldiers.

item:explosive-bolt.name: Explosive Bolt
item:explosive-bolt.description: Bolt tipped with a shard of Explosive Stone. Explodes on impact, dealing fire damage.

item:explosive-ghostflame.name: Explosive Ghostflame
item:explosive-ghostflame.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.

stats.Effect: Causes ghostflame explosion that burns wide area

item:explosive-greatbolt.name: Explosive Greatbolt
item:explosive-greatbolt.description: Greatbolt tipped with a clump of Explosive Stone shards. Detonates a large explosion on impact, dealing fire damage.
item:explosive-greatbolt.location: Abductor Virgins north-west of the Bridge of Iniquity

item:explosive-stone.name: Explosive Stone
item:explosive-stone.description: A small stone with a smoldering core.

stats.Effect: Explodes when thrown, inflicting Fire Damage

item:explosive-stone-clump.name: Explosive Stone Clump
item:explosive-stone-clump.description: A clump of small stones with smoldering cores.

stats.Effect: Explodes when thrown together, inflicting fire damage

item:extreme-repentance.name: Extreme Repentance
item:extreme-repentance.location: Obtained from angering non-hostile Patches and letting him reduce the player's health to around 50% of their total health bar.
item:extreme-repentance.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:eye-of-yelough.name: Eye of Yelough
item:eye-of-yelough.description: A shrub fruit bursting with ripened pulp. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:eye-of-yelough.location: Sold by Merchant - Academy of Raya Lucaria

item:eye-surcoat.name: Eye Surcoat

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 8 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 8 · Fire 10 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:eye-surcoat.location: Found on the ground after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

item:faded-erdleaf-flower.name: Faded Erdleaf Flower
item:faded-erdleaf-flower.description: An Erdleaf flower that has faded into a plate scarlet, found blooming in rotten lands. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:faded-erdleaf-flower.location: Faded Erdleaf Flowers are harvested in Caelid.

item:faith-knot-crystal-tear.name: Faith-knot Crystal Tear
item:faith-knot-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts one's faith.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts faith in mixed physick

item:faithful-s-canvas-talisman.name: Faithful's Canvas Talisman
item:faithful-s-canvas-talisman.description: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a group of masked figures. Raises potency of incantations.

stats.Effect: Raises potency of Incantations

item:faithful-s-canvas-talisman.location: Sellia Crystal Tunnel, on a corpse guarded by two Lesser Kindred of Rot.

item:falchion.name: Falchion
item:falchion.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.
item:falchion.location: The Falchion in Elden Ring is a random drop from Demi-Human enemies who wield the weapon.

item:fallingstar-beast-jaw.name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
item:fallingstar-beast-jaw.description: Part of a Falling star Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon. With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:fallingstar-beast-jaw.location: You can get the Fallingstar Beast Jaw in Elden Ring by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast boss located at the peak of Mt. Gelmir in the Altus Plateau.

item:falx.name: Falx
item:falx.location: It can be obtained wherever Hornsent is killed, depending on your actions and choices.
item:falx.description: Curved swords with long, sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Forged by a hornsent in the name of revenge. "In vengeance for the flames, my blade I wield..."

item:family-heads.name: Family Heads
item:family-heads.description: Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage. The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Int E

item:family-heads.location: To get the Family Heads flail in Elden Ring, you must travel to the Sage's Cave in the Altus Plateau and defeat the secret boss, Necromancer Garris.

item:fan-daggers.name: Fan Daggers
item:fan-daggers.description: A set of five throwing knives bundled together.

stats.Effect: Thrown fanned-out knives at enemies to inflict damage

item:fancy-spin.name: Fancy Spin
item:fancy-spin.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:fang-helm.name: Fang Helm
item:fang-helm.description: Helm of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. The cheek guards are shaped after lion fangs. Perhaps his fascination with the untamed strength of the wild stemmed from his past as a Redmane.

item:fanged-imp-ashes.name: Fanged Imp Ashes
item:fanged-imp-ashes.description: Ashes remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.

stats.Effect: Summons two fanged imp spirits

item:fanged-imp-ashes.location: Sold by Merchant - Academy of Raya Lucaria

item:father-marika-s-hammer.name: Father Marika's Hammer
item:father-marika-s-hammer.description:
Club of simple design, made by fitting
stone to a piece of lumber. Its small size compared to most clubs
make it easier to wield in close-quarters.

item:fell-omen-cloak.name: Fell Omen Cloak
item:fell-omen-cloak.description: "A cloak of ragged fur worn about the exposed body of Margit, the Fell Omen.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:fell-omen-cloak.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Morgott, the Omen King.

stats.Effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world

item:festive-garb.name: Festive Garb
item:festive-garb.description: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Faintly bloodstained.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:festive-garb.location: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be altered by yourself or by Boc.

item:festive-garb-altered.name: Festive Garb (altered)
item:festive-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Festive Garb.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:festive-garb-altered.location: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be unaltered by yourself or by Boc.

item:festive-grease.name: Festive Grease
item:festive-grease.description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of bone shards. Craftable item. Coats armament, imparting a festive incantation that grants the wielder a scant few runes on landing attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. The delightful festival is an old tradition; one old enough for the Erdtree to tacitly tolerate its endurance.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, granting wielder trace amount of runes on landing attacks

item:festive-hood.name: Festive Hood
item:festive-hood.description: Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Decorated with many-colored flowers.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:festive-hood.location: - The Festive Hood has a 1.50% chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wear it. Many are found at Dominula, Windmill Village in northern Altus Plateau.

item:festive-hood-altered.name: Festive Hood (altered)
item:festive-hood-altered.description: Lighter version of the Festive Hood
item:festive-hood-altered.location: Obtained by altering the Festive Hood at a

item:fetid-flesh.name: Fetid Flesh
item:fetid-flesh.description:
A lump of beast flesh pickled in egg wash. Craftable item. Beasts are highly attracted to its scent. The rancid scent prevents ingestion by any
ordinary human.

stats.Effect: Utterly entrances wild beasts

item:fetid-pot.name: Fetid Pot
item:fetid-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of effluents is sealed inside. As the mixture ferments, toxins are produced alongside a putrid stench that seeps out once ripe. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of deadly poison. Beware though; those who carry these pots will slowly accumulate poison in their own bodies. Push someone in a privy; expect to get dung on your hands.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause deadly buildup of poison.

item:fetid-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Gold-Tinged Excrement x1

item:fevor-s-cookbook-1.name: Fevor's Cookbook [1]
item:fevor-s-cookbook-1.description: Record of crafting techniques left by a man who was denied the path of becoming a Finger Maiden. He instead became a missionary, spreading holy teachings.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:fevor-s-cookbook-1.location: Found on a corpse at the graveyard south of the Summonwater Village. Can be reached safely via the bridge-like fallen structure just north of the Mistwood region, where Kenneth Haight is found calling for help.

item:fevor-s-cookbook-2.name: Fevor's Cookbook [2]
item:fevor-s-cookbook-2.description: Record of crafting techniques left by a man who was denied the path of becoming a Finger Maiden. He instead became a missionary, spreading holy teachings.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:fevor-s-cookbook-2.location: Sold by Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

item:fevor-s-cookbook-3.name: Fevor's Cookbook [3]
item:fevor-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who was utterly captivated by St. Trina. He continued the search for her in his slumber. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Bewitching Branch

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:fevor-s-cookbook-3.location: Obtained from Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing after visiting Mohgwyn Palace.

item:fia-s-hood.name: Fia's Hood
item:fia-s-hood.description: Hood of black cloth that covers the whole head. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:fia-s-hood.location: Dropped by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D, Beholder of Death.

item:fia-s-mist.name: Fia's Mist
item:fia-s-mist.description: Sorcery of Fia, the Deathbed Companion. Creates a deathly mist before the caster, which inflicts Death blight upon those who enter. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances range of the mist. This sorcery was developed to oppose the Roundtable Hold, and is effective only against the Tarnished.

stats.Effect: Release a mist of death before caster

item:fia-s-robe.name: Fia's Robe
item:fia-s-robe.description: Robe of black cloth that covers the entire body. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:fia-s-robe.location: Dropped by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D (NPC)'s twin brother.

item:fia-s-robe-altered.name: Fia's Robe (Altered)
item:fia-s-robe-altered.description: Gown worn by Phia, the Deathbed Companion

item:fine-crucible-feather-talisman.name: Fine Crucible Feather Talisman
item:fine-crucible-feather-talisman.description: Improves backsteps but increases damage taken

item:finger-maiden-fillet.name: Finger Maiden Fillet
item:finger-maiden-fillet.description: Fillet worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers. The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:finger-maiden-fillet.location: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:finger-maiden-robe.name: Finger Maiden Robe
item:finger-maiden-robe.description: Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:finger-maiden-robe.location: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:finger-maiden-robe-altered.name: Finger Maiden Robe (altered)
item:finger-maiden-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Finger Maiden Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:finger-maiden-shoes.name: Finger Maiden Shoes
item:finger-maiden-shoes.description: Shoes worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers. The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:finger-maiden-shoes.location: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:finger-maiden-therolina-puppet.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

item:finger-maiden-therolina-puppet.location: Seluvis’s puppet cellar. Locks Ranni if you finish his line.

upgradeLevels.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet +1
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

upgradeLevels.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet +2
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

upgradeLevels.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet +10
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

item:finger-mimic.name: Finger Mimic
item:finger-mimic.description: Light-pink mushroom resembling a wizened finger. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Used to by those who wish to become fingers to induce hallucinations. They call these mushrooms the stillborn of the Two Fingers.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:finger-robe.name: Finger Robe
item:finger-robe.description: Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest. The front is open, exposing the squirming fingers beneath. This robe is the image of his fervent desire having broken free, laying bare his greatest wish, and wearing it enhances finger sorceries. "I will be the true mother. My fingers will grant us redemption!"

item:finger-seal.name: Finger Seal
item:finger-seal.description: A sacred seal given by maidens of the Finger Readers which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.
item:finger-seal.location: You can buy the Finger Seal from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

stats.Effect: Sends another, or oneself, home.

item:finger-snap.name: Finger Snap
item:finger-snap.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:finger-weaver-s-cookbook-1.name: Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1]
item:finger-weaver-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a determined student of the finger ruins. His brush with the sublime all but shattered his mind, though he was left capable enough to leave these few precious words. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Glinting Nail

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:finger-weaver-s-cookbook-2.name: Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [2]
item:finger-weaver-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a determined student of the finger ruins. His brush with the sublime all but shattered his mind, though he was left capable enough to leave these few precious words. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Fingerprint Nostrum

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:fingercreeper-ashes.name: Fingercreeper Ashes
item:fingercreeper-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fingercreeper. Devoted to its summoner, this young, diminutive Fingercreeper eagerly restores HP. They are ever so fond of their mothers at this tender age.

stats.Effect: Summons Fingercreeper spirit

item:fingercreeper-ashes.location: In the Hinterland, between the Finger Ruins of Dheo and the nearest Grace, in the part where there is still grass, you can find a fissure in the ground with a gigantic hand that works as a mini-boss. Behind this creature is a cave that leads to the ashes.

item:fingerprint-armor.name: Fingerprint Armor
item:fingerprint-armor.description: Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 9 · Fire 12 · Lightning 6 · Holy 9

item:fingerprint-armor.location: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:fingerprint-armor-altered.name: Fingerprint Armor (altered)
item:fingerprint-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Fingerprint Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 11 · Pierce 11 · Magic 9 · Fire 12 · Lightning 6 · Holy 9

item:fingerprint-armor-altered.location: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:fingerprint-gauntlets.description: Iron gauntlets singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. item:fingerprint-grape.description: Eyeball of the knight Vyke, inflamed yellow.

stats.Effect: Eyeball of the knight Vyke, inflamed yellow

item:fingerprint-helm.location: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:fingerprint-nostrum.name: Fingerprint Nostrum
item:fingerprint-nostrum.description: Bolus engraved with whorl-like lines. Craftable item. Boosts mind, intelligence, faith, and arcane at the cost of gradual HP loss. A secret medicine of those who attempt to turn their human bodies into fingers. Ingesting causes something to wriggle within.

stats.Effect: Boosts mind, intelligence, faith, and arcane at cost of gradual HP loss

item:fingerprint-stone-shield.name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
item:fingerprint-stone-shield.description: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields. Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.
item:fingerprint-stone-shield.location: Found in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath Leyndell.

item:fingerslayer.name: Fingerslayer Blade
item:fingerslayer.description: The hidden treasure of the Eternal City of Nokron; a blade said to have been born of a corpse.

stats.Effect: Hidden treasure of the Eternal City of Nokron

item:fire-arrow.name: Fire Arrow
item:fire-arrow.description: Arrow with the tip set alight. Deals fire damage.

stats.Effect: Arrow with the tip set alight

item:fire-blossom.name: Fire Blossom
item:fire-blossom.description: A half-ashen and smoldering flower that blooms on the mountaintops of the Giants. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:fire-blossom.location: - Found blooming in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:fire-coil.name: Fire Coil
item:fire-coil.description: A device of fire used by Messmer's soldiers. Lingering embers, bundled into a coil. Craftable item. Uses FP to conjure tiny fire snakes from the spot that it is thrown. The writhing snakes pursue foes. Fire was a symbol of the crusade, and even Messmer's rank-and-file soldiers would wield it.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to conjure tiny fire snakes.

item:fire-grease.name: Fire Grease
item:fire-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding fire damage to attacks. The effect last only for a short time.

stats.Effect: Coats weapon, inflicting Fire Damage

item:fire-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Smoldering Butterfly x1

item:fire-knight-armor.name: Fire Knight Armor
item:fire-knight-armor.description: Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Distinguished by its red cape and twin golden snakes which adorn the neck, enhancing incantations of Messmer's flame. These were the only ones who truly knew Messmer. His flames, like serpents. The painful fate that accompanied his accursed form.

item:fire-knight-armor-altered.name: Fire Knight Armor (Altered)
item:fire-knight-armor-altered.description: Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

item:fire-knight-gauntlets.name: Fire Knight Gauntlets
item:fire-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.
item:fire-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Fire Knight Gauntlets has a 3.00% chance to drop from Fire Knights in the Shadow Keep, Shadow Keep, Church District, and Specimen Storehouse.

item:fire-knight-greaves.name: Fire Knight Greaves
item:fire-knight-greaves.description: Greaves of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.
item:fire-knight-greaves.location: - The Fire Knight Greaves has a 3.00% chance to drop from Fire Knights in the Shadow Keep, Shadow Keep, Church District, and Specimen Storehouse.

item:fire-knight-helm.name: Fire Knight Helm
item:fire-knight-helm.description: Pointed helm of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Slightly increases maximum HP, stamina, and maximum equip load. Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.
item:fire-knight-helm.location: - The Fire Knight Helm has a 3.00% chance to drop from Fire Knights in the Shadow Keep, Shadow Keep, Church District, and Specimen Storehouse.

item:fire-knight-hilde.name: Fire Knight Hilde
item:fire-knight-hilde.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Fire Knight Hilde. A spirit who belonged to the Fire Knights; an order which answers directly to Messmer. Hilde swings a slender greatsword and casts fire incantations. Hilde was a dear friend to Salza the sage, and joined those who urged that the specimens be preserved. Hilde's ashes were enshrined as a charm to protect the storehouse.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Fire Knight Hilde

item:fire-knight-queelign.name: Fire Knight Queelign
item:fire-knight-queelign.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Fire Knight Queelign. Attacks immediately after being summoned. Spirit of a knight granted relief by the Iris of Grace. Wields a spear-like greatsword that impales foes upon fire, keeping the taint of impurity away from fair mother Marika. That grace was his salvation, though it was but a fleeting blessing. And having been saved, all that was left to him was to wage war.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Fire Knight Queelign

item:fire-knight-s-cookbook-1.description:
A record of crafting techniques left by the Fire Knights, who served Messmer the Impaler. Details the art of wielding fire for the benefit of soldiers setting out to join the crusade. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Messmerfire Grease
- Drawstring Messmerfire Grease

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:fire-knight-s-cookbook-1.location: Messmer's Army encampment west of the Moorth Ruins

item:fire-knight-s-greatsword.name: Fire Knight's Greatsword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:fire-knight-s-greatsword.location: Fire Knights wielding this weapon in the Shadow Keep have a 4.0% chance of dropping it upon being killed.
item:fire-knight-s-greatsword.description: Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire. Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

item:fire-knight-s-seal.name: Fire Knight's Seal
item:fire-knight-s-seal.description: Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler. Enhances fire incantations of Messmer. The emblem of Messmer's army depicts a golden ring and the fire of his sacred seal.

item:fire-knight-s-shortsword.name: Fire Knight's Shortsword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:fire-knight-s-shortsword.location: 4% chance to be dropped by dual dagger-wielding Fire Knights.
item:fire-knight-s-shortsword.description: Shortsword used by the Fire Knights. A slender blade that undulates like fire. Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

item:fire-monk-armor.name: Fire Monk Armor
item:fire-monk-armor.description: Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Monks.

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 12 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 13 · Lightning 9 · Holy 9

item:fire-monk-armor.location: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

item:fire-monk-ashes.name: Fire Monk Ashes
item:fire-monk-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fire Monk. Spirit of a stout monk who monitored the Giants' Flame. Versed in fire incantations, and himself steeled against fire. Though he was charged with keeping watch over the Flame, after many years of solemn duty, he has succumbed to its allure.

stats.Effect: Summons Fire Monk spirit

item:fire-monk-ashes.location: Found in a chest in Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs, in the area below the first lift and past two Frostbite pillars.

item:fire-monk-gauntlets.name: Fire Monk Gauntlets
item:fire-monk-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:fire-monk-gauntlets.location: - The Fire Monk Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

item:fire-monk-greaves.name: Fire Monk Greaves
item:fire-monk-greaves.description: Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

item:fire-monk-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

item:fire-monk-hood.name: Fire Monk Hood
item:fire-monk-hood.description: Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with flames. Attire of the Fire Monks.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:fire-monk-hood.location: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

item:fire-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of incendiary materials is sealed inside.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict Fire Damage

item:fire-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Smoldering Butterfly x1

item:fire-prelate-armor.name: Fire Prelate Armor
item:fire-prelate-armor.description: Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

item:fire-prelate-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Fire Prelate Armor.

item:fire-prelate-gauntlets.name: Fire Prelate Gauntlets
item:fire-prelate-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets with the appearance of flames. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 5 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:fire-prelate-gauntlets.location: - The Fire Prelate Gauntlets have a 2.00% chance to drop from Fire Prelate enemies.

item:fire-prelate-greaves.name: Fire Prelate Greaves
item:fire-prelate-greaves.description: Black iron greaves with the appearance of flames. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 11 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:fire-prelate-helm.name: Fire Prelate Helm
item:fire-prelate-helm.description: Helm engraved with a sacred countenance and housing a cauldron. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 7 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:fire-prelate-helm.location: Chance to drop from Fire Prelates.

item:fire-s-deadly-sin.name: Fire's Deadly Sin
item:fire-s-deadly-sin.description: Incantation originating from a deeply ominous prophecy.

stats.Effect: Sets area and self ablaze with raging flames

item:fire-scorpion-charm.name: Fire Scorpion Charm
item:fire-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that burns with fire.

stats.Effect: Raises fire attack, but lowers damage negation

item:fire-scorpion-charm.location: Found inside Fort Laiedd on Mt. Gelmir.

item:fire-serpent.name: Fire Serpent
item:fire-serpent.description: Incantation of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Launches a flame with a serpentine coil. Charging enhances potency. When the flame they received from Messmer would not find purchase within them, the Fire Knights relied on fire incantations to honor their bond.

stats.Effect: Launches a flame with a serpentine coil

item:fire-spritestone.name: Fire Spritestone
item:fire-spritestone.description: A Rauh Burrow inhabited by a fire sprite. Craftable item. Uses FP to release a fire sprite that bounces along the ground. The sprite pierces through enemies, dealing fire damage. Of all the sprites, the fire sprites are said to be the most boisterous in nature.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to release a fire sprite that bounces along the ground

item:fire-spur-me.name: Fire Spur Me

stats.Effect: Inspire fellow warriors

item:fire-spur-me.location: Fire Monk campsite south of the Scenic Isle

item:firebone-arrow.name: Firebone Arrow
item:firebone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow set alight when shot
item:firebone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Arrow whittled from animal bones, its tip set alight before firing

item:firebone-arrow-fletched.name: Firebone Arrow (Fletched)
item:firebone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched animal bone arrow set alight when shot
item:firebone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Arrow whittled from animal bones, its tip set alight before firing

item:firebone-bolt.name: Firebone Bolt
item:firebone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt set alight when shot

item:fireproof-dried-liver.name: Fireproof Dried Liver
item:fireproof-dried-liver.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a flame-hued medical solution. Craftable item. Boosts fire damage negation for a short time, improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with fire.

stats.Effect: Boosts Fire Damage Negation for a short time.

item:fireproof-dried-liver.location: Kaiden Sellsword northeast of the Agheel Lake North

item:fireproof-pickled-liver.name: Fireproof Pickled Liver
item:fireproof-pickled-liver.description: Animal liver pickled in a red medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to fire damage negation, greatly improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with fire. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

stats.Effect: Temporarily grants large boost to fire damage negation

item:firespark-perfume-bottle.name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
item:firespark-perfume-bottle.description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing sparks of fire. The crusade was a violent purge, and the perfumers were not called there to heal.

item:flail.name: Flail
item:flail.description: Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss. Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.
item:flail.location: The standard Flail is found inside a chest on the back of a black caravan at the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave.

item:flamberge.name: Flamberge
item:flamberge.description: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss. Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.
item:flamberge.location: The Flamberge greatsword is found in Redmane Castle in southeast Caelid.

item:flame-cleanse-me.name: Flame, Cleanse Me
item:flame-cleanse-me.description: One of the incantations of the Fire Monks. Creates a fire within that burns away toxins. Alleviates poison and scarlet rot buildup and cures these ailments. This incantation leaves the caster with subtle burns—a reminder that they must fear the flame.

stats.Effect: Alleviates buildup & cures poison and scarlet rot

item:flame-crest-wooden-shield.name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
item:flame-crest-wooden-shield.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy. The yellow flame is the symbol of the affliction, serving as a warning to those who might approach the village.

item:flame-fall-upon-them.name: Flame, Fall Upon Them
item:flame-fall-upon-them.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the

stats.Effect: Hurls several balls of fire at once

item:flame-fortification.name: Flame Fortification
item:flame-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

stats.Effect: Increases fire damage negation.

item:flame-grant-me-strength.name: Flame, Grant Me Strength
item:flame-grant-me-strength.location: Behind Fort Gael, two flame pillars. Caelid.
item:flame-grant-me-strength.description: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks. Creates an invigorating fire within that enhances physical and fire-affinity attack power. This incantation does not burn the caster, and so it is considered forbidden by the guardians of the Flame.

stats.Effect: Raises physical and fire-affinity attack power

item:flame-of-the-fell-god.name: Flame of the Fell God
item:flame-of-the-fell-god.description: This legendary incantation is one of several that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants. Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting the area ablaze. Arghanthy, the chief guardian of the Flame, had kept this incantation a well-kept secret until it was stolen by Adan. The fell god still lurks within the Fire Giants.

stats.Effect: Summons raging fireball that explodes and sets the area ablaze

item:flame-of-the-redmanes.name: Flame of the Redmanes
item:flame-of-the-redmanes.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:"Flame of the Redmanes: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Produce a powerful burst of flames in a wide frontward arc."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:flame-of-the-redmanes.location: Scarab rolling around northeast of the Fort Gael North

stats.Effect: ash

item:flame-protect-me.name: Flame, Protect Me
item:flame-protect-me.description: The most ancient of the Fire Monks' incantations.

stats.Effect: Greatly increases fire damage negation

item:flame-shrouding-cracked-tear.name: Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear
item:flame-shrouding-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.

item:flame-shrouding-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Caelid, on the cliffs north-east of the Smoldering Church.

item:flame-skewer.name: Flame Skewer
item:flame-skewer.description: Skill: Flame Skewer Skill of Queelign of the Fire Knights. Enwreathe armament in flame and assume a low stance before skewering the enemy in a single motion. Strong attack unleashes a follow-up flame attack.

item:flame-sling.name: Flame Sling
item:flame-sling.description: Incantation originating from a sinister prophecy. Throws a ball of raging fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the ball of fire to explode. The flame of ruin is anathema to the Erdtree. But prophets sometimes glimpse it within the faith all the same. Sadly when this occurs their sole reward is banishment.

stats.Effect: Throws ball of raging fire

item:flame-spear.name: Flame Spear
item:flame-spear.description: Skill: Flame Spear Skill of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. Ready weapon for a thrusting attack and unleash a spear of flame straight ahead. Charge the attack to increase damage dealt and distance travelled.

item:flamedrake-talisman.name: Flamedrake Talisman
item:flamedrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a red ancient dragon. Boosts fire damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts fire damage negation.

item:flamedrake-talisman.location: - Obtained from the Groveside Cave in northwestern Limgrave, by defeating the Beastman of Farum Azula boss.

item:flamedrake-talisman-1.name: Flamedrake Talisman +1
item:flamedrake-talisman-1.location: - Obtained from a corpse, that sits in front of a pillar, in eastern Leyndell, Royal Capital. The corpse lies on the ground along the path eastward, out of the capital, towards the Grand Lift of Rold.

stats.Effect: Greatly boosts fire damage negation

item:flamedrake-talisman-2.name: Flamedrake Talisman +2
item:flamedrake-talisman-2.location: - Obtained from the Dragonbarrow Cave in eastern Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, by defeating the Beastman of Farum Azula bosses.

stats.Effect: Vastly boosts fire damage negation

item:flamedrake-talisman-3.name: Flamedrake Talisman +3
item:flamedrake-talisman-3.description: Boosts fire damage negation by the utmost
item:flamedrake-talisman-3.location: - It can be found at the Fort of Reprimand inside a chest. Entering through the front gate, go down the staircase in the back right corner. Continue through the doorway on the left side of the hallway and follow this path until you see two soldiers standing in front of a body. Climb over the cages to their left and it will lead you to the chest that contains the talisman.

stats.Effect: Reduces fire damage

item:flaming-bolt.name: Flaming Bolt
item:flaming-bolt.description: Bolt with a fiercely burned tip. Deals powerful fire damage. Used by survivors of Radahn's army to stave off the scarlet rot.

item:flaming-strike.name: Flaming Strike
item:flaming-strike.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:"Flaming Strike: Skill that emits flame in a wide frontward arc. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lunging, sweeping strike. This will also coat the armament in fire."Usable on melee armaments (colossal weapons and whips excepted).

stats.Effect: ash

item:flask-of-cerulean-tears.name: Flask of Cerulean Tears
item:flask-of-cerulean-tears.description: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with cerulean tears, this flask restores FP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

stats.Effect: Restores FP

item:flask-of-cerulean-tears.location: Obtained after reaching the Stranded Graveyard at the start of the game.

item:flask-of-wondrous-physick.name: Flask of Wondrous Physick
item:flask-of-wondrous-physick.description: A relic of the physick chemists, priests of the Erdtree. Harnesses the powers of crystal tears, which only form after the passage of many moons. Various specials effects are bestowed upon the drinker, dependent on the specific mixture of crystal tears. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that in the Lands Between, pools of crystal tears amass at the bases of Minor Erdtrees.

stats.Effect: Bestows various special effects

item:flask-of-wondrous-physick.location: Found in a basin in the Third Church of Marika, together with one of the two Crimson Crystal Tears.

item:fleeting-microcosm.name: Fleeting Microcosm
item:fleeting-microcosm.description: A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the secret hallowed rites. Conjures an image of a microcosm at a foe's feet that pulses with a single wave before disappearing in a burst. Charging enhances potency. The broken and discarded are fully willing to cling to fleeting simulacra, earning them some modicum of sympathy.

stats.Effect: Conjures a microcosm that pulses with a single wave, disappearing in a burst

item:flight-pinion.name: Flight Pinion
item:flight-pinion.description: Flight feather of a bird of prey. Material used for crafting items. Commonly used for arrow fletchings.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:flightless-bird-painting.name: "Flightless Bird" Painting
item:flightless-bird-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Flightless Bird." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "Flightless Bird"
Examine using

item:flock-canvas-talisman.name: Flock's Canvas Talisman
item:flock-canvas-talisman.description: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a mass of masked figures. Greatly raises potency of incantations.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises potency of Incantations.

related: Gowry — true nature revealed after Millicent's line

item:flower-dragonbolt.name: Flower Dragonbolt
item:flower-dragonbolt.description:
Unique Skill: Flower Dragonbolt

Calls down the red lightning of the ancient dragons to strike a target. Deals lightning damage and also temporarily reduces the target's lightning damage negation. Can be charged to increase its power.
item:flower-dragonbolt.location: Flower Dragonbolt is the default skill for the Flowerstone Gavel.

item:flowerstone-gavel.name: Flowerstone Gavel

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Arc D

item:flowerstone-gavel.description: Weapon of the Dragon Communion priestess. A dragonstone hammer resembling an ancient flower. The four petals and the flower's core are all sharp, ending in points, and are capable of dealing heavy damage to dragons.

item:flowing-curved-sword.name: Flowing Curved Sword
item:flowing-curved-sword.description: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend. Skill: Spinning Slash Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
item:flowing-curved-sword.location: The Flowing Curved Sword weapon can be found at the following location.

item:fly-mold.name: Fly Mold
item:fly-mold.description: A species of fungus known for its deathly sweet stench. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting man-flies. Cultivated using the flesh and blood of man-flies, it can serve as pot innards.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:foot-soldier-cap.name: Foot Soldier Cap
item:foot-soldier-cap.description: Flanged iron cap widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:foot-soldier-cap.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

item:foot-soldier-gauntlets.name: Foot Soldier Gauntlets
item:foot-soldier-gauntlets.description: Metal gauntlets covered in nicks and dents. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:foot-soldier-gauntlets.location: - The Foot Soldier Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies.

item:foot-soldier-greaves.name: Foot Soldier Greaves
item:foot-soldier-greaves.description: Metal Graves that have already been mended countless times. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:foot-soldier-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

item:foot-soldier-helm.name: Foot Soldier Helm
item:foot-soldier-helm.description: Wholly unembellished iron helm. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:foot-soldier-helm.location: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

item:foot-soldier-helmet.name: Foot Soldier Helmet
item:foot-soldier-helmet.description: Helmet with a protective metal plate. Widely issued to foot soldiers in lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:foot-soldier-helmet.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier enemies.

item:foot-soldier-tabard.name: Foot Soldier Tabard
item:foot-soldier-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:foot-soldier-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier enemies.

item:forager-brood-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by the non-human forager brood. Shared out of kindness toward Moore and his kin. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Spellproof Pickled Liver

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

- Charming Branch
