item:ghost-glovewort-9.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.

stats.Effect: Stengthened renowed ashes to +9

item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.name: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing
item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.description: They can be given to the Roundtable Hold Twin-Maiden Husks for unlimited Glovewort purchases.

item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.name: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1]
item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.description:
The bell bearing of a forager who once picked ghost glovewort flowers. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Ghost Glovewort [1]
- Ghost Glovewort [2]
- Ghost Glovewort [3]

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.name: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]
item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.description:
The bell bearing of a forager who once picked ghost glovewort flowers. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Ghost Glovewort [4]
- Ghost Glovewort [5]
- Ghost Glovewort [6]

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.name: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
item:ghost-glovewort-picker-s-bell-beari.description:
The bell bearing of a forager who once picked ghost glovewort flowers. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Ghost Glovewort [7]
- Ghost Glovewort [8]
- Ghost Glovewort [9]

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:ghostflame-bloom.name: Ghostflame Bloom
item:ghostflame-bloom.description: Ghostflame flower that grows in gravesites. Material used for crafting items. Blossoms in the hidden grave of Charo. Of a pair with another gravesite flower, the grave violet. All but incorporeal, it burns without so much as a sound.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:ghostflame-bloom.location: - Ghostflame Bloom may be harvested around Charo's Hidden Grave.

item:ghostflame-breath.name: Ghostflame Breath
item:ghostflame-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion. Transforms caster into a dragon to spew ghostflame breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be used while jumping. The land of spiritgraves is home to all manner of dead, and even the corpses of fallen dragons found their way there. Several of them were endowed with such vivacity that even in death, they could not fully die.

stats.Effect: Spews ghostflame breath from above

item:ghostflame-call.name: Ghostflame Call
item:ghostflame-call.description: Skill: Ghostflame Call Thrust out armament to summon ghostflame. Follow up with a normal attack to set the ground ablaze with ghostflame, or a strong attack to trigger a massive explosion.

item:ghostflame-torch.name: Ghostflame Torch
item:ghostflame-torch.description: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int D

item:ghostflame-torch.location: The Ghostflame Torch in Elden Ring is found on a corpse in Nokron, Eternal City, which you can access after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

item:giant-crusher.name: Giant-Crusher
item:giant-crusher.description: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.
item:giant-crusher.location: The Giant-Crusher colossal weapon is located in an unmarked military camp south of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau (Capital Outskirts).

item:giant-golden-arc.name: Giant Golden Arc
item:giant-golden-arc.description: Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral. A swing of the arm releases a giant golden arc. Charging enhances potency. The arc resembles the barb, a known symbol of coercive questioning.

stats.Effect: Releases a giant golden arc with a swing of the arm

item:giant-hunt.name: Giant Hunt
item:giant-hunt.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Giant Hunt: Skill developed for confronting gigantic foes. Step forward from a low stance, carrying the momentum into a sudden upward thrust."Usable on large and colossal weapons capable of thrusting, spears and twinblades.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:giant-rat-ashes.name: Giant Rat Ashes
item:giant-rat-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three giant rats.

stats.Effect: Summons three giant rat spirits

item:giant-rat-ashes.location: Found on a corpse in the stable just northeast of the West Windmill Pasture.

item:giant-s-flame-take-thee.name: Giant's Flame Take Thee

stats.Effect: Hurls a massive ball of raging fire

item:giant-s-flame-take-thee.description: Giant-Conquering Hero’s Grave, after the fire prelate.

item:giant-s-red-braid.name: Giant's Red Braid
item:giant-s-red-braid.description: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:giant-s-red-braid.location: Remembrance of the Fire Giant (Fire Giant)

item:giant-s-seal.name: Giant's Seal
item:giant-s-seal.description: Sacred seal depicting the one eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair. Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giants' Flame incantations.
item:giant-s-seal.location: The Giant's Seal is located on a corpse in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave dungeon in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:giantsflame-fire-pot.name: Giantsflame Fire Pot
item:giantsflame-fire-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Giants' Flame. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage. Damage scales with faith.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage.

item:giantsflame-take-thee.name: Giantsflame Take Thee
item:giantsflame-take-thee.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the

stats.Effect: Hurls massive ball of raging fire

item:giantsflame-take-thee.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Giant's Prayerbook

item:gilded-foot-soldier-cap.name: Gilded Foot Soldier Cap
item:gilded-foot-soldier-cap.description: Flanged cap made from gilded iron. Issued to foot soldiers protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:gilded-foot-soldier-cap.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

item:gilded-greatshield.name: Gilded Greatshield
item:gilded-greatshield.description: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.
item:gilded-greatshield.location: - 4% chance to be dropped by shield-wielding Godrick Knights, including the Bloodcrazed Knight at Fort Haight.

item:gilded-iron-shield.name: Gilded Iron Shield
item:gilded-iron-shield.description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.
item:gilded-iron-shield.location: Found on a corpse in the graveyard outside the Church of Pilgrimage on the Weeping Peninsula.

item:glaive.name: Glaive
item:glaive.description: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.
item:glaive.location: To get the standard Glaive, you need to farm the Graveyard Skeletons wielding this weapon.

stats.Effect: Shard of filthy glass. Worthless rubbish

item:glinstone-scrap.name: Glinstone Scrap
item:glinstone-scrap.description: Unremarkable glintstone, found along roadways everywhere. Material used for crafting items. Though too impure to use as a permanent catalyst for glintstone sorcery, it's just about sufficient for crafting disposable sorcerous items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:glintblade-phalanx.name: Glintblade Phalanx
item:glintblade-phalanx.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

stats.Effect: Forms a defensive arch of magic glintblades

item:glintblade-trio.name: Glintblade Trio
item:glintblade-trio.description: An old sorcery of the Carian royal family. Creates a sigil overhead, from which three enemy-seeking glintblades appear after a brief delay. This sorcery can be used while in motion. Charging increases the delay. The prototypical form of sword-phalanx sorceries saw a different subsequent refinement in the realm of shadow.

stats.Effect: Creates sigil that forms three projectile glintblades after delay

item:glinting-nail.name: Glinting Nail
item:glinting-nail.description: Nailstone with shining fingerprints floating above. Craftable item. Uses FP to fling a magic nail that crumbles during flight. The lampreys that guard the finger ruins resemble fingers far more than they do humans, and so the finger-weavers imitated their sorcery.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to fire a shattering magic nail

item:glintslab-firefly.name: Glintslab Firefly
item:glintslab-firefly.description: Glintstone firefly improved by selective breeding. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found near Manus Metyr. The glintstone that produces its light has become freakishly enlarged, while the span of its life is as brief as a whisper.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:glintslab-firefly.location: - Found in Castle Ensis and in the lake around the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

item:glintstone-arc.name: Glintstone Arc
item:glintstone-arc.description: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeteadly and while in motion.

stats.Effect: Fires a horizontally-widening magic arc

item:glintstone-breath.name: Glintstone Breath
item:glintstone-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew icy breath.

item:glintstone-cometshard.name: Glintstone Cometshard
item:glintstone-cometshard.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a magical comet with a trailing tail. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy.

stats.Effect: Fires a magic comet with a trailing tail

item:glintstone-cometshard.location: Sold by Sorceress Sellen - Conspectus Scroll

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-1.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.location: On a corpse right next to the Laskyar Ruins

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.description: Contains a record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.location: In a chest in the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-4.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Magic Pot -Roped Magic Pot -Shield Grease

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-4.location: In a chest in a tower north-west of the Academy Gate Town

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-5.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-5.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-6.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-6.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-6.location: Found in a room in the south-eastern wall of Caria Manor.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-7.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (7)
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-7.description: A record ofcrafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-8.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8]
item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-8.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Academy Magic Pot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire.

item:glintstone-craftsman-s-cookbook-8.location: Found in the Consecrated Snowfield, southwest of Albinauric's Rise.

item:glintstone-firefly.name: Glintstone Firefly
item:glintstone-firefly.description: A firefly whose glowing tail has hardened into glintstone, widely found in Liurnia Lake. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:glintstone-icecrag.name: Glintstone Icecrag
item:glintstone-icecrag.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

stats.Effect: Fires mass of cold magic from glintstone

item:glintstone-icecrag.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold

item:glintstone-kris.name: Glintstone Kris
item:glintstone-kris.description: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:glintstone-kris.location: The Glintstone Kris is rewarded at the conclusion of Sorceress Sellen's questline.

item:glintstone-nail.name: Glintstone Nail
item:glintstone-nail.description: Glintstone sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the finger sorceries said to have been discovered in a hallowed ruin. Flings a magic nail that crumbles during flight. Charging increases potency. Count Ymir boasts that this is mere child's play, an echo of a greater truth.

stats.Effect: Fires a shattering magic nail

item:glintstone-nails.name: Glintstone Nails
item:glintstone-nails.description: Glintstone sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the finger sorceries said to have been discovered in a hallowed ruin. Flings multiple magic nails that crumble during flight. Charging increases potency. Count Ymir boasts that this is mere child's play, an echo of a greater truth.

stats.Effect: Fires multiple shattering magic nails

item:glintstone-pebble.name: Glintstone Pebble
item:glintstone-pebble.description: The most basic glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Fires magic projectiles from glintstone

item:glintstone-scarab.name: Glintstone Scarab
item:glintstone-scarab.description: Blue-green scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of sorcery during their labors.

stats.Negation: Physical -5 · Strike -5 · Slash -5 · Pierce -5 · Magic -4 · Fire -4 · Lightning -4 · Holy -5

item:glintstone-scrap.name: Glintstone Scrap
item:glintstone-scrap.description: Piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels. Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt. Poor quality and thereby easily broken, a sorcerer wouldn't give it a second look.

stats.Effect: Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt.

item:glintstone-scrap.location: - Some can be found in the Limgrave Tunnels.

item:glintstone-sorcerer-ashes.name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
item:glintstone-sorcerer-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a glintstone sorcerer.

stats.Effect: Summons glintstone sorcerer spirit

item:glintstone-sorcerer-ashes.location: Dropped by the Spiritcaller Snail in Road's End Catacombs.

item:glintstone-staff.name: Glintstone Staff
item:glintstone-staff.description: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries. Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
item:glintstone-staff.location: For a solid all-around weapon, you can find the standard Glintstone Staff at the King's Realm Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes by farming the teleporting sorcerer enemies.

item:glintstone-stars.name: Glintstone Stars
item:glintstone-stars.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Fires three shooting stars that pursue foes

item:glintstone-whetblade.name: Glintstone Whetblade
item:glintstone-whetblade.description: Glintstone whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.

stats.Effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon

item:glintstone-whetblade.location: Found on a corpse in the side room west of the Debate Parlor

item:gloried-attire.name: Gloried Attire
item:gloried-attire.description: Traditional garb of highland warriors, made from woven fabric and finished with fur. This garment is made from fabrics with both blue and red patterns. Red-patterned fabrics were allowed only to those who hunted bears—the greatest and most glorious of the highlanders.

item:glovewort-crystal-tear.name: Glovewort Crystal Tear
item:glovewort-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily increases the attack power of spirits.

stats.Effect: Enhances attacks of spirits in mixed physick

item:glovewort-crystal-tear.location: Defeat the Furnace Golem in Charo's Hidden Grave.

item:glovewort-picker-s-bell-bearing-1.name: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1]
item:glovewort-picker-s-bell-bearing-1.description:
The bell bearing of a forager who once picked grave glovewort flowers. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Grave Glovewort [1]
- Grave Glovewort [2]
- Grave Glovewort [3]

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:glovewort-picker-s-bell-bearing-2.name: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]
item:glovewort-picker-s-bell-bearing-2.description:
The bell bearing of a forager who once picked grave glovewort flowers. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Grave Glovewort [4]
- Grave Glovewort [5]
- Grave Glovewort [6]

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:glovewort-picker-s-bell-bearing-3.name: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
item:glovewort-picker-s-bell-bearing-3.description:
The bell bearing of a forager who once picked grave glovewort flowers. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Grave Glovewort [7]
- Grave Glovewort [8]
- Grave Glovewort [9]

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:glowstone.name: Glowstone
item:glowstone.description: Polished Ruin Fragment that shines brighter than a Rainbow Stone. Craftable item. Emits light from the location it is placed, illuminating surroundings. However, the effect is short-lived, and it lacks the diverse colors of rainbow stones. May serve some benefit in dark places, or at night.

stats.Effect: Emits a faint light from the location it is placed

item:glowstone.location: Craftable — Ruin Fragment x1, Dewkissed Herba x1

item:godfrey-icon.name: Godfrey Icon
item:godfrey-icon.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Godfrey. Raises charge attack power of sorceries, incantations, and skills.

stats.Effect: Enhances charged spells and skills.

item:godfrey-icon.location: Goldfrey (Golden Lineage) at the Village of the Albinaurics plateau, charged-attack/spell talisman.

item:godrick-great-rune.name: Godrick's Great Rune
item:godrick-great-rune.description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Godrick. Its blessing raises all attributes. This Great Rune is known as the anchor ring, found in the center of the Elden Ring. The first demigods were The Elden Lord Godfrey and his offspring, the golden lineage.

stats.Effect: Raises all attributes

item:godrick-knight-armor.name: Godrick Knight Armor
item:godrick-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick The Grafted.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 10

item:godrick-knight-armor.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

item:godrick-knight-armor-altered.name: Godrick Knight Armor (altered)
item:godrick-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Godric Knight Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 10

item:godrick-knight-armor-altered.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies. Can be altered by Boc.

item:godrick-knight-gauntlets.name: Godrick Knight Gauntlets
item:godrick-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · StrEldenike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:godrick-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Godrick Knight Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

item:godrick-knight-greaves.name: Godrick Knight Greaves
item:godrick-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:godrick-knight-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

item:godrick-knight-helm.name: Godrick Knight Helm
item:godrick-knight-helm.description: Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:godrick-knight-helm.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

item:godrick-soldier-ashes.name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
item:godrick-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Godrick's soldiers.

stats.Effect: Summons two Godrick soldier spirits

item:godrick-soldier-ashes.location: Found in a cemetery on the west side of Stormhill.

item:godrick-soldier-gauntlets.name: Godrick Soldier Gauntlets
item:godrick-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:godrick-soldier-gauntlets.location: - The Godrick Soldier Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

item:godrick-soldier-greaves.name: Godrick Soldier Greaves
item:godrick-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:godrick-soldier-greaves.location: Chance to drop by Godrick Soldier enemies.

item:godrick-soldier-helm.name: Godrick Soldier Helm
item:godrick-soldier-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:godrick-soldier-helm.location: - Chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

item:godskin-apostle-bracelets.name: Godskin Apostle Bracelets
item:godskin-apostle-bracelets.description: Black bracelets of the Godskin Apostles.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:godskin-apostle-bracelets.location: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

item:godskin-apostle-hood.name: Godskin Apostle Hood
item:godskin-apostle-hood.description: Hood made by seweing together patches of smooth skin. Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:godskin-apostle-hood.location: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

item:godskin-apostle-robe.name: Godskin Apostle Robe
item:godskin-apostle-robe.description: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:godskin-apostle-robe.location: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

item:godskin-apostle-trousers.name: Godskin Apostle Trousers
item:godskin-apostle-trousers.description: Trousers made by seweing together patches of smooth skin.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 1 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:godskin-apostle-trousers.location: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

item:godskin-noble-bracelets.name: Godskin Noble Bracelets
item:godskin-noble-bracelets.description: Black bracelets of the Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · StrEldenike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:godskin-noble-bracelets.location: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

item:godskin-noble-hood.name: Godskin Noble Hood
item:godskin-noble-hood.description: Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unilke the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:godskin-noble-hood.location: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

item:godskin-noble-robe.name: Godskin Noble Robe
item:godskin-noble-robe.description: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles known for their seven-face aprons. Strengthens the Noble Presence incantation. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

stats.Negation: Physical 6.1 · Strike 9.5 · Slash 6.7 · Pierce 6.1 · Magic 13 · Fire 12.4 · Lightning 12.6 · Holy 14.1

item:godskin-noble-trousers.name: Godskin Noble Trousers
item:godskin-noble-trousers.description: Trousers made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes them plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

stats.Negation: Physical 2.3 · Strike 4.5 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2.3 · Magic 7.2 · Fire 6.5 · Lightning 6.8 · Holy 7.7

item:godskin-noble-trousers.location: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

item:godskin-peeler.name: Godskin Peeler
item:godskin-peeler.description: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.
item:godskin-peeler.location: To get the Godskin Peeler, travel to Dominula, Windmill Village at the northernmost peak of the Altus Plateau.

item:godskin-stitcher.name: Godskin Stitcher
item:godskin-stitcher.description: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.
item:godskin-stitcher.location: You can get the Godskin Stitcher in Elden Ring by defeating the Godskin Noble boss at the Temple of Eiglay in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

item:godskin-swaddling-cloth.name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
item:godskin-swaddling-cloth.description: Sacred cloth of the Godskin Apostles, made from supple skin sewn together.

stats.Effect: Successive attacks restore HP

item:godskin-swaddling-cloth.location: - Obtained from the Spiritcaller's Cave in northeastern Mountaintops of the Giants, by defeating all of the bosses at the end of the dungeon.

item:godslayer-s-greatsword.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
item:godslayer-s-greatsword.description: Sacred sword of the Dusk-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:godslayer-s-greatsword.location: The Godslayer's Greatsword is located in the basement of the Divine Tower of Caelid in the Dragonbarrow region.

item:godslayer-s-seal.name: Godslayer's Seal
item:godslayer-s-seal.description: Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian. Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.
item:godslayer-s-seal.location: The Godslayer's Seal is located in Stormveil Castle.

item:gold-bracelets.name: Gold Bracelets
item:gold-bracelets.description: Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches. Minimal adornments made my Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.
item:gold-bracelets.location: - The Gold Bracelets are obtained by completing Goldmask's questline.

item:gold-firefly.name: Gold Firefly
item:gold-firefly.description: Firefly that gives off a golden light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of water close to Minor Erdtrees. The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Golden light is considered to invite runes.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:gold-firefly.location: Found near waters close to Minor Erdtrees

item:gold-pickled-fowl-foot.name: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot
item:gold-pickled-fowl-foot.description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a golden medicinal solution. Craftable item. Boosts the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies for a certain duration Since old times, the needy would scrape the meat clean even from a fowl's claw.

stats.Effect: Boosts rune acquisition for a time (30%)

item:gold-pickled-fowl-foot.location: Crafted. Rowa fruit + gold firefly + fowl foot. Farm Lake of Rot / Siofra fireflies.

item:gold-scarab.name: Gold Scarab
item:gold-scarab.description: A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.

stats.Effect: Increases runes obtained from

item:gold-scarab.location: - Obtained by defeating the dual Cleanrot Knight in the Abandoned Cave in central Caelid. This cave can be reached by heading east of the Smoldering Wall, and using a large dead tree root to traverse a canyon.

item:gold-sewing-needle.name: Gold Sewing Needle

stats.Effect: Special sewing needle for demigod attire

item:gold-sewing-needle.location: Church of Vows, Liurnia of the Lakes

item:gold-tattoo-arm.name: Gold Tattoo (Arm)
item:gold-tattoo-arm.description: An intricate tattoo, etched into the flesh. The work of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Increases faith to the detriment of focus. It is an artificial tongue, created to express the Golden Order itself, now an unrelenting curse that binds the entire body with its rule. "Do your utmost, to rid yourself of doubt."

item:gold-tattoo-chest.name: Gold Tattoo (Chest)
item:gold-tattoo-chest.description: An intricate tattoo, etched into the flesh. The work of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Increases faith to the detriment of focus. It is an artificial tongue, created to express the Golden Order itself, now an unrelenting curse that binds the entire body with its rule. "Do your utmost, to rid yourself of doubt."

item:gold-tattoo-leg.name: Gold Tattoo (Leg)
item:gold-tattoo-leg.description: An intricate tattoo, etched into the flesh. The work of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Increases faith to the detriment of focus. It is an artificial tongue, created to express the Golden Order itself, now an unrelenting curse that binds the entire body with its rule. "Do your utmost, to rid yourself of doubt."

item:gold-tinged-excrement.name: Gold-Tinged Excrement
item:gold-tinged-excrement.description: Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Often hidden in woods and thickets. Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:gold-tinged-excrement.location: - Gold-Tinged Excrement is found hidden in forests and thickets throughout the Lands Between.

item:gold-waistwrap.name: Gold Waistwrap
item:gold-waistwrap.description: Waistwrap made in the image of Erdtree branches. A minimal adornment made by Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:gold-waistwrap.location: - Can be looted from Goldmask after collecting the Mending Rune of Perfect Order and reloading the area.

item:golden-arcs.name: Golden Arcs
item:golden-arcs.description: Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral. A swing of the arm releases a procession of golden arcs. Charging enhances potency. The arcs resemble barbs, a known symbol of coercive questioning.

stats.Effect: Releases a procession of golden arcs with a swing of the arm

item:golden-arrow.name: Golden Arrow
item:golden-arrow.description: Carved arrows made in tandem with the Erdtree Bow. Deals holy damage. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death, and able to prevent them from rising again.

stats.Effect: Carved arrow made in tandem with the Erdtree Bow

item:golden-beast-crest-shield.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
item:golden-beast-crest-shield.description: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greratshields, and subsequently easier to wield. The beast depicted is Serosh, aged counselor who guides the golden lineage.
item:golden-beast-crest-shield.location: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation. If you are not able to defeat it during your first visit, you can reattempt the fight later by going through the "Precipice of Anticipation" sending gate at the Four Belfries.

item:golden-bolt.name: Golden Bolt
item:golden-bolt.description: Bolt blessed with an incantation of the Erdtree. Deals powerful holy damage. Once used by guards of the Capital.
item:golden-bolt.location: - Purchased from the Hermit Merchant of Capital Outskirts for 120 Runes.

item:golden-braid.name: Golden Braid
item:golden-braid.description: Boosts holy damage negation by the utmost
item:golden-braid.location: - It can be found in the Shaman Village, in front of the Grandmother inside the trunk of a decayed tree on a hill.

stats.Effect: Reduces holy damage negation

item:golden-centipede.name: Golden Centipede
item:golden-centipede.description: The golden, desiccated remains of a centipede.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:golden-centipede.location: Start from the Minor Erdtree Catacombs

item:golden-dung.name: Golden Dung
item:golden-dung.description: Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:golden-epitaph.name: Golden Epitaph
item:golden-epitaph.description: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die. Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:golden-epitaph.location: The Golden Epitaph straight sword is located in the Auriza Hero's Grave on the Altus Plateau, just northeast of the Capital Outskirts.

item:golden-grease.name: Golden Grease
item:golden-grease.description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of holy resonant materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy holy damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Enchanted with an ancient Erdtree incantation. Such ministrations are all but a lost art in the realm of shadow.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy holy damage

item:golden-great-arrow.name: Golden Great Arrow
item:golden-great-arrow.description: Carved greatarrows made together with the Erdtree Greatbow. Deals holy damage. Imbued with an oath-sworn incantation, which boosts the attack and defense of the archer and their nearby allies.

item:golden-greatshield.name: Golden Greatshield
item:golden-greatshield.description: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.
item:golden-greatshield.location: 4% chance to be dropped by Leyndell Knights throughout Altus Plateau and in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:golden-halberd.name: Golden Halberd
item:golden-halberd.description: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Deals holy damage. A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one mere human strength to wield.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:golden-horn-tender.name: Golden Horn Tender
item:golden-horn-tender.description: Old currency used by hornsent made by coating spiral horns with gold. Boosts the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies for a certain duration. Can also be sold for a high price. Once bestowed upon inquisitors as an honor.

stats.Effect: Boosts rune acquisition for a time

item:golden-land.name: Golden Land
item:golden-land.description: Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash a blast of sacred energy that coalesces into golden darts. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike
item:golden-land.location: Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest

stats.Effect: Ash

item:golden-lightning-fortification.name: Golden Lightning Fortification

stats.Effect: Greatly increases lightning resistance for self and allies

item:golden-lightning-fortification.location: Drops from a Scarab south of the Dragon Temple Lift

item:golden-lion-shield.name: Golden Lion Shield
item:golden-lion-shield.description: Shield made to resemble a fierce golden lion with a luxuriant mane. Awarded to especially valorous members of Radahn's personal guard on the occasion of its formation.

item:golden-order-canon.name: Golden Order Canon
item:golden-order-canon.location: - The Golden Order Canon is unobtainable.

stats.Effect: Can be given to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:golden-order-flail.name: Golden Order Flail

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Fai C

item:golden-order-flail.description: A flail with three golden rings for striking heads, the sacred signature weapon of the esteemed Broken Mask. The golden bands are modelled upon the Elden Ring itself, half-corporeal and half formed of light, all in the process of shattering.

item:golden-order-greatsword.name: Golden Order Greatsword
item:golden-order-greatsword.description: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments. Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai C

item:golden-order-principia.name: Golden Order Principia
item:golden-order-principia.description:
Prayerbook of the Golden Order fundamentalists. A dense and complex academic treatise that contains the Order's fundamental principles. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Radagon's Rings of Light
- Law of Regression

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:golden-order-principles.name: Golden Order Principles
item:golden-order-principles.description:
Scroll containing incantations. Can be given to a learned cleric
in order to learn incantations.

stats.Effect: Scroll containing incantations

item:golden-order-seal.name: Golden Order Seal
item:golden-order-seal.description: A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Fundamentalist incantations. Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantation using both intelligence and faith.
item:golden-order-seal.location: In Elden Ring, the Golden Order Seal is located on a corpse behind the Minor Erdtree Church in the Altus Plateau (near the Capital Outskirts).

item:golden-order-totality.name: Golden Order Totality
item:golden-order-totality.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:golden-parry.name: Golden Parry
item:golden-parry.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Golden Parry: Perform an Erdtree incantation and swing the shield to deflect enemy attacks and break their stance. Effective even at a slight distance."Usable on small and medium shields.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:golden-prosthetic.name: Golden Prosthetic
item:golden-prosthetic.description: Golden prosthetic forged using ancient techniques

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:golden-prosthetic.location: - The playable version of Golden Prosthetic is cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:golden-rowa.name: Golden Rowa
item:golden-rowa.description: A Rowa fruit tinted with gold. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for craftign items

item:golden-rowa.location: Rise and the Bower of Bounty

item:golden-rune-1.name: Golden Rune [1]
item:golden-rune-1.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain a small number of runes

item:golden-rune-10.name: Golden Rune [10]
item:golden-rune-10.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.

stats.Effect: Use to gain a great many runes
Use to gain many runes

item:golden-rune-12.name: Golden Rune [12]
item:golden-rune-12.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold. Use to gain 7500 runes. The grace of gold blessed those who were first to serve it with the most vivid coloration.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 7500 runes

item:golden-rune-13.name: Golden Rune [13]
item:golden-rune-13.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain a great many runes

item:golden-rune-2.name: Golden Rune [2]
item:golden-rune-2.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain a small number of runes (400)

item:golden-rune-3.name: Golden Rune [3]
item:golden-rune-3.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Land Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain runes

item:golden-rune-3.location: Golden Rune [3] is dropped by various enemies:

item:golden-rune-4.name: Golden Rune [4]
item:golden-rune-4.description: Grace that dwells Within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain runes

item:golden-rune-5.name: Golden Rune [5]
item:golden-rune-5.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.

stats.Effect: Use to gain runes (1600)

item:golden-rune-6.name: Golden Rune [6]
item:golden-rune-6.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain many runes

item:golden-rune-7.name: Golden Rune [7]
item:golden-rune-7.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.

stats.Effect: Use to gain many runes

item:golden-rune-8.name: Golden Rune [8]
item:golden-rune-8.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.

stats.Effect: Use to gain many runes

item:golden-rune-9.name: Golden Rune [9]
item:golden-rune-9.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.

stats.Effect: Use to gain many runes

item:golden-seed.name: Golden Seed
item:golden-seed.description: A golden seed, found at the base of an illusory tree.

stats.Effect: Increases Sacred Flask's number of uses

item:golden-slam.name: Golden Slam
item:golden-slam.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Golden Slam: Skill of the avatars who protect Minor Erdtrees. Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:golden-sunflower.name: Golden Sunflower
item:golden-sunflower.description: A golden sunflower that grows facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:golden-tailoring-tools.name: Golden Tailoring Tools

stats.Effect: Allows demigod garb alteration at sites of grace

item:golden-tailoring-tools.location: Church of Vows, Liurnia of the Lakes

item:golden-vow.name: Golden Vow
item:golden-vow.location: Corpse-finger ruins north of the Altus highway, or the shared ash of war version from Knight Bernahl.
item:golden-vow.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Golden Vow: Skill passed down from antiquity among the knights of the capital. Raise armament aloft and pledge to honor the Erdtree in battle, granting self and nearby allies increased attack power and defense."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Increases attack and defense for self and allies

item:golden-vow-consumable.name: Golden Vow (Consumable)
item:golden-vow-consumable.description: Golden Vow may be found in the Realm of Shadow on the Scadu Altus.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to increase Attack Power
Increases attack and defense for self and allies

item:goldmask-s-rags.name: Goldmask's Rags
item:goldmask-s-rags.description: Worn rags that just barely cover the body. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excess of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:goldmask-s-rags.location: Complete Goldmask's questline, then reload the area to loot the armor set from where you found him.

item:golem-fist.name: Golem Fist

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:golem-fist.location: - 3% chance to be dropped by Golem Smiths in Taylew's Ruined Forge.
item:golem-fist.description: A giant fist of fractured rock. Taken from the body of a golem of the ruined forges. Carved with a smithscript enabling strong attacks to launch the entire fist straight ahead.

item:golem-greatbow.name: Golem Greatbow
item:golem-greatbow.description: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem. Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.
item:golem-greatbow.location: The Golem Greatbow is a random drop (not guaranteed) from specific Archer Golems.

item:golem-s-great-arrow.name: Golem's Great Arrow
item:golem-s-great-arrow.description: Greatarrow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Used by the Guardian Golem. This hefty arrow is enrobed in tempestuous winds, allowing it to break enemy stances and guards with ease.

item:golem-s-halberd.name: Golem's Halberd
item:golem-s-halberd.description: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.
item:golem-s-halberd.location: The Golem's Halberd is a random drop from Guardian Golems wielding this weapon, with the best early farming location being the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

item:golem-s-magic-arrow.name: Golem's Magic Arrow
item:golem-s-magic-arrow.description: Greatarrow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Imbued with its ancient magic. Deals magic damage.

item:gostoc-s-bell-bearing.name: Gostoc's Bell Bearing
item:gostoc-s-bell-bearing.description: Gatekeeper Gostoc's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:gourmet-scorpion-stew.name: Gourmet Scorpion Stew
item:gourmet-scorpion-stew.description: Scorpion simmered in a black soup. An exquisite dish chock-full of mouth-watering scorpion claws. Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores a great amount of HP. The thoughts and feelings of the cook melt and blend into the stew, but those who can distinguish the taste of love are few and far between. "Partake, partake, until thou art sated."

stats.Effect: Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores a great amount of HP

item:gowry-s-bell-bearing.name: Gowry's Bell Bearing
item:gowry-s-bell-bearing.description: Sage Gowry's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:grace-mimic.name: Grace Mimic
item:grace-mimic.description: A fetish indicating the guidance of grace.

stats.Effect: Light shows the path, but without order

item:grafted-blade-greatsword.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
item:grafted-blade-greatsword.description: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret. One of the legendary armaments. A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.

item:grafted-dragon.name: Grafted Dragon
item:grafted-dragon.description: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:grafted-dragon.location: Remembrance of the Grafted (Godrick the Grafted)

item:grass-hair-ornament.name: Grass Hair Ornament
item:grass-hair-ornament.description: A headdress made from wildflowers. Wearing this might make you less easy to spot.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:grass-hair-ornament.location: - The Grass Hair Ornament is cut content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay.

item:grave-cricket.name: Grave Cricket
item:grave-cricket.description: Cricket that produces a raspy cry. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found near stone coffins. The sound of these crickets are often taken to be the rustling of the restless dead, or sometimes the sound of their calling voices.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:grave-cricket.location: - Grave Crickets are found in Charo's Hidden Grave and around stone coffins beached on the Cerulean Coast.

item:grave-glovewort-1.name: Grave Glovewort [1]
item:grave-glovewort-1.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits. Strengthens ashes to +1. The art of strengthening ashes is known as spirit tuning. only a spirit tuner may perform this deed.

stats.Effect: Strengthen ashes to +1.

item:grave-glovewort-2.name: Grave Glovewort [2]
item:grave-glovewort-2.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits. Strengthens ashes to +2. Spirit tuning is not merely the simple act of imbuing strength. It is an art that lies somewhere between tuning an instrument and conducting a conversation, leaving both parties enriched.

stats.Effect: Strengthen ashes to +2.

item:grave-glovewort-3.name: Grave Glovewort [3]
item:grave-glovewort-3.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthen ashes to +3

item:grave-glovewort-4.name: Grave Glovewort [4]
item:grave-glovewort-4.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +4

item:grave-glovewort-5.name: Grave Glovewort [5]
item:grave-glovewort-5.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +5

item:grave-glovewort-6.name: Grave Glovewort [6]
item:grave-glovewort-6.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +6

item:grave-glovewort-7.name: Grave Glovewort [7]
item:grave-glovewort-7.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +7

item:grave-glovewort-8.name: Grave Glovewort [8]
item:grave-glovewort-8.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +8

item:grave-glovewort-9.name: Grave Glovewort [9]
item:grave-glovewort-9.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +9

item:grave-keeper-s-brainpan.name: Grave Keeper's Brainpan
item:grave-keeper-s-brainpan.description: Skull bone of an old grave keeper. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found in hidden grave of Charo. The old grave keepers are boatsmen, and continue to summon the dead even after withering away.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:grave-keeper-s-brainpan.location: - Found scattered around Charo's Hidden Grave.

item:grave-keeper-s-cookbook-1.name: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1]
item:grave-keeper-s-cookbook-1.description:
A record of crafting techniques of the grave keepers who watch over those who rest in the realm of shadow. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Piquebone Arrow
- Piquebone Arrow (Fletched)
- Piquebone Bolt

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:grave-keeper-s-cookbook-2.name: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2]
item:grave-keeper-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques of the grave keepers who watch over those who rest in the realm of shadow. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Polter Stone

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:grave-scythe.name: Grave Scythe
item:grave-scythe.description: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.
item:grave-scythe.location: To get the Grave Scythe in Elden Ring, you need to farm Gravekeeper Skeletons that wield the weapon.

item:grave-violet.name: Grave Violet
item:grave-violet.description: A purple flower than blooms in graveyards. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:gravebird-anklets.name: Gravebird Anklets
item:gravebird-anklets.description: Stone anklets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

item:gravebird-armor.name: Gravebird Armor
item:gravebird-armor.description: Stone armor with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

item:gravebird-ashes.name: Gravebird Ashes
item:gravebird-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Gravebird. The spirit of an old golem and spiritgrave keeper, who flies with stone wings and spouts ghostflame. According to legend, the Gravebirds were crafted to be kindred to the Deathbirds.

stats.Effect: Summons Gravebird spirit

item:gravebird-bracelets.name: Gravebird Bracelets
item:gravebird-bracelets.description: Stone bracelets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

item:gravebird-helm.name: Gravebird Helm
item:gravebird-helm.description: Stone helm with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Empowers spells which summon rings of spectral light. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

item:gravebird-s-blackquill-armor.name: Gravebird's Blackquill Armor
item:gravebird-s-blackquill-armor.description: Stone armor with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Featuring a cape of black Deathbird feathers, it enhances jumping attacks. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

item:gravekeeper-cloak.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
item:gravekeeper-cloak.description: Defensive wear encircled by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 8 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:gravekeeper-cloak.location: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

item:gravekeeper-cloak-altered.name: Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
item:gravekeeper-cloak-altered.description: Lighter version of the Gravekeeper Cloak.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 8 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 9 · Holy 8

item:gravel-stone.name: Gravel Stone
item:gravel-stone.description: A small clump of sharp, pointed stones. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:gravel-stone-seal.name: Gravel Stone Seal
item:gravel-stone-seal.location: The Gravel Stone Seal is found in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
item:gravel-stone-seal.description: Sacred seal made from Gravel Stone thought to be an ancient dragon scale. Enhances Dragon Cult incantations of the Royal Capital. The worship of the ancient dragons does not conflict with belief in the Erdtree. After all, this seal, and lightning itself, are both imbued with gold.

item:graven-mass-talisman.name: Graven-Mass Talisman
item:graven-mass-talisman.description: A talisman depicting the first school of graven mages — a nightmare that would continue to haunt the academy. Greatly raises potency of sorceries. The primeval current is a forbidden tradition of glintstone sorcery. To those who cleave to its teachings, the act of collecting sorcerers to fashion them into the seeds of stars is but another path of scientific inquiry.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises potency of sorceries.

item:graven-mass-talisman.location: Reward from the Raya Lucaria sorcery chain.

item:graven-school-talisman.name: Graven-School Talisman
item:graven-school-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a school of graven mages, the nightmare of the academy.

stats.Effect: Raises potency of sorceries

item:gravitas.name: Gravitas
item:gravitas.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following Skill:Gravitas A Skill from a great white king with stone skin.Pierce the ground with your armament to damage foes as a surge of gravity draws them in.It can be used on melee armaments that are not small.

stats.Effect: ash

item:gravitational-missile.name: Gravitational Missile
item:gravitational-missile.location: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast found in the crater north of the Finger Ruins of Dheo.
item:gravitational-missile.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Fires a gravitational projectile that pulls in enemies before finally exploding. Charging extends reach of projectile and number of inward pulls. Said to have originated in the lightless dark far beyond—the home of the fallingstar beasts.

stats.Effect: Fires a bolt of gravity that pulls in enemies before exploding

item:gravity-stone-chunk.name: Gravity Stone Chunk
item:gravity-stone-chunk.description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to cause a gravitational explosion

item:gravity-stone-chunk.location: Chest in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid

item:gravity-stone-fan.name: Gravity Stone Fan
item:gravity-stone-fan.description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to emit fan-shaped gravitational shockwave

item:gravity-stone-fan.location: Chest in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid

item:gravity-stone-peddler-s-bell-bearin.name: Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing
item:gravity-stone-peddler-s-bell-bearin.description:
Bell bearing of an unfortunate gravity stone peddler who was slain by the Bell Bearing Hunter. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Gravity Stone Fan
- Gravity Stone Chunk

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:gravity-well.name: Gravity Well
item:gravity-well.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Fires a projectile of condensed gravitational force. Those struck by it will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency. A gravitational technique studied by the young Radahn. His master was an Alabaster Lord with skin of stone.

stats.Effect: Pulls foes toward caster with gravity projectile

item:greasemonger-s-bell-bearing.name: Greasemonger's Bell Bearing
item:greasemonger-s-bell-bearing.description:
The bell bearing of a hornsent greasemonger who did not survive the war. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Root Resin
- Knot Resin

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:greasemonger-s-bell-bearing.location: Bearing is found north of the Bridge Leading to the Village

item:great-arrow.name: Great Arrow
item:great-arrow.description: A greatarrow as large as a spear for use with greatbows. Used by archers of monstrous strength employed by a lord's army.

item:great-club.name: Great Club
item:great-club.description: An enormous club of hardwood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.
item:great-club.location: The Great Club weapon can be found at the following location: Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss in Old Altus Tunnel, the tunnel requires two Stonesword Keys.

item:great-dragonfly-head.name: Great Dragonfly Head
item:great-dragonfly-head.description: Head of a large dragonfly. Material used for crafting items. Long believed to have the ability to neutralize poisons.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:great-epee.name: Great Epee
item:great-epee.description: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade. Commonly used in life or death duels. Like its smaller counterparts, its made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.
item:great-epee.location: The Great Épée is located in West Limgrave, inside a chest in an enemy encampment.

item:great-ghost-glovewort.name: Great Ghost Glovewort
item:great-ghost-glovewort.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to this grand specimen.

stats.Effect: Strengthens renowned ashes to +10

item:great-ghost-glovewort.location: Found in chests in Ainsel River, Night's Sacred Ground, Nokstella and the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum.

item:great-glintstone-shard.name: Great Glintstone Shard
item:great-glintstone-shard.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

stats.Effect: Fires larger magic projectiles from glintstone

item:great-glintstone-shard.location: Sold by Sorceress Sellen - Academy Scroll

item:great-grave-glovewort.name: Great Grave Glovewort
item:great-grave-glovewort.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. An especially large specimen.

stats.Effect: Strengthens ashes to +10

item:great-grave-glovewort.location: Found in the Consecrated Snowfield, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, Crumbling Farum Azula and Elphael.

item:great-heal.name: Great Heal
item:great-heal.description: Superior incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

stats.Effect: Greatly Heals HP for self and nearby allies

item:great-heal.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Altus Plateau

item:great-horned-headband.name: Great Horned Headband
item:great-horned-headband.description: Headband decorated by a pair of great horns.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:great-horned-headband.location: - The Great Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

item:great-jar-s-arsenal.name: Great-Jar's Arsenal
item:great-jar-s-arsenal.description: A charm that resembles a great jar overflowing with weaponry. Vastly boosts maximum equipment load.

stats.Effect: Vastly Raises maximum equip load (~19%)

item:great-jar-s-arsenal.location: Reward for the three Great-Jar duels in Dragonbarrow.

item:great-katana.name: Great Katana
item:great-katana.location: Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought.
item:great-katana.description: Large katana with a prominent tempering pattern on its black blade, unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. The most finely honed of its ilk. Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.

item:great-knife.name: Great Knife
item:great-knife.description: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.
item:great-knife.location: The Great Knife is the starting weapon for the Bandit class.

item:great-mace.name: Great Mace
item:great-mace.description: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin. Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.
item:great-mace.location: The Great Mace is located inside a chest at a soldier camp southwest of the Grand Lift of Dectus in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:great-omenkiller-cleaver.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
item:great-omenkiller-cleaver.description: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omen ktillers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.
item:great-omenkiller-cleaver.location: The Great Omenkiller Cleaver is dropped by an Omenkiller mini-boss inside Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

item:great-oracular-bubble.name: Great Oracular Bubble
item:great-oracular-bubble.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient

stats.Effect: Launches a large magic bubble

item:great-oracular-bubble.location: Portal found on some ruins south of the Worshippers' Woods

item:great-stars.name: Great Stars
item:great-stars.description: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss. A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.
item:great-stars.location: The Great Stars is located in the Altus Plateau, inside a chest on the back of a large carriage pulled by two trolls.

item:great-turtle-shell.name: Great Turtle Shell
item:great-turtle-shell.description: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks. The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed.
item:great-turtle-shell.location: - Found in the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise. Reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant, jumping towards the tower.

item:greataxe.name: Greataxe
item:greataxe.description: Greatxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains. Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.
item:greataxe.location: The standard Greataxe can be found early in West Limgrave, in a chest at the rear of a moving carriage pulled by two trolls.

item:greatblade-phalanx.name: Greatblade Phalanx
item:greatblade-phalanx.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Creates a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. Used by the enchanted troll knights. They were the comrades of the young Rennala, bound by oath.

stats.Effect: Forms a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades

item:greatbow.name: Greatbow
item:greatbow.description: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire great arrows.
item:greatbow.location: You can find the standard Greatbow inside a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower in the northeastern Altus Plateau.

item:greater-potentate-s-cookbook-1.name: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1]
item:greater-potentate-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques of the greater potentate who roamed lands near and far. Haunted by the grotesque practice of his village of birth, he stuffed great pots with all manner of things. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Hefty Fire Pot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:greater-potentate-s-cookbook-10.description: A record of crafting techniques of the greater potentate who roamed lands near and far. Haunted by the grotesque practice of his village of birth, he stuffed great pots with all manner of things. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Hefty Fly Pot

item:greathelm.name: Greathelm
item:greathelm.description: Sturdy greathelm made from iron. Though it is uncomfortably heavy and obstructs the vision of the wearer, it provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:greathelm.location: Nomadic Merchant near the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank

item:greathood.name: Greathood
item:greathood.description: Hood far larger than the head it is meant to cover. A burial shroud of sorts for those who discover, at long last, the truth they sought.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:greathorn-hammer.name: Greathorn Hammer
item:greathorn-hammer.description: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors. The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
item:greathorn-hammer.location: The Greathorn Hammer in Elden Ring is acquired by farming Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield the weapon in the Siofra River underground region.

item:greatjar.name: Greatjar
item:greatjar.description: A greatjar which fits comfortably over the head when upturned. Attire of the shamans who perform their worship at gaols. Increases the power of thrown pots of all sizes. They offer their prayers to the innards of the greatjars, such that they might be reborn one day into sainthood. This is the cycle of death and rebirth, taken into the hands of mortal men.

item:greatshield-soldier-ashes.name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
item:greatshield-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon five greatshield soldier spirits.

stats.Effect: Summons five greatshield soldier spirits

item:greatshield-talisman.name: Greatshield Talisman
item:greatshield-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a knight holding a greatshield. Boosts guarding ability.

stats.Effect: Boosts guarding ability.

item:greatshield-talisman.location: Carriage chest east of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, watched by three fire-arrow ballistae.

item:greatsword.name: Greatsword
item:greatsword.description: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.
item:greatsword.location: The iconic Greatsword (often called the "Guts" sword) is located in the region of Caelid.
related: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame
Remembrance of a God and a Lord

item:greatsword-of-damnation.name: Greatsword of Damnation

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:greatsword-of-damnation.description: Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. Used by the hornsent in the execution of a damnation like no other. The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade.
related: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

item:greatsword-of-radahn-light.name: Greatsword of Radahn (Light)

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:greatsword-of-radahn-light.description: Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars—the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.
related: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

item:greatsword-of-radahn-lord.name: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)
item:greatsword-of-radahn-lord.description: Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars—the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.
item:greatsword-of-radahn-lord.location: Can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of a God and a Lord with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
related: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

item:greatsword-of-solitude.name: Greatsword of Solitude
item:greatsword-of-solitude.location: - Defeat the Knight of the Solitary Gaol in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.
item:greatsword-of-solitude.description: Steel greatsword wielded by the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Through a secret rite, they relinquished their hearts for heightened battle prowess. Next, they engraved their blades with two crests: one depicting the light of birth, and the other, solitude.

item:greaves-of-night.name: Greaves of Night
item:greaves-of-night.description: Bottomless black greaves, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark. Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

item:greaves-of-solitude.name: Greaves of Solitude
item:greaves-of-solitude.description: Steel greaves of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel. The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

item:green-turtle-talisman.name: Green Turtle Talisman
item:green-turtle-talisman.description: A talisman in the shape of a green turtle. Raises stamina recovery speed.

stats.Effect: Raises stamina recovery speed.

item:greenburst-crystal-tear.name: Greenburst Crystal Tear
item:greenburst-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction gradually restores stamina recovery speed.
