item:kaiden-gauntlets.location: - The Kaiden Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

item:kaiden-helm.name: Kaiden Helm
item:kaiden-helm.description: Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords. These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:kaiden-helm.location: - Kaiden Helm has a 3.00% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

item:kaiden-sellsword-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a Kaiden sellsword.

stats.Effect: Summons Kaiden Sellsword spirit.

item:kaiden-sellsword-ashes.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in the Cliffbottom Catacombs, Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:kaiden-trousers.name: Kaiden Trousers

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 4 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:kaiden-trousers.location: - Kaiden Trousers have a 3.00% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

item:kal-s-bell-bearing.name: Kalé's Bell Bearing
item:kal-s-bell-bearing.description: Merchant Kalé's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:karolos-glintstone-crown.name: Karolos Glintstone Crown
item:karolos-glintstone-crown.description: Stone mask depicting the wise Karolos

item:katar.name: Katar
item:katar.description: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.
item:katar.location: The Katar can be found inside a treasure chest at Fort Gael in southwestern Caelid.

item:keep-wall-key.name: Keep Wall Key
item:keep-wall-key.description: Iron key with an engraved crest. Opens the wooden door beside the great gate on the shadow keep's west wall.

stats.Effect: Opens the wooden door on the west wall of the keep

item:keep-wall-key.location: - The Keep Wall Key is unobtainable.

item:kick.name: Kick
item:kick.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Kick: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:kindred-of-rot-ashes.name: Kindred of Rot Ashes
item:kindred-of-rot-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot. This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken.

stats.Effect: Summons Kindred of Rot spirit

item:kindred-of-rot-ashes.location: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Caelid Catacombs.

item:kindred-of-rot-s-exultation.name: Kindred of Rot's Exultation
item:kindred-of-rot-s-exultation.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of pests.

stats.Effect: Poisoning or rot in vicinity increases attack power

item:kindred-of-rot-s-exultation.location: - Kindred of Rot's Exultation is obtained by defeating the Kindred of Rot in Seethewater Cave in central Mt. Gelmir.

item:kite-shield.name: Kite Shield
item:kite-shield.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.
item:kite-shield.location: Runes from the Nomadic Merchant by the Liurnia Lake Shore

item:knifeprint-clue.name: Knifeprint Clue
item:knifeprint-clue.description: A simple map given by Fia. A clue to the whereabouts of a black knifeprint.

stats.Effect:
Simple map showing location of black knifeprint
Examine using

item:knight-armor.name: Knight Armor
item:knight-armor.description: Iron armor of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 9 · Holy 8

item:knight-armor.location: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:knight-gauntlets.name: Knight Gauntlets
item:knight-gauntlets.description: Iron gauntlets of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:knight-gauntlets.location: - The Knight Gauntlets can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 3,000 runes.

item:knight-greaves.name: Knight Greaves
item:knight-greaves.description: Iron greaves of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:knight-greaves.location: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:knight-helm.name: Knight Helm
item:knight-helm.description: Iron helm of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:knight-helm.location: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:knight-s-greatsword.name: Knight's Greatsword
item:knight-s-greatsword.description: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.
item:knight-s-greatsword.location: The Knight's Greatsword is not a guaranteed drop, but it is farmed by killing wandering knights throughout the Lands Between.

item:knight-s-lightning-spear.name: Knight's Lightning Spear
item:knight-s-lightning-spear.location: Scorpion River Catacombs chest, Realm of Shadow.
item:knight-s-lightning-spear.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear while also manifesting ancient dragon crests. On throwing the spear, the crests will launch additional spears. Charge to increase the number of crests and add a bolt of lightning to impact. An incantation that was taught only to the most accomplished knights, and now a lost art in the Lands Between.

stats.Effect: Hurls lightning spear while firing additional spears from ancient dragon crests

item:knot-resin.name: Knot Resin
item:knot-resin.description: Knot-shaped lump of resin that exuded from the roots of trees. Material used for crafting items. Found near tree roots everywhere in the realm of shadow. Serves as a primitive catalyst, making it suitable for processing using sorceries, incantations, and the like.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:knot-resin.location: Found near tree roots everywhere in the realm of shadow

item:kukri.name: Kukri
item:kukri.description: A large knife used for throwing.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up onset of blood loss

item:kukri.location: - Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region

stats.Effect: Enhances dash attacks

item:lamenter-s-mask.name: Lamenter's Mask
item:lamenter-s-mask.description: A stone mask twisted into an expression of rapturous grief. Use while disrobed to transform into a lamenter. The change cannot be undone except by death. Using this mask while already transformed causes the head to swell in size. This transformation tallies with the state of a denizen of paradise, but the people of the tower denied and hid it from the world. In their foolishness, they viewed true bliss with deep fear.

stats.Effect: Transforms wearer into a lamenter and causes head to swell in size

item:lamenting-visage.name: Lamenting Visage
item:lamenting-visage.location: Found on a corpse within the Lamenter's Gaol behind an illusory wall and a gate needing the Gaol Lower Level Key to unlock.
item:lamenting-visage.description: A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area. The unusual expression somehow imparts a sense of contentment. The languid ease of one who needs not sight.

item:lance.name: Lance
item:lance.description: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce. Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.
item:lance.location: The Lance is located in northern Limgrave on a ruined structure within an enemy camp, situated just northeast of the Warmaster's Shack.

item:lance-talisman.name: Lance Talisman
item:lance-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a lance and a knight. Enhances attacks while on horseback.

stats.Effect: Enhances attacks on horseback

item:lance-talisman.location: - Obtained from the northeastern-most tip of Stormhill directly west of the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

item:land-octopus-ovary.name: Land Octopus Ovary
item:land-octopus-ovary.description: Puffy, milky white ovary of a land octopus. Material used for crafting items. Land octopuses eat humans in order to bear young, and theirs is the blood that runs through these ovaries.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:land-of-reeds-armor.name: Land of Reeds Armor
item:land-of-reeds-armor.description: Armor made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

item:land-of-reeds-armor-altered.description: Armor of a warrior from the land of reeds

item:land-of-reeds-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets wrapped in tough leather. Worn by the warriors of the Land of Reeds

item:land-squirt-ashes.name: Land Squirt Ashes
item:land-squirt-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three land squirts Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings

stats.Effect: Summons three land squirts

item:land-squirt-ashes.location: Found in Liurnia of the Lakes, at the foot of the cliffs east of Academy Gate Town.

item:lands-between-rune.name: Lands Between Rune
item:lands-between-rune.description: Grace said to have once dwelled in the eyes of the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold.

stats.Effect: Use to gain many runes

item:lands-between-rune.location: The Lands Between Rune can only be acquired as a Keepsake during character creation.

item:lansseax-s-glaive.name: Lansseax's Glaive
item:lansseax-s-glaive.description: Incantation that channels the powr of the ancient dragon Lansseax.

stats.Effect: Sweeps from above with red lightning glaive.

item:lantern.name: Lantern
item:lantern.description: A small waist-worn lantern that illuminates surroundings. Use once to turn on, and again to turn off. While its light is dimmer than that of a torch, it has the advantage of freeing up the user's hands.

stats.Effect: Attach to waist to illuminate surroundings

item:lantern.location: Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore

item:large-club.name: Large Club
item:large-club.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.
item:large-club.location: The Large Club is hidden in the southern tip of West Limgrave, just below the Forlorn Hound Evergaol.

item:large-glintstone-scrap.name: Large Glintstone Scrap
item:large-glintstone-scrap.description: Large piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels.

stats.Effect: Break gem and use FP to produce many magic bolts

item:large-glintstone-scrap.location: In a hut guarded by Rotten Strays in Limgrave Tunnels, and on a corpse behind the shack in Morne Tunnel.

item:large-leather-shield.name: Large Leather Shield
item:large-leather-shield.description: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.

item:larval-tear.name: Larval Tear
item:larval-tear.description: Core of a creature of mimicry known as a silver tear.

stats.Effect: Material needed by Rennala to grant rebirth

item:larval-tear.location: Silver sphere enemies and a few static corpses. Needed for Rennala respec and Boc.

item:larval-tear-spirit.name: Larval Tear (Spirit)
item:larval-tear-spirit.description: Larval Tears are Key Items in Shadow of the Erdtree.
item:larval-tear-spirit.location: - Found at night in spiritgrave fairy rings around the Realm of Shadow.

stats.Effect: Material used to perfect rebirth

item:latenna-the-albinauric.name: Latenna the Albinauric
item:latenna-the-albinauric.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric.

stats.Effect: Summons the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric

item:latenna-the-albinauric.location: Obtained after talking to Latenna the Albinauric (NPC) at Slumbering Wolf's Shack and accepting her request.

sections.heading: Questline (3 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Liurnia of the Lakes (Slumbering Wolf's Shack)] Meet Latenna at the Slumbering Wolf’s Shack 2. [Mountaintops of the Giants (Castle Sol)] Take Castle Sol for the medallion’s other half 3. [Consecrated Snowfields (Apostate Derelict)] Summon Latenna at the Apostate Derelict

questSteps.title: Meet Latenna at the Slumbering Wolf’s Shack
questSteps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Slumbering Wolf's Shack)
questSteps.text: Latenna can be found at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack, accessible by clearing the Lakeside Crystal Cave. If you have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), obtained from Old Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics, she will die and you will be able to pick up Latenna the Albinauric (Spirit Ashes). If you have already obtained Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) from Castle Sol, Latenna will already be dead, and you can pick up her Spirit Ashes.

questSteps.title: Take Castle Sol for the medallion’s other half
questSteps.text: After defeating Commander Niall, continue past his arena and pick up the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left).

questSteps.title: Summon Latenna at the Apostate Derelict
questSteps.text: Travel to the Apostate Derelict in the northernmost part of the Consecrated Snowfields and approach the giant Albinauric woman to summon Latenna. Exhaust Latenna's dialogue to obtain a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

item:latenna-the-albinauric-spirit-ash.description: Make sure to place her carefully, preferably on a high, hard to reach spot.
item:latenna-the-albinauric-spirit-ash.location: Obtained after talking to Latenna the Albinauric (NPC) at Slumbering Wolf's Shack and accepting her request.

item:law-of-causality.name: Law of Causality
item:law-of-causality.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

stats.Effect: Retaliates upon receiving a number of blows

item:law-of-causality.location: Sold by Twin Maiden Husks - Mohg

item:law-of-regression.name: Law of Regression
item:law-of-regression.description: Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals. Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms. The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge.

stats.Effect: Heals all ailments and dispels all special effects

item:law-of-regression.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Golden Order Principia

item:lazuli-glintstone-crown.name: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
item:lazuli-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:lazuli-glintstone-sword.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
item:lazuli-glintstone-sword.description: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:lazuli-glintstone-sword.location: The Lazuli Glintstone Sword is a rare drop (roughly a 2% drop rate) from Lazuli Sorcerers wielding swords and shields.

item:lazuli-robe.name: Lazuli Robe
item:lazuli-robe.description: Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy. These scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars. This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:lazuli-robe.location: Chance to drop from Lazuli Sorcerer enemies that wear it.

item:leaden-hardtear.name: Leaden Hardtear
item:leaden-hardtear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts poise in mixed physick

item:leather-arm-wraps.name: Leather Arm Wraps
item:leather-arm-wraps.description: Arm wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps. Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

item:leather-armor.name: Leather Armor
item:leather-armor.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather armor worn by a savvy soldier.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 9 · Fire 9 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:leather-boots.name: Leather Boots
item:leather-boots.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather boots worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 5 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:leather-crown.name: Leather Crown
item:leather-crown.description: Helm worn by highland warriors, pieced together using leather. The white favor represents their home settlement. Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

item:leather-draped-tabard.name: Leather-Draped Tabard
item:leather-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl draped over the shoulders.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 10 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 12 · Holy 10

item:leather-draped-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

item:leather-gloves.name: Leather Gloves
item:leather-gloves.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather gloves worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:leather-gloves.location: - The Leather Gloves are obtained by defeating Patches.

item:leather-headband.name: Leather Headband
item:leather-headband.description: Headband worn by highland warriors, made of woven leather. The white favor represents their home settlement. Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

item:leather-leg-wraps.name: Leather Leg Wraps
item:leather-leg-wraps.description: Leg wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps. The addition of animal pelt keeps the wearer warm. Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

item:leather-trousers.name: Leather Trousers
item:leather-trousers.description: Well-made leather trousers. The lower legs are each bound in cord for ease of movement.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:leather-trousers.location: - Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region

item:leda-s-armor.name: Leda's Armor
item:leda-s-armor.description: Chest armor of Needle Knight Leda. Slightly strengthens attacks following a dodge roll or backstep, as well as dash attacks. Embroidered with a golden crossed-tree motif, the chalk white cloak and surcoat symbolize the honor of the Needle Knights. "Kindly Miquella fashioned us as his needles to quell all, to ward away all."

item:leda-s-rune.name: Leda's Rune
item:leda-s-rune.description: Blessing of Needle Knight Leda. An unalloyed light that has never dwelled in an eye. Use to gain 40000 runes. Miquella gifted Leda with gentle gold to bring a soft hue to her faded eyes.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 40000 runes

item:leda-s-sword.name: Leda's Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Fai D

item:leda-s-sword.location: The weapon can be obtained after defeating Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.
item:leda-s-sword.description: Light greatsword with gold inlaid. Weapon of Leda, the Needle Knight. Deals holy damage. Though polished to a mirror sheen, this blade still reeks with the stench of crusted blood that lingers from the cull of her knightly comrades.

item:leontiel-greatsword.name: Leontiel's Greatsword
item:leontiel-greatsword.description: The knight Leontiel's favored weapon—a greatsword whose blade is wrapped in leather at the base. Said to have been wielded by a proud order of orthodox knights long ago, weapons of this ilk demand high dexterity.

item:leontiel-s-armor.name: Leontiel's Armor
item:leontiel-s-armor.description: Armor comprised of a mixture of metal and hard leather, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel. The distinctive pauldrons accentuate the wearer's graceful movements, Leontiel's own eccentric little quirk.

item:leontiel-s-boots.name: Leontiel's Boots
item:leontiel-s-boots.description: Leather boots designed for real combat, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel. The fold-overs have been tanned a contrasting white.

item:leontiel-s-hat.name: Leontiel's Hat
item:leontiel-s-hat.description: A sharp-brimmed ceremonial hat affixed with a mask, the favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel. Leontiel admired Jerren as a father figure of sorts, and this mask lends her the same distinguished severity she saw in his own.

item:leontiel-s-hat-altered.name: Leontiel's Hat (Altered)
item:leontiel-s-hat-altered.description: A sharp-brimmed ceremonial hat, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel. Features a long, pointed crest that juts out from behind.

item:leontiel-s-leather-gloves.name: Leontiel's Leather Gloves
item:leontiel-s-leather-gloves.description: Thick leather gloves designed for real combat, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel. Affixed to the wrist with a belt-like mechanism.

item:letter-for-freyja.name: Letter for Freyja
item:letter-for-freyja.description: A letter written by Sir Ansbach to Freyja the Redmane. Presumably written in answer to her query, but the page is neatly folded to keep prying eyes from reading it.

stats.Effect: A piece of paper, folded over so that the contents cannot be read

item:letter-from-volcano-manor.name: Letter from Volcano Manor
item:letter-from-volcano-manor.description: A written request from Volcano Manor disclosing the name of a Tarnished to be hunted. "Old Knight Istvan" He can be found in Limgrave. Find the red mark on your map for the exact location.

stats.Effect:
Request from Volcano Manor
Examine using

item:letter-from-volcano-manor-old-knigh.description: The Letter from Volcano Manor is an Info Item . It is part of Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress's questline.

stats.Effect: Unlocks Old Knight Istvan's invasion sign in Limgrave

item:letter-from-volcano-manor-rileigh-t.name: Letter from Volcano Manor (Rileigh the Idle)
item:letter-from-volcano-manor-rileigh-t.description: The Letter from Volcano Manor is an Info Item . It is part of Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress's questline.

stats.Effect: Unlocks Rileigh the Idle's invasion sign in Altus Plateau

item:letter-to-bernahl.name: Letter to Bernahl
item:letter-to-bernahl.description:
A written request from Volcano Manor addressed to Bernahl disclosing the names of two Tarnished to be hunted. "Vargram the Raging Wolf"
"Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm" Both men can be found in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Find the red mark on your map for the exact location.

stats.Effect:

stats.Effect:

item:leyndell-knight-armor.name: Leyndell Knight Armor
item:leyndell-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

item:leyndell-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster

item:leyndell-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers. Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.

stats.Effect: Summons two Leyndell soldier spirits

item:leyndell-soldier-ashes.location: Found on a corpse in Sainted Hero's Grave, after falling through a collapsing floor.

item:leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.name: Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets
item:leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

item:lifesteal-fist.name: Lifesteal Fist
item:lifesteal-fist.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"Lifesteal Fist: Skill that demonstrates mastery of the art of controlling vital energies.A slow, controlled punch with an energy-infused fist that renders foes unconscious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build."Usable on fists and claws.
item:lifesteal-fist.location: Scarab northwest of the Astray from Caelid Highway North

stats.Effect: ash

item:light-crossbow.name: Light Crossbow
item:light-crossbow.description: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
item:light-crossbow.location: The Light Crossbow in Elden Ring can be purchased for 1,500 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant located at the Castle Morne Rampart site of grace in the Weeping Peninsula

item:light-of-miquella.name: Light of Miquella
item:light-of-miquella.description: The strength of Miquella upon his deific return, wielded as an incantation. Annihilates foes with a pillar of light. Miquella sought to accept all that was and would be, but found one that refused to be embraced. No wonder, as one god, and one king consort, is all the world needs.

stats.Effect: Annihilates foes with a pillar of light

related: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

item:lightning-bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
item:lightning-bolt.description: Bolt tipped with a shard of Gravel Stone. Deals powerful lightning damage. Used by worshippers of the ancient dragons.

item:lightning-fortification.name: Lightning Fortification
item:lightning-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

stats.Effect: Increass lighting damage negation

item:lightning-fortification.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Altus Plateau

item:lightning-grease.name: Lightning Grease
item:lightning-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting lightning damage

item:lightning-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Fulgurbloom x1

item:lightning-greatbolt.name: Lightning Greatbolt
item:lightning-greatbolt.description: Greatbolt tipped with a clump of Gravel Stone shards. Deals powerful lightning damage.

item:lightning-perfume-bottle.name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
item:lightning-perfume-bottle.location: Found on a corpse amongst the Lightning Rams north of the Cerulean Coast.
item:lightning-perfume-bottle.description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing lightning. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.

item:lightning-pot.name: Lightning Pot
item:lightning-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of fulminating materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to inflict lightning damage.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict lightning damage

item:lightning-ram.name: Lightning Ram
item:lightning-ram.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:"Lightning Ram: Skill inspired by tumbling rams. Let out a bleat, then tumble forwards, clad in lightning. Tumbles can be repeated in rapid succession."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:lightning-scorpion-charm.name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
item:lightning-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that sparks with lightning.

stats.Effect: Raises lightning attack, but lowers damage negation

item:lightning-scorpion-charm.location: Wyndham Catacombs, in a room sealed by an imp statue — bring a Stonesword Key.

item:lightning-shrouding-cracked-tear.name: Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear
item:lightning-shrouding-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts lightning attacks in mixed physick

item:lightning-shrouding-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar found at the Minor Erdtree in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes, along with the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear and the Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

item:lightning-slash.name: Lightning Slash
item:lightning-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:"Lightning Slash: Call down a bolt of lightning into armament, then swing it down to create an explosive shock. The armament retains the lightning enchantment for a while."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:lightning-spear.name: Lightning Spear
item:lightning-spear.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point ofimpact. Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe — an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.

stats.Effect: Hurls lightning spear before caster

item:lightning-spear.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Dragon Cult Prayerbook

item:lightning-strike.name: Lightning Strike
item:lightning-strike.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

stats.Effect: Summons lightning bolt that spreads from impact.

item:lightningbone-arrow.name: Lightningbone Arrow
item:lightningbone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow charged with lightning
item:lightningbone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Animal bone arrow charged with lightning

item:lightningbone-arrow-fletched.name: Lightningbone Arrow (Fletched)
item:lightningbone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched animal bone arrow charged with lightning
item:lightningbone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Fletched animal bone arrow charged with lightning

item:lightningbone-bolt.name: Lightningbone Bolt
item:lightningbone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt with lightning-imbued tip

stats.Effect: Animal bone bolt with lightning-imbued tip

item:lightningproof-dried-liver.name: Lightningproof Dried Liver
item:lightningproof-dried-liver.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in an yellow medicinal

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts lightning damage negation

item:lightningproof-dried-liver.location: It is found past the Dragon Temple Lift

item:lightningproof-pickled-liver.name: Lightningproof Pickled Liver
item:lightningproof-pickled-liver.description: Animal liver pickled in a yellow medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to lightning damage negation, greatly improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with lightning. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

stats.Effect: Temporarily grants large boost to lightning damage negation

item:lion-greatbow.name: Lion Greatbow
item:lion-greatbow.description: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with. Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

item:lion-s-claw.name: Lion's Claw
item:lion-s-claw.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Lion's Claw: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small armaments and thrusting swords excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:lizard-greatsword.name: Lizard Greatsword
item:lizard-greatsword.location: This weapon can be dropped by Lion Imps (2% chance) in the Scorpion River Catacombs and Fog Rift Catacombs.
item:lizard-greatsword.description: A peculiar weapon carried by imps. Greatsword smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued lizard. Strong attacks allow the wielder to fire the forked tongue from the blade.

item:lone-wolf-ashes.name: Lone Wolf Ashes
item:lone-wolf-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three lone wolves.

stats.Effect: Summons three lone wolf spirits.

item:longbow.name: Longbow
item:longbow.description: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
item:longbow.location: You can easily purchase the Longbow for 1,200 Runes from the Twin Maiden Husks NPC at the Roundtable Hold.

item:longhaft-axe.name: Longhaft Axe
item:longhaft-axe.description: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.
item:longhaft-axe.location: You can find the standard Longhaft by farming Misbegotten enemies.

item:longsword.name: Longsword
item:longsword.description: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.
item:longsword.location: The Longsword can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.

item:longtail-cat-talisman.name: Longtail Cat Talisman
item:longtail-cat-talisman.description: A brooch depicting Lacrima, the long-tailed cat.

stats.Effect: Renders the wearer immune to fall damage

item:longtail-cat-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Raya Lucaria Academy, in central Liurnia of the Lakes. From School House Classroom, head back outside and ride the lift down to the bottom (jump off the lift to the platform, near the bottom, because falling off the lift, even at its lowest point, is a lethal fall). The corpse can be found within the Iron Virgin's fight arena, at the bottom of this area.

item:lord-of-blood-favor.name: Lord of Blood's Favor
item:lord-of-blood-favor.description: Pure white oath-cloth given by Varré. The final trial to be anointed a Knight of Mohg, Lord of Blood. "Soak the cloth with a maiden's blood... The blood of anyone's maiden will do. You are maidenless, after all."

stats.Effect: Pure white oath-cloth given by Varré

item:lord-of-blood-favor.location: Rose Church, Liurnia of the Lakes
related: Varré — cloth soaked in maiden blood
Varré / Rose Church ignored or killed

item:lord-of-blood-s-exultation.name: Lord of Blood's Exultation
item:lord-of-blood-s-exultation.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of the Lord of Blood.

stats.Effect: Enhances critical hits

item:lord-of-blood-s-exultation.location: Esgar, Priest of Blood in Leyndell Catacombs.

item:lord-of-blood-s-robe.name: Lord of Blood's Robe
item:lord-of-blood-s-robe.description: Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth. The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:lord-of-blood-s-robe.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood.

item:lord-of-blood-s-robe-altered.name: Lord of Blood's Robe (altered)
item:lord-of-blood-s-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Lord Of Blood's Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:lord-s-aid.name: Lord's Aid
item:lord-s-aid.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished

stats.Effect: Alleviates poison / blood loss / sleep buildup for self / allies

item:lord-s-aid.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Two Fingers' Prayerbook

item:lord-s-divine-fortification.name: Lord's Divine Fortification
item:lord-s-divine-fortification.description: Incantation taught to Gideon the All-Knowing by the Two

stats.Effect: Greatly increases holy damage negation incl. allies

item:lord-s-heal.name: Lord's Heal
item:lord-s-heal.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished

stats.Effect: Massively heals HP for self and nearby allies

item:lord-s-heal.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Two Fingers' Prayerbook

item:lord-s-rune.name: Lord's Rune
item:lord-s-rune.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;

stats.Effect: Use to gain an enormous abundance of runes

item:lordsworn-s-bolt.name: Lordsworn's Bolt
item:lordsworn-s-bolt.description: Well-crafted bolt with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Deals more damage than its commonplace cousin.

item:lordsworn-s-greatsword.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
item:lordsworn-s-greatsword.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Through blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
item:lordsworn-s-greatsword.location: To get the Lordsworn's Greatsword in Elden Ring, travel to the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, clear the nearby guards, and open the chest inside the back of the large horse-drawn carriage.

item:lordsworn-s-shield.name: Lordsworn's Shield
item:lordsworn-s-shield.description: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
item:lordsworn-s-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped by various greatshield-wielding enemy soldiers, such as Godrick Soldiers.

item:lordsworn-s-straight-sword.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
item:lordsworn-s-straight-sword.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a servicable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
item:lordsworn-s-straight-sword.location: The Lordsworn's Straight Sword is a random drop obtained by defeating Godrick Soldiers or Mausoleum Soldiers.

item:loretta-s-greatbow.name: Loretta's Greatbow
item:loretta-s-greatbow.description: Sorcery used by Royal Knight Loretta. Creates a magic greatbow and fires a great arrow. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrow nocked. It is said that the bow was Loretta's favored weapon.

stats.Effect: Fires great arrow from a magic greatbow

item:loretta-s-mastery.name: Loretta's Mastery
item:loretta-s-mastery.description: Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Creates a magic greatbow and fires four great arrows simultaneously. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrows nocked. Developed by Loretta after her long, bloody journey to seek out a place where the Albinaurics could live in peace.

stats.Effect: Fires four great arrow from a magic greatbow at once

item:loretta-s-slash.name: Loretta's Slash
item:loretta-s-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Loretta's Slash: Skill of Loretta the Royal Knight. Leap forward, imbuing the blade with glintstone, then descend, accelerating into a sweeping slash."Usable on polearms and twinblades.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:loretta-s-war-sickle.name: Loretta's War Sickle
item:loretta-s-war-sickle.description: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:loretta-s-war-sickle.location: Drop from Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree

item:lost-ashes-of-war.name: Lost Ashes of War
item:lost-ashes-of-war.description: Empty ashes of war, devoid of any memories of battle.Unable to apply any kind of affinity in their current state, but can be used by Smithing Master Hewg of the Roundtable Hold to recreate other ashes.Thus does the copy pass into becoming the genuine article.

stats.Effect: Used to duplicate Ashes of War

item:loyal-knight-s-cookbook.name: Loyal Knight's Cookbook
item:loyal-knight-s-cookbook.description:
A record of crafting techniques of the Royal Carian Knights. Details the arts of the old enchanted knights. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Royal Magic Grease
- Drawstring Royal Magic Grease

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:lucent-baldachin-s-blessing.name: Lucent Baldachin's Blessing
item:lucent-baldachin-s-blessing.description:
Sacred seal of a hidden shrine that looks much
like a bedchamber. A faint light leaks through
a crack in its fastened doors, as if the Firefly is
beckoning to come inside. Raise in prayer to gain protection. Gaining protection consumes this item,
but can grant unique effects. Take care though, these effects cannot be undone.

stats.Effect: Raise in prayer to gain protection

item:lucent-baldachin-s-blessing.location: - The Lucent Baldachin's Blessing is unobtainable.

item:lucerne.name: Lucerne
item:lucerne.description: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor. Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.
item:lucerne.location: To get the Lucerne halberd in Elden Ring, travel to the Liurnia Highway North Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes, head north up the road to a ghost battlefield, and loot it from a corpse near a broken cart on the right.

item:lucidity.name: Lucidity
item:lucidity.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

stats.Effect: Alleviates buildup of sleep and madness

item:lulling-branch.name: Lulling Branch
item:lulling-branch.description: Tree branch blessed with a velvety purple incantation. Craftable item. Pierce oneself, causing a gentle buildup of sleep. FP gradually recovers during this time. When this sleep reaches the threshold of causing temporary fogginess, no FP loss is incurred. In the midst of drowsiness, there is the will to awaken. Feelings that rise from the depths of one's heart.

stats.Effect: Slowly builds up sleep while gradually restoring FP

item:lulling-branch.location: - Crafted with St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook (3).

item:lump-of-flesh.name: Lump of Flesh
item:lump-of-flesh.description: A lump of beast flesh filled with rich juices. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting carnivorous beast. Meat suitable for a rustic feast.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:lusat-s-glintstone-crown.name: Lusat's Glintstone Crown
item:lusat-s-glintstone-crown.description: The giant blue glintstone crown worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:lusat-s-glintstone-staff.name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
item:lusat-s-glintstone-staff.description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom ofstone may wield it. Enhances power ofall sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
item:lusat-s-glintstone-staff.location: To get Lusat's Glintstone Staff in Elden Ring, travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery in Caelid.

item:lusat-s-manchettes.name: Lusat's Manchettes
item:lusat-s-manchettes.description: Manchettes corroded by blue glintstones. Worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:lusat-s-robe.name: Lusat's Robe
item:lusat-s-robe.description: A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue glintstones.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 6 · Magic 15 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:lusat-s-robe.location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

item:mace.name: Mace
item:mace.description: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.
item:mace.location: The standard Mace can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

item:mad-craftsman-s-cookbook-1.name: Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
item:mad-craftsman-s-cookbook-1.description:
A record of crafting techniques left by a craftsman who served Midra, master of the manse, and Nanaya, its lady. His eyes were burned by the Flame of Frenzy. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Frenzied Flame Pot
- Roped Frenzied Flame Pot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:mad-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.name: Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [2]
item:mad-craftsman-s-cookbook-2.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a craftsman who served Midra, master of the manse, and Nanaya, its lady. His eyes were burned by the Flame of Frenzy. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Hefty Frenzied Flame Pot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:mad-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.name: Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [3]
item:mad-craftsman-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a craftsman who served Midra, master of the manse, and Nanaya, its lady. His eyes were burned by the Flame of Frenzy. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Surging Frenzied Flame

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:mad-pumpkin-head-ashes.name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
item:mad-pumpkin-head-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head. Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.

stats.Effect: Summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head

item:mad-pumpkin-head-ashes.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo in the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.

item:madding-hand.name: Madding Hand

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:madding-hand.location: Dropped by Madding Hand in the Abyssal Woods.
item:madding-hand.description: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with madness. Raises attack power when madness is triggered in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who were hunted down as heretics by their own brethren, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

item:madding-hand-weapon.name: Madding Hand (weapon)
item:madding-hand-weapon.location: Dropped by Madding Hand in the Abyssal Woods.

item:magic-downpour.name: Magic Downpour
item:magic-downpour.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

stats.Effect: Summon a magic mass that sprays projectiles over area

item:magic-fortification.name: Magic Fortification
item:magic-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful. Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me – the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.

stats.Effect: Increases magic damage negation

item:magic-glintblade.name: Magic Glintblade
item:magic-glintblade.description: An old sorcery of the Carian Royal Family.

stats.Effect: Creates sigil that forms a projectile glintblade after delay

item:magic-glintblade.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold

item:magic-grease.name: Magic Grease
item:magic-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting magic damage

item:magic-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Crystal Bud x1

item:magic-pot.name: Magic Pot
item:magic-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of magically resonant materials is sealed inside. Called a "faux sorcery" in Raya Lucaria. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to inflict magic damage.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw to inflict magic damage.

item:magic-scorpion-charm.name: Magic Scorpion Charm
item:magic-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.

stats.Effect: Raises magic attack, but lowers damage negation

item:magic-scorpion-charm.location: Given by Preceptor Seluvis after his quest.
related: Buy out his puppet stock before Nokron

item:magic-shrouding-cracked-tear.name: Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear
item:magic-shrouding-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts magic attacks in mixed physick

item:magic-shrouding-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by one of the two Erdtree Avatars in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically the one in the north-east.

item:magicbone-arrow.name: Magicbone Arrow
item:magicbone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow with glintstone tincture tip
item:magicbone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Animal bone arrow with glintstone tincture tip

item:magicbone-arrow-fletched.name: Magicbone Arrow (Fletched)
item:magicbone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched bone arrow with glintstone tincture tip
item:magicbone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Fletched bone arrow with glintstone tincture tip

item:magicbone-bolt.name: Magicbone Bolt
item:magicbone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt with glintstone tincture tip

stats.Effect: Animal bone bolt with glintstone tincture tip

item:magma-blade.name: Magma Blade
item:magma-blade.description: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:magma-blade.location: The Magma Blade is a rare drop from Man-Serpent enemies wielding bright orange glowing swords in Volcano Manor.

item:magma-breath.name: Magma Breath
item:magma-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Channels wyrm to spew magma breath

item:magma-shot.name: Magma Shot
item:magma-shot.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

stats.Effect: Fire lump of magma that explodes on contact

item:magma-whip-candlestick.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
item:magma-whip-candlestick.description: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:magma-whip-candlestick.location: To get the Magma Whip Candlestick in Elden Ring, you must progress Patches' questline inside Volcano Manor and complete an assassination assignment for him.

item:magma-wyrm-s-scalesword.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
item:magma-wyrm-s-scalesword.description: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once humans heroes who partook in dragon communication, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex D · Fai D

item:main-gauche.name: Main-gauche
item:main-gauche.description: Dagger with a large hand guard. Intended to be used in the left hand, thereby complementing a piercing sword or identical blade held in the right to enable a distinctive style of fighting.

item:malenia-great-rune.name: Malenia's Great Rune
item:malenia-great-rune.description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Malenia. The blessing of this half-rotted rune reduces the healing power of Flask of Crimson Tears. And yet, due to the infusion of Malenia's spirit of resistance, attacks made immediately after receiving damage will partially recover HP. Malenia is daughter to Queen Marika and Radagon, and her Great Rune should have been the most sacred of all.

stats.Effect: Attacks recover HP after damage is taken

item:malenia-s-armor.name: Malenia's Armor
item:malenia-s-armor.description: Armor made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 7 · Slash 11 · Pierce 9 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 4 · Holy 7

item:malenia-s-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malenia-s-armor-altered.name: Malenia's Armor (altered)
item:malenia-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Maleinia's Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 6 · Slash 10 · Pierce 8 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 2 · Holy 6

item:malenia-s-gauntlet.name: Malenia's Gauntlet
item:malenia-s-gauntlet.description: Gauntlet made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 1 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:malenia-s-gauntlet.location: - Malenia's Gauntlet can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 12,000 runes after defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malenia-s-greaves.name: Malenia's Greaves
item:malenia-s-greaves.description: Greaves made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 3 · Holy 6

item:malenia-s-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malenia-s-winged-helm.name: Malenia's Winged Helm
item:malenia-s-winged-helm.description: Winged helm made of unalloyed gold.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:malenia-s-winged-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 12,000 runes after defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

item:malformed-dragon-armor.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
item:malformed-dragon-armor.description: Malformed golden armor. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

stats.Negation: Physical 16 · Strike 15 · Slash 17 · Pierce 16 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:malformed-dragon-armor.location: Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge

item:malformed-dragon-gauntlets.name: Malformed Dragon Gauntlets

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:malformed-dragon-gauntlets.location: Draconic Tree Sentinel near the Beside the Great Bridge

item:malformed-dragon-greaves.name: Malformed Dragon Greaves

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 9 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:malformed-dragon-greaves.location: Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge

item:malformed-dragon-helm.name: Malformed Dragon Helm
item:malformed-dragon-helm.description: A malformed golden helm. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:malformed-dragon-helm.location: Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge

item:maliketh-s-armor.name: Maliketh's Armor
item:maliketh-s-armor.description: Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 13 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 12

item:maliketh-s-armor.location: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

item:maliketh-s-armor-altered.name: Maliketh's Armor (altered)
item:maliketh-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Maliketh's Armor.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 12

item:maliketh-s-armor-altered.location: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

item:maliketh-s-black-blade.name: Maliketh's Black Blade
item:maliketh-s-black-blade.description: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:maliketh-s-gauntlets.name: Maliketh's Gauntlets
item:maliketh-s-gauntlets.description: Beast's gauntlets made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyral half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:maliketh-s-gauntlets.location: - Maliketh's Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 10,000 runes after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

item:maliketh-s-greaves.name: Maliketh's Greaves
item:maliketh-s-greaves.description: Beast's greaves made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 7

item:maliketh-s-greaves.location: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

item:maliketh-s-helm.name: Maliketh's Helm
item:maliketh-s-helm.description: Beast's helm made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 4

item:maliketh-s-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 12,000 runes after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

item:man-fly-ashes.name: Man-Fly Ashes
item:man-fly-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three man-flies. Two of the man-flies attack foes from the air, while the third spits poison from the rear. Afflicted hornsent eventually metamorphosed into a fly-like form. It was believed that the moment the transformation took place, they were relieved from their suffering.

stats.Effect: Summons three man-fly spirits

item:man-fly-ashes.location: Found as loot in the Village of Flies.

item:man-serpent-ashes.name: Man-Serpent Ashes
item:man-serpent-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent. Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.

stats.Effect: Summons man-serpent spirit

item:man-serpent-ashes.location: Found in the hall containing several Wandering Nobles and Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor, before the sending gate leading to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

item:man-serpent-s-shield.name: Man-Serpent's Shield
item:man-serpent-s-shield.description: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.
item:man-serpent-s-shield.location: 4% chance to be dropped by Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor.

item:manor-towershield.name: Manor Towershield
item:manor-towershield.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

item:mantis-blade.name: Mantis Blade
item:mantis-blade.description: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers. The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.
item:mantis-blade.location: To get the Mantis Blade in Elden Ring, travel to the Gelmir Hero's Grave in Mt. Gelmir.

item:mantle-of-thorns.name: Mantle of Thorns
item:mantle-of-thorns.description:
Sorcery of those who abandoned the practice of incantations after devout faith rewarded them with only despair. The caster wounds their own flesh using impenetrable thorns grown from the Scadutree, which then cover the body entirely. Once covered, dodge rolls will damage enemies. The image of the misshapen Scadutree is an edict:
Spurn all that exists. Wound all that exists. For we have been abandoned.

stats.Effect: Covers self with the Scadutree's impenetrable thorns

item:map-abyss.name: Map: Abyss
item:map-abyss.description: Map of the abyss at the east of the Gravesite Plain. A thick forest sprawls at the depths of the ravine that is untouched even by sunlight. Known as the sanctum of Sage Midra, and is a region forbidden by the hornsent.

stats.Effect: Map of the Abyss to the east of Gravesite Plain

item:map-ainsel-river.name: Map (ainsel River)
item:map-ainsel-river.description: Map of Ainsel River and environs

stats.Effect: Map of Ainsel River and environs

item:map-altus-plateau.name: Map (altus Plateau)
item:map-altus-plateau.description: Map of Altus Plateau and environs. The Altus Plateau, where the Erdtree's base can be found, contains the Royal Capital of Leyndell to the east, and Mt. Gelmir to the west. Scars from the Shattering remain apparent to this day.

stats.Effect: Reveals Altus Plateau on your map

item:map-altus-plateau.location: Guide Stele north of the Altus Highway Junction

item:map-caelid.name: Map (caelid)

stats.Effect: Reveals the region of Caelid on the map.

item:map-caelid.location: Guide Stele southeast of the Caelid Highway South

item:map-consecrated-snowfield.name: Map (consecrated Snowfield)
item:map-consecrated-snowfield.description: Map of Consecrated Snowfield and environs. The route through this land, crossed east to west by a frozen river, leads to Miquella's Haligtree. This is the path taken by those unchosen, though it is a trial all the same.

stats.Effect: Map of Consecrated Snowfield and environs.

item:map-consecrated-snowfield.location: Guide Stele north of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield

item:map-deeproot-depths.name: Map (deeproot Depths)
item:map-deeproot-depths.description: Map of Deeproot Depths and environs. At the very depths of the Erdtree's majestic roots lies the source of the Ainsel and the Siofra rivers. Here too begins the network of Greattree roots that spread throughout the Lands Between.

stats.Effect: Revels Deeproot Depths and environs on your map

item:map-deeproot-depths.location: Stele within a gazebo east of the The Nameless Eternal City

item:map-dragonbarrow.name: Map (dragonbarrow)

stats.Effect: Reveals the region of Dragonbarrow on the map.

item:map-dragonbarrow.location: Guide Stele east of the Dragonbarrow West

item:map-gravesite-plain.name: Map: Gravesite Plain
item:map-gravesite-plain.description: Map of the Gravesite Plain. A somber plain covered in spiritgraves. The spiral tower of the hornsent lies to the northwest, and the entire expanse is marred by the harrowing ravages of war.

stats.Effect: Map of Gravesite Plain

item:map-lake-of-rot.name: Map (lake of Rot)
item:map-lake-of-rot.description: Map of Lake of Rot and environs. A great lake of standing water downstream of the Ainsel River. It is said that the divine essence of an outer god is sealed away in this land.

stats.Effect: Map of Lake of Rot and environs.

item:map-lake-of-rot.location: Guide Stele just south of the Lake of Rot Shoreside

item:map-leyndell-royal-capital.name: Map (leyndell, Royal Capital)
item:map-leyndell-royal-capital.description: Map of the Royal Capital of Leyndell and environs.

stats.Effect: Reveals the region of Leyndell on the map.

item:map-leyndell-royal-capital.location: Guide Stele next to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree

item:map-limgrave-east.name: Map (limgrave, East)
item:map-limgrave-east.description: Map of the eastern region of Limgrave.

stats.Effect: Map of Limgrave's eastern region

item:map-limgrave-east.location: Guide Stele north-northeast of the Mistwood Ruins

item:map-limgrave-west.name: Map (limgrave, West)
item:map-limgrave-west.description: Map of the western region of Limgrave. The demesne of Limgrave, far south of the Erdtree, is bordered to the northwest by the cliffs of Stormveil, and under its ever-clouded skies roll the great steppes of the pale lands.

stats.Effect: Map of Limgrave's western region.

item:map-limgrave-west.location: West is located in front of a Guide Stele near the Gatefront

item:map-liurnia-east.name: Map (liurnia, East)

stats.Effect: Map of Liurnia's eastern region

item:map-liurnia-east.location: Guide Stele north of the Liurnia Lake Shore

item:map-liurnia-north.name: Map (liurnia, North)

stats.Effect: Map of Liurnia's northern region

item:map-liurnia-north.location: Guide Stele southeast of the Academy Gate Town

item:map-liurnia-west.name: Map (liurnia, West)

stats.Effect: Reveals the western portion of Liurnia on your map.

item:map-liurnia-west.location: Guide Stele north of the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore

item:map-mohgwyn-palace.name: Map: Mohgwyn Palace
item:map-mohgwyn-palace.description: Map of Mohgwyn Palace and environs. In the lightless depths lies the grave of an ancient civilization. It is here Mohg, the Lord of Blood, is building his palace, to be the seat of his coming dynasty named Mohgwyn. And whatever nightmares that may bring.

stats.Effect: Map of Mohgwyn Palace and environs

item:map-mohgwyn-palace.location: Guide Stele northwest of the Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance

item:map-mountaintops-of-the-giants-east.name: Map (mountaintops of the Giants, East)
item:map-mountaintops-of-the-giants-east.description: Map of Eastern Mountaintops of the Giants. The remote, desolate eastern summit is the highest point in all the Lands Between, overlooking even the Flame Peak to the south.

stats.Effect: Map of Eastern Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:map-mountaintops-of-the-giants-east.location: Guide Stele south of the Giants' Gravepost

item:map-mountaintops-of-the-giants-west.name: Map (mountaintops of the Giants, West)
item:map-mountaintops-of-the-giants-west.description: Map of Western Mountaintops of the Giants. Marching ground during the War against the Giants. They carved winding paths in the cliff walls right up to the summit, leading to the untrodden snow-laden region beyond.

stats.Effect: Map of Western Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:map-mountaintops-of-the-giants-west.location: Guide Stele southwest of the Zamor Ruins

item:map-mt-gelmir.name: Map (mt. Gelmir)

stats.Effect: Map of Mt. Gelmir region

item:map-mt-gelmir.location: Guide Stele west of the Road of Iniquity

item:map-rauh-ruins.name: Map: Rauh Ruins
item:map-rauh-ruins.description: Map of the ancient Rauh Ruins. These giant ruins are flooded, overgrown, and split into two by a chasm. To the southwest is the Church of the Bud, overlooking the tower of shadow.

stats.Effect: Map of the Rauh Ruins

item:map-scadu-altus.name: Map: Scadu Altus
item:map-scadu-altus.description: Map of Scadu Altus. The plateau occupied by Messmer's army that peers towards the Scadutree to the northeast, named after its counterpart in the realm of the Erdtree. At its center lies the shadow keep.

stats.Effect: Map of Scadu Altus

item:map-scadu-altus.location: Stele at a fork in the road just north of the Highroad Cross

item:map-siofra-river.name: Map (siofra River)
item:map-siofra-river.description: Map of Siofra River and environs

stats.Effect: Reveals the region of Siofra River on the map.

item:map-southern-shore.name: Map: Southern Shore
item:map-southern-shore.description: Map of the southern shore of the Gravesite Plain. A captivating vista of brilliant blue flowers, intermingled with colossal stone coffins of unknown origin that seemingly drifted to this place. To the east, the jagged peak thrusts upward into the clouds.

stats.Effect: Map of the southern shore of Gravesite Plain

item:map-southern-shore.location: Stele along a path northwest of the Cerulean Coast Cross

item:map-weeping-peninsula.name: Map (weeping Peninsula)

stats.Effect: Map of Weeping peninsula

item:map-weeping-peninsula.location: Guide Stele south of the Castle Morne Rampart

item:marais-executioner-s-sword.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
item:marais-executioner-s-sword.description: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments. Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid..

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Arc D

item:marais-executioner-s-sword.location: Drop from Elemer of the Briar

item:marais-mask.name: Marais Mask
item:marais-mask.description: Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. Increases arcane. The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. This mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:marais-robe.name: Marais Robe
item:marais-robe.description: Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce goddess who was born into rot.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 4 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:marais-robe.location: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan.

item:margit-s-shackle.name: Margit's Shackle
item:margit-s-shackle.description: A fetish bathed in golden magic. Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough to trap the once-bound Margit on earth, if only for a short time.

stats.Effect: Binds Margit and Morgott two times per battle

item:marika-s-hammer.name: Marika's Hammer
item:marika-s-hammer.description: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:marika-s-rune.name: Marika's Rune
item:marika-s-rune.description: Golden remnants of the grace personally bestowed by Queen Marika to the heroes who joined the crusade for her. Use to gain 80000 runes. The brilliance of Queen Marika's grace blinds even the very best.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 80000 runes

item:marika-s-scarseal.name: Marika's Scarseal
item:marika-s-scarseal.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of Queen Marika.

stats.Effect: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

item:marika-s-scarseal.location: - Obtained from a corpse in northwestern Siofra River, at the base of a waterfall behind the Dragonkin Soldier boss fight arena.

item:marika-s-soreseal.name: Marika's Soreseal
item:marika-s-soreseal.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of Queen Marika.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

item:marionette-soldier-armor.name: Marionette Soldier Armor
item:marionette-soldier-armor.description: Armor of metal bands arranged in a lattice. Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers. The construction of this armor is remarkably crude, now rusted over and severely dented. For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 8 · Slash 13 · Pierce 8 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:marionette-soldier-armor.location: Chance to drop from Marionette Soldier enemies.

item:marionette-soldier-ashes.name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
item:marionette-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two marionette soldiers.

stats.Effect: Summons two marionette soldier spirits

item:marionette-soldier-ashes.location: Found in the graveyard near the start of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, on a corpse hanging off a ledge accessed via a short tunnel.

item:marionette-soldier-birdhelm.name: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm
item:marionette-soldier-birdhelm.description: Metal helm formed in the likeness of the face of a bird.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:marionette-soldier-birdhelm.location: Chance to drop from Avionette Soldier enemies.

item:marionette-soldier-helm.name: Marionette Soldier Helm
item:marionette-soldier-helm.description: Cylindrical helm of plate metal reinforced with a lattice. Worm by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:marionette-soldier-helm.location: Chance to drop from Marionette Soldier enemies.

item:marred-leather-shield.name: Marred Leather Shield
item:marred-leather-shield.description: Leather shield of Stormveil soldiers. Miuch like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

item:marred-wooden-shield.name: Marred Wooden Shield
item:marred-wooden-shield.description: "Wooden shield of the Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle."

item:mask-of-confidence.name: Mask of Confidence
item:mask-of-confidence.description: Mask with the mouth sewn shut with gold thread. Increases arcane. When Radagon married Rennala, he ordered the Carian magic preceptors to don these masks. To make it clear that all of their matters were to be kept strictly private.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:mask-of-confidence.location: Found on a corpse inside the Carian Study Hall once having placed the Carian Inverted Statue.

item:mass-of-putrescence.name: Mass of Putrescence
item:mass-of-putrescence.location: Fissure by jumping to a lower ledge near the Fissure Waypoint
item:mass-of-putrescence.description: Sorcery originating from the putrid liquor of the stone coffins. Flings a great mass of putrescence that bathes its landing area in ghostflame. Charging increases potency. In an age long past, Death was burned by ghostflame. Even the remains of tainted flesh were given equal treatment in death.

stats.Effect: Flings a great mass of putrescence

item:maternal-staff.name: Maternal Staff
