stats.Scaling: Str E · Int D · Arc D

item:maternal-staff.location: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after having slain Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
item:maternal-staff.description: Staff of Count Ymir, who made himself a Mother of Fingers. Carried for want of tail-fingers of his own. Enhances finger sorceries. The crystal ball, though representative of a microcosm, would not receive any sign.

item:mausoleum-gauntlets.name: Mausoleum Gauntlets
item:mausoleum-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:mausoleum-gauntlets.location: - The Mausoleum Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

item:mausoleum-greaves.name: Mausoleum Greaves
item:mausoleum-greaves.description: Greaves worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Museum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:mausoleum-greaves.location: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

item:mausoleum-knight-armor.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor
item:mausoleum-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. The wing-shaped ornaments on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve theirs masters in death.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 10 · Holy 11

item:mausoleum-knight-armor.location: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

item:mausoleum-knight-armor-altered.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor (altered)
item:mausoleum-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Mausoleum Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 14 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 11

item:mausoleum-knight-gauntlets.name: Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets
item:mausoleum-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Walking Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:mausoleum-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

item:mausoleum-knight-greaves.name: Mausoleum Knight Greaves
item:mausoleum-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:mausoleum-knight-greaves.location: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

item:mausoleum-soldier-ashes.name: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
item:mausoleum-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five mausoleum soldiers. Spirits of five headless soldiers who confound foes by disappearing and reappearing at will. The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.

stats.Effect: Summons five mausoleum soldier spirits

item:mausoleum-soldier-ashes.location: Straight north of The Nameless Eternal City

item:mausoleum-surcoat.name: Mausoleum Surcoat
item:mausoleum-surcoat.description: Armor worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 10 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 10

item:mausoleum-surcoat.location: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

item:meat-peddler-s-bell-bearing.name: Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing
item:meat-peddler-s-bell-bearing.description:
Bell bearing of an unfortunate meat peddler who was slain by the Bell Bearing Hunter. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Sliver of Meat
- Lump of Flesh
- Turtle Neck Meat

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:medicine-peddler-s-bell-bearing.name: Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing
item:medicine-peddler-s-bell-bearing.description:
Bell bearing of an unfortunate medicine peddler who was slain by the Bell Bearing Hunter. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Neutralizing Boluses
- Stanching Boluses
- Thawfrost Boluses
- Stimulating Boluses

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:meeting-place-map.name: Meeting Place Map
item:meeting-place-map.description: Simple map found on a corpse. Seems to point to a meeting place. The man it came from surely desired one. The sole means of gaining entry into the academy: a glintstone key.

stats.Effect:
Simple map showing a meeting place
Examine using

item:melted-mushroom.name: Melted Mushroom
item:melted-mushroom.description: A mushroom that grows in the false night in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:melted-mushroom.location: Found in and around the Eternal City

item:memory-of-grace.name: Memory of Grace
item:memory-of-grace.description: A phantom vision of the first grace, which once guided the Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace at which you rested. It all repeats. Be seen by the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.

stats.Effect: Lose all runes, return to last site of lost grace.

item:memory-of-grace.location: The Memory of Grace is assigned to the Inventory during Character Creation and is available to all Origins by default.

stats.Effect: Increases memory slots

item:mending-rune-death-prince.name: Mending Rune of the Death-Prince
item:mending-rune-death-prince.description: Rune gestated by Fia, the Deathbed Companion. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord. Formed of the two hallowbrand half-wheels combined, it will embed the principle of life within Death into Order. The Golden Order was created by confining Destined Death. Thus, this new Order will be one of Death restored.

stats.Effect: Can be used to mend the shattered Elden Ring

item:mending-rune-fell-curse.name: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
item:mending-rune-fell-curse.description: Loathsome rune gestated by the Dung Eater. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord. The reviled curse will last eternally, and the world's children, grandchildren, and every generation hence, will be its pustules. If Order is defiled entirely, defilement is defilement no more, and for every curse, a cursed blessing.

stats.Effect: Can be used to mend the shattered Elden Ring

related: Dung Eater — defeated at the Leyndell moat
Or pour Seluvis’s potion into him

item:mending-rune-order.name: Mending Rune of Perfect Order
item:mending-rune-order.description: Rune discovered by the noble Goldmask. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord. A rune of transcendental ideology which will attempt to perfect the Golden Order. The current imperfection of the Golden Order, or instability of ideology, can be blamed upon the fickleness of the gods no better than men. That is the fly in the ointment.

stats.Effect: Can be used to mend the shattered Elden Ring

related: Goldmask — Law of Regression read at the Erdtree statue

item:message-from-leda.name: Message from Leda
item:message-from-leda.description:
Message left by Needle Knight Leda, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail. "Dane passed on a message... The sealing tree is in the ancient ruins of Rauh. It lies beyond the high bridge leading from the first floor of the storehouse. I will join you there,
once I have finished the task at hand."

stats.Effect:
Message left for the author's compatriots
Examine using

item:messmer-s-armor.name: Messmer's Armor
item:messmer-s-armor.description: Black armor of Messmer the Impaler. Draped with a red cloak bearing his crest embroidered. On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired. "Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

item:messmer-s-gauntlets.name: Messmer's Gauntlets
item:messmer-s-gauntlets.description: Black gauntlets of Messmer the Impaler. On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired. "Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

item:messmer-s-greaves.name: Messmer's Greaves
item:messmer-s-greaves.description: Black greaves of Messmer the Impaler. On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired. "Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

item:messmer-s-helm.name: Messmer's Helm
item:messmer-s-helm.description: Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills. The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions. They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form, born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.

item:messmer-s-helm-altered.name: Messmer's Helm (Altered)
item:messmer-s-helm-altered.description: Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills. The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions. They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form, born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.

item:messmer-s-kindling.name: Messmer's Kindling
item:messmer-s-kindling.description: The kindling that burned inside Messmer the Impaler. A dark thing, eaten away at by a wicked serpent. Burns the sealing tree said to be found at the old Rauh ruins. Messmer, much like his younger sister, bore a vision of fire.

stats.Effect: Burns the sealing tree

item:messmer-s-orb.name: Messmer's Orb
item:messmer-s-orb.description: An incantation of Messmer the Impaler. Summons Messmer's flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay. Charging enhances potency. Messmer despised his own fire. Time and time again he hoped to rid himself of it, but ever did it burn.

stats.Effect: Shapes Messmer's flame into a giant orb that soars at foe

item:messmer-soldier-armor.name: Messmer Soldier Armor
item:messmer-soldier-armor.description: Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A ragged cloak is draped over rusted mail. Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

item:messmer-soldier-armor-altered.name: Messmer Soldier Armor (Altered)
item:messmer-soldier-armor-altered.description: Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The mail has rusted while fighting in unending war. Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

item:messmer-soldier-ashes.name: Messmer Soldier Ashes
item:messmer-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Messmer's soldiers. One soldier wields an axe, while the other wields a spear. Both of them are adept at charge attacks. These soldiers belonged to the ignoble penal battalion, and were buried hidden from the Scadutree's sight.

stats.Effect: Summons two Messmer soldier spirits

item:messmer-soldier-gauntlets.name: Messmer Soldier Gauntlets
item:messmer-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

item:messmer-soldier-greaves.name: Messmer Soldier Greaves
item:messmer-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

item:messmer-soldier-helm.name: Messmer Soldier Helm
item:messmer-soldier-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The iron helm features a visor. Though the engraving upon the forehead is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

item:messmer-soldier-s-axe.name: Messmer Soldier's Axe
item:messmer-soldier-s-axe.location: There is a 2% chance that axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers can drop this weapon.
item:messmer-soldier-s-axe.description: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A steel axe, worn from use. A favorite of those who lost themselves utterly in their lord's war. Capable of performing powerful charge attacks.

item:messmer-soldier-s-spear.name: Messmer Soldier's Spear
item:messmer-soldier-s-spear.description: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a steel blade worn from use. Being made for overwhelming onslaughts, attacks with this weapon can be charged to unleash consecutive strikes.

item:messmer-soldier-shield.name: Messmer Soldier Shield
item:messmer-soldier-shield.description: Worn roundshield carried by soldiers loyal to Messmer, the Impaler. The largest of all metal shields in their class.
item:messmer-soldier-shield.location: 2.00% drop from shield-wielding Messmer Soldiers in camps across Gravesite Plain and Scadu Altus, and inside Castle Ensis and Shadow Keep.

item:messmerfire-grease.name: Messmerfire Grease
item:messmerfire-grease.description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy fire damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Fire was a symbol of the crusade, and even Messmer's rank-and-file soldiers would wield it.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy fire damage

item:meteor-bolt.name: Meteor Bolt
item:meteor-bolt.description: Enchanted work of craft made in tandem with the Full Moon Crossbow. The tip is embedded with glintstone. Like a shooting star, these bolts leave a beautiful trail when fired. Deals magic damage.

item:meteoric-ore-blade.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
item:meteoric-ore-blade.description: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage. The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:meteoric-ore-blade.location: To get the Meteoric Ore Blade in Elden Ring, travel to the cellar beneath the Caelid Waypoint Ruins in southern Caelid.

item:meteorite.name: Meteorite
item:meteorite.description: A glintstone sorcery that draws on gravitational force, used by a great white king with stone skin. Calls small meteorites down from the sky. The meteor shower continues for as long as the sorcery is in effect. It is said that, in the Eternal City, now lost in ruin underground, meteorites held the same import as stars.

stats.Effect: Calls small meteors down from the sky.

item:meteorite-of-astel.name: Meteorite of Astel
item:meteorite-of-astel.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Summons a void that emits a hail of meteorites. Hold to continue the effect. A manifestation of the power with which Astel leveled the Eternal City.

stats.Effect: Calls a hail of small meteorites from the void.

item:meteorite-staff.name: Meteorite Staff
item:meteorite-staff.description: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well. However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.
item:meteorite-staff.location: To get the Meteorite Staff, travel to the Street of Sages Ruins in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid.

item:midra-s-flame-of-frenzy.name: Midra's Flame of Frenzy
item:midra-s-flame-of-frenzy.description: Incantation in praise of Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. Summons an apparition of the Lord's head to spew frenzied flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. The apparition will remain for as long as the input is held. The Lord of Frenzied Flame shall take their torment, despair. Their affliction. Every sin, every curse. All melted away. Yet Midra, like others before him, was too weak to become a Lord.

stats.Effect: Summons Lord of Frenzied Flame's head to spew frenzied flame

related: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

item:mighty-shot.name: Mighty Shot
item:mighty-shot.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Mighty Shot: Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard."Usable on light bows and longbows.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:milady.name: Milady
item:milady.location: The Milady can be found inside a chest in a watchtower at Castle Ensis.
item:milady.description: Though its blade is of standard greatsword length, its weight has been whittled away to the absolute minimum. Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.

item:millicent-prosthesis.name: Millicent's Prosthesis
item:millicent-prosthesis.description: Part of the golden prosthesis used by Millicent. The hand is locked into a fist that once raised a sword aloft.

stats.Effect: Boosts dexterity, raises attack power with successive attacks

item:millicent-s-boots.name: Millicent's Boots
item:millicent-s-boots.description: Boots worn by Millicent the Rotting
item:millicent-s-boots.location: - The playable version of Millicent's Boots is cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:millicent-s-gloves.name: Millicent's Gloves
item:millicent-s-gloves.description: Gloves worn by Millicent the Rotting

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:millicent-s-gloves.location: - The playable version of Millicent's Gloves is cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:millicent-s-robe.name: Millicent's Robe
item:millicent-s-robe.description: Robe worn by Millicent the Rotting
item:millicent-s-robe.location: - The playable version of Millicent's Robe is cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:millicent-s-tunic.name: Millicent's Tunic
item:millicent-s-tunic.description: Tunic worn by Millicent the Rotting
item:millicent-s-tunic.location: - The playable version of Millicent's Tunic is cut content and cannot be acquired.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to mimic nearby objects.

item:mimic-tear-ashes.name: Mimic Tear Ashes
item:mimic-tear-ashes.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of a mimic tear. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

stats.Effect: Summons mimic tear spirit

item:miniature-ranni.name: Miniature Ranni
item:miniature-ranni.description: A doll resembling Ranni the Witch.

stats.Effect: Doll resembling Ranni the Witch

item:minor-erdtree.name: Minor Erdtree
item:minor-erdtree.description: Secret incantation of Queen Marika. Only the kindness of gold, without Order. Creates a small, illusory Erdtree that continuously restores the HP of nearby allies. Marika bathed the village of her home in gold, knowing full well that there was no one to heal.

stats.Effect: Continuously heals allies in the area

item:minor-erdtree-spell.name: Minor Erdtree (spell)
item:minor-erdtree-spell.description: It is one of the Erdtree Incantations.

stats.Effect: Continuously heals allies in the area

item:miquella-needle.name: Miquella's Needle
item:miquella-needle.description: One of the unalloyed gold needles that Miquella crafted to ward away the meddling of outer gods. Capable of subduing the flame of frenzy if inherited, allowing one to cheat fate and avoid becoming Lord of Frenzied Flame. However, the needle is as yet unfinished and can only be used in the heart of the storm beyond time said to be found in Farum Azula.

stats.Effect: Subdues a once-accepted frenzied flame

item:miquella-s-great-rune.name: Miquella's Great Rune
item:miquella-s-great-rune.description: A Great Rune relinquished by Miquella. Broken and bereft of its bounty, it retains naught but the power to resist charms. Miquella set off for the tower enshrouded by shadow, abandoning everything—his golden flesh, his blinding strength, even his fate. All in an effort to bury the original sin. To embrace the whole of it, and be reborn as a new god.

stats.Effect: Retains naught but the power to resist charms

item:miquella-s-lily.name: Miquella's Lily
item:miquella-s-lily.description: A delicate water lily of unalloyed gold that has started to fade and wilt. Material used for crafting items. Exeedingly rare to find.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:miquella-s-lily.location: Miquella's Lilies are scattered across the Lands Between, particularly around sacred areas associated with Miquella or the Haligtree. These flowers do not respawn once harvested until the next playthrough.

item:miquellan-knight-s-sword.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
item:miquellan-knight-s-sword.description: Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade. A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight — an ill-starred sword with no master. Skill: Sacred Blade

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai E

item:miquellan-knight-s-sword.location: The Miquellan Knight's Sword is located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:mirage-riddle.name: Mirage Riddle
item:mirage-riddle.description: A riddle concerning a rise that vanishes like a mirage.

stats.Effect: Simple map taken from an imp statue.

item:miranda-powder.name: Miranda Powder
item:miranda-powder.description: Pollen from a man-eating miranda flower. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:miranda-powder.location: - Obtained by defeating miranda blossoms and miranda sprouts.

item:miranda-s-prayer.name: Miranda's Prayer
item:miranda-s-prayer.description: This statuette depicts a flower that preys on humans, posed in prayer. Uses FP to call down a deluge of light. Miranda, maiden of the Flower Crucible is said to have been the very first of this breed.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to call down a deluge of light

item:miranda-sprout-ashes.name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
item:miranda-sprout-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to fire—do take care of the little darlings

stats.Effect: Summons five miranda sprouts

item:miranda-sprout-ashes.location: Found behind an illusory wall in Caelid Catacombs.

item:miriam-s-vanishing.name: Miriam's Vanishing
item:miriam-s-vanishing.location: Available for purchase from Count Ymir upon first meeting him in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.
item:miriam-s-vanishing.description: Sorcery of a preceptor who served the Carian royal family. Used to conceal oneself in a glintstone haze, reappearing after a few seconds have passed. Directional inputs determine where one will reappear. The curator of the study hall was such a master of this sorcery that it now bears her name.

stats.Effect: Conceals self in a glintstone haze

item:miriel-s-bell-bearing.name: Miriel's Bell Bearing
item:miriel-s-bell-bearing.description: Miriel, Pastor of Vows' bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:mis-ricorde.name: Miséricorde
item:mis-ricorde.description: Dagger favored by military physicians in white. The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent. Medicine is mercy. and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothes as men of compassion
item:mis-ricorde.location: To get the Misericorde in Elden Ring, travel to Stormveil Castle and unlock the fog door in the armory room using one Stonesword Key.

item:misbegotten-shortbow.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
item:misbegotten-shortbow.description: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it. Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.
item:misbegotten-shortbow.location: The Misbegotten Shortbow is a rare random drop from Winged Misbegotten archer enemies found in the Weeping Peninsula and other regions.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-1.name: Missionary's Cookbook [1]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-1.location: Sold by Merchant Kalé in the Church of Elleh.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-2.name: Missionary's Cookbook [2]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-2.description:
A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Scriptstone
- Grace Mimic
- Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-3.name: Missionary's Cookbook [3]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-3.location: Found on a corpse in Smoldering Church.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-4.name: Missionary's Cookbook [4]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Holy Grease -Drawstring Holy Grease -Haligbone Arrow -Haligbone Arrow (Fletched) -Haligbone Bolt

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-4.location: Found in the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-5.name: Missionary's Cookbook [5]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-5.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-5.location: Found in the Siofra Aqueduct, in a circular room across a bridge patrolled by a Crucible Knight.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-6.name: Missionary's Cookbook [6]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-6.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Holyproof Dried Liver

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-6.location: Found in a cell in Volcano Manor.

item:missionary-s-cookbook-7.name: Missionary's Cookbook [7]
item:missionary-s-cookbook-7.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Rejuvenating Boluces

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:missionary-s-cookbook-7.location: Sold by Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

item:mohg-great-rune.name: Mohg's Great Rune
item:mohg-great-rune.description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Mohg. Its blessing grants a blessing of blood to summoned phantoms, and imparts a Phantom Great Rune upon successful invasion. Mohg and Morgott are twin brothers, and their Great Runes are naturally similar. But Mohg's rune is soaked in accursed blood, from his devout love for the wretched mire that he was born into far below the earth.

stats.Effect: Grants a blessing of blood to phantoms

item:mohg-s-shackle.name: Mohg's Shackle
item:mohg-s-shackle.description: A fetish bathed in golden magic.

stats.Effect: Briefly binds Mogh, once imprisoned, to earth

item:mohg-s-shackle.location: In the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital. At the bottom of the large room full of pipes where imps will ambush you.

item:mohgwyn-s-sacred-spear.name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
item:mohgwyn-s-sacred-spear.description: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:mohgwyn-s-sacred-spear.location: Remembrance of the Blood Lord (Mohg, Lord of Blood)

item:moldmonger-s-bell-bearing.name: Moldmonger's Bell Bearing
item:moldmonger-s-bell-bearing.description: The bell bearing of a hornsent moldmonger who did not survive the war. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Fly Mold

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:monk-s-flameblade.name: Monk's Flameblade
item:monk-s-flameblade.description: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.
item:monk-s-flameblade.location: The Monk's Flameblade is a rare drop farmed by defeating a specific Fire Monk inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave dungeon in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:monk-s-flamemace.name: Monk's Flamemace
item:monk-s-flamemace.description: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.
item:monk-s-flamemace.location: The Monk's Flamemace is a rare random drop obtained by defeating specific Flame Monks who wield this mace.

item:monk-s-missive.name: Monk's Missive
item:monk-s-missive.description: A letter bearing a terse message and an illustration of a monk, his hands held together. "Seek me to the east if you wish to pursue the way of the warrior. When you find me, you will challenge me to a bout. There is no need for words."

stats.Effect:
Letter with terse message and an illustration of a monk
Examine using

item:moon-egg.name: Moon Egg
item:moon-egg.description: Owl eggs that will never hatch. Material used for crafting items. Prized as a symbol of the most sublime slumber.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:moon-egg.location: One in Mirage Rise, three in Fort Laiedd, two southwest of the Smoldering Wall grace; also sold by Pidia, Carian Servant.

item:moon-of-nokstella.name: Moon of Nokstella
item:moon-of-nokstella.description: This legendary talisman is a treasure of Nokstella, the Eternal City.

stats.Effect: Increases memory slots by 2

item:moonrithyll-s-knight-sword.name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:moonrithyll-s-knight-sword.location: This item can be obtained after defeating the NPC Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.
item:moonrithyll-s-knight-sword.description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. The favored weapon of the steadfast Carian knight, Moonrithyll. Moonrithyll was the Twin Moon Knight's chamberlain. She was also a friend to the trolls, who served the royal family, and proudly wielded their weapons as she fought arm in arm with her gargantuan comrades.

item:moonveil.name: Moonveil
item:moonveil.description: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian wordsmith. Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int C

item:moonveil.location: To get the Moonveil Katana, you need to defeat the Magma Wyrm boss inside Gael Tunnel, located on the border between Limgrave and Caelid.

item:moore-s-bell-bearing.name: Moore's Bell Bearing
item:moore-s-bell-bearing.description: Moore's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:morgott-great-rune.name: Morgott's Great Rune
item:morgott-great-rune.description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Morgott. Its blessing greatly raises maximum HP. This Great Rune is the anchor ring that houses the base, and proves two things: That the Omen King was born of the golden lineage, and that he was indeed the Lord of Leyndell.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises maximum HP

item:morgott-great-rune.location: Obtained upon the defeat of Morgott, the Omen King

item:morgott-s-cursed-sword.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
item:morgott-s-cursed-sword.description: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King. The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Arc D

item:morning-star.name: Morning Star
item:morning-star.description: Warhammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star covered. in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its grace name, this weapon often reeks of blood.
item:morning-star.location: To get the Morning Star, head to the Weeping Peninsula, just south of Limgrave.

item:mottled-necklace.name: Mottled Necklace
item:mottled-necklace.description: A vividly-colored accoutrement precious to the ancestral followers.

stats.Effect: Raises Robustness, Immunity, and Focus

item:mottled-necklace.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Siofra River, which lies at the end of a broken bridge, leading to Nokron, Eternal City. This area can only be reached from a waygate at one of The Four Belfries, next to a message that reads "Night Sky Unceasing".

item:mottled-necklace-1.name: Mottled Necklace +1
item:mottled-necklace-1.description: Greatly raises robustness, immunity, and focus
item:mottled-necklace-1.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Nokron, Eternal City, atop the pillars above Hallowhorn Grounds. Climb around the terrain on the left side of the ruins to reach the top of the pillars.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises Robustness, Immunity, and Focus

item:mottled-necklace-2.name: Mottled Necklace +2
item:mottled-necklace-2.description: Vastly raises robustness, immunity, and focus
item:mottled-necklace-2.location: - Mottled Necklace +2 is at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. After unlocking the spiritspring, use it to reach a previously inaccessible area. The talisman is looted at the top of a staircase.

stats.Effect: Raises Immunity, Robustness, and Focus by +100 each

item:multilayered-ring-of-light.name: Multilayered Ring of Light
item:multilayered-ring-of-light.location: Phantom Misbegotten Warrior found past the Fissure Waypoint
item:multilayered-ring-of-light.description: Incantation of those who served Miquella. Produces a multilayered ring of golden light and fires it forwards, inflicting continuous damage on those struck by it. Charging extends duration and increases potency. This light-ring incantation was cultivated by a tradition separate from Golden Order fundamentalism.

stats.Effect: Fires a multilayered golden ring of light that continuously inflicts damage

item:mushroom.name: Mushroom
item:mushroom.description: A fungal growth that thrives in damp thickets and elsewhere. Material used for crafting items. Its thick, spongy flesh makes it a key component in throwing pots.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:mushroom-arms.name: Mushroom Arms
item:mushroom-arms.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the arms.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 1 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:mushroom-body.name: Mushroom Body
item:mushroom-body.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the torso. To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 7 · Slash 2 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 5 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:mushroom-body.location: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:mushroom-crown.name: Mushroom Crown
item:mushroom-crown.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms form a towering headpiece. Raises attack power when something nearby suffers from poison or rot. Long ago, great lords served the scarlet rot. Perhaps such fungal bodies served as their crowns.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 7 · Magic 4 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:mushroom-crown.location: Found on a corpse up a pillar inside ruins located south-east of Lake of Rot.

item:mushroom-head.name: Mushroom Head
item:mushroom-head.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the head.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 1 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:mushroom-head.location: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:mushroom-legs.name: Mushroom Legs
item:mushroom-legs.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the Legs. To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 4 · Slash 1 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 3 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:mushroom-legs.location: Found on a corpse alongside the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave, located in Mt. Gelmir.

item:mushroom-seller-s-bell-bearing-1.name: Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [1]
item:mushroom-seller-s-bell-bearing-1.description:
The bell bearing of a hornsent mushroom-seller who did not survive the war. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Mushroom
- Redflesh Mushroom

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:mushroom-seller-s-bell-bearing-2.name: Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [2]
item:mushroom-seller-s-bell-bearing-2.description:
The bell bearing of a hornsent mushroom-seller who did not survive the war. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - Toxic Mushroom
- Whiteflesh Mushroom

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:my-lord.name: My Lord
