item:ordovis-s-greatsword.location: To get Ordovis's Greatsword, you must defeat the duo boss Crucible Knight and Crucible Knight Ordovis at the end of the Auriza Hero's Grave on the Altus Plateau.

item:ornamental-straight-sword.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
item:ornamental-straight-sword.description: Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

stats.Effect: Raises arcane

item:outer-order.name: Outer Order
item:outer-order.location: - Given to the player when talking to Melina in the Minor Erdtree Church.
item:outer-order.description: However it will become available again after defeating Morgott, the Omen King and reuniting with her.

item:overhead-stance.name: Overhead Stance
item:overhead-stance.description: Skill: Overhead Stance A skill that starts with the blade held high in a ready stance. Execute a normal attack from this stance to step forward and slash downwards, or a strong attack to deliver a series of downward slashes.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:page-ashes.name: Page Ashes
item:page-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a page.

stats.Effect: Summons page spirit

item:page-ashes.location: Cliffbottom Catacombs, the same floor with the lever that opens the boss room.

item:page-garb.name: Page Garb
item:page-garb.description: Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:page-garb.location: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

item:page-garb-altered.name: Page Garb (altered)
item:page-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Page Garb.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:page-hood.name: Page Hood
item:page-hood.description: Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way. The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:page-hood.location: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

item:page-trousers.name: Page Trousers
item:page-trousers.description: Trousers worn by pages who serve nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:page-trousers.location: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

item:palm-blast.name: Palm Blast
item:palm-blast.description: Skill: Palm Blast Skill of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Imbues hand with energy before using a palm strike to unleash an explosive blast. The already formidable power and impact can be bolstered by charging the attack.

item:parry.name: Parry
item:parry.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Parry: Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance. This provides an opening to perform a critical hit."Usable on daggers, curved swords, thrusting swords, fists, claws, and small and medium shields.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:parrying-dagger.name: Parrying Dagger
item:parrying-dagger.description: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them. For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.
item:parrying-dagger.location: The Parrying Dagger can be purchased from the NPC Patches for 1,600 runes.

item:partisan.name: Partisan
item:partisan.description: Spear with a wide tip. In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swing to sweep through foes.
item:partisan.location: To get the Partisan spear in Elden Ring, you need to farm and defeat specific faction knights like the Godrick Knight at the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave.

item:pata.name: Pata
item:pata.location: Found on a corpse behind the Church of Benediction, overlooking the place where you spawn as you enter the Realm of Shadow.
item:pata.description: A weapon comprised of a linear, double-sided blade attached to a substantial guard. Wielded by the Oathseeker Knights. This versatile armament can be swung about like a fist or used in the manner of a straight sword.

item:patches-bell-bearing.name: Patches' Bell Bearing
item:patches-bell-bearing.description: Patches' bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:patches-crouch.name: Patches' Crouch
item:patches-crouch.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:pauper-s-rune.name: Pauper's Rune
item:pauper-s-rune.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of The Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold. Use to gain a few runes. For all that they may be feeble things, these runes will act as nourishment for the development of any Tarnished. Provided a Finger Maiden can be found...

stats.Effect: Use to gain a few runes

item:pauper-s-rune.location: The Pauper's Rune is cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:pearl-shield-talisman.name: Pearl Shield Talisman
item:pearl-shield-talisman.description: Boosts all non-physical damage negation while guarding
item:pearl-shield-talisman.location: Soldiers located Southwestern of Taylew's Ruined Forge

item:pearldrake-talisman.name: Pearldrake Talisman
item:pearldrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a pearlescent ancient dragon. Boosts non-physical damage negation.

stats.Effect: Boosts non-physical damage negation.

item:pearldrake-talisman.location: - Obtained from a corpse on the north end of the western isolated platform in Crumbling Farum Azula. This area is only accessible via the waygate at the first of The Four Belfrys in western Liurnia of the Lakes, next to a message that reads "Crumbling Lands". After traveling through the waygate, drop down several platforms to reach a pair of Bestmen and drop from the northern edge of this platform to find the corpse.

item:pearldrake-talisman-1.name: Pearldrake Talisman +1
item:pearldrake-talisman-1.location: - Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Wyndham Ruins in central Mt. Gelmir. The cellar is locked behind a semi-transparent fog wall, which can be unlocked by inserting one Stonesword Key into the adjacent imp statue.

stats.Effect: Greatly boosts non-physical damage negation

item:pearldrake-talisman-2.name: Pearldrake Talisman +2
item:pearldrake-talisman-2.location: :Obtained from a corpse in central Miquella's Haligtree. From Haligtree Town, head northwest to a ladder, climb it, and jump backwards across a gap, to a platform leading to the corpse, which lies at the base of a statue, guarded by a Misbegotten Warrior.

stats.Effect: Vastly boosts non-physical damage negation

item:pearldrake-talisman-3.name: Pearldrake Talisman +3
item:pearldrake-talisman-3.description: Boosts non-physical damage negation by the utmost

stats.Effect: Vastly reduces elemental damage

item:pearlescent-scale.name: Pearlescent Scale
item:pearlescent-scale.description: A glassy and glistening fragment of pearlescent hue. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting lamprey. These retrograde scales are found embedded deep within the skin of lamprey.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:pearlescent-scale.location: - Dropped by lamprey in the Finger Ruins of Rhia and Dheo.

item:pelt-of-ralva.name: Pelt of Ralva
item:pelt-of-ralva.description: The pelt of Ralva the Great Red Bear, worn upon the head without modification. Enhances incantations of what is jokingly called "Bear Communion." This untreated hide, won at the end of a bloody bout, is just the thing to make a wild bear out of a warrior.

item:perfume-bottle.name: Perfume Bottle
item:perfume-bottle.description: Glass bottles used by perfumers. Used to seal various scent compounds.

stats.Effect: Container required for crafting perfume items

item:perfume-bottle.location: Omen northwest of the Altus Highway Junction

item:perfumed-oil-of-ranah.name: Perfumed Oil of Ranah
item:perfumed-oil-of-ranah.description: A small bottle wrapped in a bright-red cloth. Filled with flammable perfume oil. Uses FP to spout flames forward. The dancers of Ranah keep these concealed as they dance, marking their height of their passion with an explosion of searing flame and sweet, enticing scents.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to spout flames forward

item:perfumed-oil-of-ranah.location: Found a few meters from the entrance of the Southern Nameless Mausoleum containing the Dancer of Ranah.

item:perfumer-gloves.name: Perfumer Gloves
item:perfumer-gloves.description: Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 2 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:perfumer-gloves.location: - The Perfumer Gloves have a 3.00% chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:perfumer-hood.name: Perfumer Hood
item:perfumer-hood.description: Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:perfumer-hood.location: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:perfumer-robe.name: Perfumer Robe
item:perfumer-robe.description: Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-robe.location: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:perfumer-robe-altered.name: Perfumer Robe (altered)
item:perfumer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Perfurmer's Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-s-bolt.name: Perfumer's Bolt
item:perfumer-s-bolt.description: Bolt created with perfumer techniques. Used by nobles' guards and the like. The point of impact explodes with sparks, dealing fire damage.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-1.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [1]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a military perfumer. Contains martial techniques beyond the repertoire of an ordinary physician.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-1.location: In a treasure chest at the Perfumer's Ruins in south-west Altus Plateau. Guarded by an Omenkiller that drops the Omenkiller set.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-13.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [2]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-13.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-13.location: Found on a corpse on the rooftops of the Shaded Castle. Head north from the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace and climb up a ladder, then enter the dark room and take the ladder inside to a small rooftop with a body on a chair holding the item.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-3.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [3]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-3.location: Found on a corpse in the Auriza Side Tomb.

item:perfumer-s-cookbook-4.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [4]
item:perfumer-s-cookbook-4.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer. Contains perilous techniques no ordinary physician would attempt.

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:perfumer-s-shield.name: Perfumer's Shield
item:perfumer-s-shield.description: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.
item:perfumer-s-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped by shield-wielding Perfumers and Depraved Perfumers.

item:perfumer-s-talisman.name: Perfumer's Talisman
item:perfumer-s-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a set of perfume bottles. Raises potency of perfume items.

stats.Effect: Raises potency of perfume items

item:perfumer-s-talisman.location: - Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Perfumer's Ruins, in southwestern Mt. Gelmir.

item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb
item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb.description: Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb.location: - Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb-altered.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb (altered)
item:perfumer-s-traveling-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Perfumer's Traveling Garb.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:perfumer-sarong.name: Perfumer Sarong
item:perfumer-sarong.description: Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 7 · Fire 6 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:perfumer-sarong.location: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

item:pest-s-glaive.name: Pest's Glaive
item:pest-s-glaive.description: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.
item:pest-s-glaive.location: To get the Pest's Glaive in Elden Ring, you must farm it from Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pest) enemies found in Caelid, the Grand Cloister, or Elphael.

item:pest-thread-spears.name: Pest-Thread Spears
item:pest-thread-spears.description: Secrete sticky threads and twist them into two frontward flying spears

item:pest-threads.name: Pest Threads
item:pest-threads.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.

stats.Effect: Launches countless sticky threads before caster

item:pest-threads.location: Church of the Bud, after crossing the sealed woods approach.

item:petition-for-help.name: Petition for Help
item:petition-for-help.description: Summons Stalker to face invading Broken Finger

item:phantom-bloody-finger.name: Phantom Bloody Finger
item:phantom-bloody-finger.description: Item for online play. Obtained after invading another world. Consumed upon use. Attempts another invasion of the most recently invaded world. This may come in handy should separation from the Host of Fingers force a temporary retreat.

stats.Effect: Attempts repeat invasion of last targeted world

item:phantom-finger.name: Phantom Finger
item:phantom-finger.description: This can lead to Invaders being placed at the top or bottom of a cliff, demanding an inappropriately lengthy detour.

stats.Effect: Attempts repeat invasion of last targeted world

item:phantom-great-rune.name: Phantom Great Rune
item:phantom-great-rune.description: Item for online play. Obtained after using the Mohg's Great Rune and invading another world. Consumed upon use. Enemies inside the invaded world receive a blessing of blood, which boosts their attack power when blood loss occurs nearby. Also, your HP recovers when blessed enemies defeat a player.

stats.Effect: Give blessing of blood to enemies in invaded world

item:phantom-great-rune.location: The Phantom Great Rune is automatically added upon invading another world with Mohg's Great Rune active.

item:phantom-recusant-finger.name: Phantom Recusant Finger
item:phantom-recusant-finger.description: Item for online play. Obtained after invading another world. Consumed upon use. Attempts another invasion of the most recently invaded world. This may come in handy should separation from the Host of Fingers force a temporary retreat.

stats.Effect: Attempts repeat invasion of last targeted world

item:phantom-slash.name: Phantom Slash
item:phantom-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Phantom Slash: Skill inspired by the fond remembrances of the Night's Cavalry. Creates an apparition of the knights' former instructor who guides a joint lunging upward swing. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."Usable on polearms and twinblades (great spears excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
item:pickaxe.description: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"
item:pickaxe.location: To get the Pickaxe in Elden Ring, travel to the Limgrave Tunnels (located north of Agheel Lake).

item:pickled-turtle-neck.name: Pickled Turtle Neck
item:pickled-turtle-neck.description: Turtle neck meat, pickled in a bitter medicinal solution.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts Stamina recovery

item:pidia-s-bell-bearing.name: Pidia's Bell Bearing
item:pidia-s-bell-bearing.description: Servant Pidia's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:piercing-fang.name: Piercing Fang
item:piercing-fang.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Piercing Fang: Skill used by Yura, the Bloody Finger Hunter. Starting with the blade held horizontally, make a powerful thrust that cannot be blocked."Usable on medium and large armaments capable of thrusting.

stats.Effect: ash

item:piercing-throw.name: Piercing Throw
item:piercing-throw.description: Skill: Piercing Throw Throw armament with a powerful spin, causing it to bore through foes. When using this skill, the armament can be thrown further than normal and also pierce through enemies.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:pike.name: Pike
item:pike.description: A longspear featuring an especially length handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incrdibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.
item:pike.location: The Pike in Elden Ring is found on a corpse inside the main barricaded courtyard of Stormveil Castle.

item:pillory-shield.name: Pillory Shield
item:pillory-shield.description: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such. Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.
item:pillory-shield.location: Looted from a corpse inside one of the locked cells within the Gaol Cave in Caelid.

item:piquebone-arrow.name: Piquebone Arrow
item:piquebone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow with putrescence-soaked tip
item:piquebone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

item:piquebone-arrow-fletched.name: Piquebone Arrow (Fletched)
item:piquebone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched bone arrow with putrescence-soaked tip
item:piquebone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

item:piquebone-bolt.name: Piquebone Bolt
item:piquebone-bolt.description: Piquebone Bolt is a Bolt, a type of Ammunition used with Crossbows .
item:piquebone-bolt.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

item:placidusax-s-ruin.name: Placidusax's Ruin
item:placidusax-s-ruin.description: Power gleaned form the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.

stats.Effect: Spews golden breath of Dragonlord Placidusax

item:point-downwards.name: Point Downwards
item:point-downwards.location: Available from the start of the game.
item:point-downwards.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:point-forwards.name: Point Forwards
item:point-forwards.location: Available from the start of the game.
item:point-forwards.description: Elden Ring's variant of the animation is also used in: - Dark Souls - Dark Souls II (then simply known as "Point") - Dark Souls III (allowed players to move during the animation)

item:point-upwards.name: Point Upwards
item:point-upwards.location: Available from the start of the game.
item:point-upwards.description: Elden Ring's variant of the animation is also used in: - Dark Souls (then simply known as "Point Up") - Dark Souls III (then simply known as "Point Up" and allowed players to move during the animation)

item:poison-armament.name: Poison Armament
item:poison-armament.description: Incantation of the servants of rot. Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with poison

item:poison-grease.name: Poison Grease
item:poison-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of poison-green materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting poison

item:poison-mist.name: Poison Mist
item:poison-mist.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.

stats.Effect: Releases poison mist before caster.

item:poison-moth-flight.name: Poison Moth Flight
item:poison-moth-flight.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and thefollowing skill:"Poison Moth Flight: Slash with a poison-infused blade. If thefollow-up strike lands on a poisoned foe, it will deal significantdamage."Usable on small and medium swords (twinblades excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:poison-pot.name: Poison Pot
item:poison-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of poisonous materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison.

item:poison-pot.location: Craftable — Toxic Mushroom x1, Poisonbloom x1

item:poison-spraymist.name: Poison Spraymist
item:poison-spraymist.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to release a poison mist from user's mouth, causing a buildup of poison. Perfumed powder is held in the mouth to dissolve before being expelled. It was once a restorative art, or so it is said.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to release poison mist from the mouth.

item:poison-spraymist.location: Crafted with the Perfumer's Cookbook [2], found on a rooftop corpse at the Shaded Castle in Altus Plateau.

item:poisonbloom.name: Poisonbloom
item:poisonbloom.description: Flower that grows in toxic terrain. Material used for crafting items. Poisonous, but may also provide the cure.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:poisonbone-arrow.name: Poisonbone Arrow
item:poisonbone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow with poison-daubed tip
item:poisonbone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Animal bone arrow with venom-tipped head

item:poisonbone-arrow-fletched.name: Poisonbone Arrow (Fletched)
item:poisonbone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched animal bone arrow with poison-daubed tip
item:poisonbone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Fletched bone arrow tipped with venom

item:poisonbone-bolt.name: Poisonbone Bolt
item:poisonbone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt with poison-coated tip

item:poisonbone-dart.name: Poisonbone Dart
item:poisonbone-dart.description: Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing, with a poison-laced tip. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up poison

item:poisoned-hand.name: Poisoned Hand
item:poisoned-hand.location: Found in the sewers of Belurat, Tower Settlement. The weapon is on the far right side of the poison pond guarded by a Horned Warrior.
item:poisoned-hand.description: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with deadly poison. Raises attack power when poisoning occurs in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who have had everything burned or stolen from them, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

item:poisoned-stone.name: Poisoned Stone
item:poisoned-stone.description: A small stone with a poisoned core.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison

item:poisoned-stone-clump.name: Poisoned Stone Clump
item:poisoned-stone-clump.description: A clump of small stones with poison cores.

stats.Effect: Throw together to cause buildup of poison

item:poisonous-mist.name: Poisonous Mist
item:poisonous-mist.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and the following skill:"Poisonous Mist: Bathe armament in poison, and then slash, spreading toxic mist forwards. The armament retains its poison for a while."Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:poleblade-of-the-bud.name: Poleblade of the Bud

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:poleblade-of-the-bud.description: Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot. Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade.
related: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

stats.Effect: A formal bow

item:polter-stone.name: Polter Stone
item:polter-stone.description: Contrivance of the grave keepers made from spiritgrave stone. Craftable item. Creates noises imitative of human presence where it lands when thrown. Said to have been used by the solitary grave keepers to distract themselves from their longing for company.

stats.Effect: Makes a noise imitative of human presence

item:prattling-pate-apologies.name: Prattling Pate "Apologies"
item:prattling-pate-apologies.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Apologies."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Apologies"

item:prattling-pate-hello.name: Prattling Pate "Hello"
item:prattling-pate-hello.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Hello"

item:prattling-pate-lamentation.name: Prattling Pate "Lamentation"
item:prattling-pate-lamentation.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a blissful lamentation. The voice resounds, seeping into the brain. Weeping, weeping, weeping. Ever weeping.

stats.Effect: Emits a blissful lamentation

item:prattling-pate-let-s-get-to-it.name: Prattling Pate "Let's get to it"
item:prattling-pate-let-s-get-to-it.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Let's get to it." A wistful fetish that imparts voices and words on an eternal journey.

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Let's get to it"

item:prattling-pate-my-beloved.name: Prattling Pate "My beloved"
item:prattling-pate-my-beloved.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "My beloved." A wistful fetish that imparts voices and words on an eternal journey. Expressions of love are among the most fickle.

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "My beloved"

item:prattling-pate-my-beloved.location: Miquella's Haligtree, all the way up in the canopy at the start on a branch.

item:prattling-pate-please-help.name: Prattling Pate "Please help"
item:prattling-pate-please-help.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Please help."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Please help"

item:prattling-pate-thank-you.name: Prattling Pate "Thank you"
item:prattling-pate-thank-you.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Thank you"

item:prattling-pate-wonderful.name: Prattling Pate "Wonderful"
item:prattling-pate-wonderful.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Wonderful."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "Wonderful"

item:prattling-pate-you-re-beautiful.name: Prattling Pate "You're beautiful"
item:prattling-pate-you-re-beautiful.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a demi-human head. Emits a voice that says "You're beautiful."

stats.Effect: Emits a voice that says "You're beautiful"

item:prayer.name: Prayer
item:prayer.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:prayer-room-key.name: Prayer Room Key
item:prayer-room-key.description: Iron key with an engraved crest. Opens the door to the prayer room in the house of worship found in the church district of the shadow keep.

stats.Effect: Opens prayer room door in the house of worship found in the church district

item:prayerbook-ancient-dragon.name: Ancient Dragon Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-ancient-dragon.description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult. A lost tome that never reached the Lands Between.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-assassins.name: Assassin's Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-assassins.description: Prayerbook of the Roundtable Hold's assassins.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-dragon-cult.name: Dragon Cult Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-dragon-cult.description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-fire-monks.name: Fire Monks' Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-fire-monks.description: Prayerbook of the Fire Monks, who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants far to the north.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-giants.name: Giant's Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-giants.description:
Prayerbook that contains the secrets of the Fire Giants. Kept hidden by the prelates who monitor the Giant's Flame. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Giantsflame Take Thee
- Flame, Fall Upon Them

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-godskin.name: Godskin Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-godskin.description:
Prayerbook bound in supple skin. Incantations of the god-slaying black flame are written within. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: - Black Flame
- Black Flame Blade

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerbook-two-fingers.name: Two Fingers' Prayerbook
item:prayerbook-two-fingers.description: Prayerbook containing incantations of the Two Fingers. An item once entrusted to Tarnished worthy of lordship.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

item:prayerful-strike.name: Prayerful Strike
item:prayerful-strike.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Prayerful Strike: Raise armament aloft in prayer, then slam it into the ground. This inspired blow restores HP to the self and nearby allies if it successfully hits."Usable on axes and hammers.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:preceptor-s-big-hat.name: Preceptor's Big Hat
item:preceptor-s-big-hat.description: Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:preceptor-s-gloves.name: Preceptor's Gloves
item:preceptor-s-gloves.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:preceptor-s-gloves.location: - The Preceptor's Gloves are found in Seluvis's Rise after completing Ranni the Witch's questline.

item:preceptor-s-long-gown.name: Preceptor's Long Gown
item:preceptor-s-long-gown.description: A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals. Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 14 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:preceptor-s-long-gown.location: Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:preceptor-s-long-gown-altered.name: Preceptor's Long Gown (altered)
item:preceptor-s-long-gown-altered.description: Lighter version of the Preceptor's Long Gown.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 2 · Pierce 4 · Magic 12 · Fire 12 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:preceptor-s-trousers.name: Preceptor's Trousers
item:preceptor-s-trousers.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 8 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:preceptor-s-trousers.location: Located inside Seluvis's Rise at Three Sisters after completing Ranni's questline.

item:prelate-s-charge.name: Prelate's Charge
item:prelate-s-charge.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame affinity and the following skill:"Prelate's Charge: Slam armament into the ground to create a surge of flames, then charge in. Hold to continue the charge."Usable on large and colossal axes and hammers.
item:prelate-s-charge.location: Can alternatively be approached from the Giants' Gravepost

stats.Effect: Ash

item:prelate-s-inferno-crozier.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
item:prelate-s-inferno-crozier.description: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship. The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks' will fling foes into the air.
item:prelate-s-inferno-crozier.location: To get the Prelate's Inferno Crozier in Elden Ring, you need to defeat the Fire Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir.

item:preserving-boluses.name: Preserving Boluses
item:preserving-boluses.description: Scarlet boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Alleviates scarlet rot buildup and cures rot

item:preserving-boluses.location: Nomadic Merchant near the Caelid Highway North

item:priestess-heart.name: Priestess Heart
item:priestess-heart.description: The stone heart of a Dragon Communion priestess. Use while disrobed to turn one's human flesh into an ancient dragon. The change cannot be undone except by death. Using this heart while already transformed temporarily boosts incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The priestess was once an ancient dragon herself, but sacrificed that form for feeble flesh to aid in the destruction of Bayle the Dread.

stats.Effect: Turns human frame into ancient dragon and boosts Dragon Cult incantations

item:priestess-heart.location: Found in the spot where the Dragon Communion Priestess stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. It spawns after the player defeats Bayle the Dread.

item:primal-glintstone.name: Sellen's Primal Glintstone
item:primal-glintstone.description: Glintstone from within the sorceress Sellen's body. Seemingly half-alive, blood vessels are visible within. In essence, a primal glintstone is a sorcerer's soul. If transplanted into a compatible new body after their original body dies, the sorcerer will rise again. "My apprentice, do you think it distasteful?"

stats.Effect: Glintstone from within Sellen's body

item:primal-glintstone-blade.name: Primal Glintstone Blade
item:primal-glintstone-blade.description: An old glintstone blade that has been stained with blood.

stats.Effect: Spells consume less FP, but maximum HP is reduced

item:primal-glintstone-blade.location: - Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Stargazer's Ruins in central Mountaintops of the Giants. The cellar is locked by a seal, which can be dispelled by summoning the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes near the NPC jellyfish that speaks, near the center of the ruins. Note that the NPC jellyfish does respawn, if killed.

item:prince-of-death-s-cyst.name: Prince of Death's Cyst
item:prince-of-death-s-cyst.description: A fetid, overgrown cyst taken from facial flesh. Greatly raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

stats.Effect: Greatly raises vitality

item:prince-of-death-s-pustule.name: Prince of Death's Pustule
item:prince-of-death-s-pustule.description: A fetid pustule taken from facial flesh. Raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

stats.Effect: Raises Vitality

item:prince-of-death-s-pustule.location: - Obtained from a corpse next to the giant root-like face underneath Stormveil Castle.

item:prince-of-death-s-staff.name: Prince of Death's Staff

stats.Scaling: Str E · Int D · Fai D

item:prince-of-death-s-staff.location: The Prince of Death's Staff is located in the Deeproot Depths area.
item:prince-of-death-s-staff.description: Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries. One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.

item:prisoner-clothing.name: Prisoner Clothing
item:prisoner-clothing.description: Tattered clothing. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 12

item:prisoner-iron-mask.name: Prisoner Iron Mask
item:prisoner-iron-mask.description: Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling. A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:prisoner-trousers.name: Prisoner Trousers
item:prisoner-trousers.description: Tattered trousers. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy. The smell is beyond belief.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 7

item:prophecy-painting.name: "Prophecy" Painting
item:prophecy-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Prophecy." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "Prophecy"
Examine using

item:prophet-blindfold.name: Prophet Blindfold
item:prophet-blindfold.description: Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk.

item:prophet-robe.name: Prophet Robe
item:prophet-robe.description: Robe of exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:prophet-robe-altered.name: Prophet Robe (Altered)
item:prophet-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Prophet Robe.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 6 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:prophet-trousers.name: Prophet Trousers
item:prophet-trousers.description: Trousers of the exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

stats.Effect: Raises dexterity by 5

item:protection-of-the-erdtree.name: Protection of the Erdtree
item:protection-of-the-erdtree.description: A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship. Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical, for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation. In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.

stats.Effect: Increases affinity damage negation for self & allies

item:pulley-crossbow.name: Pulley Bow
item:pulley-crossbow.description: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order Fundamentalism. Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.
item:pulley-crossbow.location: The Pulley Bow is located on a corpse at the top of a siege tower in Mt. Gelmir, in the Altus Plateau region.

item:pumpkin-helm.name: Pumpkin Helm
item:pumpkin-helm.description: An oval helmet large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard. Reduces damage from headshots and impacts. The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 5 · Holy 4

item:pumpkin-helm.location: Chance to drop from Mad Pumpkin Head enemies.

item:pureblood-medal.name: Pureblood Knight's Medal
item:pureblood-medal.description: Proof that one is a glorious knight of the new Dynasty of Mohgwyn that the Lord of Blood will inaugurate. Use to be granted audience with Mohg. Only, it is not yet time. For Mohg yet slumbers beside the Divinity. Be patient. The new dynasty is nigh.

stats.Effect: Audience with Mohg will be granted, one day

related: Varré — cloth soaked in maiden blood
Varré / Rose Church ignored or killed

item:purifying-crystal-tear.name: Purifying Crystal Tear
item:purifying-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the age where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wonderous Physick. The resulting conction purifies the curse from Mohg, Lord of Blood's terrifying rite of blood.

stats.Effect: Purifies the Lord of Blood's curse in a mixed physick

item:purifying-crystal-tear.location: Defeat Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger when advancing Yura's questline.

item:putrescence-cleaver.name: Putrescence Cleaver

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Arc D

item:putrescence-cleaver.description: Weapon wielded by the Putrescent Knight. A great cleaver of hardened putrescence affixed to an arch fashioned from human bones. Gains power from the wielder's arcane attribute.

item:putrid-corpse-ashes.name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
item:putrid-corpse-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four putrid corpses.

stats.Effect: Summons four putrid corpse spirits

item:putrid-corpse-ashes.location: Dropped by the Frenzied Duelist at the end of Gaol Cave.

item:queelign-s-greatsword.name: Queelign's Greatsword

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:queelign-s-greatsword.location: This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation.
item:queelign-s-greatsword.description: Greatsword of the Fire Knight Queelign. A weighty piercing sword with a blade that undulates like fire. Queelign devoted his all to the crusade, and remade his greatsword in the shape of the lance wielded by his liege—aspiring to become a second Impaler.

item:queen-s-bracelets.name: Queen's Bracelets
item:queen-s-bracelets.description: Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:queen-s-bracelets.location: - The Queen's Bracelets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 7,000 runes after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

item:queen-s-crescent-crown.name: Queen's Crescent Crown
item:queen-s-crescent-crown.description: A tall crown depicting the moon. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 1 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:queen-s-crescent-crown.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 7,000 runes after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

item:queen-s-leggings.description: Leggings indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. item:quickstep.name: Quickstep
item:quickstep.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Quickstep: Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:rabbath-s-cannon.name: Rabbath's Cannon
item:rabbath-s-cannon.location: Found in a chest atop Rabbath's Rise northeast of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr in eastern Scadu Altus. To reach it, unseal the Spiritspring by breaking the sealing stones hidden behind the illusory wall on the rise's lower balcony.
item:rabbath-s-cannon.description: A type of jar cannon used to fire greatbolts. A masterwork of Spellmachinist Rabbath. The power of the glintstones that encircle the barrel imbues bolts with magic damage and guides shots toward their targets.

item:rabbath-s-greatbolt.name: Rabbath's Greatbolt
item:rabbath-s-greatbolt.description: Rabbath's Greatbolt is a Greatbolt, a type of Ammunition used with Ballistas .

item:rada-fruit.name: Rada Fruit
item:rada-fruit.description: Berry-like fruit that grows into spiritgrave grass. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow, though its bitter taste makes it unsuitable for consumption by humans.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rada-fruit.location: - Can be found commonly throughout the Gravesite Plain and the Realm of Shadow.

item:radagon-icon.name: Radagon Icon
item:radagon-icon.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Radagon. Shortens the casting time of sorceries and incantations.

stats.Effect: Shortens spell casting time

item:radagon-icon.location: Debate Parlor side path, argument hall upstairs chest.

item:radagon-s-rings-of-light.name: Radagon's Rings of Light
item:radagon-s-rings-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

stats.Effect: Creates golden ring of light to attack wide area

item:radagon-s-rings-of-light.location: Sold by Brother Corhyn - Golden Order Principia

item:radagon-s-scarseal.name: Radagon's Scarseal
item:radagon-s-scarseal.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.

stats.Effect: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

item:radagon-s-soreseal.name: Radagon's Soreseal
item:radagon-s-soreseal.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

item:radagon-s-soreseal.location: Chest inside Fort Faroth in Dragonbarrow.

item:radahn-great-rune.name: Radahn's Great Rune
item:radahn-great-rune.description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Radahn. Its blessing raises maximum HP, FP and Stamina. Radahn was amongst the children of Rennala and Radagon, who became demigod stepchildren after Radagon's union with Queen Marika. The Great Rune burns, to resist the encroachment of the scarlet rot.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum HP, FP and stamina

item:radahn-great-rune.location: Upon the defeat of General Radahn.

item:radahn-s-gauntlets.name: Radahn's Gauntlets
item:radahn-s-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:radahn-s-gauntlets.location: - Radahn's Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 8,000 runes after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

item:radahn-s-greaves.name: Radahn's Greaves
item:radahn-s-greaves.description: Greaves depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:radahn-s-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

item:radahn-s-lion-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Radahn's Lion Armor.

item:radahn-s-redmane-helm.name: Radahn's Redmane Helm
item:radahn-s-redmane-helm.description: Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair. Worn by General Radahn.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:radahn-s-redmane-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 8,000 runes after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

item:radahn-s-spear.name: Radahn's Spear
item:radahn-s-spear.description: Radahn's Spear is a Great Arrow, a type of Ammunition used with Greatbows .

item:radahn-soldier-ashes.name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
item:radahn-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Radahn's soldiers.

stats.Effect: Summons two Radahn Soldier spirits

item:radahn-soldier-ashes.location: Found in the War-Dead Catacombs. From the main hall, take the back right set of stairs and go through the tunnel forward until there is a window to the right, just before the dead-end, that can be jumped out of to get to a platform. Take the stairs to the left up to a couple of Imps and it's found in a small room full of Scarlet Rot.

item:radahn-soldier-gauntlets.name: Radahn Soldier Gauntlets
item:radahn-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:radahn-soldier-gauntlets.location: - The Radahn Soldier Gauntlets have a chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

item:radahn-soldier-greaves.name: Radahn Soldier Greaves
item:radahn-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:radahn-soldier-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

item:radahn-soldier-helm.name: Radahn Soldier Helm
item:radahn-soldier-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:radahn-soldier-helm.location: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

item:radiant-baldachin-s-blessing.name: Radiant Baldachin's Blessing
item:radiant-baldachin-s-blessing.description: Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. This blessing is of the utmost rarity. Uses FP to temporarily raise poise. The effect lasts longer than a mere favor. It's said a deathbed companion will only produce a blessing of this kind for a champion but once in her entire life. The sole blessing which she imbues of her own volition.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to temporarily raise poise

item:radiant-baldachin-s-blessing.location: Obtained from Fia after handing her the Cursemark of Death.

item:radiant-gold-mask.name: Radiant Gold Mask
item:radiant-gold-mask.description: A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Strenthens Golden Order incantations. Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit. "To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:radiant-gold-mask.location: Can be found on a corpse at the edge of the north part of the broken bridge in Altus Plateau.

item:ragged-armor.name: Ragged Armor
item:ragged-armor.description: Armor pieced together from scavenged metal.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:ragged-armor.location: - The Ragged Armor is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:ragged-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Ragged Armor.

item:ragged-armor-altered.location: - The Ragged Armor (Altered) is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:ragged-gloves.name: Ragged Gloves
item:ragged-gloves.description: Gauntlets pieced together from scavenged metal.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:ragged-gloves.location: The Ragged Gloves are cut content and cannot be acquired.

item:ragged-hat.description: Helm pieced together from scavenged metal.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:ragged-hat.location: - The Ragged Hat is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:ragged-hat-altered.description: Lighter version of the Ragged Hat.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:ragged-hat-altered.location: - The Ragged Hat (Altered) is unused content and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. Possessing this item while playing online may result in a permanent ban.

item:ragged-loincloth.description: Greaves pieced together from scavenged metal.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:raging-beast.name: Raging Beast
item:raging-beast.description: Skill: Raging Beast Step with the swiftness of a beast, leap high, and slash foe from above. Initial step can be taken forward, backward, left, or right. Strong attack allows for a follow-up attack.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:raging-wolf-armor.name: Raging Wolf Armor
item:raging-wolf-armor.description: Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold. According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 7 · Holy 9

item:raging-wolf-armor-altered.name: Raging Wolf Armor (altered)
item:raging-wolf-armor-altered.description: Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 8 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:raging-wolf-armor-altered.location: Defeat Vargram the Raging Wolf and modify with Boc.

item:raging-wolf-gauntlets.name: Raging Wolf Gauntlets
item:raging-wolf-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of Vargram the Bloody Wolf
item:raging-wolf-gauntlets.location: - The Raging Wolf Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Vargram the Raging Wolf.

item:raging-wolf-greaves.name: Raging Wolf Greaves
item:raging-wolf-greaves.description: Greaves of Vargram the Bloody Wolf

item:raging-wolf-helm.name: Raging Wolf Helm
item:raging-wolf-helm.description: Helm of Vargram the Bloody Wolf
item:raging-wolf-helm.location: Obtained as part of Bernahl's Volcano Manor quest. You will have to defeat two NPCs in a scripted invasion together with Bernahl in the Fortified Manor, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:rain-of-arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
item:rain-of-arrows.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Rain of Arrows: Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow, then fire a burst of arrows into the sky to shower the enemy with projectiles."Usable on all bows.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:rain-of-fire.name: Rain of Fire
item:rain-of-fire.description: Incantation of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights. Summons a cloud of flame overhead that pelts foe with rain of fire from above. Charging increases potency. Salza's disdain for barbarism never waned, even as he burned more villages and scorched more land than any other.

stats.Effect: Pelts foe with rain of fire from above

item:rainbow-stone.name: Rainbow Stone
item:rainbow-stone.description: Ruin Fragment that has undergone some simple processing.

stats.Effect: Shines with colored light when placed, serving as a guide

item:rainbow-stone-arrow.name: Rainbow Stone Arrow
item:rainbow-stone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow tipped with Rainbow Stone shard
item:rainbow-stone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Animal bone arrow tipped with Rainbow Stone fragments

item:rainbow-stone-arrow-fletched.name: Rainbow Stone Arrow (Fletched)
item:rainbow-stone-arrow-fletched.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones tipped with chips of Rainbow Stone. Colored light shines at the point of impact. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.
item:rainbow-stone-arrow-fletched.location: - Subterranean Shunning-Grounds — x10 found among Slugs in the first maze of pipes before the first shortcut.

item:rakshasa-armor.name: Rakshasa Armor
item:rakshasa-armor.description: Armor of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free. Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer. Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

item:rakshasa-gauntlets.name: Rakshasa Gauntlets
item:rakshasa-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free. Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer. Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

item:rakshasa-greaves.name: Rakshasa Greaves
item:rakshasa-greaves.description: Greaves of Rakshasa, soaked the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free. Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer. Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

item:rakshasa-helm.name: Rakshasa Helm
item:rakshasa-helm.description: Helm of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free. Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer. Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

item:rakshasa-s-great-katana.name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
item:rakshasa-s-great-katana.location: Gained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.
item:rakshasa-s-great-katana.description: A great katana with the tempering pattern of its blade forever stained red with blood. Weapon of Rakshasa, who cuts down and devours. A berserker's weapon used to endure enemy attacks and reply with one's full fury. When attacking, the wielder is less likely to stagger from counterattacks, but will also take increased damage.

item:rallying-cry.name: Rallying Cry

stats.Effect: Raise morale

item:rallying-cry.location: Available from the start of the game.

item:rancor-pot.name: Rancor Pot
item:rancor-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by the ancient death hex. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to spawn vengeful spirits that chase down foes. In times of old, the dead were burned with ghostflame, and from those cinders arose vengeful spirits.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw to summon vengeful spirits.

item:rancorcall.name: Rancorcall
item:rancorcall.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.

stats.Effect: Summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes

item:ranni-s-dark-moon.name: Ranni's Dark Moon
item:ranni-s-dark-moon.description: Legendary sorcery associated with the Carian queen.

stats.Effect: Incarnate a cold, dark moon and launch it at foes.

item:ranni-s-dark-moon.location: Chelona's Rise, in the south-west of the Moonfolk Ruins. You'll have to solve the puzzle with the three spirit turtles. One is right next to the Rise, the other at the cliff south-east of the Lunar Estate Ruins on a ledge and the third is flying above the evergaol portal in the north-west. You'll have to start at Chelona's Rise and travel to each location by foot/horse, otherwise the turtles don't spawn.

stats.Effect: Can be given to a learned sorcerer to acquire new sorceries

item:rapier.name: Rapier
item:rapier.description: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield. As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.
item:rapier.location: To get the standard Rapier in Elden Ring, you can simply purchase it for 1,000 Runes from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

item:raptor-of-the-mists.name: Raptor of the Mists
item:raptor-of-the-mists.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Raptor of the Mists: Duck into a low stance, momentarily vanishing. If an enemy attack connects, avian wings will allow for a quick escape into the air."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:raptor-of-the-mists.location: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin near the Main Academy Gate

stats.Effect: ash

item:raptor-s-black-feathers.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
item:raptor-s-black-feathers.description: Robe crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey. Worn by the assassin Ravenmount.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 9 · Pierce 9 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 9

item:raptor-talons.name: Raptor Talons
item:raptor-talons.description: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades, wielded by the assassins of Ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.
item:raptor-talons.location: To get the Raptor Talons in Elden Ring, travel to Sage's Cave in the Altus Plateau.

item:rapture.name: Rapture
item:rapture.location: Recieved by interacting with the Two Fingers in the Roundtable Hold.
item:rapture.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:rauh-burrow.name: Rauh Burrow
item:rauh-burrow.description: Oval-shaped stone bearing an engraving. Material used for crafting items. Relic found at the ancient ruins of Rauh. In the center of the stone is a small nest-like hole. Once this is inhabited by a sprite, the stone can be used as a ritual implement.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rauh-burrow.location: Found at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

item:raw-meat-dumpling.name: Raw Meat Dumpling
item:raw-meat-dumpling.description: A pungent raw meatball, made succulent by virtue of being on the verge of turning.

stats.Effect: Restores HP but causes poison buildup

item:raw-meat-dumpling.location: Found by Killing Giant Pots. ( Just like Alexander )

item:raya-lucaria-soldier-ashes.name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
item:raya-lucaria-soldier-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three Raya Lucaria soldiers.

stats.Effect: Summons three Raya Lucaria soldier spirits

item:raya-lucaria-soldier-ashes.location: Found in a chest in Road's End Catacombs, behind an illusory wall near the end of the dungeon.

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons three Raya Lucaria soldier spirits

item:raya-lucarian-gauntlets.name: Raya Lucarian Gauntlets
item:raya-lucarian-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:raya-lucarian-gauntlets.location: - The Raya Lucarian Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Soldier enemies.

item:raya-lucarian-greaves.name: Raya Lucarian Greaves
item:raya-lucarian-greaves.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:raya-lucarian-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Soldier enemies.

item:raya-lucarian-helm.name: Raya Lucarian Helm
item:raya-lucarian-helm.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Its brow adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:raya-lucarian-helm.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Soldier enemies.

item:raya-lucarian-robe.name: Raya Lucarian Robe
item:raya-lucarian-robe.description: Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep blue garb along with their vows of virtue and austerity. But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:raya-lucarian-robe.location: Chance to drop from Glintstone Sorcerer enemies.

stats.Effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world

item:red-bear-s-claw.name: Red Bear's Claw
item:red-bear-s-claw.location: Dropped by Red Bear in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.
item:red-bear-s-claw.description: Claw of a great red bear wielded without modification by Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

item:red-branch-shortbow.name: Red Branch Shortbow
item:red-branch-shortbow.description: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages. A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.
item:red-branch-shortbow.location: To get the Red Branch Shortbow in Elden Ring, you need to farm and defeat Page enemies (the hooded human enemies) until it drops, with reliable spots at Tombsward Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula, Caria Manor in Liurnia, or the East Capital Rampart in Leyndell.

item:red-crest-heater-shield.name: Red Crest Heater Shield
item:red-crest-heater-shield.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.
item:red-crest-heater-shield.location: Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge

item:red-feathered-branchsword.name: Red-Feathered Branchsword
item:red-feathered-branchsword.description: A talisman adorned with red feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power when HP is low.

item:red-fulgurbloom.name: Red Fulgurbloom
item:red-fulgurbloom.description: Flower that crackles with red lightning. Material used for crafting items. Found at the jagged peak on the south coast. Said to bloom where the red lightning of the ancient dragons strikes the earth.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:red-fulgurbloom.location: - Red Fulgurbloom grows on the Jagged Peak and at the Foot of the Jagged Peak on the Southern Shore of the Realm of Shadow.

item:red-hot-whetblade.name: Red-Hot Whetblade
item:red-hot-whetblade.description: Red-hot whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife. When applying an affinity using physical or flame-type ashes of war, an additional affinity of fire or flame art can be chosen.

stats.Effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon

item:red-insignia.name: Red Insignia
item:red-insignia.description: It is considered cut content and was only obtainable in version 1.00.

stats.Effect: Volcano Manor fellow sign, given by Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress

item:red-letter.name: Red Letter
item:red-letter.description: A written request from Volcano Manor disclosing the name of a Tarnished to be hunted. As the final request, the letter is vivid red. "Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood" He can be found in the Mountaintops of the Giants. Find the red mark on your map for the exact location.

stats.Effect:
Request from Volcano Manor
Examine using

item:red-lightning-pot.name: Red Lightning Pot
item:red-lightning-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. A cocktail of red fulminating materials is sealed inside. Throw at an enemy to inflict lightning damage that links to surrounding enemies. The ancient dragons who betrayed their lord to side with a tyrant were known for wielding branching red lightning.

stats.Effect: Inflict lightning damage that links to nearby enemies

item:red-lightning-pot.location: Crafted with Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook (1).

item:red-thorn-roundshield.name: Red Thorn Roundshield
item:red-thorn-roundshield.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.
item:red-thorn-roundshield.location: Sold by Merchant - East Weeping Peninsula

item:redflesh-mushroom.name: Redflesh Mushroom
item:redflesh-mushroom.description: Red mushroom that grows in sullen lands. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow. The flesh of the mushroom is similar to raw meat, and can serve as pot innards.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:redflesh-mushroom.location: Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow

item:redmane-fire-pot.name: Redmane Fire Pot
item:redmane-fire-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Engraved with the crest of red-maned lion. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage. Even today, the survivors of Radahn's battalion employ fire to stave off the scarlet rot.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage

item:redmane-greatshield.name: Redmane Greatshield
item:redmane-greatshield.description: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.
item:redmane-greatshield.location: 4% chance to be dropped by Redmane Knights throughout Caelid.

item:redmane-knight-armor.name: Redmane Knight Armor
item:redmane-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 9 · Holy 10

item:redmane-knight-armor.location: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

item:redmane-knight-armor-altered.name: Redmane Knight Armor (altered)
item:redmane-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Redmane Knight Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 13 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 12 · Lightning 9 · Holy 10

item:redmane-knight-gauntlets.name: Redmane Knight Gauntlets
item:redmane-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets used by Elite Caelid Wilds Knights
item:redmane-knight-gauntlets.location: - The Redmane Knight Gauntlets have a chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

item:redmane-knight-greaves.name: Redmane Knight Greaves
item:redmane-knight-greaves.description: Black iron greaves worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:redmane-knight-greaves.location: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

item:redmane-knight-helm.name: Redmane Knight Helm

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:redmane-knight-helm.location: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.
item:redmane-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

item:redmane-knight-ogha.name: Redmane Knight Ogha
item:redmane-knight-ogha.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Ogha, the Redmane Knight. Spirit of a mighty knight versed in the use of a greatbow. A valiant warrior who will attack immediately after being summoned. The longest-serving member of the Redmane Knights, Ogha studied techniques to manipulate gravity alongside Radahn. May use a rain of gravitational arrows in response to a war cry, but only once.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha

item:redmane-knight-ogha.location: Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit in War-Dead Catacombs.

upgradeLevels.name: Redmane Knight Ogha +1
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha

upgradeLevels.name: Redmane Knight Ogha +10
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha

item:redmane-painting.name: "Redmane" Painting
item:redmane-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Redmane." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "Redmane"
Examine using

item:redmane-surcoat.name: Redmane Surcoat
item:redmane-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 8 · Holy 9

item:redmane-surcoat.location: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

item:reduvia.name: Reduvia
item:reduvia.description: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curled blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:reed-great-katana.name: Reed Great Katana
item:reed-great-katana.description: Large katana with a long, heavy blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.
item:reed-great-katana.location: On a corpse in a meditating position atop the white rock structure north of the Fort Faroth site of grace, Dragonbarrow.

item:regal-omen-bairn.name: Regal Omen Bairn
item:regal-omen-bairn.description: Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line. Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase that foes

item:regalia-of-eochaid.name: Regalia of Eochaid
item:regalia-of-eochaid.description: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone. Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:regalia-of-eochaid.location: To get the Regalia of Eochaid, an Arcane-scaling straight sword, head to the secluded beach plateau in East Limgrave.

item:rejection.name: Rejection
item:rejection.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

stats.Effect: Produces a shockwave that pushes away foes.

item:rejuvenating-boluses.name: Rejuvenating Boluses
item:rejuvenating-boluses.description: Black boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Alleviates death blight buildup

item:rellana-s-armor.name: Rellana's Armor
item:rellana-s-armor.description: Ornate armor of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel. Adorned with the lapis-lazuli blue that is symbolic of Caria, its radiance is yet to fully fade.

item:rellana-s-cameo.name: Rellana's Cameo
item:rellana-s-cameo.description: Enhances attacks executed after maintaining the same stance for a while
item:rellana-s-cameo.location: - Obtained from an altar in Castle Ensis beside Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.

stats.Effect: Enhances attacks executed after maintaining the same stance for a while

item:rellana-s-gloves.name: Rellana's Gloves
item:rellana-s-gloves.description: Gloves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from quality leather.

item:rellana-s-greaves.name: Rellana's Greaves
item:rellana-s-greaves.description: Ornate greaves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

item:rellana-s-helm.name: Rellana's Helm
item:rellana-s-helm.description: Ornate helm of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel. Rennala, head of the royal family of Caria, was said to have given her younger sister, who renounced her lineage to chase after Messmer, a gift of lustrous black hair.

item:rellana-s-twin-blades.name: Rellana's Twin Blades

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D · Fai D

item:rellana-s-twin-blades.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight at Enia after Rellana.
