item:rellana-s-twin-blades.description: Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Weapon of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Two swords as a single armament. When two-handing, a straight sword engraved with golden flame will be carried in the left hand. Here, and here alone, were moon and fire ever together.
related: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

item:rellana-s-twin-moons.name: Rellana's Twin Moons
item:rellana-s-twin-moons.description: Sorcery of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Associated with a Carian princess. Incarnate overlapping twin moons which strike the ground one after the other, violently shaking the earth with moonlight. In her childhood, she and her elder sister Rennala met these moons. Overlapping, as though nestled against one another.

stats.Effect: Incarnate twin moons and repeatedly strike the ground

related: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

item:remembrance-a-god-and-a-lord.name: Remembrance of a God and a Lord
item:remembrance-a-god-and-a-lord.description: Remembrance of Radahn, consort of Miquella, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. In their childhood, Miquella saw in Radahn a lord. His strength, and his kindness, that stood in stark contrast with their afflicted selves. And so Miquella made his heartfelt wish. That Radahn would one day be his king consort.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

related: Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella

item:remembrance-black-blade.name: Remembrance of the Black Blade
item:remembrance-black-blade.description: Remembrance of Maliketh, the Black Blade, hewn into the

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-blasphemous.name: Remembrance of the Blasphemous
item:remembrance-blasphemous.description: Remembrance of the warrior I-Ioarah Loux, hewn into the

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-blood-lord.name: Remembrance of the Blood Lord
item:remembrance-blood-lord.description: Remembrance of Mohg, Lord of Blood, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Wishing to raise Miquella to full godhood, Mohg wished to become his consort, taking the role of monarch. But no matter how much of his bloody bedchamber he tried to share, he received no response from the young Empyrean.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-dancing-lion.name: Remembrance of the Dancing Lion
item:remembrance-dancing-lion.description: Remembrance of the Dancing Lion, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. When the Impaler's army assailed the tower, the ritual of the lion dance was turned toward martial ends—its divinity, its fury, its light-footed beauty.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

related: Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp

item:remembrance-dragonlord.name: Remembrance of the Dragonlord
item:remembrance-dragonlord.description: Remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-fire-giant.name: Remembrance of the Fire Giant
item:remembrance-fire-giant.description: Remembrance of Fire Giant, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-full-moon-queen.name: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen
item:remembrance-full-moon-queen.description: Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

related: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

item:remembrance-grafted.name: Remembrance of the Grafted
item:remembrance-grafted.description: Remembrance of Godrick, the Grafted, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-hoarah-loux.name: Remembrance of Hoarah Loux

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-hoarah-loux.description: Remembrance of the warrior Hoarah Loux, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. When Godfrey, first Elden Lord was robbed of his grace, becoming Tarnished, he took with him his kinfolk and left the Lands Between. After the Long March of the Tarnished came to an end, Godfrey divested himself of kingship, becoming a simple warrior once more.
related: Godfrey, First Elden Lord / Hoarah Loux
Ash of War: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker

item:remembrance-impaler.name: Remembrance of the Impaler
item:remembrance-impaler.description: Remembrance of Messmer the Impaler, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-lichdragon.name: Remembrance of the Lichdragon
item:remembrance-lichdragon.description: Remembrance of Lichdragon Fortissax, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-lord-of-frenzied-flame.name: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame
item:remembrance-lord-of-frenzied-flame.description: Remembrance of Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. As the golden barbs inflicted eternal agony upon him, Midra held fast to Nanaya's entreaty: "Endure." The word was a curse.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-mother-of-fingers.name: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers
item:remembrance-mother-of-fingers.description: Remembrance of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The mother of all Two Fingers and Fingercreepers was in turn a magnificently gleaming daughter of the Greater Will, and the first shooting star to fall upon the Lands Between.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-naturalborn.name: Remembrance of the Naturalborn
item:remembrance-naturalborn.description: Remembrance of Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

related: Ash of War: Waves of Darkness

item:remembrance-of-the-elder-inquisitor.name: Remembrance of the Elder Inquisitor
item:remembrance-of-the-elder-inquisitor.description: It lacks an item record; only the icon made it into the game.
item:remembrance-of-the-elder-inquisitor.location: The Remembrance of the Elder Inquisitor is fully unobtainable.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader Enia

item:remembrance-omen-king.name: Remembrance of the Omen King
item:remembrance-omen-king.description: Remembrance of Morgott, the Omen King, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Though born one of the graceless Omen, Morgott took it upon himself to become the Erdtree's protector. He loved not in return, for he was never loved, but nevertheless, love it he did.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-putrescence.name: Remembrance of Putrescence
item:remembrance-putrescence.description: Remembrance of the Putrescent Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. All tainted flesh eventually becomes putrescence, and this clump of it imbibed St. Trina's nectar, which granted it eternal rest. And so it was that putrescence became her knight.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-regal-ancestor.name: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor
item:remembrance-regal-ancestor.description: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor Spirit, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-rot-goddess.name: Remembrance of the Rot Goddess
item:remembrance-rot-goddess.description: Remembrance of Malenia, Goddess of Rot, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-saint-of-the-bud.name: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud
item:remembrance-saint-of-the-bud.description: Remembrance of Romina, Saint of the Bud, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. After the church was burned to the ground, Romina discovered a twisted divine element, which she weaved into the baleful scarlet rot. Perhaps then, the buds might find somewhere to gain purchase once more, within the scorched remains.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-saint-of-the-bud.location: Defeat Romina, Saint of the Bud

item:remembrance-shadow-sunflower.name: Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower
item:remembrance-shadow-sunflower.description: Remembrance of the Scadutree Avatar, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Scadutree is the shadow of the Erdtree. Born of dark notions that bear no sense of Order, that twist and bend its stock, rendering it brittle.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-starscourge.name: Remembrance of the Starscourge
item:remembrance-starscourge.description: Remembrance of Starscourge Radahn, hewn into the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-twin-moon-knight.name: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight
item:remembrance-twin-moon-knight.description: Remembrance of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Once a Carian princess, Rellana disavowed her birthright and chose to stand at Messmer's side instead, knowing full well that not even the brilliance of the moon could grant him succor. Before long, she became known as the Sword of Messmer.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:remembrance-wild-boar-rider.name: Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider
item:remembrance-wild-boar-rider.description: Remembrance of Commander Gaius, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Both were as elder brothers to the lion, and both were cursed from birth. In spite of, or perhaps because of this very reason, Gaius was both Messmer's friend and the leader of his men.

stats.Effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

item:rennala-great-rune.name: Great Rune of the Unborn
item:rennala-great-rune.description: Amber egg clutched by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Great Rune of unborn demigods. Perfects those who have been born anew. Children born anew by Rennala are all frail and short-lived. Imperfect beings, each and all.

stats.Effect: Used to perfect rebirth

related: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

item:rennala-s-full-moon.name: Rennala's Full Moon
item:rennala-s-full-moon.description: Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.

stats.Effect: Incarnate a full moon and launch it at foes

related: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen

item:repeating-crossbow.name: Repeating Crossbow
item:repeating-crossbow.location: Found on a body next to the Ghostflame Dragon in Scadu Altus.
item:repeating-crossbow.description: A mechanized crossbow that has been fitted with a fan-shaped contraption. This metallic piece adds a reloading system used in the execution of a unique battle art.

item:repeating-thrust.name: Repeating Thrust
item:repeating-thrust.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following Skill:Repeating Thrust Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.This Skill takes some time to build up, but it is very powerful.It can be used on all thrusting armaments.

stats.Effect: ash

item:rest.name: Rest

stats.Effect: Rest on the floor

item:rest.location: Available from the start of the game.

item:resurrection-painting.name: "Resurrection" Painting
item:resurrection-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Resurrection." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "Resurrection"
Examine using

item:retaliatory-crossed-tree.name: Retaliatory Crossed-Tree
item:retaliatory-crossed-tree.description: Enhances attacks executed after rolling or backstepping

stats.Effect: Enhances attacks executed after rolling or backstepping by 17%

item:revered-ash.name: Revered Spirit Ash
item:revered-ash.description: Spirit ash of those who came before, infused with potent spirituality. Acquired from the corpses of hornsent and other objects that ritually decorate townships and villages across the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Revered Spirit Ash Blessing. The Revered Spirit Ash Blessing bolsters both summoned spirits' and spectral steed's abilities to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. The withered corpses were called tutelary deities, and Revered Spirit Ash was said to quietly accumulate in the palms of their hands.

stats.Effect: Bolsters Revered Spirit Ash Blessing

item:revered-ash.location: On a small altar northeast of the Gravesite Plain

stats.Effect: A reverential bow

item:reverse-bladed.name: Reverse-Bladed Sword
item:reverse-bladed.description: Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip, said to have originated from the hidden realm of shadow. The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.

item:rickety-shield.name: Rickety Shield
item:rickety-shield.description: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

item:rift-shield.name: Rift Shield
item:rift-shield.description: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.

item:rimed-crystal-bud.name: Rimed Crystal Bud
item:rimed-crystal-bud.description: A young plant, frozen into a crystal before it could mature. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rimed-rowa.name: Rimed Rowa
item:rimed-rowa.description: A berry-like fruit, thought to be the original strain of Rowa. Material used for crafting items. Found in frigid highlands.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rimed-rowa.location: Found in Mountaintops of the Giants

item:ring-of-miquella.name: Ring of Miquella
item:ring-of-miquella.description: The Player Character slowly raises their bent arms upwards until the fingertips of both respective arms touch.

item:ringed-finger.name: Ringed Finger
item:ringed-finger.description: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper. Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.
item:ringed-finger.location: The Ringed Finger is a quirky, club-like weapon found inside Gelmir Hero's Grave in Mt. Gelmir.

item:rings-of-spectral-light.name: Rings of Spectral Light
item:rings-of-spectral-light.location: Charo's Hidden Grave on top of the arch leading from the
item:rings-of-spectral-light.description: Sorcery practiced by the keepers of the spiritgraves, where all death ultimately drifts. Creates rings of spectral light that fire in unison. Charging enhances potency. The rings of light have the same qualities as ghostflame, and deal magic damage while also causing frost buildup.

stats.Effect: Creates rings of spectral light that fire in unison

item:ripple-blade.name: Ripple Blade
item:ripple-blade.description: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.
item:ripple-blade.location: The Ripple Blade in Elden Ring can be purchased for 3,500 runes from Pidia, Carian Servant at Caria Manor in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:ripple-crescent-halberd.name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
item:ripple-crescent-halberd.description: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.
item:ripple-crescent-halberd.location: To get the Ripple Crescent Halberd in Elden Ring, you must farm second-generation Albinaurics who wield the weapon in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically around the Academy Gate Town or the Fallen Ruins of the Lake.

item:ritual-pot.name: Ritual Pot
item:ritual-pot.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Special item with greater durability than a cracked pot.

stats.Effect: Container required for crafting ritual pot items

item:ritual-pot.location: One on top of an inert Living Jar Warrior just north of the

item:ritual-shield-talisman.name: Ritual Shield Talisman
item:ritual-shield-talisman.description: A talisman patterned after shields used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Raises defense when HP is at maximum.

item:ritual-sword-talisman.name: Ritual Sword Talisman
item:ritual-sword-talisman.description: A talisman patterned after swords used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.

stats.Effect: Raises attack power when HP is at maximum.

item:ritual-sword-talisman.location: Altus, Lux Ruins chest after the demi-human queen.

item:ritual-thrusting-shield.name: Ritual Thrusting Shield
item:ritual-thrusting-shield.description: A "thrusting shield," or combined weapon and shield. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. An armament once used in rites of combat performed to honor the Erdtree, now lost to time.
item:ritual-thrusting-shield.location: In the main entrance of the Caelid Colosseum behind the giant jar; the corpse is near the door in the nearby bleachers.

item:rivers-of-blood.name: Rivers of Blood
item:rivers-of-blood.description: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men. When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:riveted-wooden-shield.name: Riveted Wooden Shield
item:riveted-wooden-shield.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.

item:roar-medallion.name: Roar Medallion
item:roar-medallion.location: - Obtained by defeating the Stonedigger Troll in Limgrave Tunnels in central Limgrave.

stats.Effect: Enhances roars and breath attacks

item:roar-of-rugalea.name: Roar of Rugalea
item:roar-of-rugalea.description:
An incantation of what is jokingly called "the bear communion."
Channels the power of Rugalea, the great red bear. Transform oneself into a great red bear and emit a mighty roar. Charging increases potency. An incantation that is more akin to the divine invocation of the hornsent than it is to the Dragon Communion. Only through desperate battle with the feral wild can one discover a god unique to oneself.

stats.Effect: Channels great red bear to emit a furious roar

item:rock-blaster.name: Rock Blaster
item:rock-blaster.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Thurst staff into ground to emit a massive shockwave

item:rock-heart.name: Rock Heart
item:rock-heart.description: Heart consumed in the ancient, original form of Dragon Communion. Use while disrobed to turn one's human flesh into an ancient dragon. The change cannot be undone except by death. Using this heart while already transformed temporarily boosts Dragon Communion incantations. The last thing the partaker saw with human eyes was a sunset, its colors faded and tarnished—a remote thing from eternity.

stats.Effect: Turns human frame into ancient dragon and boosts Dragon Communion incantations

item:rock-heart.location: Obtained after finding the "Domain of Dragons" Painting and traveling to the location it depicts on the Jagged Peak.

item:rock-sling.name: Rock Sling
item:rock-sling.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

stats.Effect: Summons rocks from the earth and sends its flying

item:rogier-s-bell-bearing.name: Rogier's Bell Bearing
item:rogier-s-bell-bearing.description: Rogier the Sorcerer's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:rogier-s-letter.name: Rogier's Letter
item:rogier-s-letter.description: Letter written in a trembling hand. "I forgot to tell you, but it seems D has a younger brother. I heard he lies in a deep sleep in the aqueduct beside the Eternal City of Nokron. And it's said he stood before the Prince of Death not far beyond that spot."

stats.Effect:
Letter written in a trembling hand
Examine using

item:rogier-s-rapier.name: Rogier's Rapier
item:rogier-s-rapier.description: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.
item:rogier-s-rapier.location: To get Rogier's Rapier, first speak to Sorcerer Rogier in the chapel at Stormveil Castle.

item:roiling-magma.name: Roiling Magma
item:roiling-magma.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir. Fires a lump of condensed magma that explodes a short delay after hitting the target. Charging enhances potency and further delays the explosion. After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.

stats.Effect: Fires lump of magma that explodes after delay

item:rold-medallion.name: Rold Medallion
item:rold-medallion.description: Conjoined split medallion depicting the Flame Peak. Brandishing the medallion activates the Grand Lift of Rold, connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants. The forge of the flame of ruin is said to be found upon their peaks, and it is here Melina wishes to travel in resuming your journey together.

stats.Effect: Operates Grand Lift of Rold

item:rold-medallion.location: Opens the Grand Lift of Rold to the Mountaintops.

item:rolling-sparks.name: Rolling Sparks
item:rolling-sparks.description: Skill: Rolling Sparks Scatter perfumed powder before you, triggering rolling explosions of deadly sparks. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used.

item:ronin-s-armor.name: Ronin's Armor
item:ronin-s-armor.description: Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 10 · Slash 11 · Pierce 10 · Magic 11 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 11

item:ronin-s-armor.location: Dropped by Shabriri on death, or left in his place if the Tarnished meets the Three Fingers and inherits the Frenzied Flame. Will not be dropped by Yura if he is killed before Shabriri possesses him.

item:ronin-s-armor-altered.name: Ronin's Armor (altered)
item:ronin-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Ronin's Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 8 · Slash 9 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:ronin-s-gauntlets.name: Ronin's Gauntlets
item:ronin-s-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 2

item:ronin-s-gauntlets.location: Gauntlets are dropped by Shabriri near the Zamor Ruins

item:ronin-s-greaves.name: Ronin's Greaves
item:ronin-s-greaves.description: Greaves of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 6 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 6

item:ronin-s-greaves.location: Dropped by Shabriri during his questline.

item:root-resin.name: Root Resin
item:root-resin.description: Resin secreted from the roots of the Great tree. Material used in crafting items. The roots of the Great tree drive far and wide through the earth of the Lands Between. They were once entwined with the roots of the Erdtree, or so they say.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:root-resin.location: Can easily be farmed from the Warmaster's Shack

item:roped-fetid-pot.name: Roped Fetid Pot
item:roped-fetid-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of effluents is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of deadly poison. Beware though; those who carry these pots will slowly accumulate poison in their own bodies. Push someone in a privy; expect to get dung on your hands.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of deadly poison

item:roped-fetid-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Gold-Tinged Excrement x1, String x1

item:roped-fire-pot.name: Roped Fire Pot
item:roped-fire-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to inflict fire damage.

item:roped-fire-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Smoldering Butterfly x1, String x1

item:roped-fly-pot.name: Roped Fly Pot
item:roped-fly-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of effluents is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to release a swarm of bloodflies. Their fangs inflict countless painful lacerations on the victim while the grating sound of their wings assails their sanity. The maggots found in waste feed on blood and turn into vicious flies that are pitiably short-lived.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to release a swarm of bloodflies

item:roped-freezing-pot.name: Roped Freezing Pot
item:roped-freezing-pot.description:
Craftable with a cracked pot. Frost has been sealed inside. A short rope that aids throwing is attached. Thrown at rearward enemies using the rope,
the pot explodes, causing frostbite buildup
in enemies.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to cause frostbite build-up

item:roped-frenzied-flame-pot.name: Roped Frenzied Flame Pot
item:roped-frenzied-flame-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of Frenzied Flame materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of madness. The flame of frenzy burns the eyes, but tranquility follows in its wake. May this pot bring salvation to those it strikes.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of madness

item:roped-holy-water-pot.name: Roped Holy Water Pot
item:roped-holy-water-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw behind to inflict holy damage

item:roped-holy-water-pot.location: - Can be crafted after purchasing the Missionary's Cookbook [1] from Merchant Kalé for 1000 runes at the Church of Elleh.

item:roped-lightning-pot.name: Roped Lightning Pot
item:roped-lightning-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of fulminating materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to inflict lightning damage.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to inflict lightning damage

item:roped-magic-pot.name: Roped Magic Pot
item:roped-magic-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of magically resonant materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Consumes FP. Throw at rearward enemies to inflict magic damage.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw behind to inflict magic damage.

item:roped-oil-pot.name: Roped Oil Pot
item:roped-oil-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of oil-infused materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to soak them in oil, making them heavily susceptible to fire damage.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to douse enemies in oil

item:roped-oil-pot.location: Craftable — Melted Mushroom x1, String x1

item:roped-poison-pot.name: Roped Poison Pot
item:roped-poison-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of poisonous materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of poison.

stats.Effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of poison

item:roped-poison-pot.location: Craftable — Toxic Mushroom x1, Poisonbloom x1, String x1

item:roped-volcano-pot.name: Roped Volcano Pot
item:roped-volcano-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Powdered volcanic rock is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Thrown at rearward enemies to disperse a cloud of heat, dealing continuous damage to those caught inside for a short duration.

stats.Effect: Creates heat cloud, causing continuous fire damage

item:rosus-axe.name: Rosus' Axe
item:rosus-axe.description: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need i of a guiding hand.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:rosus-axe.location: To get Rosus' Axe, travel to the Black Knife Catacombs in northeast Liurnia of the Lakes, use a Stonesword Key on the imp statue fog door near the entrance, and loot the weapon inside the room.

item:rot-grease.name: Rot Grease
item:rot-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of rotten materials.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot

item:rot-pot.name: Rot Pot
item:rot-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Decorated with the crest of scarlet wings. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot. The rot bubbles up from the Swamp of Aeonia, and eats away at life like a vicious plague.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot.

item:rotbone-arrow.name: Rotbone Arrow
item:rotbone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow with rot-coated tip
item:rotbone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Animal bone arrow with rot-coated tip

item:rotbone-arrow-fletched.name: Rotbone Arrow (Fletched)
item:rotbone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched bone arrow with rot-coated tip
item:rotbone-arrow-fletched.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Fletched bone arrow with rot-coated tip

item:rotbone-bolt.name: Rotbone Bolt
item:rotbone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt with rot-coated tip

stats.Effect: Animal bone bolt with rot-coated tip

item:rotted-wing.name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
item:rotted-wing.description: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold, snapped in half.

stats.Effect: Snapped intricate needle of unalloyed gold

related: Meet Gowry at his shack in Sellia

item:rotten-battle-hammer.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
item:rotten-battle-hammer.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike. Skill: Braggart's Roar Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.
item:rotten-battle-hammer.location: To get the Rotten Battle Hammer in Elden Ring, you must travel to the Concerated Snowfield and defeat the Rotten Duelist boss.

item:rotten-breath.name: Rotten Breath
item:rotten-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

stats.Effect: Channels dragon to spew scarlet rot breath

item:rotten-breath.location: Bought at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion with a dragon heart.

item:rotten-butterflies.name: Rotten Butterflies
item:rotten-butterflies.description: Incantation used by Romina, Saint of the Bud. Summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle twirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction. The scarlet butterflies are as the Goddess of Rot's wings. Bereft of a master, they were soothed by Romina, who reached out to them.

stats.Effect: Summons countless butterflies to scatter rot

related: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

item:rotten-crystal-spear.name: Rotten Crystal Spear
item:rotten-crystal-spear.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E

item:rotten-crystal-spear.location: The Rotten Crystal Spear is obtained as a random drop from lesser Crystalian enemies in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, specifically near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.

item:rotten-crystal-staff.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
item:rotten-crystal-staff.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.
item:rotten-crystal-staff.location: To get the Rotten Crystal Staff, you must farm the Lesser Crystalian mage located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:rotten-crystal-sword.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
item:rotten-crystal-sword.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:rotten-crystal-sword.location: To get the Rotten Crystal Sword in Elden Ring, travel to Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, locate the chest guarded by three Crystalian enemies near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, and loot it.

item:rotten-duelist-greaves.name: Rotten Duelist Greaves
item:rotten-duelist-greaves.description: Greaves wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 7 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 6

item:rotten-duelist-greaves.location: Dropped by the Rotten Duelist enemy located north west of Ordina, Liturgical Town in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:rotten-duelist-helm.name: Rotten Duelist Helm
item:rotten-duelist-helm.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:rotten-duelist-helm.location: Duelist enemy located north west of the Consecrated Snowfield

item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.description: Thick, bristly cloak eaten through by scarlet rot. The symbol of an underground gravekeeper's station.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.location: Dropped by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak-altered.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
item:rotten-gravekeeper-cloak-altered.description: Lighter version of the Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 8 · Fire 8 · Lightning 10 · Holy 8

item:rotten-greataxe.name: Rotten Greataxe
item:rotten-greataxe.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
item:rotten-greataxe.location: To get the Rotten Greataxe in Elden Ring, travel to the Consecrated Snowfield, locate the Rotten Duelist northwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town, and defeat him.

item:rotten-staff.name: Rotten Staff
item:rotten-staff.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
item:rotten-staff.location: To get the Rotten Staff in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Putrid Avatar boss located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

item:rotten-stray-ashes.name: Rotten Stray Ashes
item:rotten-stray-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a rotten stray. Spirit of a stray dog corrupted by the scarlet rot. Through it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble, and its fangs fester with poisonous rot

stats.Effect: Summon rotten stray spirit

item:rotten-winged-sword-insignia.name: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia
item:rotten-winged-sword-insignia.description: Greatly raises attack power with successive attacks
item:rotten-winged-sword-insignia.location: - Obtained from Millicent after choosing to assist her in defeating her sisters, as part of her questline.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises attack power with successive attacks

item:round-shield.name: Round Shield
item:round-shield.description: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.
item:round-shield.location: - Bought for 1000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them his Bell Bearing.

item:roundrock.name: Roundrock
item:roundrock.description: Round piece of rock shaped by the water's current. Can be used for crafting, or simply for throwing at enemies. Found on the ground at places like river banks. It breaks easily, owing to extensive cracking.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rowa-fruit.name: Rowa Fruit
item:rowa-fruit.description: Berry-like red fruits that grow in shrubs. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the Lands Between, it is primarily used in preserved foods.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:rowa-fruit.location: An early farming point is at The First Step

stats.Effect: On horseback, feed to spectral steed to restore HP

item:royal-greatsword.name: Royal Greatsword
item:royal-greatsword.description: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int D

item:royal-greatsword.location: To get the Royal Greatsword, you must complete the extensive questline for Ranni the Witch.

item:royal-knight-armor.name: Royal Knight Armor
item:royal-knight-armor.description: Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

stats.Negation: Physical 16 · Strike 14 · Slash 17 · Pierce 16 · Magic 14 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:royal-knight-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-armor-altered.name: Royal Knight Armor (altered)
item:royal-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Royal Knight Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

stats.Negation: Physical 15 · Strike 14 · Slash 17 · Pierce 16 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:royal-knight-gauntlets.name: Royal Knight Gauntlets
item:royal-knight-gauntlets.description: Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:royal-knight-gauntlets.location: - Royal Knight Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-greaves.name: Royal Knight Greaves
item:royal-knight-greaves.description: Silver greaves of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 9 · Magic 8 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:royal-knight-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-helm.name: Royal Knight Helm
item:royal-knight-helm.description: Silver helm of Loretta, a Knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:royal-knight-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

item:royal-knight-s-resolve.name: Royal Knight's Resolve
item:royal-knight-s-resolve.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Royal Knight's Resolve: Skill of the knights who once served the Elden Lord. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, greatly powering up your next attack."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: ash

item:royal-magic-grease.name: Royal Magic Grease
item:royal-magic-grease.description: Solidified knotgrease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding heavy magic damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time. Believed to have once been bestowed upon low-ranking Carian knights in lieu of the fellowship's characteristic swords.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting heavy magic damage

item:royal-remains-armor.name: Royal Remains Armor
item:royal-remains-armor.description: Armory graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:royal-remains-gauntlets.name: Royal Remains Gauntlets
item:royal-remains-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 1 · Holy 2

item:royal-remains-greaves.name: Royal Remains Greaves
item:royal-remains-greaves.description: Greaves graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:royal-remains-helm.name: Royal Remains Helm
item:royal-remains-helm.description: Helm graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 3

item:ruin-fragment.name: Ruin Fragment
item:ruin-fragment.description: Stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky. Can be used for crafting, or simply for throwing at enemies. These shards of stone are believed to have once been part of a temple in the sky. They glow with a faint light from within.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items.

item:ruins-greatsword.name: Ruins Greatsword
item:ruins-greatsword.description: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbords its destructive power.
item:ruins-greatsword.location: Drop from Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight duo

item:ruins-map.name: Ruins Map
item:ruins-map.description: A simple old map, faded and dirty. Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest. Indicates the location of a hallowed ruin. "I only wish to be of service."

stats.Effect:
Map indicating the location of a hallowed ruin
Examine using

item:ruins-map-2nd.name: Ruins Map (2nd)
item:ruins-map-2nd.description: A simple old map, faded and dirty. Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest. Indicates another hallowed ruin, apart from the one shown on the first map. "May the gleaming stars guide you evermore."

stats.Effect:
Map indicating the location of a hallowed ruin
Examine using

item:ruins-map-3rd.name: Ruins Map (3rd)
item:ruins-map-3rd.description: A simple old map, faded and dirty. Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest. Indicates a third and final hallowed ruin, distinct from those shown on the first two maps. "May you join the glimmering stars above."

stats.Effect:
Map indicating the location of a hallowed ruin
Examine using

item:ruler-s-mask.name: Ruler's Mask
item:ruler-s-mask.description: Mask in the image of a wizened sage. Customary dress among lords in a smaller nation. Increases faith. Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality. One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:ruler-s-robe.name: Ruler's Robe
item:ruler-s-robe.description: Luxurious robe worn by lords in a smaller nation. Its fine blue mantle serves to prove its wearer's status.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:rune-arc.name: Rune Arc
item:rune-arc.description: A shard of the shattered Elden Ring.

stats.Effect: Grants the blessing of an equipped rune upon use

item:rune-arc.location: Earthbore Cave and the Beside the Rampart Gaol

item:rune-of-an-unsung-hero.name: Rune of an Unsung Hero
item:rune-of-an-unsung-hero.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon heroes who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 50000 runes. The great heroes of the war were richly blessed by the grace of the Erdtree, but were not honored in death.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 50000 runes

item:ruptured-crystal-tear.name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
item:ruptured-crystal-tear.description: A special crystallization formed within a tear of life over the course of many moons. Causes concoction to explode when taken in mixed physick. A dangerous form of crystal tear which possesses absolutely no medicinal qualities. A lesson said to be learned the hard way for some; faith can be a volatile matter, after all.

stats.Effect: Causes concoction to explode in mixed physick

item:ruptured-crystal-tear.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar in Liurnia of the Lakes and the Putrid Avatar at the Consecrated Snowfield Minor Erdtree.

item:rusted-anchor.name: Rusted Anchor
item:rusted-anchor.description: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. While the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Kird, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.
item:rusted-anchor.location: To get the Rusted Anchor in Elden Ring, travel to the Morne Tunnel in the Weeping Peninsula.

stats.Effect: Opens a locked door in Stormveil Castle

item:ryas-necklace.name: Rya's Necklace
item:ryas-necklace.description: A necklace worn and treasured by Irina. Given to her as a farewell gift.

stats.Effect: Necklace worn everywhere by Irina

item:ryas-necklace.location: Boilprawn Shack, Liurnia of the Lakes

item:rykard-great-rune.name: Rykard's Great Rune
item:rykard-great-rune.description: A Great Rune of the shardbearer Rykard. Its blessing restores HP upon defeating enemies. Rykard was amongst the children of Rennala and Radagon, who became demigod stepchildren after Radagon's union with Queen Marika. But Rykard fed himself to the blasphemous serpent, Great Rune and all.

stats.Effect: Restores HP upon defeating enemies

item:rykard-great-rune.location: Lord of Blasphemy near the Audience Pathway

item:rykard-s-rancor.name: Rykard's Rancor
item:rykard-s-rancor.description: The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

stats.Effect: Releases searing spirits that repeatedly explode after delay

item:sacramental-bud.name: Sacramental Bud
item:sacramental-bud.description: An immature bud containing fresh blood. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sacred-blade.name: Sacred Blade
item:sacred-blade.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Sacred Blade: Grants armament's attacks holy essence and fires off a golden blade projectile. The armament retains its holy essence for awhile."Usable on all melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:sacred-bloody-flesh.name: Sacred Bloody Flesh
item:sacred-bloody-flesh.description: Raw meat soaked with blood. A delicacy of the bloodfiends. Temporarily boosts physical attack power and arcane. When blood loss occurs nearby, further boosts attack power. The blood is said to have fallen from the Formless Mother's wound. Never will it dry, never will it rot.

stats.Effect: Boosts physical attack power and arcane once. Attack power boosted further when blood loss occurs.

item:sacred-crown-helm.name: Sacred Crown Helm
item:sacred-crown-helm.description: Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Who is it that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:sacred-crown-helm.location: Chance to drop from Haligtree Foot Soldier enemies.

item:sacred-order.name: Sacred Order
item:sacred-order.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Sacred Order: Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Perform a salute and grant the armament holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:sacred-order-pot.name: Sacred Order Pot
item:sacred-order-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy holy damage. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death, even preventing them from rising again. The Golden Order has no mercy for those who trespass beyond life's bounds.

stats.Effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy holy damage.

item:sacred-order-pot.location: Can be crafted after acquiring the Missionary's Cookbook [5] from Siofra Aqueduct, in the offshoot tower guarded by a greatsword-wielding Crucible Knight.

item:sacred-relic-sword.name: Sacred Relic Sword
item:sacred-relic-sword.description: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal. Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:sacred-ring-of-light.name: Sacred Ring of Light
item:sacred-ring-of-light.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Sacred Ring of Light: Skill used by the commanders of the Cleanrot Knights. Gather a sacred ring of light in the armament, and then fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:sacred-scorpion-charm.name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
item:sacred-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart with a blessed glow.

stats.Effect: Raises holy attack, but lowers damage negation.

item:sacred-scorpion-charm.location: - Obtained by defeating Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, who invades the player near the Smoldering Church in northwestern Caelid.

item:sacred-tear.name: Sacred Tear
item:sacred-tear.description: Blessing of the Erdtree, worshiped in the churches of all lands; this

stats.Effect: Improves Sacred Flask's potency

item:sacrificial-axe.name: Sacrificial Axe
item:sacrificial-axe.description: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.
item:sacrificial-axe.location: To get the Sacrificial Axe in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Deathbird boss located in the Weeping Peninsula at nighttime.

item:sacrificial-twig.name: Sacrificial Twig
item:sacrificial-twig.description: A talisman fashioned from a dried twig, so slender that it might snap at the slightest touch.

stats.Effect: Will be lost on death in place of runes.

item:sage-hood.name: Sage Hood
item:sage-hood.description: A burgundy pointed hood. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:sage-robe.name: Sage Robe
item:sage-robe.description: Thick burgundy robe. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:sage-robe.location: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:sage-trousers.name: Sage Trousers
item:sage-trousers.description: Thick burgundy trousers. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 1 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:sage-trousers.location: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:salza-s-hood.name: Salza's Hood
item:salza-s-hood.description: Hood of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights. A prodigious amount of cloth wound around it, giving the impression of a greatly swollen head, and wearing it increases intelligence. A disciple of the elder Wego, he refused to burn down an old ruin, at the risk of his own life.

item:sanctified-whetblade.name: Sanctified Whetblade
item:sanctified-whetblade.description: Sanctified whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife. When applying an affinity using physical or golden-type ashes of war, an additional affinity of sacred or lightning can be chosen.

stats.Effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon.

related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:sanctuary-stone.name: Sanctuary Stone
item:sanctuary-stone.description: A rare piece of stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sanguine-amaryllis.name: Sanguine Amaryllis
item:sanguine-amaryllis.description: A bloodflower with meaty petals. Material used for crafting items. Grown by bloodfiends in pools of blood. Perhaps even the fiends admire blood's beauty.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sanguine-amaryllis.location: Grown by bloodfiends in pools of blood

item:sanguine-noble-hood.name: Sanguine Noble Hood
item:sanguine-noble-hood.description: Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.
item:sanguine-noble-hood.location: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble (invader), near the white trees northwest of Consecrated Snowfield. He guards a Sending Gate that leads to the Mohgwyn Palace.

item:sanguine-noble-robe.name: Sanguine Noble Robe
item:sanguine-noble-robe.description: Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 13 · Fire 11 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:sanguine-noble-robe.location: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees in the northwestern Consecrated Snowfield.

item:sanguine-noble-waistcloth.name: Sanguine Noble Waistcloth
item:sanguine-noble-waistcloth.location: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees northwest of Consecrated Snowfield.

item:savage-claws.name: Savage Claws
item:savage-claws.description: Skill: Savage Claws Pounce like a beast to viciously slash into foe with left and right claws.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:savage-lion-s-claw.name: Savage Lion's Claw
item:savage-lion-s-claw.description: Skill: Savage Lion's Claw Skill of the particularly brave, even among the Redmanes. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament. An additional strike may be performed with an additional input.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:scale-armor.name: Scale Armor
item:scale-armor.description: Armor reinforced with small metal scales. The cape covering the shoulders is made with treated rock lizard skin, and provides ample protection against fire.

stats.Negation: Physical 11 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 10 · Lightning 6 · Holy 8

item:scale-armor.location: - Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

item:scaled-armor.name: Scaled Armor
item:scaled-armor.description: Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks.

stats.Negation: Physical 16 · Strike 14 · Slash 17 · Pierce 16 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:scaled-armor.location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

item:scaled-armor-altered.name: Scaled Armor (altered)
item:scaled-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Scaled Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 15 · Strike 13 · Slash 16 · Pierce 15 · Magic 12 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:scaled-gauntlets.name: Scaled Gauntlets
item:scaled-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:scaled-gauntlets.location: - The Scaled Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Old Knight Istvan as part of the Volcano Manor questline.

item:scaled-greaves.name: Scaled Greaves
item:scaled-greaves.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 8 · Slash 10 · Pierce 9 · Magic 7 · Fire 7 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:scaled-greaves.location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

item:scaled-helm.name: Scaled Helm
item:scaled-helm.description: Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:scaled-helm.location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

item:scarlet-aeonia.name: Scarlet Aeonia
item:scarlet-aeonia.description: Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot.

stats.Effect: Creates a giant flower that explodes with scarlet rot.

item:scarlet-bud.name: Scarlet Bud
item:scarlet-bud.description: A large, rotten bud that will never come into bloom. Material used for crafting items. Grows in lands blighted by the scarlet rot. There was a time when these buds were not touched by the scarlet rot's blight—when they were the symbol of the small church deep in the ancient ruins of Rauh.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:scarlet-bud.location: Grows in lands blighted by the scarlet rot

item:scarlet-tabard.name: Scarlet Tabard
item:scarlet-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot. Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 9 · Slash 8 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 11 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:scarlet-tabard.location: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

item:scattershot-throw.name: Scattershot Throw
item:scattershot-throw.description: Skill: Scattershot Throw Employ smithing arts to conjure multiple copies of the armament in both hands and throw them all at once. Follow up with an additional input to throw again.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:scavenger-s-curved-sword.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
item:scavenger-s-curved-sword.description: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.
item:scavenger-s-curved-sword.location: To get the Scavenger's Curved Sword in Elden Ring, head to the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir.

item:scepter-of-the-all-knowing.name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
item:scepter-of-the-all-knowing.description: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All- Knowing's hand grasps for it.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:scepter-of-the-all-knowing.location: You can get the Scepter of the All-Knowing by defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

item:scholar-s-armament.name: Scholar's Armament
item:scholar-s-armament.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with magic damage

item:scholar-s-shield.name: Scholar's Shield
item:scholar-s-shield.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Enhances left-handed shield damage negation

item:scimitar.name: Scimitar
item:scimitar.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.
item:scimitar.location: You can get the Scimitar in Elden Ring by purchasing it from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, choosing the Warrior starting class, or farming it from skeleton enemies.

item:scorpion-kite-shield.name: Scorpion Kite Shield
item:scorpion-kite-shield.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.
item:scorpion-kite-shield.location: Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge

item:scorpion-liver.name: Scorpion Liver
item:scorpion-liver.description: Fresh organ of a spider-scorpion. It is referred to as 'liver,' but no one is quite sure of its purpose. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting spider-scorpions. A delicacy known for its numbing toxins.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:scorpion-s-stinger.name: Scorpion's Stinger
item:scorpion-s-stinger.description: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.
item:scorpion-s-stinger.location: To get the Scorpion's Stinger dagger, head to the Grand Cloister in the Lake of Rot.

item:scorpion-stew.name: Scorpion Stew
item:scorpion-stew.description: Scorpion simmered in a black soup. Traditional meal of the hornsent. Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores HP. Once made with love by a certain elderly woman for the family table. Having long gone cold, this soup gives off a rank, sour smell.

stats.Effect: Boosts physical damage negation temporarily and gradually restores HP

item:scouring-black-flame.name: Scouring Black Flame
item:scouring-black-flame.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles. Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range. The black flame could once slay gods. But when Maliketh sealed Destined Death, the true power of the black flame was lost.

stats.Effect: Sweeps area before caster with black flame

item:scouring-black-flame.location: Godskin Prayerbook, found at the Roundtable Hold.

item:scriptstone.name: Scriptstone
item:scriptstone.description: Ruin fragment inscribed with letters. Craftable item. Reveals additional messages from other worlds. Words are gregarious things, drawn to one another much as people are.

stats.Effect: Reveals more messages from other worlds

item:scriptstone.location: Craftable — Ruin Fragment x1, Human Bone Shard x1

item:scripture-wooden-shield.name: Scripture Wooden Shield
item:scripture-wooden-shield.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

item:scroll-academy.name: Academy Scroll
item:scroll-academy.description: Scroll of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, the glintstone sorcerers' place of study.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned sorcerer to acquire new sorceries
Give to Sorceress Sellen to unlock Glintstone Cometshard and Star Shower

item:scroll-royal-house.name: Royal House Scroll
item:scroll-royal-house.description: Sorcery scroll of the Carian royal family, the heads of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Give to a learned sorcerer to acquire new sorceries

item:scythe.name: Scythe
item:scythe.description: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard. In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.
item:scythe.location: To get the standard Scythe in Elden Ring, head to the Cliffbottom Catacombs in the southeastern region of Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:secret-rite-scroll.name: Secret Rite Scroll
item:secret-rite-scroll.description:
A scroll made of white tree bark. Few can decipher the scroll, which describes the secret rite of the divine gateway said to be found at the tower enshrouded by shadow. "A lord will usher in a god's return,
and the lord's soul will require a vessel."

stats.Effect: Learn about the secret rite of the divine gateway

item:seedbed-curse.name: Seedbed Curse
item:seedbed-curse.description: Curse grown on a corpse killed and defiled by the Dung Eater. A tender pox afflicted with omen horns.

stats.Effect: Curse grown on a body defiled by a Dung Eater

related: Dung Eater — defeated at the Leyndell moat
Give him the Seedbed Curses for the Mending Rune

item:sellen-s-bell-bearing.name: Sellen's Bell Bearing
item:sellen-s-bell-bearing.description: Sorceress Sellen's bell bearing, found upon her perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:sellia-s-secret.name: Sellia's Secret
item:sellia-s-secret.description:
Note given by Sage Gowry detailing the secret he promised. The Town of Sellia
hides the source. Light three flames
atop the candle towers
to break the seal.

stats.Effect:
A piece of paper given by Sage Gowry
Examine using
Can be given to a learned sorcerer to acquire new sorceries

item:sellian-sealbreaker.name: Sellian Sealbreaker
item:sellian-sealbreaker.description: Glintstone key received from the sorceress Sellen. Capable of breaking the seal that keeps Master Lusat confined. Sellia, Town of Sorcery can be found in Caelid. This key was said to have been found in the possession of a Sellian sorcerer.

stats.Effect: Can release Master Lusat from his confinement

item:seluvis-s-bell-bearing.name: Seluvis's Bell Bearing
item:seluvis-s-bell-bearing.description: Preceptor Seluvis's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:seluvis-s-introduction.name: Seluvis's Introduction
item:seluvis-s-introduction.description: Scroll bearing a royal coat of arms.

stats.Effect: Letter of introduction addressed to Sellen

item:seluvis-s-introduction.location: Seluvis's Rise, Liurnia of the Lakes

item:seluvis-s-potion.name: Seluvis's Potion
item:seluvis-s-potion.description: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis containing a cloudy tonic of bluish black.

stats.Effect: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis

item:seluvis-s-potion.location: Seluvis's Rise, Liurnia of the Lakes

item:sentry-s-torch.name: Sentry's Torch
item:sentry-s-torch.description: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:sentry-s-torch.location: To get the Sentry's Torch in Elden Ring, purchase it from the Hermit Merchant in the Altus Plateau for 7,000 Runes.

item:seppuku.name: Seppuku
item:seppuku.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood and the following skill:"Seppuku: A forbidden technique used by swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Plunge the blade into your stomach to stain it with blood. Increases attack power and improves ability to inflict blood loss."Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (small and colossal weapons excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:serpent-amnion.name: Serpent's Amnion
item:serpent-amnion.description: Amnion from the mother's womb which cradled the poor unwanted offspring of a repellant birthing ritual. It will never dry out, remaining damp indefinitely.

stats.Effect: Amnion from a womb that bore unintended offspring

item:serpent-arrow.name: Serpent Arrow
item:serpent-arrow.description: Arrow carved to resemble a flying snake. Used in tandem with the Serpent Bow. Loyal minions of the Formless Serpents, their fangs are daubed with deadly poison.

item:serpent-bow.name: Serpent Bow
item:serpent-bow.description: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc D

item:serpent-bow.location: Serpent Bow can be found by a pool of rot in Abandoned Cave

item:serpent-crest-shield.name: Serpent Crest Shield
item:serpent-crest-shield.description: A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire. Said to have been made to commemorate the beginnings of the crusade started by Messmer, son of Marika.

item:serpent-flail.name: Serpent Flail

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:serpent-flail.location: This weapon can be found in a chest in Fog Rift Fort. The chest is in the fort's courtyard, on the other end from Black Knight Garrew.
item:serpent-flail.description: A flail with coiled snakes for bludgeoning heads. Fire roars within the snakes' bodies, inflicting horrible burns. Some of Messmer's army used these flails to burn hornsent—to brand them with agony and fear.

item:serpent-god-s-curved-sword.name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
item:serpent-god-s-curved-sword.description: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.
item:serpent-god-s-curved-sword.location: To get the Serpent-God's Curved Sword in Elden Ring, travel to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice dungeon in northern Liurnia of the Lakes, navigate up the chasm past the ladders and lifts, and find it on an outdoor ledge guarded by a large Land Octopus.

item:serpent-hunter.name: Serpent-Hunter
item:serpent-hunter.description: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.
item:serpent-hunter.location: To get the Serpent-Hunter, travel to the Audience Pathway Site of Grace in Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir).

item:serpentbone-blade.name: Serpentbone Blade
item:serpentbone-blade.description: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The denely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison
item:serpentbone-blade.location: To get the Serpentbone Blade, complete the second assassination contract given by Tanith at Volcano Manor in the Altus Plateau.

item:sewer-gaol-key.name: Sewer-Gaol Key
item:sewer-gaol-key.description: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.

stats.Effect: Unlocks sewer-gaol door beneath Leyndell

item:sewing-needle.name: Sewing Needle
item:sewing-needle.description: A large sewing needle, curved like a fang. Boc the demi-human's prized possession.

stats.Effect: Boc the demi-human's prized sewing needle

item:shabriri-grape.name: Shabriri Grape
item:shabriri-grape.description: A yellowing, oozing eyeball of the infirm. The surface is shriveled, and the inside is squishy, not unlike a large, overly-ripe grape.

stats.Effect: Yellow, oozing eyeball of the infirm

item:shabriri-s-woe.name: Shabriri's Woe
item:shabriri-s-woe.description: Disturbing likeness of a man whose eyes have been gouged out. The corners of his mouth are upturned in an almost flirtatious manner.

stats.Effect: Constantly attracts enemies' aggression

item:shadow-bait.name: Shadow Bait
item:shadow-bait.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' sewants, who once served as the

stats.Effect: Creates shadow that lures the aggression of foes of human build

item:shadow-militiaman-armor.name: Shadow Militiaman Armor
item:shadow-militiaman-armor.description: Armor as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

item:shadow-militiaman-gauntlets.name: Shadow Militiaman Gauntlets
item:shadow-militiaman-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

item:shadow-militiaman-greaves.name: Shadow Militiaman Greaves
item:shadow-militiaman-greaves.description: Greaves as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

item:shadow-militiaman-helm.name: Shadow Militiaman Helm
item:shadow-militiaman-helm.description: Helm as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

item:shadow-realm-blessing.name: Scadutree Fragment
item:shadow-realm-blessing.description: A splinter of the Scadutree that contains golden brilliance. Acquired at the Church of Marika and other places in the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Scadutree Blessing. The Scadutree Blessing bolsters the bearer's ability to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. It is said that when the Scadutree crumbles from its core that it will scatter across the entire realm of shadow. The people of the Erdtree collect the splinters and use them in prayer.

stats.Effect: Bolsters Scadutree Blessing

item:shadow-realm-rune-1.name: Shadow Realm Rune [1]
