item:shadow-realm-rune-1.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 7500 runes. The Scadutree is the shadow of the Erdtree. No wonder grace shines ever so brilliantly.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 7500 runes

item:shadow-realm-rune-2.name: Shadow Realm Rune [2]
item:shadow-realm-rune-2.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 10000 runes. The Scadutree is the shadow of the Erdtree. No wonder grace shines ever so brilliantly.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 10000 runes

item:shadow-realm-rune-3.name: Shadow Realm Rune [3]
item:shadow-realm-rune-3.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 12500 runes. The soldiers who joined the crusade were rewarded with grace aplenty.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 12500 runes

item:shadow-realm-rune-4.name: Shadow Realm Rune [4]
item:shadow-realm-rune-4.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 15000 runes. The soldiers who joined the crusade were rewarded with grace aplenty.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 15000 runes

item:shadow-realm-rune-5.name: Shadow Realm Rune [5]
item:shadow-realm-rune-5.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 17500 runes. In a long-forgotten place where none would tread, the light of grace quietly grew ever more brilliant.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 17500 runes

item:shadow-realm-rune-6.name: Shadow Realm Rune [6]
item:shadow-realm-rune-6.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 22500 runes. In a long-forgotten place where none would tread, the light of grace quietly grew ever more brilliant.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 22500 runes

item:shadow-realm-rune-7.name: Shadow Realm Rune [7]
item:shadow-realm-rune-7.description: Golden remnants of the grace bestowed upon those who fell in the realm of shadow. Use to gain 30000 runes. In a long-forgotten place where none would tread, the light of grace quietly grew ever more brilliant.

stats.Effect: Use to gain 30000 runes

item:shadow-sunflower.name: Shadow Sunflower
item:shadow-sunflower.description: A large flower that blooms facing the Scadutree. Material used for crafting items. Found near the Scadutree. These flowers, veiled in shadow and covered in impenetrable thorns, are suffused with profound holiness—much akin to the Scadutree itself.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:shadow-sunflower.location: - Found in places near the Scadutree, like Scadu Altus and Scaduview.

item:shadow-sunflower-blossom.name: Shadow Sunflower Blossom

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:shadow-sunflower-blossom.description: The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might be just a flower, wielded as a weapon. Much like the Scadutree itself in appearance, a second stalk winds tightly around the first, almost as if in a tender embrace.

item:shaman-furs.name: Shaman Furs
item:shaman-furs.description: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 8 · Magic 8 · Fire 7 · Lightning 8 · Holy 6

item:shaman-furs.location: Shaman Furs have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

item:shaman-leggings.name: Shaman Leggings
item:shaman-leggings.description: Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:shaman-leggings.location: Shaman Leggings have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

item:shamshir.name: Shamshir
item:shamshir.description: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.
item:shamshir.location: To get the Shamshir in Elden Ring, travel to the Saintsbridge site of grace in Limgrave, use the spirit spring to drop into the ravine, and find it on a corpse guarded by bats at the bottom of Highroad Cave.

item:shard-of-alexander.name: Shard of Alexander
item:shard-of-alexander.description: Shard of the late Alexander, a shattered warrior jar.

stats.Effect: Greatly boosts the attack power of skills.

item:shard-spiral.name: Shard Spiral
item:shard-spiral.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Fire twin spiraling projectiles

item:shard-spiral.location: Quest Item/ Purchase: Academy of Raya Lucaria

item:shared-order.name: Shared Order
item:shared-order.description: Skill: Shared Order Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Grant the armament and those of nearby allies holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:sharktooth-curved-sword.name: Sharktooth Curved Sword
item:sharktooth-curved-sword.description:
Unique curved sword, notched like a shark's tooth. Stubborn bloodstains cling to the blade, which was
once used to cut the horns from countless Omen.

item:sharp-gravel-stone.name: Sharp Gravel Stone
item:sharp-gravel-stone.description: A particularly sharp piece of gravel stone. Material used for crafting items. Found at the jagged peak on the south coast. The scale of an ancient dragon that has supped on the blood of lesser dragons.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sharp-gravel-stone.location: Found at the jagged peak on the south coast

item:sharpshot-talisman.name: Sharpshot Talisman
item:sharpshot-talisman.description: Boosts attack power of precision-aimed shots
item:sharpshot-talisman.location: - Obtained inside Albinauric's Shack in Scaduview.

stats.Effect: Boosts attack power of precision-aimed shots by 12%

item:shatter-earth.name: Shatter Earth
item:shatter-earth.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a magical shockwave. Allows one follow-up attack. A Stonedigger sorcery used by the glintstone miners of the crystal tunnel. At the academy, use of this sorcery was a stigma that marked out failed scholars.

stats.Effect: Thrust staff into ground to emit a shockwave

item:shattered-stone-talisman.name: Shattered Stone Talisman
item:shattered-stone-talisman.description: Raises potency of kicking and stomping skills

stats.Effect: Raises potency of kicking and stomping skills

item:shattering-crystal.name: Shattering Crystal
item:shattering-crystal.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it in a forward burst. Charging enhances potency. The Crystalians are inorganic beings, yet they live. They cleave close to the ideals of the primeval current, and as such, they are revered guests of the sorcerers.

stats.Effect: Creates crystal mass that shatters in forward burst

item:shattershard-arrow.name: Shattershard Arrow
item:shattershard-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow tipped with crystal shard
item:shattershard-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

item:shattershard-arrow-fletched.name: Shattershard Arrow (Fletched)
item:shattershard-arrow-fletched.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones tipped with a shard of crystal. Creates a resonating noise at the point of impact. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.

item:shield-bash.name: Shield Bash
item:shield-bash.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Shield Bash: Brace behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered."Usable on all shields.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:shield-crash.name: Shield Crash
item:shield-crash.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Shield Crash: Two-hand the shield and charge forwards while maintaining guard. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards and can even be staggered. Hold to extend the duration of the charge forwards."Usable on all shields.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:shield-grease.name: Shield Grease
item:shield-grease.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Boosts guarding ability and all damage negation.

item:shield-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Silver Tear Husk x1, Crystal Bud x1

item:shield-of-night.name: Shield of Night

stats.Skill: Unique Skill: Revenge of the Night

item:shield-of-night.location: Found on a corpse within Bonny Gaol. Before the bridge leading to the drop down to the boss room, there is a jar elevator that leads up to a ledge where the shield can be found inside a broken cell.
item:shield-of-night.description: A shield awarded to Swordhands of Night, cast in a bottomless black from which no light can escape. The outer surface is only semicorporeal, providing reliable defense against attacks that are not physical in nature.

item:shield-of-the-guilty.name: Shield of the Guilty
item:shield-of-the-guilty.description: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands. Venerating the repose of the soul, this shield boosts focus. The briars can be used to attack foes.

item:shield-strike.name: Shield Strike
item:shield-strike.description: Skill: Shield Strike A skill that uses the shield to attack. Repeated inputs allow for up to three follow-up attacks.

item:shining-horned-headband.name: Shining Horned Headband
item:shining-horned-headband.description: Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:shining-horned-headband.location: - The Shining Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

item:short-spear.name: Short Spear
item:short-spear.description: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.
item:short-spear.location: You can get the Short Spear in Elden Ring by purchasing it from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, choosing the Prophet starting class, or farming it from foot soldiers.

item:short-sword.name: Short Sword
item:short-sword.description: A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.
item:short-sword.location: To get the Short Sword in Elden Ring, buy it from the Nomadic Merchant in North Limgrave for 600 Runes, start as the Astrologer class, or farm it from Highwaymen.

item:shortbow.name: Shortbow
item:shortbow.description: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
item:shortbow.location: You can buy the standard Shortbow from the Nomadic Merchant on the West Limgrave beach for 600 Runes, or start the game as the Bandit class.

item:shotel.name: Shotel
item:shotel.description: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.
item:shotel.location: To get the standard Shotel, buy it from the abandoned nomadic merchant near the Worshipper's Woods site of grace in Siofra River Well for 2,500 runes.

item:shriek-of-sorrow.name: Shriek of Sorrow
item:shriek-of-sorrow.description: Skill: Shriek of Sorrow Skill utilized by the downtrodden. Scream, causing nearby enemies to flinch, while also recalling deep-seated resentment, boosting attack power based on the amount of HP remaining. The lower the HP, the greater the effect.

item:siluria-s-tree.name: Siluria's Tree
item:siluria-s-tree.description: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai D

item:siluria-s-tree.location: To get Siluria's Tree in Elden Ring, you must travel to the Deeproot Depths Wiki region, reach the Nameless Eternal City Site of Grace, and defeat the Crucible Knight Siluria boss.

item:silver-firefly.name: Silver Firefly
item:silver-firefly.description: Firefly that gives off a silvery light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of cold water untouched by sunlight. The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Silver light is considered to invite riches.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:silver-firefly.location: Found near cold waters untouched by sunlight

item:silver-grooved-armor.name: Silver Grooved Armor
item:silver-grooved-armor.description: Silver armor whose expert craftsmanship compensates for its weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce its strength as protective gear. The verdant green raiment is given upon receiving the guidance of grace—even if the wearer is but a sapling at present, in time must they grow into ripened gold.

item:silver-grooved-armor-altered.name: Silver Grooved Armor (Altered)
item:silver-grooved-armor-altered.description: Silver armor whose expert craftsmanship compensates for their weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce their strength as protective gear. In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

item:silver-grooved-gauntlets.name: Silver Grooved Gauntlets
item:silver-grooved-gauntlets.description: Silver gauntlets whose expert craftsmanship compensates for their weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce their strength as protective gear. In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

item:silver-grooved-greaves.name: Silver Grooved Greaves
item:silver-grooved-greaves.description: Silver greaves whose expert craftsmanship compensates for their weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce their strength as protective gear. In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

item:silver-grooved-helm.name: Silver Grooved Helm
item:silver-grooved-helm.description: A silver helm whose expert craftsmanship compensates for its weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce its strength as protective gear. In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

item:silver-grooved-shield.name: Silver Grooved Shield
item:silver-grooved-shield.description: A silver shield whose expert craftsmanship compensates for its weight. The elegant grooves render a picturesque scene, recalling the faraway Erdtree's principles. Spread out above shall its many boughs, spread below shall its many roots, till the world entire knows its blessing.
item:silver-grooved-shield.location: North of the Bellum Church site of grace, at a Nomadic Merchant's camp (also the Idus Knight's starting shield).

item:silver-horn-tender.name: Silver Horn Tender
item:silver-horn-tender.description: Old currency used by hornsent made by coating spiral horns with silver. Temporarily boosts item discovery. Can also be sold for a high price. These trinkets were once symbolic of society's upper echelons.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts item discovery

item:silver-mirrorshield.name: Silver Mirrorshield
item:silver-mirrorshield.description: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric.
item:silver-mirrorshield.location: - Found inside the Apostate Derelict, located in Consecrated Snowfield.

item:silver-pickled-fowl-foot.name: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot
item:silver-pickled-fowl-foot.description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a silvery medicinal solution.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts item discovery (+50)

item:silver-pickled-fowl-foot.location: One is found on a ledge behind the starting building in Limgrave (must drop down to get it).

item:silver-scarab.name: Silver Scarab
item:silver-scarab.location: - Obtained from a chest in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, Forbidden Lands. From the large circular platform in the large central room, drop straight down from the broken railing to land on an invisible platform, and walk directly South to a small room. Dispel the illusory wall behind a Grave Glovewort (9) to reveal the chest.

stats.Effect: Raises item discovery

item:silver-tear-husk.name: Silver Tear Husk
item:silver-tear-husk.description: A hardened husk shed by a formless life form known as the Silver Tear, found in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items. The Silver Tear makes mockery of life, reborn again and again into imitation. Perhaps, one day, it will be reborn a lord...

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:silver-tear-husk.location: Found in and around the Eternal City.

item:silver-tear-mask.name: Silver Tear Mask
item:silver-tear-mask.description: Mask fashioned from the corpse of a formless Silver Tear, supported by its hardened, shed husk. Greatly increases arcane to the detriment of physical attack power. To imitate the imitator is a cunning play indeed.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:silver-tear-mask.location: Received upon defeating the Mimic Tear boss in Nokron, Eternal City.

item:sitting-sideways.name: Sitting Sideways
item:sitting-sideways.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:skeletal-bandit-ashes.name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
item:skeletal-bandit-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of a skeletal bandit.

stats.Effect: Summons skeletal bandit spirit

item:skeletal-bandit-ashes.location: Dropped by the Tibia Mariner in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:skeletal-mask.name: Skeletal Mask
item:skeletal-mask.description: Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face. Worn by the assassin's of Ravensmount.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:skeletal-militiaman-ashes.name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
item:skeletal-militiaman-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two skeletal militiamen.

stats.Effect: Summons two skeletal militiaman spirits

item:skeletal-militiaman-ashes.location: - Dropped by the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village.

item:skill-barbaric-roar.name: Skill: Barbaric Roar
item:skill-barbaric-roar.description: Grants a Weapon Buff for 40 seconds upon use, increasing damage by roughly 10%.

item:skill-beast-s-roar.name: Skill: Beast's Roar
item:skill-beast-s-roar.description: Deals another 6 Stance damage at melee range, for 12 Stance damage in total.
item:skill-beast-s-roar.location: - Can be granted to any melee weapon or thrusting shield with the Ash of War: Beast's Roar.

item:skill-blind-spot.name: Skill: Blind Spot
item:skill-blind-spot.description: Instead, the bypass effect comes from attacking at an angle that the blocking doesn't cover.

item:skill-blood-tax.name: Skill: Blood Tax
item:skill-blood-tax.description: Unleash a series of four thrusts that apply blood loss.

item:skill-bloodhound-s-step.name: Skill: Bloodhound's Step
item:skill-bloodhound-s-step.description: Increased travel distance when on light equip load.

item:skill-carian-grandeur.name: Skill: Carian Grandeur
item:skill-carian-grandeur.description: Manifests a spectral greatsword from with 220 Magic base damage that is then used in an overhead slash.

item:skill-cragblade.name: Skill: Cragblade
item:skill-cragblade.description: It also just generally boosts combat performance, without the user having to think much about using it.
item:skill-cragblade.location: - Can be granted to infusable melee weapons of any type (except for Whips) with the Ash of War: Cragblade.

item:skill-double-slash.name: Skill: Double Slash
item:skill-double-slash.description: This means only 29 points of Stamina is needed to use the second input (33 points for larger weapons) and 71 points for the final input (81 points for larger weapons).

item:skill-earthshaker.name: Skill: Earthshaker
item:skill-earthshaker.description: Slam weapon head first into the ground, dealing damage equal to 100% of weapon Attack Power, before causing a shockwave all around the user with 120 base Standard Attack Power.
item:skill-earthshaker.location: - Can be granted to infusable axes, hammers, and spears of great-size and larger as well as Colossal Swords with the Ash of War: Earthshaker.

item:skill-endure.name: Skill: Endure
item:skill-endure.description: Adjustments made in patch 1.07 had a greater impact on the game balance than expected.

item:skill-gravitas.name: Skill: Gravitas
item:skill-gravitas.description: The former causes the same damage type as your weapon while the implosion causes Magic damage.

item:skill-ground-slam.name: Skill: Ground Slam
item:skill-ground-slam.description: For comparison, a Great Hammer's charged heavy attack deals 40 Stance damage and a hammer-type Colossal Weapon's charged heavy attack deals 42 Stance damage.
item:skill-ground-slam.location: Can be granted to infusable melee weapons of any type with the Ash of War: Ground Slam.

item:skill-hoarah-loux-s-earthshaker.name: Skill: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker
item:skill-hoarah-loux-s-earthshaker.description: If all 3 hits land on a single target this means that 1 tier of said attack boost is gained and will be applied to the slam-shockwaves.
item:skill-hoarah-loux-s-earthshaker.location: - Can be granted to infusible melee weapons of any type with Ash of War: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker.

item:skill-impaling-thrust.name: Skill: Impaling Thrust
item:skill-impaling-thrust.description: For a 100% Guard Damage Negation rate only 1-1*0.85=0.15=15% damage will be blocked while a 50% Guarded Damage Negation rate will let 0.5-0.5*0.85=0.075=7.5% damage will be blocked.

item:skill-kick.name: Skill: Kick
item:skill-kick.description: Kicks with one foot, causing an attack with a low 30 base Strike Attack Power, staggering foes, and breaking their guard by dealing 999 damage to the Stamina of guarding opponents.

item:skill-lion-s-claw.name: Skill: Lion's Claw
item:skill-lion-s-claw.description: Quickly ducks down before leaping forwards with a vertical stuff ending in a slam with the weapon, dealing damage equal to 240% of weapon Attack Power.

item:skill-overhead-stance.name: Skill: Overhead Stance
item:skill-overhead-stance.description: The light attack follow-up costs 20 points of Stamina while the heavy attack follow-up costs 20 points of Stamina per attack (60 points in total for all 3 slashes).

item:skill-parry.name: Skill: Parry
item:skill-parry.description: It can also be applied with Ash of War: Parry to compatible shields
item:skill-parry.location: - Parry is a skill that can be found as a default skill on many shields and some daggers. It can also be applied with Ash of War: Parry to compatible shields

item:skill-piercing-fang.name: Skill: Piercing Fang
item:skill-piercing-fang.description: This is the same amount of Stance damage as a one-handed charged heavy attack for that weapon type.

item:skill-piercing-throw.name: Skill: Piercing Throw
item:skill-piercing-throw.description: Rear back and then throw a blade with 175% Attack Power that penetrates through enemies.

item:skill-quickstep.name: Skill: Quickstep
item:skill-quickstep.description: The Player Character dashes quickly in any direction.

item:skill-raging-beast.name: Skill: Raging Beast
item:skill-raging-beast.description: Using the heavy attack follow-up costs 10 points of Stamina for the spin and then 20 points for the slam (30 points of Stamina in total for the follow-up, or 45 points for the entire skill).
item:skill-raging-beast.location: - Can be granted to Beast Claws Shadow of the Erdtree with the Ash of War: Raging Beast Shadow of the Erdtree.

item:skill-raptor-of-the-mists.name: Skill: Raptor of the Mists
item:skill-raptor-of-the-mists.description: The crouch itself doesn't cost any FP.
item:skill-raptor-of-the-mists.location: - Can be granted to any infusable melee weapon or thrusting shield with the Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.

item:skill-repeating-thrust.name: Skill: Repeating Thrust
item:skill-repeating-thrust.description: Reduced the delay between the end of various actions (such as using items or attack animations) and being able to perform the skill.

item:skill-sacred-blade.name: Skill: Sacred Blade
item:skill-sacred-blade.description: Sweeps the weapon forward, launching a wave of Holy light.

item:skill-savage-claws.name: Skill: Savage Claws
item:skill-savage-claws.description: Bloodflame Blade, meanwhile, will always deal its full effect 40 Blood Loss build-up per hit.

item:skill-savage-lion-s-claw.name: Skill: Savage Lion's Claw
item:skill-savage-lion-s-claw.description: The follow-up spin costs 20 points of Stamina to make the mid-air flip and then another 30 points of Stamina for the final slam.
item:skill-savage-lion-s-claw.location: - Can be granted to infusable swords, axes, and hammers (except for Daggers, Thrusting Swords, or Heavy Thrusting Swords) with the Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw Shadow of the Erdtree.

item:skill-scattershot-throw.name: Skill: Scattershot Throw
item:skill-scattershot-throw.description: verification needed - This equals 9.6 Stance damage if all projectiles land, or 14.4 Stance damage with all hits.

item:skill-shield-crash.name: Skill: Shield Crash
item:skill-shield-crash.location: - Can be granted to any infusable shield with the Ash of War: Shield Crash.

item:skill-spinning-gravity-thrust.name: Skill: Spinning Gravity Thrust
item:skill-spinning-gravity-thrust.description: This means that the first part of the skill has 295% Status Effect build-up and the follow-up has 230% build-up, totaling 525% Status Effect build-up while the total Attack Power is only roughly 471%.

item:skill-spinning-slash.name: Skill: Spinning Slash
item:skill-spinning-slash.description: It comes in two different variants carrying the same name, one is generic, is available as an Ash of War and is native to many different weapons (particularly among Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Twinblades, Halberds and Reapers). While the other variant, despite sharing the exact same name, has unique, additional Ice Lightning properties and only exists on one weapon, the Dragon Halberd. |-| Normal=

item:skill-stamp-sweep.name: Skill: Stamp (Sweep)
item:skill-stamp-sweep.description: when the animation for the heavy attack follow-up begins.
item:skill-stamp-sweep.location: - Can be granted to infusable swords, axes, and hammers (except for swords smaller than Greatswords) with the Ash of War: Stamp (Sweep).

item:skill-stamp-upward-cut.name: Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut)
item:skill-stamp-upward-cut.description: when the animation for the heavy attack follow-up begins.

item:skill-swift-slash.name: Skill: Swift Slash
item:skill-swift-slash.description: Charging the skill increases the cost to 50 points.

item:skill-sword-dance.name: Skill: Sword Dance
item:skill-sword-dance.description: Twinblades also use the slower variant of the skill, despite having the same damage multipliers as smaller weapons.
item:skill-sword-dance.location: Can be granted to Swords, Axes, and Polearms capable of making slashing attacks (except for Colossal Swords) with the Ash of War: Sword Dance.

item:skill-troll-s-roar.name: Skill: Troll's Roar
item:skill-troll-s-roar.description: Slowly step forward and let loose a roar with 195 base Strike Attack Power (155 base Standard Attack Power for targets further out) to hit enemies around you.

item:skill-unsheathe.name: Skill: Unsheathe
item:skill-unsheathe.description: The light attack follow-up costs 24 points of Stamina while the heavy attack follow-up costs 40 points of Stamina.

item:skill-war-cry.name: Skill: War Cry
item:skill-war-cry.description: The cost for the changed heavy attack depends on the weapon's type, whether or not the attack is charged, and whether or not the weapon is being two-handed or not: 20-40 points for one-handed reguar heavy attacks (24-48 points if two-handed) and 35-55 points for one-handed charged heavy attacks (40-66 points if two-handed).

item:skill-wild-strikes.name: Skill: Wild Strikes
item:skill-wild-strikes.description: User Poise will also constantly reset, making the user fairly difficult to stagger out of the skill.

item:sky-shot.name: Sky Shot
item:sky-shot.description: Skill: Sky Shot Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow, then fire an arrow high up into the air, arcing so as to strike the enemy from above when it comes down.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:sleep-pot.name: Sleep Pot
item:sleep-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Filled with the incantations of St. Trina. Consumes FP. Throw at enemy to release a purple, soporific haze. Like a lullaby, or a quagmire, it irresistibly draws its victims down into sleep. Sweet dreams.

stats.Effect: Emits a Soporific purple haze

item:sleep-pot.location: Craftable — Mushroom x1, Trina's Lily x1

item:sleepbone-arrow.name: Sleepbone Arrow
item:sleepbone-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow with waterlily tincture tip
item:sleepbone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

item:sleepbone-arrow-fletched.name: Sleepbone Arrow (Fletched)
item:sleepbone-arrow-fletched.description: Fletched animal bone arrow with waterlily tincture tip

stats.Effect: Fletched animal bone arrow with waterlily tincture tip

item:sleepbone-bolt.name: Sleepbone Bolt
item:sleepbone-bolt.description: Animal bone bolt with waterlily tincture tip

stats.Effect: Animal bone bolt with waterlily tincture tip

item:sliver-of-meat.name: Sliver of Meat
item:sliver-of-meat.description: A slice of thinly carved beast flesh. Material used for crating items. Found by hunting herbivorous beast. The dried meat toughens the constitution.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:slumbering-egg.name: Slumbering Egg
item:slumbering-egg.description: Owl eggs that will never hatch. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:small-golden-effigy.name: Small Golden Effigy
item:small-golden-effigy.description: Online multiplayer item. Sends a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer to a nearby summoning pool. In cooperative multiplayer, you will be summoned to another world to help defeat the area boss.

stats.Effect: Send co-operative sign to summoning pool

item:small-red-effigy.name: Small Red Effigy
item:small-red-effigy.description: Item for online play. Sends a competitive sign to a nearby summoning pool. In competitive multiplayer, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned.

stats.Effect: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool
Spews magic breath of Glintstone Dragon Smarag from above

item:smithing-stone-1.name: Smithing Stone [1]
item:smithing-stone-1.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A shard found in plenty.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +3.

item:smithing-stone-2.name: Smithing Stone [2]
item:smithing-stone-2.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A large shard found in plenty. Strengthens armaments up to +6. Smithing stone is found throughout the Lands Between, and mining galleries built to excavate it can be found everywhere

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +6.

item:smithing-stone-2.location: Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore

item:smithing-stone-3.name: Smithing Stone [3]
item:smithing-stone-3.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A particularly hard specimen.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +9.

item:smithing-stone-3.location: Sold by Merchant - Liurnia of the Lakes

item:smithing-stone-4.name: Smithing Stone [4]
item:smithing-stone-4.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A large and particularly hard specimen.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +12.

item:smithing-stone-5.name: Smithing Stone [5]
item:smithing-stone-5.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armamemnts. A rare specimen, it is tinged with gold.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +15.

item:smithing-stone-5.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them

item:smithing-stone-6.name: Smithing Stone [6]
item:smithing-stone-6.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A larger rare specimen, it is tinged with gold.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +18.

item:smithing-stone-6.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them.

item:smithing-stone-7.name: Smithing Stone [7]
item:smithing-stone-7.description: Stone used to smith a variey of armaments. Found in a polar region, it is semi-vitrified.

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +21.

item:smithing-stone-7.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them

item:smithing-stone-8.name: Smithing Stone [8]
item:smithing-stone-8.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. Found in a polar region, it is semi-vitrified

stats.Effect: Reinforce armaments up to +24.

item:smithscript-axe.name: Smithscript Axe

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-axe.location: This weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge. Follow the path until you reach a crumbled floor. Jump over the gap and turn left to enter a room with a Golem Smith. The axe is at the far end of the room.
item:smithscript-axe.description: Axe engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack or jumping strong attack to throw the axe. Incompatible with ashes of war that grant skills with an affinity.

item:smithscript-cirque.name: Smithscript Cirque

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-cirque.location: It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.
item:smithscript-cirque.description: Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack to throw the backhand blade, causing it to fly in a curved trajectory. Incompatible with ashes of war that grant skills with an affinity.

item:smithscript-dagger.name: Smithscript Dagger

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-dagger.location: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.
item:smithscript-dagger.description: Dagger engraved with a smithscript. Reduced mass enhances the effects of the smithing arts, allowing this weapon to function as a throwing dagger for all attacks. Once thrown, the dagger instantly reappears in the wielder's hand. Incompatible with ashes of war that grant skills with an affinity.

item:smithscript-greathammer.name: Smithscript Greathammer

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-greathammer.location: The weapon can be found on a corpse at Taylew's Ruined Forge. After first jumping onto the pipe, simply cross over to the opposite side to find the hammer.
item:smithscript-greathammer.description: Greathammer engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack or dashing strong attack to spin and fling the greathammer. Incompatible with ashes of war that grant skills with an affinity.

item:smithscript-shield.name: Smithscript Shield

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-shield.location: Found on a corpse in Taylew's Ruined Forge. After reaching the top of the pipe at its original position, jump over to the path leading to the lever, but instead climb the rubble in the room past the hallway to reach the shield. It is guarded by a Golem Smith.
item:smithscript-shield.description: Roundshield engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Can be thrown by performing the armament's Skill.

item:smithscript-spear.name: Smithscript Spear

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E · Fai E

item:smithscript-spear.description: Spear engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack, a dashing strong attack, or a mounted strong attack to throw the spear. Incompatible with ashes of war that grant skills with an affinity.

item:smoldering-butterfly.name: Smoldering Butterfly
item:smoldering-butterfly.description: An eternally burning butterfly found near wildfires and elsewhere. Material used for crafting items. Serves as the kindling for a number of items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:smoldering-shield.name: Smoldering Shield
item:smoldering-shield.description: Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava. Resists frost with its heat, and can even be used to deal fire damage if wielded as a weapon.
item:smoldering-shield.location: Looted from a corpse in an low area filled with explosive Living Jars within Volcano Manor.

item:snow-witch-hat.name: Snow Witch Hat
item:snow-witch-hat.description: Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through. Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery. Strengthens cold sorcery. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:snow-witch-robe.name: Snow Witch Robe
item:snow-witch-robe.description: Witch's robe in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:snow-witch-robe.location: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

item:snow-witch-robe-altered.name: Snow Witch Robe (altered)
item:snow-witch-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Snow Witch Robe

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 3 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:soap.description: A plant-based soap made from mushroom juice. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Removes filth and accumulations on the body

item:soft-cotton.name: Soft Cotton
item:soft-cotton.description: A soft but sturdy cotton formed from splitting open Rowa fruit in a particular manner. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Temporarily reduces fall damage and sound

item:soft-cotton.location: Found south-southeast of the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins

item:soiled-loincloth.name: Soiled Loincloth
item:soiled-loincloth.description: This lightly soiled loincloth of ragged cloth does little more than conceal one's nether regions.

item:soldier-s-crossbow.name: Soldier's Crossbow
item:soldier-s-crossbow.description: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
item:soldier-s-crossbow.location: The Soldier's Crossbow is a random drop obtained by defeating specific foot soldiers and exile soldiers who wield it.

item:soldjars-of-fortune-ashes.name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
item:soldjars-of-fortune-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three little living jars. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These reckless spirits sacrifice themselves to vanquish their summoner's foes, and explode upon death. Though their bravery is admirable, their explosions can harm friend as well as foe, and they will also immediately explode on contact with fire. "Tell the others—tell them how brightly a fire jar burns."

stats.Effect: Summons three little living jar spirits

item:soldjars-of-fortune-ashes.location: Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist at the end of Auriza Side Tomb.

stats.Effect: Coats armament, inflicting sleep

item:soporific-grease.location: Craftable — Root Resin x1, Trina's Lily x1

item:sorcerer-leggings.name: Sorcerer Leggings
item:sorcerer-leggings.description: Leggings worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the legs.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 2 · Holy 5

item:sorcerer-leggings.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.

item:sorcerer-manchettes.name: Sorcerer Manchettes
item:sorcerer-manchettes.description: Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.
item:sorcerer-manchettes.location: - The Sorcerer Manchettes have a 1.50% chance to drop from Glintstone Sorcerer enemies.

item:sorcerer-painting.name: "Sorcerer" Painting
item:sorcerer-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Sorcerer." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "Sorcerer"
Examine using

item:spark-aromatic.name: Spark Aromatic
item:spark-aromatic.description: Art of the perfumers who fought In the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to broadly scatter sparks in a wide arc straight ahead. Though fire was prohibited to those who served the Erdtree, this rule was forgotten as the war drew ever on.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to broadly scatter sparks in a wide arc straight ahead

item:spark-aromatic.location: Crafted with the Perfumer's Cookbook [1] from Altus Bloom and Miranda Powder.

item:spear.name: Spear
item:spear.description: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.
item:spear.location: To get a basic Spear in Elden Ring early on, you can either buy a Shortspear from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, or farm one from the Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle.

item:spear-of-the-impaler.name: Spear of the Impaler

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Fai D

item:spear-of-the-impaler.description: Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.

item:spear-talisman.name: Spear Talisman
item:spear-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a spear and a soldier. Enhances the counterattacks that are unique to thrusting weapons.

stats.Effect: Enhances counterattacks unique to thrusting weapons

item:spear-talisman.location: Chest inside the Lakeside Crystal Cave, by a demi-human campfire.

item:speckled-hardtear.name: Speckled Hardtear
item:speckled-hardtear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily raises all resistances and heals all status ailments.

stats.Effect: Boosts resistance and heals status in mixed physick.

item:speckled-hardtear.location: Dropped by the Wormface miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in central Altus Plateau, west of the Woodfolk Ruins.

item:spectral-lance.name: Spectral Lance
item:spectral-lance.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"Spectral Lance: Skill of the headless Mausoleum Knights. Hurl a phantasmic spear at foes."Usable on polearms (reapers excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:spectral-steed-regalia-carian-silve.name: Spectral Steed Regalia: Carian Silver
item:spectral-steed-regalia-carian-silve.description: The richly ornamented white silver armor of the Carian Royal line is a one-of-a-kind item made for a certain spectral steed, once forged in the lands of the Three Sisters. It is through grace that the spectral steed Torrent's appearance may be changed. Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

stats.Effect: Allows grace to alter Torrent's appearance

item:spectral-steed-regalia-funereal-nig.name: Spectral Steed Regalia: Funereal Night
item:spectral-steed-regalia-funereal-nig.description: A smaller version of the sable attire used to adorn and conceal the warhorses of the Night's Cavalry. One of several liveries once prepared for spectral steeds, which allows Torrent, through grace, to change his appearance. Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

stats.Effect: Allows grace to alter Torrent's appearance

item:spectral-steed-regalia-tree-sentine.name: Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel
item:spectral-steed-regalia-tree-sentine.description: A smaller version of the solemn gold armor that adorns the warhorses of the Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree. One of several liveries once prepared for spectral steeds, which allows Torrent, through grace, to change his appearance. Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

stats.Effect: Allows grace to alter Torrent's appearance

item:spectral-steed-whistle.name: Spectral Steed Whistle
item:spectral-steed-whistle.description: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so consumes the Flask of Crimson Tears.

stats.Effect: Summon and ride spectral steed Torrent.

item:spectral-steed-whistle.location: Obtained from Melina after visiting three Sites of Grace and then resting. She will give the player the item after a cutscene and some dialogue.

item:spellblade-s-gloves.name: Spellblade's Gloves

item:spellblade-s-gloves.location: - The Spellblade's Gloves are dropped by Sorcerer Rogier.

This seal can be dispelled by lighting the flame in the southwest candle tower, within the town.

stats.Effect: Greatly boosts magical damage negation

item:spelldrake-talisman-2.name: Spelldrake Talisman +2
item:spelldrake-talisman-2.location: - Obtained from a corpse in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree. From the large circular platform in the large central room, drop straight down from the broken railing to land on an invisible platform. Walk directly north, and then turn directly west, when aligned with an enemy that can be seen in the distance, standing on the invisible platform. At the end of the invisible platform, jump down to the ledge below, on the left, and through one of the open windows. Proceed south to the room with the boss door, and turn right to reach an elevator.
