stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:spellproof-dried-liver.name: Spellproof Dried Liver
item:spellproof-dried-liver.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a blue medicinal

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts magic damage negation

item:spellproof-pickled-liver.name: Spellproof Pickled Liver
item:spellproof-pickled-liver.description: Animal liver pickled in a blue medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily grants large boost to magic damage negation, greatly improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with magic. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

stats.Effect: Temporarily grants large boost to magic damage negation

item:spellproof-pickled-liver.location: - Moore, just outside Belurat, Tower Settlement in the Graveside Plain (x2)

item:spider-scorpion-ashes.name: Spider Scorpion Ashes
item:spider-scorpion-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a spider scorpion. This scorpion is larger than a human, and attacks with pincers and a poisonous tail. Appears some distance from the summoner. This breed of scorpion was native to the realm of shadow, but was far smaller in size. Recent giant scorpions are said to trace back to the Church of the Bud.

stats.Effect: Summons spider scorpion spirit

item:spider-scorpion-ashes.location: Found in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

item:spiked-caestus.name: Spiked Caestus
item:spiked-caestus.description: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.
item:spiked-caestus.location: Get the Spiked Caestus at the Isolated Merchant Shack in northern Caelid.

item:spiked-club.name: Spiked Club
item:spiked-club.description: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.
item:spiked-club.location: The Spiked Club in Elden Ring is acquired by farming large, chief-type Demi-Humans who wield the weapon, featuring a 2% base drop rate.

item:spiked-cracked-tear.name: Spiked Cracked Tear
item:spiked-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Enhances charged attacks for a time in mixed physick

item:spiked-cracked-tear.location: - Found at an altar near Mistwood's Minor Erdtree, along with Greenspill Crystal Tear

item:spiked-palisade-shield.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
item:spiked-palisade-shield.description: Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield"
item:spiked-palisade-shield.location: Looted from a corpse at the feet of a Guardian Golem in the chasm northwest of the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid.

item:spiked-spear.name: Spiked Spear
item:spiked-spear.description: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capaable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss. Weapon of the Marionette Soliders employed by sorcerers.
item:spiked-spear.location: The Spiked Spear in Elden Ring is farmed by defeating Marionette Soldiers who wield spears near the Converted Tower in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:spinning-gravity-thrust.name: Spinning Gravity Thrust
item:spinning-gravity-thrust.description: Skill: Spinning Gravity Thrust A gravity skill honed by the disciples of an Alabaster Lord. Uses gravitational power to hang in the air before rotating the body and charging forward. An additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:spinning-slash.name: Spinning Slash
item:spinning-slash.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Spinning Slash: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."Usable on swords, axes, and polearms (colossal weapons excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:spinning-strikes.name: Spinning Strikes
item:spinning-strikes.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Spinning Strikes: Polearm skill that performs continuous spinning attacks. Hold to continue the attack. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack. Nullifies projectiles such as arrows while spinning."Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:spinning-weapon.name: Spinning Weapon
item:spinning-weapon.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Spinning Weapon: Defensive skill employed by Carian princesses. Lifts armament into mid-air, then makes it spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive attacks."Usable on small and medium swords, axes, and hammers, as well as polearms and staves (great spears excepted)

stats.Effect: ash

item:spira.name: Spira
item:spira.description: Superior sorcery of the tower priests, wielded as an incantation of the spiral. Wrap one's arms together and hold them up to the heavens to summon a spiral of light that erupts at the enemy's feet. Column of light persists for as long as the button is pressed. The spiral is a normalized Crucible current that, one day, will form a column that stretches to the gods.

stats.Effect: Summons a spiral of light that erupts at the enemy's feet

item:spiralhorn-shield.name: Spiralhorn Shield
item:spiralhorn-shield.description: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss. Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.

item:spiraltree-seal.name: Spiraltree Seal
item:spiraltree-seal.location: Reward for solving "The Sacred Tower" Painting puzzle. It can only be solved after using Messmer's Kindling on the Sealing Tree past Romina, Saint of the Bud.
item:spiraltree-seal.description: Sacred seal of soiled amber engraved with a spiral tree design. Enhances spiral incantations. The majesty of the white tower, stretching to reach the gods, even inspired a secret faith in the invaders, the people of the Erdtree.

item:spirit-calculus.name: Spirit Calculus
item:spirit-calculus.description: An exceedingly rare to find calculus, suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting horned beasts in the ancient ruins of Rauh. Has a distinctive acrid odor, which some claim to be a sign of particular spiritual potency.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:spirit-calculus.location: - Dropped by horned beasts in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

item:spirit-calling-bell.name: Spirit Calling Bell
item:spirit-calling-bell.description: A bell capable of summoning various spirits from ashen remains. It usually requires FP to use.

stats.Effect: Bell that summons various spirits from ashen items

item:spirit-calling-bell.location: Location A: Church of Elleh during the night

item:spirit-glaive.name: Spirit Glaive

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:spirit-glaive.location: - In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plain and it will be on a grave.
item:spirit-glaive.description: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A glaive that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.

item:spirit-jellyfish-ashes.name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
item:spirit-jellyfish-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit jellyfish.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit jellyfish.

item:spirit-raisin.name: Spirit Raisin
item:spirit-raisin.description: Preparation of dried Rada fruit. Craftable item. Feed to Torrent while riding to enable the spectral steed to push back enemies when breaking into a gallop. The effect ends after a short time. A bitter medicine traditionally claimed to enhance one's spirituality, but Torrent seems to have a taste for it.

stats.Effect: Spectral steed pushes back enemies when breaking into gallop

item:spirit-sword.name: Spirit Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:spirit-sword.description: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A sword that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.

item:spiritflame-arrow.name: Spiritflame Arrow
item:spiritflame-arrow.description: Arrow set alight with ghostflame before firing. Deals magic damage while also afflicting foes with frost. Used by the Company of the Fallen Hawk, once ordered to explore the Eternal City.

stats.Effect: Arrow imbued with ghostflame, dealing magic damage and causing frost buildup

item:spiritgrave-stone.name: Spiritgrave Stone
item:spiritgrave-stone.description: A piece of a gravestone that has started to turn into a spirit. Material used for crafting items. Mainly found on the Gravesite Plain. In places to where the dead have been brought since antiquity, the oldest gravestones turn into spirits and then fade away.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:spiritgrave-stone.location: Mainly found on the Gravesite Plain

item:spread-crossbow.name: Spread Crossbow
item:spread-crossbow.location: Found along the ravine south of the Castle Front
item:spread-crossbow.description: A modified crossbow made by combining two crossbows into one. Capable of loading multiple bolts and firing them simultaneously, enabling a spread of fire.

item:spread-out.name: Spread Out
item:spread-out.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:spritestone.name: Spritestone
item:spritestone.description: A Rauh Burrow inhabited by a sprite. Craftable item. Uses FP to release a sprite that slowly homes in on enemies. After a short time, the sprite fades away into glittering lights, causing a spiritual explosion on its passing. According to the records left by hornsent scholars, there were also contrivances known as "bondstones" that could manipulate the moment that the sprite vanishes.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to release a sprite that slowly homes in on enemies

item:square-off.name: Square Off
item:square-off.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Square Off: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust"Usable on straight swords.
item:square-off.location: Drops from a Scarab north-northwest of the Worshippers' Woods

stats.Effect: Ash

item:st-trina-disciple-s-cookbook-1.name: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1]
item:st-trina-disciple-s-cookbook-1.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a disciple who pursued the teachings of the saint of sleep—yet what seemed a gentle sleep at first ripened into velvet. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Eternal Sleep Pot

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:st-trina-disciple-s-cookbook-2.name: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2]
item:st-trina-disciple-s-cookbook-2.description:
A record of crafting techniques left by a disciple who pursued the teachings of the saint of sleep—yet what seemed a gentle sleep at first ripened into velvet. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Eternal Sleep Grease
- Drawstring Eternal Sleep Grease

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:st-trina-disciple-s-cookbook-3.name: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3]
item:st-trina-disciple-s-cookbook-3.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a disciple who pursued the teachings of the saint of sleep—yet what seemed a gentle sleep at first ripened into velvet. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Lulling Branch

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:st-trina-s-arrow.name: St. Trina's Arrow
item:st-trina-s-arrow.description: Arrow carved to resemble a withered water lily. Afflicts targets with a powerful sleep effect. Priests of St. Trina use these arrows to spread their teachings. The sweet oblivion of sleep can become quite the habit.

item:st-trina-s-blossom.name: St. Trina's Blossom
item:st-trina-s-blossom.description: St. Trina's life withered and fell, as fleeting as the seasons. At her last, she left a single water lily. Slightly boosts max FP. Despite the velvety-purple hue, the flower is in no way poisonous—it merely blooms in quietude.

item:st-trina-s-crystal-ball.name: St. Trina's Crystal Ball
item:st-trina-s-crystal-ball.location: - St. Trina's Crystal Ball would have been obtained after agreeing to help Merchant Kalé or Reeling Rico, depending on the version of the game.

stats.Effect: Copies Dream Mist from any sleeping being

item:st-trina-s-smile.name: St. Trina's Smile
item:st-trina-s-smile.description: Sleep in the vicinity increases attack power

stats.Effect: Sleep in the vicinity increases attack power

item:st-trina-s-torch.name: St. Trina's Torch
item:st-trina-s-torch.description: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly. The light-purple flame induces sleep.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Fai D

item:st-trina-s-torch.location: To get St. Trina's Torch in Elden Ring, you must travel to a guarded carriage caravan in the Consecrated Snowfield.

item:staff-of-loss.name: Staff of Loss
item:staff-of-loss.description: Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism. This staff is only capable of casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int C

item:staff-of-loss.location: To get the Staff of Loss, travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery in northeastern Caelid.

item:staff-of-the-avatar.name: Staff of the Avatar
item:staff-of-the-avatar.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees. The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:staff-of-the-avatar.location: To get the Staff of the Avatar in Elden Ring, travel to the Deeproot Depths, find the Great Waterfall Crest Site of Grace, and defeat the Erdtree Avatar nearby.

item:staff-of-the-great-beyond.name: Staff of the Great Beyond

stats.Scaling: Str E · Int D · Fai D

item:staff-of-the-great-beyond.description: Staff fashioned from the tail-fingers of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, and the microcosm raised aloft over the crux they form. Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations. The Mother received signs from the Greater Will from the beyond of the microcosm. Despite being broken and abandoned, she kept waiting for another message to come.
related: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

item:staff-of-the-guilty.name: Staff of the Guilty
item:staff-of-the-guilty.description: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.
item:staff-of-the-guilty.location: To get the Staff of the Guilty in Elden Ring, you must farm Thorn Sorcerers who wield blazing red staves at locations like Fort Laiedd or Guardian's Garrison, as it is a rare random drop.

item:stalwart-horn-charm.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
item:stalwart-horn-charm.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Greatly raises robustness. (Robustness governs resistance to blood loss and frost.) Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises robustness

item:stalwart-horn-charm.location: - Obtained from a corpse in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes. From Mausoleum Compound, head north up an incline, then left, and proceed southwest to a large tall rock formation. Walk counterclockwise around this formation to find a hole in the formation, forming an archway over a small ledge. Drop down from this ledge and head left to find the corpse, dangling over the edge of a cliff.

item:stalwart-horn-charm-1.name: Stalwart Horn Charm +1
item:stalwart-horn-charm-1.location: - Obtained from a corpse in southwestern Consecrated Snowfield, in western Mountaintops of the Giants. The corpse can be found laying over a log, between the two large dead trees, guarded by two Ancestral Followers.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises robustness

item:stalwart-horn-charm-2.name: Stalwart Horn Charm +2
item:stalwart-horn-charm-2.location: - Stalwart Horn Charm +2 is found at the Bonny Gaol. Jump down into a hole and then climb a ladder to the east after passing rats. The talisman is located in a room with jar innards.

stats.Effect: Raises Robustness by +180

item:stamp-sweep.name: Stamp (sweep)
item:stamp-sweep.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Stamp (Sweep): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for a sweeping strike"Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small and medium swords excepted)

stats.Effect: Ash

item:stamp-upward-cut.name: Stamp (Upward Cut)
item:stamp-upward-cut.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Stamp (Upward Cut): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers, (small and medium swords excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:stanching-boluses.name: Stanching Boluses
item:stanching-boluses.description: Red boluses made from cave moss Craftable item. Alleviates impending blood loss Blood loss escalates gradually, causing great damage once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such an event.

stats.Effect: Alleviates impending blood loss

item:star-fist.name: Star Fist
item:star-fist.description: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss. Used in brutal games of pugilism.
item:star-fist.location: To get the Star Fist in Elden Ring, travel to the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

item:star-lined-sword.name: Star-Lined Sword

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Int D

item:star-lined-sword.location: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga on the Cerulean Coast.
item:star-lined-sword.description: Sword encrusted with a line of stars fashioned from small pieces of crude glintstone. Weapon of the demi-human swordsmen. When bestowed with this weapon by their queen, the swordsmen swear to find the truth that lies at the end of the procession of stars.

item:star-shower.name: Star Shower
item:star-shower.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.

stats.Effect: Fires six shooting stars that pursue foes

item:star-shower.location: Sold by Sorceress Sellen - Conspectus Scroll

item:stargazer-heirloom.name: Stargazer Heirloom
item:stargazer-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of a queen. Raises intelligence.

stats.Effect: Raises intelligence by 5.

item:stargazer-heirloom.location: Found in the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

item:starlight.name: Starlight
item:starlight.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

stats.Effect: Creates star light to illuminate surroundings

item:starlight.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold

item:starlight-shards.name: Starlight Shards
item:starlight-shards.description: An ephemeral sliver that gives off a pale blue glow.

stats.Effect: Use to gradually recover FP

item:starlight-shards.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold

item:stars-of-ruin.name: Stars of Ruin
item:stars-of-ruin.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Lusat, primeval sorcerers.

stats.Effect: Fire twelve dark shooting stars that pursue foes

related: Sellen — sided with her against Jerren

item:starscourge-greatsword.name: Starscourge Greatsword
item:starscourge-greatsword.description: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:starscourge-heirloom.name: Starscourge Heirloom
item:starscourge-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with a scene from a heroic tale. Raises strength.

stats.Effect: Raises strength

item:steel-armor.name: Steel Armor
item:steel-armor.description: Armor of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boasts high damage negation. A piece of protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield. Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

item:steel-gauntlets.name: Steel Gauntlets
item:steel-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boast high damage negation. Protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield. Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

item:steel-greaves.name: Steel Greaves
item:steel-greaves.description: Greaves of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boast high damage negation. Protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield. Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

item:steel-helm.name: Steel Helm
item:steel-helm.description: A helm of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boasts high damage negation. A piece of protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield. Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

item:steel-wire-torch.name: Steel-Wire Torch
item:steel-wire-torch.description: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies. Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.
item:steel-wire-torch.location: The Steel-Wire Torch in Elden Ring is found on a corpse along the ramparts of Castle Morne on the Weeping Peninsula.

item:stimulating-boluses.name: Stimulating Boluses
item:stimulating-boluses.description: Light-purple boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates buildup of sleep. Sleep accumulates gradually, causing sudden fogginess and loss of FP once the threshold is reached, even if it does not force the afflicted into true slumber. Take one of these into timely fashion to avoid such events.

stats.Effect: Alleviates buildup of sleep

item:stone-club.name: Stone Club
item:stone-club.description: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.
item:stone-club.location: The Stone Club is a rare weapon in Elden Ring that drops from Battlemage enemies.

item:stone-of-gurranq.name: Stone of Gurranq
item:stone-of-gurranq.description: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

stats.Effect: Hurls a boulder before the caster

item:stone-sheathed-sword.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
item:stone-sheathed-sword.description: A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone. Relic of a lost civilization from a time long past, said to have served a ritual purpose at altars of light and darkness.

item:stonebarb-cracked-tear.name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
item:stonebarb-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Make attacks more likely to break enemy stances in a mixed physick

item:stonebarb-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Caelid, on the cliffs north-east of the Smoldering Church.

stats.Effect: Use to break one imp statue seal

item:storehouse-cross-message.name: Storehouse Cross Message
item:storehouse-cross-message.description: Message left by Sir Ansbach, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail. "It would seem that the people of the keep have flooded the holy quarter that leads onward to the Scadutree, barring access. However, there is no route that leads there from this storehouse. Perhaps there is another way to reach the holy quarter, from somewhere else in this keep..."

stats.Effect:
Message left for the author's compatriots
Examine using

item:storeroom-key.name: Storeroom Key
item:storeroom-key.description: A key with a spiral engraving. Opens the door to the storeroom on the second floor of Belurat, the tower settlement.

stats.Effect: Use to open the storeroom on the second floor of Belurat

item:storm-arrow.name: Storm Arrow
item:storm-arrow.description: Animal bone arrow, gust knocks enemies away

item:storm-assault.name: Storm Assault
item:storm-assault.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Assault: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Leap forward through surrounding storm winds and thrust armament downward. The attack will produce more storm winds at the point of impact."Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.

stats.Effect: ash

item:storm-blade.name: Storm Blade
item:storm-blade.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Blade: Lost skill of Stormveil. Surround armament with shearing storm winds that can be fired forward. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on swords (colossal weapons and twinblades excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:storm-stomp.name: Storm Stomp
item:storm-stomp.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Stomp: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Stomp hard on the ground to kick up a momentary storm."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: ash

item:storm-wall.name: Storm Wall
item:storm-wall.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Storm Wall: Swing the shield to create a wall of storm winds in front of you, deflecting arrows and other such physical projectiles. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry."Usable on small and medium shields.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
item:stormcaller.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Stormcaller: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Spin armament to create surrounding storm winds. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks."Usable on swords capable of slashing, axes, hammers, and polearms (small and colossal weapons excepted).
item:stormcaller.location: Drops from a Scarab found east of the Secluded Cell

stats.Effect: ash

item:stormhawk-axe.name: Stormhawk Axe
item:stormhawk-axe.description: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, wioth its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.
item:stormhawk-axe.location: The Stormhawk Axe can be obtained in two main ways: by defeating the NPC Nepheli Loux, or by looting it from specific locations in the Royal Capital or Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:stormhawk-deenh.name: Stormhawk Deenh
item:stormhawk-deenh.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Stormhawk Dreenh

item:stormhawk-deenh.location: Found in the Chapel of Anticipation. After returning to the area via the portal at The Four Belfries, go through the previously locked door near the main entrance, and follow the staircase into the upper level of the chapel to find the ashes.

item:stormhawk-feather.name: Stormhawk Feather
item:stormhawk-feather.description: A feather from a hawk that lived as one with the storms. Material used for crafting items. These feathers, enveloped in swirling winds, are often used for arrow fletching.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:stormwing-bone-arrow.name: Stormwing Bone Arrow
item:stormwing-bone-arrow.description: Bone arrow fletched with stormhawk feathers
item:stormwing-bone-arrow.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

stats.Effect: Bone arrow fletched with Stormhawk Feather
A tough fist gesture

item:strength-knot-crystal-tear.name: Strength-knot Crystal Tear
item:strength-knot-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily boosts strength in mixed physick

item:strength-knot-crystal-tear.location: Found inside of a bowl at a cliff north-east of the Stormhill Shack, west of the Warmaster's Shack. There will be a Troll guarding it.

item:string.name: String
item:string.description: Boasting no special qualities, this is merely a goodly length of string.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:string-seller-s-bell-bearing.name: String-Seller's Bell Bearing
item:string-seller-s-bell-bearing.description: The bell bearing of a hornsent string-seller who did not survive the war. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to the following items: - String

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:strip-of-white-flesh.name: Strip of White Flesh
item:strip-of-white-flesh.description: Thin strips of flesh taken from a bloodless creature. Material used for crafting items. The dried meat toughens the constitution, boosting resistance. It's known for its long-lasting effect.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:sun-realm-shield.name: Sun Realm Shield
item:sun-realm-shield.description: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.
item:sun-realm-shield.location: 2% chance to be dropped from various Skeleton Knights who carry it.

item:sunwarmth-stone.name: Sunwarmth Stone
item:sunwarmth-stone.description: Spiritgrave stone blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Craftable item. Uses FP to generate sunwarmth, continuously restoring the HP of those nearby. Has a more potent effect than a Warming Stone. Sunlight feels all the warmer in darkened lands.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to continuously heal nearby allies

item:surge-o-flame.name: Surge, O Flame!
item:surge-o-flame.description: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.

stats.Effect: Incinerates area before caster with stream of fire

item:surging-frenzied-flame.name: Surging Frenzied Flame
item:surging-frenzied-flame.description: Spiritgrave stone burned by frenzied flame. Craftable item. Uses FP to place a stone on the ground, where it spews frenzied flames. Spirits are eternal, and yet frenzied flame melts them away regardless. No wonder the hornsent forbid the flame's use.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to spew frenzied flame

item:swarm-of-flies.name: Swarm of Flies
item:swarm-of-flies.description: A Blood Oath incantation, shared from the Lord of Blood's power. Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster to assault foes. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion. The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.

stats.Effect: Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster

item:swarm-pot.name: Swarm Pot
item:swarm-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of effluents is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to set a swarm of bloodflies upon them. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. The cacophony of their wings assails the sanity of berserkers. The maggots found in waste feed on blood and turn into vicious flies that are pitiably short-lived.

stats.Effect: Throw at enemies to release a swarm of bloodflies

item:sweet-raisin.name: Sweet Raisin
item:sweet-raisin.description: Preparation of dried Golden Rowa fruit. Craftable item. Feed to Torrent, the spectral steed, while riding to greatly restore his HP. Golden Rowa fruit is not unlike honey, and Torrent seems to have a taste for it.

stats.Effect: On horseback, feed to Torrent to greatly restore HP

item:swift-glintstone-shard.name: Swift Glintstone Shard
item:swift-glintstone-shard.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

stats.Effect: Swiftly fires magic projectiles from glintstone

item:swift-glintstone-shard.location: Bought from Miriel or Sellen once the Academy Scroll is handed in.

item:swift-slash.name: Swift Slash
item:swift-slash.description: Skill: Swift Slash A skill passed down amongst hornsent swordsmen. Take a swift forward step to slice through foes. This sharp strike also fires off a shearing vacuum. Can be charged to increase the skill's power and the distance of the forward step.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:swift-spear.name: Swift Spear
item:swift-spear.description: A metal-bodied spear of extremely lightweight make, being the result of a sophisticated molding technique. Capable of swift consecutive attacks.

item:swollen-grape.name: Swollen Grape
item:swollen-grape.description: An eyeball of the frenzied flame that has swollen from within. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Marked with fingerprint burns, proof of having being touched directly by the Three Fingers' embrace.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:swollen-grape.location: - Found as loot and dropped by Aging Untouchables.

item:sword-dance.name: Sword Dance
item:sword-dance.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Sword Dance: Quickly close in to perform a series of spinning upward slashes. Follow up with an additional input to finish with a downward slash."Usable on swords, axes, and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons and great spears excepted).

stats.Effect: ash

item:sword-lance.name: Sword Lance
item:sword-lance.location: Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
item:sword-lance.description: Weapon once wielded by Commander Gaius. A combination of greatsword and lance. Weighty and capable of being brought to bear with great force, this armament shows its true potential when used astride a mount. Gaius himself was never without his boar.

item:sword-of-darkness.name: Sword of Darkness

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai E

item:sword-of-darkness.description: Sword of darkness, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, wandering coils of darkness coalesce and release, their eddies and vortices giving form to the dark blade.

item:sword-of-light.name: Sword of Light

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex E · Fai E

item:sword-of-light.description: Sword of light, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, unswerving rays of light intersect and reflect to give the silver blade form.

item:sword-of-milos.name: Sword of Milos
item:sword-of-milos.description: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. The spines along each side of the blade have been tapered to a fine point and mete out wounds like a lopside saw-blade. Milos was indersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly gortesque.
item:sword-of-milos.location: To get the Sword of Milos, you must defeat the Dung Eater.
related: Dung Eater — defeated at the Leyndell moat
Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:sword-of-night.name: Sword of Night
item:sword-of-night.location: - Complete Jolán, Swordhand of Night's questline.
item:sword-of-night.description: Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolán, Swordhand of Night. The blade of the sword is only semicorporeal, and thus cannot be guarded against completely.

item:sword-of-night-and-flame.name: Sword of Night and Flame
item:sword-of-night-and-flame.description: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments. Astrologers, who preceded the sroveres, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex E · Int D · Fai D

item:sword-of-st-trina.name: Sword of St. Trina
item:sword-of-st-trina.description: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int E

item:sword-of-st-trina.location: To get the original Sword of St. Trina in the base game, travel to the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace in Caelid, head down to the Forsaken Ruins while avoiding the giant crows, use a Stonesword Key on the imp statue basement seal, and open the chest inside.

item:swordhand-of-night-jol-n.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
item:swordhand-of-night-jol-n.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán. Spirit of a swordhand granted light by the Iris of Grace. Wields a sword of bottomless black that penetrates the enemy's guard. Though it was not by the shining star that she had longed for, thus was her Night illuminated. But this was an at times blinding light, and threatened to expunge the Night entirely.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

item:swordhand-of-night-jol-n.location: Obtained after completing Count Ymir's questline and boss fight and giving Jolán the Iris of Grace.

upgradeLevels.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán +1
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán +2
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán +3
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

upgradeLevels.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán +10
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán

item:tailoring-tools.name: Tailoring Tools
item:tailoring-tools.description: A portable set of tailoring tools.

stats.Effect: Enables armor adjustment at sites of grace

item:taker-s-cameo.name: Taker's Cameo
item:taker-s-cameo.description: A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor.

stats.Effect: Restores HP upon defeating enemies

item:taker-s-cameo.location: - Obtained from Tanith in Volcano Manor in central Mt. Gelmir after completing the third assassination quest, by killing Juno Hoslow in northern Mountaintops of the Giants, near the Shack of the Lofty.

item:talisman-of-all-crucibles.name: Talisman of All Crucibles
item:talisman-of-all-crucibles.description: Grants effects of all crucible talismans

stats.Effect: Grants effects of all crucible talismans

item:talisman-of-lord-s-bestowal.name: Talisman of Lord's Bestowal
item:talisman-of-lord-s-bestowal.description: Increases poise after using a flask of tears

stats.Effect: Increases poise after using a Flask of Crimson Tears

item:talisman-of-the-dread.name: Talisman of the Dread
item:talisman-of-the-dread.location: - Found inside the Elder's Hovel in Gravesite Plain.

stats.Effect: Raises potency of magma

item:talisman-pouch.name: Talisman Pouch
item:talisman-pouch.description: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader.

stats.Effect: Increases Talisman equip slots.

item:talisman-pouch.location: Location A: Defeat Margit, the Fell Omen

item:tarnished-golden-sunflower.name: Tarnished Golden Sunflower
item:tarnished-golden-sunflower.description: A large flower that blooms facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:tarnished-s-furled-finger.name: Tarnished's Furled Finger
item:tarnished-s-furled-finger.description: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the area boss of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

stats.Effect: Creates cooperative multiplayer summon sign.

item:tarnished-s-furled-finger.location: At the Stranded Graveyard site of grace, on a corpse to the right of the lift entrance alongside a Finger Severer.

item:tarnished-s-wizened-finger.name: Tarnished's Wizened Finger
item:tarnished-s-wizened-finger.description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Messages menu.) Use to write messages. Your messages will be conveyed to other worlds, allowing other players to read them. A finger of corpse wax, so emaciated the bone is visible. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

stats.Effect: Used to write messages.

item:tarnished-wrap.name: Tarnished Wrap
item:tarnished-wrap.description: Arm wraps made of rough material
item:tarnished-wrap.location: - The Tarnished Wrap is cut content and cannot be obtained.

item:taunter-s-tongue.name: Taunter's Tongue
item:taunter-s-tongue.description: Item for online play. Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion. Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader. (When two invaders are present, you will be limited to one cooperator.)

stats.Effect: Lures in invanders.

item:taylew-the-golem-smith.name: Taylew the Golem Smith
item:taylew-the-golem-smith.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Taylew the golem smith. The spirit of the stalwart stone golem who launches his own fists as projectiles. Taylew was said to be the runt of the litter and the first to stop moving, but it was he who became the guardian deity of smithery.

stats.Effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +1
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +2
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +3
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +4
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +5
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +6
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +7
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +8
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +9
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

upgradeLevels.name: Taylew the Golem Smith +10
upgradeLevels.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

item:telescope.name: Telescope
item:telescope.description: Astrology tool used by members of the Carian royal family. Part of a larger instrument, removed and stolen away. Allows the viewer to better see faraway things. During the age of the Erdtree, Carian astrology withered on the vine. The fate once writ in the night skies had been fettered by the Golden Order.

stats.Effect: Allows viewer to see faraway things

item:terra-magica.name: Terra Magica
item:terra-magica.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Draws an academy sigil upon the ground, raising the magic strength of those within. Once, the sigil would be cast from the highest belfry of the academy, covering the entire institution's grounds. This spell allows such vivid experience of spell—casting success, it turns many a fledgling into a true sorcerer in a flash of newfound understanding.

stats.Effect: Raises the magic strength of those within the sigil

item:terra-magica.location: In a chest at the top of the tower reached after completing the Academy Crystal Cave dungeon and taking the elevator behind the Crystalian bosses.

item:thawfrost-boluses.name: Thawfrost Boluses
item:thawfrost-boluses.description: Ice-hued boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item.

stats.Effect: Alleviates buildup of frost

item:thawfrost-boluses.location: Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

stats.Effect: The Carian oath

item:the-flame-of-frenzy.name: The Flame of Frenzy
item:the-flame-of-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

stats.Effect: Emits burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

item:the-poison-flower-blooms-twice.name: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice
item:the-poison-flower-blooms-twice.description: Skill: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice Conjures stingers of scarlet rot from below to stab the enemy. Landing a follow-up attack on a foe already inflicted with poison or rot deals massive damage in one fell swoop.

item:the-ring.name: The Ring
item:the-ring.description: The Player Character slowly raises their bent arms upwards until the fingertips of both respective arms touch.

item:the-sacred-tower-painting.name: "The Sacred Tower" Painting
item:the-sacred-tower-painting.description: Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "The Sacred Tower." This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

stats.Effect:
Reminiscence of the painting "The Sacred Tower"
Examine using

item:the-stormhawk-king.name: The Stormhawk King
item:the-stormhawk-king.description: Ashes of a hawk revered by all others as sovereign back in the days when Stormveil's winds still raged like no other. This ancient monarch is proud however, refusing to answer anyone's summons.

stats.Effect: Ashes of a hawk which heeds no summons.

item:theodorix-s-magma.name: Theodorix's Magma
item:theodorix-s-magma.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix. Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack. The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on — as a hero of the War against the Giants.

stats.Effect: Spews magma breath of Theodorix from above

item:thin-beast-bones.name: Thin Beast Bones
item:thin-beast-bones.description: Thin, hard beast bones. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting beasts.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:thiollier-s-concoction.name: Thiollier's Concoction
item:thiollier-s-concoction.description: An ebony-black concoction mixed by Thiollier. A condensed, somniferous elixir, purported to be capable of putting even an ancient dragon to sleep. For an ordinary mortal, a single sip would assuredly result in swift and certain death. Thiollier thought of St. Trina's sleep when he created this, but the ebony sleep he concocted had not the sweetness of nectar nor the gentleness of rest's embrace.

stats.Effect: Causes immediate death if imbibed by an ordinary human

item:thiollier-s-garb.name: Thiollier's Garb
item:thiollier-s-garb.description: The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret. The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's, increasing arcane. Additionally, countless needles are sewn onto the exterior, apparently for talismanic effect.

item:thiollier-s-garb-altered.name: Thiollier's Garb (Altered)
item:thiollier-s-garb-altered.description: The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret. Countless needles are sewn onto the exterior for talismanic effect.

item:thiollier-s-gloves.name: Thiollier's Gloves
item:thiollier-s-gloves.description: The dark gloves of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.

item:thiollier-s-hidden-needle.name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Int D

item:thiollier-s-hidden-needle.location: Acquired from Thiollier after defeating Promised Consort Radahn at the top of Enir-Ilim, but only if you have completed his quest line before reaching Needle Knight Leda in the Cleansing Chamber.
item:thiollier-s-hidden-needle.description: Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes. Like St. Trina, who blossomed in the deep-purple garden, a rich poison is secreted from within which sends its victims into an eternal sleep.

item:thiollier-s-mask.name: Thiollier's Mask
item:thiollier-s-mask.description: A mask upon which is carved a tranquil sleeping face. The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's, increasing arcane. Just once, Thiollier was granted the sweet repose of velvety sleep. The remainder of his days would be spent attempting to recapture it.

item:thiollier-s-trousers.name: Thiollier's Trousers
item:thiollier-s-trousers.description: The dark trousers of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.

item:thops-barrier.name: Thops's Barrier
item:thops-barrier.description: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.

stats.Effect: Erect a magic forcefield to deflect spells

related: Thops — body found at Raya Lucaria

item:thops-s-bell-bearing.name: Thops's Bell Bearing
item:thops-s-bell-bearing.description: Sorcerer Thops's bell bearing, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

stats.Effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access

item:thorned-whip.name: Thorned Whip
item:thorned-whip.description: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin. Very effective at inflicting blood loss.
item:thorned-whip.location: The Thorned Whip is a rare drop from a specific Fire Prelate located in the Mountaintops of the Giants region.

item:thorny-cracked-tear.name: Thorny Cracked Tear
item:thorny-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction makes consecutive attacks grow stronger the longer they continue. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.

stats.Effect: Makes consecutive attacks grow stronger in mixed physick.

item:thorny-cracked-tear.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Consecrated Snowfield, east of Ordina, Liturgical Town.

item:through-and-through.name: Through and Through
item:through-and-through.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Through and Through: Powerful archery skill using a greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready the greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies."Usable on greatbows.

stats.Effect: Ash
Throw at enemies to inflict damage

item:thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
item:thunderbolt.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:"Thunderbolt: Skill used by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Raise armament aloft to call down a bolt of lightning. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on all melee armaments.

stats.Effect: ash

item:tibia-s-cookbook.name: Tibia's Cookbook
item:tibia-s-cookbook.description: A record of crafting techniques of the mariners, the oldest of grave keepers. Details an ancient means of summoning the dead. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Call of Tibia

stats.Effect: Expands crafting repertoire

item:tibia-s-summons.name: Tibia's Summons
item:tibia-s-summons.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death. Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.

stats.Effect: Summons Those Who Live in Death

item:tonic-of-forgetfulness.name: Tonic of Forgetfulness
item:tonic-of-forgetfulness.description: Tonic in a small brass vial. Banishes distress and bitter memories. A gift bestowed by Rykard, sworn to blasphemy, to Lady Tanith, who unfortunately had no use for it. "My Lord, there could be no greater distress than to forget you."

stats.Effect: Tonic that banishes distress and bitter memories

item:tooth-whip.name: Tooth Whip
item:tooth-whip.location: Found inside the Whipping Hut on the outskirts of Bonny Village, across a rope bridge.
item:tooth-whip.description: Whip bestrewn with rotting, misshapen teeth. Filthy and seething with disease, the teeth are embedded in the whip and dose the victim with deadly poison upon each strike. As the wounds ripen they grow inflamed and ooze pus. The flesh of shamans was said to meld harmoniously with others.

item:torch.name: Torch
item:torch.description: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

stats.Effect: Phy 54 Mag 0 Fire 97 Ligt 0 Holy 0 Crit 100
stats.Type: Guard Phy 21 Mag 15 Fire 25 Ligt 15 Holy 15 Boost 19

item:torch.location: The easiest way to get a torch in Elden Ring is to purchase the standard Torch for 200 Runes from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh in West Limgrave.

item:torchpole.name: Torchpole
item:torchpole.description: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.
item:torchpole.location: To get the Torchpole in Elden Ring, you must farm the Exiled Soldiers who carry torch poles in Stormveil Castle.

item:torn-diary-page.name: Torn Diary Page
item:torn-diary-page.description:
A discarded page ripped from a diary, bearing a passage written in a tremulous hand. "I touched him, but only once. When he thrust his staff in my face,
I brushed it aside. It was then that I touched him. The aging untouchable."

stats.Effect:
Discarded page ripped from a diary
Examine using

item:torn-diary-page.location: Strike the painting to the left of the Manse Hall

item:tower-of-shadow-message.name: Tower of Shadow Message
item:tower-of-shadow-message.description: Message left by Needle Knight Leda, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail. "The Gate of Divinity lies in the tower sealed by shadow. That is surely where Kind Miquella is headed. We are no Empyreans, but we must locate the path that will lead us there. I will follow the crosses east."

stats.Effect:
Message left for the author's compatriots
Examine using

item:toxic-mossling.name: Toxic Mossling
item:toxic-mossling.description: A large moss animal glutted with poison. Material used for crafting items. Found in poison swamps. Round and plump, like a darling infant.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:toxic-mossling.location: - Found in poison swamps around the Realm of Shadow, such as beyond the Belurat well depths and the path to the Rauh Base.

item:toxic-mushroom.name: Toxic Mushroom
item:toxic-mushroom.description: A mushroom covered in toxic mold that grows in rotten lands. Material used for crafting items.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:toxic-mushroom.location: - Harvestable Toxic Mushrooms are found growing in the rotten lands of Caelid and Lake of Rot, particularly in areas afflicted by scarlet rot.

item:traveling-maiden-robe.name: Traveling Maiden Robe
item:traveling-maiden-robe.description: Robe worn by traveling maidens. Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 4 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 13 · Holy 13

item:traveling-maiden-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Traveling Maiden Robe

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 5 · Slash 5 · Pierce 2 · Magic 13 · Fire 12 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:tree-and-beast-surcoat.name: Tree-and-Beast Surcoat
item:tree-and-beast-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. The surcoat depicts the distant Erdtree and the beast regent, an emblem of the golden lineage. Both are symbols of glory now past.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 12 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 9

item:tree-and-beast-surcoat.location: Chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

item:tree-sentinel-armor.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
item:tree-sentinel-armor.description: Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 15 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 17 · Lightning 12 · Holy 14

item:tree-sentinel-armor.location: Received upon destroying the Merciless Chariots patrolling the Auriza Hero's Grave, located in the Capital Outskirts.

item:tree-sentinel-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Tree Sentinel Armor

item:tree-sentinel-gauntlets.description: Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

item:tree-sentinel-greaves.location: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.
