item:tree-sentinel-helm.description: Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 6 · Lightning 4 · Holy 5

item:tree-surcoat.name: Tree Surcoat
item:tree-surcoat.description: Blue surcoat draped over chainmail. The tree insignia emblazoned on the front depicts the Erdtree, and is a design beloved throughout the Lands Between.

stats.Negation: Physical 12 · Strike 8 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 8 · Fire 10 · Lightning 7 · Holy 8

item:treespear.name: Treespear
item:treespear.description: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals only holy damage. Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Fai D

item:treespear.location: The Treespear is located in a chest on the back of an abandoned carriage in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes, just south of a broken bridge.

item:trina-s-lily.name: Trina's Lily
item:trina-s-lily.description: A pale purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A symbol of faith in St. Trina. Dulls the senses, preventing agitation.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:trina-s-lily.location: Trina's Lilies grow in hidden corners throughout the Lands Between. Once a lily has been picked up, it will not respawn until the next playthrough. They can be found in every single region except Caelid, Ainsel River, and Deeproot Depths.

item:triple-rings-of-light.name: Triple Rings of Light
item:triple-rings-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. A gift from the young Ivliquella to his father, Radagon.

stats.Effect: Fire three rings of light before the caster

item:triple-rings-of-light.location: Imp Statue located at the lower level near the Prayer Room

item:triumphant-delight.name: Triumphant Delight
item:triumphant-delight.description: Gelmir before encountering Alexander on the cliffs west of Jarburg.

item:troll-knight-s-sword.name: Troll Knight's Sword
item:troll-knight-s-sword.description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

stats.Scaling: Str D · Dex D · Int D

item:troll-knight-s-sword.location: To get the Troll Knight's Sword in Elden Ring, you can get a guaranteed drop from Caria Manor or farm spectral troll knights in Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:troll-s-golden-sword.name: Troll's Golden Sword
item:troll-s-golden-sword.description: Sword given to the giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.
item:troll-s-golden-sword.location: To get the Troll's Golden Sword in Elden Ring, travel to the Altus Plateau, locate the enemy camp east of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, and open the chest on the back of the carriage.

item:troll-s-hammer.name: Troll's Hammer
item:troll-s-hammer.description: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock. Trolls are descended form the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distance past, smithing was considered divine.

stats.Scaling: Str C · Dex E · Fai D

item:troll-s-hammer.location: To get the Troll's Hammer in Elden Ring, you need 2 Stonesword Keys and must travel to the Old Altus Tunnel in the Altus Plateau.

item:troll-s-roar.name: Troll's Roar
item:troll-s-roar.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Troll's Roar: Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down."Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:turtle-neck-meat.name: Turtle Neck Meat
item:turtle-neck-meat.description: A splendid, lengthy cut of turtle neck meat. Material used for crafting items. Turtle meat is said to boost virility, but none in the Lands Between seem to have much appetite for it these days. In Lands Between, the urge to reproduce has waned long ago.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:twiggy-cracked-tear.name: Twiggy Cracked Tear
item:twiggy-cracked-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Briefly stop rune loss on death in mixed physick

item:twinbird-kite-shield.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
item:twinbird-kite-shield.description: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds. At dwindling levels of HP, this shield slightly boosts both attack and defense.
item:twinbird-kite-shield.location: Dropped by the Deathbird that you encounter at night north of the Leyndell, Royal Capital, northeast of the Hermit Merchant's shack in the Capital Outskirts.

item:twinblade.name: Twinblade
item:twinblade.description: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield, and requires high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is enabled with dual-handed spinning attacks.
item:twinblade.location: Head east from the Agheel Lake South or The First Step Site of Grace to the Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave.

item:twinblade-talisman.name: Twinblade Talisman
item:twinblade-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a twinblade and a confessor. Enhances the final hit ending a chain of attacks.

stats.Effect: Enhances final hit of chain attacks.

item:twinblade-talisman.location: - Obtained from a chest in Castle Morne, in southern Limgrave. From Behind the Castle, head down the cliff and northwest to the western corner of the castle. Climb a ladder and circle the top of this tower to find the chest.

item:twinned-armor.name: Twinned Armor
item:twinned-armor.description: Armor worn by D, Knight of the Golden Order

item:twinned-armor-altered.name: Twinned Armor (altered)
item:twinned-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Twinned Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 14 · Strike 12 · Slash 15 · Pierce 12 · Magic 11 · Fire 11 · Lightning 9 · Holy 10

item:twinned-gauntlets.name: Twinned Gauntlets
item:twinned-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:twinned-greaves.name: Twinned Greaves
item:twinned-greaves.description: Greaves depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 6 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 5 · Holy 5

item:twinned-greaves.location: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

item:twinned-greaves-altered.name: Twinned Greaves (Altered)
item:twinned-greaves-altered.description: Greaves worn by D, Knight of the Golden Order

item:twinned-helm.name: Twinned Helm
item:twinned-helm.description: Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:twinned-helm.location: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

item:twinned-knight-swords.name: Twinned Knight Swords
item:twinned-knight-swords.description: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.
item:twinned-knight-swords.location: To get the Twinned Knight Swords in Elden Ring, head to East Windmill Pasture in the Altus Plateau, loot the corpse by the burning pile, and watch out for exploding enemies.

item:twinsage-glintstone-crown.name: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
item:twinsage-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Greatly increases intelligence to the detriment of HP and stamina. Scholars of the Twinsage Conspectus were the elites of the academy, permitted to study and excel in sorceries of all kinds.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 5 · Pierce 4 · Magic 4 · Fire 4 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:twinsage-sorcerer-ashes.name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
item:twinsage-sorcerer-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer.

stats.Effect: Summons Twinsage sorcerer spirit

item:two-fingers-heirloom.name: Two Fingers Heirloom
item:two-fingers-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of the Two Fingers. Raises faith.

stats.Effect: Raises faith by 5.

item:two-handed-sword-talisman.name: Two-Handed Sword Talisman
item:two-handed-sword-talisman.location: - Obtained at Temple Town Ruins; Found inside the highest structure. After the fight with the Horned Warrior, just continue up the stairs into the next room to find a chest with this item inside.

stats.Effect: Enhances attacks with two-handed weapons by 15%

item:two-headed-turtle-talisman.name: Two-Headed Turtle Talisman
item:two-headed-turtle-talisman.location: Waterfall cave under the Ensis bridge.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises stamina recovery speed

item:uchigatana.name: Uchigatana
item:uchigatana.description: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and ts slash attacks cause blood loss.
item:uchigatana.location: To get the Uchigatana in Elden Ring, you can either start the game by choosing the Samurai class, or find it on a corpse inside the Deathtouched Catacombs in northern Limgrave.

item:unarmed.name: Unarmed
item:unarmed.description: No armament equipped. Bare fists will be used to attack.
item:unarmed.location: Innate — the default bare-fist strikes and kicks used when no weapon is equipped; no acquisition.

item:unendurable-frenzy.name: Unendurable Frenzy
item:unendurable-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.

stats.Effect: Emits violent burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes.

item:unendurable-frenzy.location: Frenzied Flame incantation from the Frenzied Flame Village.

item:unseen-blade.name: Unseen Blade
item:unseen-blade.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Enchants armament held in right hand, making it completely invisible. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Used by Sellian assassins to present themselves as unarmed sorcerers.

stats.Effect: Makes right-hand armament completely invisible

item:unseen-form.name: Unseen Form
item:unseen-form.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Makes the caster semi-invisible. While on horseback, effect extends to cover the mount. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The Sellian assassins considered every option that aided their dirty work.

stats.Effect: Makes the caster semi-invisible

item:unsheathe.name: Unsheathe
item:unsheathe.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Unsheathe: Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack."Usable on katana.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:uplifting-aromatic.name: Uplifting Aromatic
item:uplifting-aromatic.description: An of the perfumers who fought in the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to raise the attack power of the user and nearby allies while also reducing the damage from one incoming attack by half. This aromatic has an extremely potent morale-raising effect that makes those accustomed to it fearless in the face of death. It was this influence that made the perfumers exceptional commanders.

stats.Effect: Boosts ally attack power and reduces incoming damage once.

item:uplifting-aromatic.location: Crafted with the Perfumer's Cookbook [1] from Altus Bloom, Budding Cave Moss, Silver Tear Husk and Arteria Leaf.

item:upper-class-robe.name: Upper-Class Robe
item:upper-class-robe.description: Embroidered, bright green robe worn by noble children. Donning such a robe is traditionally the child's first show of burgeoning independence.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 2 · Magic 12 · Fire 11 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:urgent-heal.name: Urgent Heal
item:urgent-heal.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers faithful.

stats.Effect: Heals a small amount of HP.

item:urumi.name: Urumi
item:urumi.description: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfold warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.
item:urumi.location: To get the Urumi whip in Elden Ring, head to Caria Manor in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

item:vacuum-slice.name: Vacuum Slice
item:vacuum-slice.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Vacuum Slice: Lost skill of ancient heroes. Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile."Usable on swords and axes (small and colossal axes excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:vagabond-knight-armor.name: Vagabond Knight Armor
item:vagabond-knight-armor.description: Chest piece of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 11 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:vagabond-knight-armor.location: Sold by Merchant - Mountaintops of the Giants

item:vagabond-knight-armor-altered.name: Vagabond Knight Armor (altered)
item:vagabond-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Vagabond Knight Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 13 · Strike 10 · Slash 12 · Pierce 11 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 8 · Holy 8

item:vagabond-knight-gauntlets.name: Vagabond Knight Gauntlets
item:vagabond-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of a knight banished form their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey. Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 2 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:vagabond-knight-gauntlets.location: Sold by Merchant - Mountaintops of the Giants

item:vagabond-knight-greaves.name: Vagabond Knight Greaves
item:vagabond-knight-greaves.description: Greaves of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:vagabond-knight-greaves.location: Sold by Merchant - Mountaintops of the Giants

item:vagabond-knight-helm.name: Vagabond Knight Helm
item:vagabond-knight-helm.description: Helm of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 3 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:vagabond-knight-helm.location: Sold by Merchant - Mountaintops of the Giants

item:valkyries-prosthesis.name: Valkyrie's Prosthesis
item:valkyries-prosthesis.description: Golden prosthesis once used by the one-armed valkyrie. A masterwork of craftsmanship, with practice and skill it can be used as proficiently as a real arm. When Maleigh Marais, Lord of the Shaded Castle, embraced this prosthesis, he claimed to feel the presence of his personal goddess.

stats.Effect: Golden prosthesis used by the one-armed Valkyrie

related: Millicent — cured at the Church of the Plague

item:varre-s-bouquet.name: Varre's Bouquet
item:varre-s-bouquet.description: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood. This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Arc C

item:varre-s-bouquet.location: To get Varré's Bouquet in Elden Ring, complete White Mask Varré's questline, travel to Mohgwyn Palace using the Pureblood Knight's Medal, find his red invasion sign near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace, defeat him in his world, and exhaust his dying dialogue.

item:velvet-sword-of-st-trina.name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int E

item:velvet-sword-of-st-trina.description: Silver sword of St. Trina, now stained the color of velvet. Inflicts eternal sleep. When St. Trina was abandoned, the faint, light-purple mists coalesced into an intoxicating deep-purple cloud.

item:venomous-fang.name: Venomous Fang
item:venomous-fang.description: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.
item:venomous-fang.location: The Venomous Fang, a fist/claw weapon known for its unique "deadly poison" effect, is found in the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.

item:verdigris-armor.name: Verdigris Armor
item:verdigris-armor.description: Chest armor made from an unusual metal known as verdigris. Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

item:verdigris-discus.name: Verdigris Discus
item:verdigris-discus.description: Raises defense with higher equipment load

stats.Effect: Raises defense with higher equipment load

item:verdigris-gauntlets.name: Verdigris Gauntlets
item:verdigris-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets made from an unusual metal known as verdigris. Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

item:verdigris-greatshield.name: Verdigris Greatshield
item:verdigris-greatshield.location: Dropped by Moore upon his death, regardless of how he dies.
item:verdigris-greatshield.description: Greatshield made of the unusual metal known as verdigris. Boasts greater guard capacity than damage negation. To the extent that the shield will continue to protect its target even if its bearer should die.

item:verdigris-greaves.name: Verdigris Greaves
item:verdigris-greaves.description: Greaves made from an unusual metal known as verdigris. Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

item:verdigris-helm.name: Verdigris Helm
item:verdigris-helm.description: Helm made from an unusual metal known as verdigris. Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

item:veteran-s-armor.name: Veteran's Armor
item:veteran-s-armor.description: Old armor that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol. Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master. This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 17 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 14 · Lightning 12 · Holy 13

item:veteran-s-armor.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-armor-altered.name: Veteran's Armor (altered)
item:veteran-s-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Veteran's Armor

stats.Negation: Physical 18 · Strike 16 · Slash 18 · Pierce 17 · Magic 13 · Fire 13 · Lightning 12 · Holy 12

item:veteran-s-gauntlets.name: Veteran's Gauntlets
item:veteran-s-gauntlets.description: Old gauntlets that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

stats.Negation: Physical 4 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:veteran-s-gauntlets.location: - The Veteran's Gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-greaves.name: Veteran's Greaves
item:veteran-s-greaves.description: An old greaves that has seen many battles.Worn by Niall, the great veteran general of Sol.

stats.Negation: Physical 10 · Strike 9 · Slash 10 · Pierce 10 · Magic 7 · Fire 8 · Lightning 7 · Holy 7

item:veteran-s-greaves.location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-helm.name: Veteran's Helm
item:veteran-s-helm.description: An old helm that has seen many battles.Worn by Niall, the great veteran general of Sol.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 6 · Slash 6 · Pierce 6 · Magic 4 · Fire 5 · Lightning 4 · Holy 4

item:veteran-s-helm.location: - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia for 4,000 runes after defeating Commander Niall.

item:veteran-s-prosthesis.name: Veteran's Prosthesis
item:veteran-s-prosthesis.description: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.
item:veteran-s-prosthesis.location: To get the Veteran's Prosthesis in Elden Ring, you must travel to Castle Sol, locate the boss arena, and defeat the boss, Commander Niall.

item:viridian-amber-medallion.name: Viridian Amber Medallion
item:viridian-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with viridian amber inlaid. Boosts maximum stamina. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside

stats.Effect: Raises maximum stamina

item:viridian-amber-medallion.location: - Obtained by defeating Miranda Blossom in the Tombsward Cave, in western Weeping Peninsula, in southwestern Limgrave.

item:viridian-amber-medallion-1.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +1
item:viridian-amber-medallion-1.location: - Obtained by defeating Margit the Fell Omen in northwestern Leyndell, Royal Capital, south of the Outer Wall Battleground grace. He will break disguise as a Commoner when you approach him. The decoy will still be there even if Morgott, the Omen King has been slain.

stats.Effect: Greatly raises maximum stamina

item:viridian-amber-medallion-2.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +2
item:viridian-amber-medallion-2.location: - Obtained from a chest in Miquella's Haligtree. From Haligtree Town Plaza head southeast, drop down to the rooftops guarded by Summoning Snails, and continue southeast to perform a running jump across to another rooftop, which is slightly lower in height. Turn immediately around and perform a running jump to reach the inside of the previous building. The chest can be found in a room in this building.

stats.Effect: Vastly raises maximum stamina

item:viridian-amber-medallion-3.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +3
item:viridian-amber-medallion-3.description: Boosts maximum stamina by the utmost
item:viridian-amber-medallion-3.location: - It can be found in Darklight Catacombs, right after the first canon imp. Jump over on the ledge to the right and then drop down to that small archway under it.

stats.Effect: Raises maximum stamina

item:viridian-hidden-tear.name: Viridian Hidden Tear
item:viridian-hidden-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction eliminates all stamina consumption. However, this effect is only brief and will quickly expire.

stats.Effect: Eliminates all stamina consumption in mixed physick

item:viridian-hidden-tear.location: Defeat the Furnace Golem in Gravesite Plain on the path to the Cerulean Coast.

item:visage-shield.name: Visage Shield
item:visage-shield.description: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth. The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.
item:visage-shield.location: It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest after defeating the Pumpkin Head duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.

item:vision-of-grace.name: Vision of Grace
item:vision-of-grace.description: Be seen by the Elden Ring.

stats.Effect: Lose all runes, return to last site of lost grace

item:volcanic-stone.name: Volcanic Stone
item:volcanic-stone.description: A smoldering rock containing hot gas.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:volcano-manor-invitation.name: Volcano Manor Invitation
item:volcano-manor-invitation.description:
Letter given by Rya as thanks for retrieving her necklace. Contains an invitation to Volcano Manor. "Brave Tarnished,
Seek the Altus Plateau in the realm of the Erdtree. Prove yourself by making this journey, and the Volcano Manor will fully extend its invitation. To fight, amongst a family of champions."

stats.Effect: Letter of invitation to Volcano Manor

item:volcano-pot.name: Volcano Pot
item:volcano-pot.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Powdered volcanic rock is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to disperse a cloud of heat, dealing continuous damage to those caught inside for a short duration.

stats.Effect: Creates heat cloud, causing continuous fire damage

item:vortex-of-putrescence.name: Vortex of Putrescence
item:vortex-of-putrescence.description: Sorcery used by the Putrescent Knight. Launches a whirl of putrescent jets that bathe the surroundings of all they touch in ghostflame. In an age long past, Death was burned by ghostflame. Even the remains of tainted flesh were given equal treatment in death.

stats.Effect: Launches a whirl of putrescent jets

item:vow-of-the-indomitable.name: Vow of the Indomitable
item:vow-of-the-indomitable.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:"Vow of the Indomitable: Skill of the ancient warriors of the Erdtree. Hold shield aloft to imbue yourself with golden power, granting momentary invincibility."Usable on all shields.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:vulgar-militia-armor.name: Vulgar Militia Armor
item:vulgar-militia-armor.description: Armor worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

stats.Negation: Physical 8 · Strike 10 · Slash 9 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:vulgar-militia-armor.location: The Vulgar Militia Armor is a random drop (1.50%) from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-ashes.name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
item:vulgar-militia-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three vulgar militiamen. Spirits of the vulgar militia who wield long-hafted, serrated hatchets. These brutal weapons are particularly effective at causing blood loss to opponents. In the Lands Between, the small were scorned, and so they formed their vulgar militia as a means to make a living, albeit in ignominy.

stats.Effect: Summons three vulgar Militia spirits

item:vulgar-militia-ashes.location: Found in the Auriza Hero's Grave. At the bottom of the hallway with the two chariots, drop down to the wooden beams below and head north to a room containing a statue. Go through the corridor behind the statue and to the right.

item:vulgar-militia-gauntlets.name: Vulgar Militia Gauntlets
item:vulgar-militia-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Str 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:vulgar-militia-gauntlets.location: - The Vulgar Militia Gauntlets have a 1.50% chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-greaves.name: Vulgar Militia Greaves
item:vulgar-militia-greaves.description: Greaves worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 6 · Slash 5 · Pierce 5 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 6

item:vulgar-militia-greaves.location: The Vulgar Militia Greaves are a random drop (1.50%) from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-helm.name: Vulgar Militia Helm
item:vulgar-militia-helm.description: Helm worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen. The upward extension serves to create an appearance of larger size, however slightly.

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 3 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 4 · Holy 3

item:vulgar-militia-helm.location: The Vulgar Militia Helm is a random drop (1.50%) from Vulgar Militia enemies encountered throughout the Lands Between.

item:vulgar-militia-saw.name: Vulgar Militia Saw
item:vulgar-militia-saw.description: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.
item:vulgar-militia-saw.location: To get the Vulgar Militia Saw in Elden Ring, travel to the Bestial Sanctum or Farum Great Bridge Site of Grace in northern Caelid, and repeatedly defeat the nearby Vulgar Militiamen wielding this weapon until it drops.

item:vulgar-militia-shotel.name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
item:vulgar-militia-shotel.description: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world
item:vulgar-militia-shotel.location: To get the Vulgar Militia Shotel in Elden Ring, you must farm and defeat the Vulgar Militiamen enemies who wield this specific weapon.

item:vyke-s-dragonbolt.name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
item:vyke-s-dragonbolt.description: Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

stats.Effect: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

item:vyke-s-war-spear.name: Vyke's War Spear
item:vyke-s-war-spear.description: War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold. Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex C · Fai D

item:wait.name: Wait!
item:wait.location: Available from the start of the game.
item:wait.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:wakizashi.name: Wakizashi
item:wakizashi.description: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.
item:wakizashi.location: The Wakizashi is hidden inside Gaol Cave in southwestern Caelid.

item:wall-of-sparks.name: Wall of Sparks
item:wall-of-sparks.description: Skill: Wall of Sparks Scatter perfumed powder in vicinity, producing intense sparks after a brief delay. Can be charged to increase power and range. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used.

item:wandering-noble-ashes.name: Wandering Noble Ashes
item:wandering-noble-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five wandering nobles.

stats.Effect: Summons five wandering noble spirits.

item:wandering-noble-ashes.location: Found on a corpse in Stormfoot Catacombs, in a dead-end room guarded by Imps.

item:war-cry.name: War Cry
item:war-cry.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"War Cry: Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks."Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).

stats.Effect: Ash

item:war-surgeon-gloves.name: War Surgeon Gloves
item:war-surgeon-gloves.description: Bloodstained white gloves of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception

stats.Negation: Physical 1 · Strike 1 · Slash 2 · Pierce 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:war-surgeon-gloves.location: - The War Surgeon Gloves are dropped by one of the Nameless White Mask invaders near the blood marsh in Mohgwyn Palace.

item:war-surgeon-gown.name: War Surgeon Gown
item:war-surgeon-gown.description: "Bloodstained white gown of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception."

stats.Negation: Physical 7 · Strike 7 · Slash 8 · Pierce 7 · Magic 9 · Fire 10 · Lightning 10 · Holy 10

item:war-surgeon-gown.location: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace.

item:war-surgeon-gown-altered.name: War Surgeon Gown (altered)
item:war-surgeon-gown-altered.description: Lighter version of the War Surgeon Gown.

stats.Negation: Physical 6 · Strike 7 · Slash 7 · Pierce 6 · Magic 8 · Fire 9 · Lightning 10 · Holy 9

item:war-surgeon-gown-altered.location: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace. Then, alter with Boc.

item:war-surgeon-trousers.name: War Surgeon Trousers
item:war-surgeon-trousers.description: Bloodstained trousers of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception

stats.Negation: Physical 3 · Strike 4 · Slash 4 · Pierce 3 · Magic 5 · Fire 5 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:war-surgeon-trousers.location: Dropped by Unnamed White Mask invader at the blood river of Mohgwyn Palace.

item:warhawk-ashes.name: Warhawk Ashes
item:warhawk-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a warhawk. Spirit of a Stormveil warhawk, the talons of which have been sliced off so that razor-fine swords could be grafted in their place. With its lord vanquished, and its wings wounded, the hawk perished as it solemnly gazed at its former home. The storm is a warhawk's cradle.

stats.Effect: Summons warhawk spirit

item:warhawk-s-talon.name: Warhawk's Talon
item:warhawk-s-talon.description: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.
item:warhawk-s-talon.location: To get the Warhawk's Talon straight sword in Elden Ring, you must farm the Bladed Talon Eagle (Warhawk) enemies located inside Stormveil Castle.

item:warm-welcome.name: Warm Welcome
item:warm-welcome.location: Available from the start of the game.
item:warm-welcome.description: Locks the player character in place during the animation.

item:warming-stone.name: Warming Stone
item:warming-stone.description: Ruin Fragment blessed with an incantation of the Two Fingers. Craftable item. Uses FP to generate warmth, continuously restoring the HP of those nearby. It's said that the Erdtree was once as warm as the gentle sun, and would gradually heal all who bathed in its rays.

stats.Effect: Uses FP to continuously heal nearby allies

item:warped-axe.name: Warped Axe
item:warped-axe.description: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.
item:warped-axe.location: The Warped Axe is a rare 4% drop from axe-wielding Omen enemies.

item:warpick.name: Warpick
item:warpick.description: Warhammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence. A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.
item:warpick.location: The Warpick in Elden Ring is a random drop obtained by defeating specific soldier enemies who wield the weapon, such as those near the Gatefront Ruins or Agheel Lake South in Limgrave.

item:warrior-gauntlets.name: Warrior Gauntlets
item:warrior-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 1 · Pierce 1 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:warrior-gauntlets.location: Sold by Merchant - Academy of Raya Lucaria

item:warrior-greaves.name: Warrior Greaves
item:warrior-greaves.description: Greaves of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 4 · Pierce 4 · Magic 5 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:warrior-greaves.location: Sold by Merchant - Academy of Raya Lucaria

item:warrior-jar-shard.name: Warrior Jar Shard
item:warrior-jar-shard.description: Shard of a shattered warrior jar.

stats.Effect: Boosts the attack power of skills.

item:warrior-jar-shard.location: - Obtained by killing Iron Fist Alexander, before completing his questline.

item:watchdog-s-greatsword.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
item:watchdog-s-greatsword.description: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.
item:watchdog-s-greatsword.location: To get the Watchdog's Greatsword in Elden Ring, you must farm sword-wielding Erdtree Burial Watchdogs located in late-game dungeons like the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave or the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs.

item:watchdog-s-staff.name: Watchdog's Staff
item:watchdog-s-staff.description: Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs. The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps. Unique Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.
item:watchdog-s-staff.location: To get the Watchdog's Staff in Elden Ring, travel to the Road's End Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes, head down two flights of stairs from the site of grace, and strike the illusory back wall.

item:watchful-spirit.name: Watchful Spirit
item:watchful-spirit.description: An entreaty received from the hornsent grandam. Summon a guardian spirit above the caster's head. The spirit never strays far from the caster, conjuring several apparitions before dissipating. "Take vengeance upon Messmer and his lot. They who betrayed us, aye, they who burned us... Let them face in thy wrath their just deserts."

stats.Effect: Summons a guardian spirit above the caster's head

item:wave.name: Wave

stats.Effect: Wave hand

item:wave.location: Available from the start of the game.

item:waves-of-darkness.name: Waves of Darkness
item:waves-of-darkness.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:"Waves of Darkness: Plunge armament into the ground to release three waves of darkness. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike."Usable on greataxes, warhammers, and colossal weapons.

stats.Effect: Ash

item:weathered-dagger.name: Weathered Dagger
item:weathered-dagger.description: Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion.

stats.Effect: Dagger received from Fia, Deathbed Companion

related: Forge of the Giants / burning the Erdtree

item:weathered-map.name: Weathered Map
item:weathered-map.description: A simple, badly weathered map. Left discarded and forgotten for some time. Depicts streaks of amber light.

stats.Effect:
A simple map, badly weathered
Examine using

item:weathered-straight-sword.name: Weathered Straight Sword
item:weathered-straight-sword.description: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.
item:weathered-straight-sword.location: To get the Weathered Straight Sword in Elden Ring, you must farm Commoner enemies at Stormveil Castle or the Ailing Village until it drops.

item:well-depths-key.name: Well Depths Key
item:well-depths-key.description: A crude, corroded key. Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat, the tower settlement.

stats.Effect: Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat

item:well-pickled-turtle-neck.name: Well-Pickled Turtle Neck
item:well-pickled-turtle-neck.description: Turtle neck meat that has been thoroughly pickled in a bitter solution. Temporarily grants large boost to stamina recovery speed. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.

stats.Effect: Temporarily grants large boost to stamina recovery speed
A dismissive gesture

item:whetstone-knife.name: Whetstone Knife
item:whetstone-knife.description: Whetstone with a cipher inscription, made to look like a small knifeblade.

stats.Effect: Can add new battle arts and affinities to weapons

item:whip.name: Whip
item:whip.description: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain. Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.
item:whip.location: The standard base Whip is the easiest to find early on.

item:whirl-o-flame.name: Whirl, O Flame!
item:whirl-o-flame.description: Superior Incantation of the Fire Monks.

stats.Effect: Sweeps area before caster with stream of fire

item:white-cipher-ring.name: White Cipher Ring
item:white-cipher-ring.description: Item for online play. Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded. (You may be unable to summon rescuers under certain circumstances). A lost mystic code, enchanted to take the form of a ring. One of the fetishes said to have been bestowed by the Two Fingers.

stats.Effect: When invaded, request the aid of a hunter.

item:white-mask.name: White Mask
item:white-mask.description: Bloodstained, faintly grinning mask. Worn by war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. The Lord of Blood's curse enlivens the wearer when bloodletting occurs. Slightly raises attack power when there is blood loss nearby.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 3 · Slash 3 · Pierce 2 · Magic 3 · Fire 3 · Lightning 3 · Holy 3

item:white-mask.location: Dropped by the White Mask invaders at Mohgwyn Palace.

item:white-reed-armor.name: White Reed Armor
item:white-reed-armor.description: Armor of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina.

stats.Negation: Physical 9 · Strike 10 · Slash 11 · Pierce 8 · Magic 10 · Fire 10 · Lightning 11 · Holy 10

item:white-reed-armor.location: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:white-reed-gauntlets.name: White Reed Gauntlets
item:white-reed-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothingmore than to die by the sword.

stats.Negation: Physical 2 · Strike 2 · Slash 2 · Pierce 2 · Magic 2 · Fire 2 · Lightning 2 · Holy 2

item:white-reed-greaves.name: White Reed Greaves
item:white-reed-greaves.description: Greaves of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothingmore than to die by the sword.

stats.Negation: Physical 5 · Strike 5 · Slash 6 · Pierce 5 · Magic 6 · Fire 6 · Lightning 6 · Holy 5

item:white-reed-greaves.location: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Mountaintops of the Giants.

item:white-shadow-s-lure.name: White Shadow's Lure
item:white-shadow-s-lure.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:"White Shadow's Lure: Hold armament in a brief, silent prayer to create a white shadow. The apparition lures in foes of human build who are not in combat, drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state."Usable on all melee armaments.
item:white-shadow-s-lure.location: North-west of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield

stats.Effect: ash

item:whiteflesh-mushroom.name: Whiteflesh Mushroom
item:whiteflesh-mushroom.description: Milky-white mushroom that grows in sullen lands. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow. The flesh of the mushroom is similar to raw meat, and can serve as pot innards.

stats.Effect: Material used for crafting items

item:whiteflesh-mushroom.location: Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow

item:wild-strikes.name: Wild Strikes
item:wild-strikes.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:"Wild strikes: Swing armaments with wild abandon. Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack."Usable on axes and hammers as well as curved swords and greatswords (colossal weapons excepted).
item:wild-strikes.location: Scarab found on the road approaching the Castleward Tunnel

stats.Effect: Ash

item:windy-crystal-tear.name: Windy Crystal Tear
item:windy-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction increases the effectiveness of dodgerolls for a certain duration. However, damage taken is also increased during the concoction's effect.

stats.Effect: Enhances dodge rolls for a time in mixed physick

item:windy-crystal-tear.location: Looted from a bowl in southern Caelid, south of the highway.

item:wing-of-astel.name: Wing of Astel
item:wing-of-astel.description: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light. Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.

stats.Scaling: Str E · Dex D · Int D

item:wing-of-astel.location: The Wing of Astel is found in a chest atop a ruined structure in the Uhl Palace Ruins, located in the Ainsel River underground area.

item:wing-stance.name: Wing Stance
item:wing-stance.description: Skill: Wing Stance Calmly assume a right-sided stance. Normal attack triggers a rapid three-slash combination. Strong attack triggers a leaping thrust.

item:winged-crystal-tear.name: Winged Crystal Tear
item:winged-crystal-tear.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

stats.Effect: Temporarily reduces equip load in mixed physick

item:winged-greathorn.name: Winged Greathorn
item:winged-greathorn.description: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirit fiercly dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as weapon of spirit worship. In the ancestral spirit-woshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.
item:winged-greathorn.location: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor (Regal Ancestor Spirit)

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
item:winged-misbegotten-ashes.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten.

stats.Effect: Summons winged misbegotten spirit

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes.location: Unsightly Catacombs, on the bottom level of a hall with lots of dead Misbegotten on the ground around it.

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-1.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes + 1
item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-1.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten. A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.

stats.Effect: Summons winged misbegotten spirit

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-10.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes + 10
item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-10.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten. A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.

stats.Effect: Summons winged misbegotten spirit

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-2.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes + 2
item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-2.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten. A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.

stats.Effect: Summons winged misbegotten spirit

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-3.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes + 3
item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-3.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten. A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.

stats.Effect: Summons winged misbegotten spirit

item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-4.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes + 4
item:winged-misbegotten-ashes-4.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten. A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow. mechanic:affinities.name: Weapon affinities
mechanic:affinities.description: An affinity changes a weapon’s damage type and scaling: Heavy favours Strength, Keen favours Dexterity, Quality uses both, and Magic and Cold add Intelligence. Fire and Flame Art add fire with Strength and Faith scaling respectively, Lightning is Dexterity, and Sacred is Faith. Blood, Poison and Occult scale with Arcane.

mechanic:ashes-of-war.name: Ashes of War
mechanic:ashes-of-war.description: An Ash of War grants a weapon a skill and, on most armaments, lets you choose its affinity. Applying one overwrites the previous skill and affinity, and some Ashes can be duplicated for a second copy with Lost Ashes of War. Unique weapons and many boss weapons cannot take Ashes at all.

mechanic:attack-rating.name: Attack rating (AR)
mechanic:attack-rating.description: Attack rating, or AR, is the total damage number a weapon shows across every damage type it deals, after the character’s stats are applied through scaling. Buffs, enemy negation and status buildup are not part of the displayed AR. The number the game shows is the summed damage types floored, matching the AR calculator the app uses.

mechanic:buff-stacking.name: Buff stacking
mechanic:buff-stacking.description: Buffs fall into categories such as aura, body, weapon and shield, and two buffs from the same category overwrite each other. Golden Vow is an aura and Flame, Grant Me Strength is a body buff, so they stack with each other and with a weapon grease. The Wondrous Physick supplies another independent layer.

mechanic:co-op.name: Co-op & Furlcalling Finger Remedy
mechanic:co-op.description: A Furlcalling Finger Remedy reveals summon signs left by other players, which you touch to call a cooperator. A password lets you link with a specific friend regardless of level, and the host’s session is what the group plays in. Co-op disables Torrent and Spirit Ashes and opens the world to invaders.

mechanic:crafting.name: Crafting & cookbooks
mechanic:crafting.description: The crafting kit lets you turn gathered materials into throwables, pots, greases, arrows and perfumes. Cookbooks unlock new recipes, and each one is found in a specific place or sold by a merchant. Crafted pots and perfumes are among the best status and burst tools in the game.

mechanic:critical-hits.name: Backstabs, ripostes & critical hits
mechanic:critical-hits.description: A critical hit multiplies your weapon’s attack rating rather than adding a flat amount. Backstabs land from directly behind an unaware or outmanoeuvred enemy, while ripostes follow a successful parry or a stance break. The Misericorde is the classic critical weapon because of its very high critical modifier.

mechanic:damage-types.name: Damage types
mechanic:damage-types.description: Physical damage splits into standard, strike, slash and pierce, and enemies resist each differently. Elemental damage comes as magic, fire, lightning and holy, and a weapon can carry a physical component plus one or more elements. The type matters more than the number against a boss with a lopsided negation.

mechanic:defense-negation.name: Defense & negation
mechanic:defense-negation.description: Defense is the flat number that shaves damage off every hit, while negation is the percentage that reduces what is left. Physical defense comes mostly from your stats and armour, and elemental negation comes from armour and talismans. Because the two apply in sequence, stacking a matching negation talisman can blunt a boss’s signature element.

mechanic:equip-load.name: Equip load classes
mechanic:equip-load.description: Your equipped weight as a share of maximum equip load decides your roll. Under thirty percent you light roll with the most distance, from thirty to seventy you medium roll, and above seventy you heavy roll with a long recovery. Going over one hundred percent overloads you and slows movement to a crawl.

mechanic:flask-charges.name: Flask charges (Golden Seeds)
mechanic:flask-charges.description: Golden Seeds increase the number of charges in your Flask of Crimson Tears and Flask of Cerulean Tears. The first seed or two cost one each and later upgrades cost more, so a full run needs thirty seeds. The two flask types share the same total charge pool.

mechanic:flask-potency.name: Flask potency (Sacred Tears)
mechanic:flask-potency.description: Sacred Tears upgrade the potency of both flasks, healing more per Crimson charge and restoring more FP per Cerulean charge. There are twelve Sacred Tears and each adds one upgrade level. Full potency makes a flask heal roughly twice a starting flask.

mechanic:great-runes.name: Great Runes
mechanic:great-runes.description: Great Runes are won from the shardbearers and equipped at any Site of Grace, but they do nothing until activated with a Rune Arc. Each one grants a different boon, from a flat boost to every stat to more health, and the effect ends when you die. They are a run-long buff, not a permanent stat.

mechanic:guard-boost.name: Blocking & guard boost
mechanic:guard-boost.description: Blocking an attack absorbs part of its damage and drains stamina based on your shield’s guard boost. A higher guard boost means less stamina lost per blocked hit, which lets you hold the line and set up guard counters. Greatshields and the Greatshield Talisman push guard boost highest.

mechanic:guard-counter.name: Guard counter
mechanic:guard-counter.description: Block an incoming attack, then press the heavy attack button immediately to launch a guard counter. It deals much more stance damage than a normal heavy and often breaks a boss’s stance in a few uses. The timing is forgiving as long as the block connected first.

mechanic:hyperarmor.name: Hyperarmor
mechanic:hyperarmor.description: Hyperarmor is temporary immunity to being staggered during specific attack animations. It is granted by the move itself, not by your poise, so a colossal swing can power through a hit that would interrupt a lighter weapon. Your poise still decides whether damage that lands outside those frames staggers you.

mechanic:incantation.name: Incantations
related: Feed him Deathroot from the Tibia Mariners and elsewhere
mechanic:incantation.description: Incantations are cast with a sacred seal and scale with Faith, though dragon and blood incantations can also use Arcane. They cost FP and cover healing, buffs, fire and lightning. Like sorceries, the seal’s stats and upgrade level shape the damage.

mechanic:invasions.name: Invasions
mechanic:invasions.description: Bloody Fingers and Recusant Fingers let you invade a host’s world to fight for runes and rewards. The Taunter’s Tongue invites invaders into your own world, and the Blue Cipher Ring calls hunters to defend a host in trouble. Invaders are always outnumbered and downscaled when the host has cooperators.

mechanic:jump-attacks.name: Jump attacks
mechanic:jump-attacks.description: A jumping heavy attack leaps in, hits hard, does solid stance damage and has a short recovery. It is the safest way to punish a boss because you are already moving out of range as the swing ends. The Claw Talisman boosts jump attack damage and the Raptor’s Black Feathers add another jump-attack bonus.

mechanic:larval-tears.name: Rebirth & Larval Tears
mechanic:larval-tears.description: After defeating Rennala you can ask her to rebirth your character, redistributing every level you have spent. Each rebirth costs one Larval Tear, which are found through the world and bought from a few merchants. Your level total and collected gear do not change, only where the points sit.

mechanic:map-fragments.name: Map fragments
mechanic:map-fragments.description: Each region’s map is blank until you collect its Map Fragment from a stele marked on the map edge. Until then you can still travel and explore, but you have no map of the area. Collecting the fragment reveals the terrain, graces and many markers for that region.

mechanic:matchmaking.name: Co-op & PvP matchmaking
mechanic:matchmaking.description: Summon range is decided by both your rune level and the highest-upgraded weapon you have ever held. That weapon memory means a low-level character who picked up a late-game weapon can only be matched with tougher players. A password overrides both limits and downscales the stronger player to the host.

mechanic:memory-slots.name: Memory slots & Memory Stones
mechanic:memory-slots.description: Memory slots decide how many sorceries and incantations you can have equipped at once. Each Memory Stone you find adds one slot, and the starting count depends on your class. The cap is ten slots once every stone is collected.

mechanic:ng-plus.name: NG+ scaling
mechanic:ng-plus.description: Starting Journey 2 keeps your level, gear, items and most graces but makes every enemy tougher and worth more runes. The difficulty climbs each cycle up to Journey 7, after which it stops rising. Some quest items and key items are reset, so re-earn anything a quest needs.

mechanic:parry.name: Parrying
mechanic:parry.description: A parry deflects an incoming attack during a short window and leaves the attacker open to a riposte. Small shields and the Parry Ash of War have the widest timing, while medium shields and weapons parry poorly or not at all. Some attacks, including many grabs and colossal swings, cannot be parried.

mechanic:point-of-no-return.name: Point of no return
mechanic:point-of-no-return.description: Resting at the Forge of the Giants and burning the Erdtree permanently changes the world. Leyndell becomes the Ashen Capital, several quest lines close and some items can no longer be obtained. The app warns before this and other gates so you can finish what matters first.

mechanic:poise.name: Poise
mechanic:poise.description: Poise is the hidden stat that decides whether an incoming hit interrupts your attack or cast. Every hit drains poise by that attack’s poise damage; reaching zero staggers you and briefly opens you up. Poise refills on its own after roughly thirty seconds without being hit.

mechanic:powerstance.name: Powerstancing
mechanic:powerstance.description: Equipping two weapons of the same class, one in each hand, unlocks paired attacks that swing both at once. The L1 chain and the jumping L1 hit with both weapons, stacking status buildup and stance damage in a single swing. It costs more stamina than a normal attack line.

mechanic:revered-spirit-ash.name: Revered Spirit Ash
mechanic:revered-spirit-ash.description: Revered Spirit Ashes raise the Revered Spirit Ash Blessing, which strengthens your summoned spirits in the Realm of Shadow. It is a separate track from the Scadutree Blessing and only affects summons, not you. It runs to level ten with twenty-five ashes.

mechanic:rune-arc.name: Rune Arc
mechanic:rune-arc.description: A Rune Arc activates the Great Rune you have equipped at a Site of Grace. The effect lasts until you die, so a careful player can keep one running for a long stretch. Rune Arcs drop from co-op and invasion wins as well as from enemies.

mechanic:rune-loss.name: Rune loss & recovery
mechanic:rune-loss.description: When you die you drop all carried runes at the spot where you fell. Return and touch them to recover the lot; die again before that and the first drop is gone for good. A Sacrificial Twig in your inventory prevents the loss once.

mechanic:scadutree-blessing.name: Scadutree Blessing
mechanic:scadutree-blessing.description: Scadutree Fragments raise your Scadutree Blessing, which increases the damage you deal and reduces the damage you take inside the Realm of Shadow. The blessing only applies in the DLC, and it is the main counter to the region’s inflated enemy scaling. It runs to level twenty with fifty fragments.

mechanic:scaling-letters.name: Scaling letters
mechanic:scaling-letters.description: The letter beside a stat on a weapon shows how strongly its AR grows from that stat, running E, D, C, B, A, S from weakest to strongest. The grade is a band of the weapon’s stored scaling coefficient, so S adds far more per point than E. Upgrading a weapon usually raises these coefficients, which is why a weapon can climb a letter as it is reinforced.

mechanic:sites-of-grace.name: Sites of Grace
mechanic:sites-of-grace.description: Sites of Grace are the checkpoints you rest at to refill flasks, reset enemies and fast travel. Resting revives normal enemies and respawns bosses you have not killed, so it is also how you retry a fight. The map shows every grace you have discovered and lets you jump between them.

mechanic:soft-cap-endurance.name: Endurance soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-endurance.description: Endurance raises stamina as well as maximum equip load. Stamina gains are largely done past thirty and effectively stop at fifty, but the equip-load curve keeps climbing all the way to ninety-nine. That is why a heavy build may keep investing long after a light one stops.

mechanic:soft-cap-mind.name: Mind soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-mind.description: Mind raises your FP pool and therefore how many spells, Ashes of War and summons you can chain before drinking. The FP gains slow down after forty and nearly stop after sixty. Casters usually stop at forty early and push toward sixty later.

mechanic:soft-cap-offensive.name: Offensive stat soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-offensive.description: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Faith and Arcane all scale weapon and spell damage through breakpoints around twenty, sixty and eighty. Points before twenty are the most efficient, the stretch to sixty is the main investment, and gains past eighty are small. Matching the weapon’s own scaling letters is what makes a point pay off.

mechanic:soft-cap-vigor.name: Vigor soft caps
mechanic:soft-cap-vigor.description: Vigor is the stat that buys you mistakes, and it is the first one most builds should push. Its HP gains fall off sharply after forty, then again after sixty, so points spent past the second cap return very little. Sixty Vigor is a common endgame target for a comfortable health pool.

mechanic:sorcery.name: Sorceries
mechanic:sorcery.description: Sorceries are cast with a staff and scale with Intelligence, with a few exceptions that dip into other stats. They cost FP and are gated by the staff’s stats and upgrade level as well as your own. Glintstone magic is the core family, with frost and gravity branches.

mechanic:spirit-ashes.name: Spirit Ashes
mechanic:spirit-ashes.description: Spirit Ashes summon an ally at the gravestone markers found before most boss arenas. You need the Spirit Calling Bell from Renna and enough FP to pay the summon cost. They cannot be used in co-op or in the handful of arenas that disable them.

mechanic:stamina.name: Stamina
mechanic:stamina.description: Stamina is spent on attacks, rolls, running, jumping and blocking. It regenerates after a short delay and the rate is raised by the Green Turtle Talisman and similar effects. Running out mid-swing usually means eating the next hit, so manage the bar rather than mashing.

mechanic:stance-break.name: Stance break
mechanic:stance-break.description: Bosses and large enemies have a separate hidden stance meter that fills as you land charged heavies, jump attacks and many Ashes of War. When it breaks, the enemy is staggered and a glowing weak point lets you take a critical hit. The meter drains slowly, so damage must be delivered in a burst.

mechanic:stat-requirements.name: Stat requirements
mechanic:stat-requirements.description: Each armament and catalyst lists minimum Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Faith and Arcane. Failing a requirement cuts your damage sharply and can make the weapon bounce off enemies, even though you can still swing it. Two-handing lowers the Strength requirement you need to meet.

mechanic:status-bleed.name: Blood loss (bleed)
mechanic:status-bleed.description: Blood loss drains a percentage of the target’s maximum HP plus a flat amount when the bar fills. It scales with Arcane on most blood-affinity weapons and is the fastest way to delete a high-health boss. Because resistance rises after each proc, bleed builds pair best with rapid multi-hit attacks.

mechanic:status-buildup.name: Status buildup & resistance
mechanic:status-buildup.description: Status effects fill a hidden bar as hits land, and the effect triggers when the bar fills. After it triggers the bar empties and your resistance to that status rises, so the same effect takes longer the next time. Buildup also decays gradually while you are not being hit.

mechanic:status-death-blight.name: Death blight
mechanic:status-death-blight.description: Death blight kills the target outright when the bar fills, with no saving throw. It is rare from the player side and mostly appears on certain enemies and in PvP. Its bar decays quickly, so it must be applied in a burst.

mechanic:status-frostbite.name: Frostbite
mechanic:status-frostbite.description: Frostbite deals burst damage and temporarily lowers the target’s absorption, so follow-up hits land harder. It can trigger again after a cooldown, and cold affinity weapons also keep a physical component. Fire damage removes the frost debuff early, so avoid mixing the two.

mechanic:status-madness.name: Madness
mechanic:status-madness.description: Madness damages both HP and FP and staggers the victim when it triggers. It only affects humanoid, Tarnished-descended enemies, so it does nothing to most beasts and monsters. In PvP it is one of the strongest burst windows in the game.

mechanic:status-poison.name: Poison
mechanic:status-poison.description: Poison applies a damage-over-time effect that ticks down the target’s HP for a set duration. The stronger variant is Deadly Poison, which does more damage per tick. Poison scales with Arcane and is best used to soften a boss you expect to fight for a while.

mechanic:status-scarlet-rot.name: Scarlet rot
mechanic:status-scarlet-rot.description: Scarlet rot is a stronger damage-over-time than poison and is the signature tool of Caelid and the Haligtree. A rot proc ticks for a large share of health over a short window, which makes it ideal against bosses with huge health pools. Boluses and Preserving Boluses cure it.

mechanic:status-sleep.name: Sleep
mechanic:status-sleep.description: Sleep incapacitates the target for a short time, letting you land free hits or reposition. It only works on enemies that are not immune, and any damage wakes them, so it is a control tool rather than a damage tool. Sleep Pots are the usual delivery method.

mechanic:stealth.name: Stealth
mechanic:stealth.description: Crouching lowers the noise you make and the distance at which enemies notice you, and tall grass hides you completely. From behind, an unaware enemy can be backstabbed or simply walked past. The Crepus’s Vial and similar talismans improve stealth further.

mechanic:summoning-pools.name: Summoning pools
mechanic:summoning-pools.description: Each Effigy of the Martyr you activate adds that area to your summoning pool. The Small Golden Effigy then places your sign at every activated pool at once, and the Small Red Effigy does the same for invasions. Pools persist for the whole run once touched.

mechanic:talisman-slots.name: Talisman slots
mechanic:talisman-slots.description: You begin with a single talisman slot and expand it with Talisman Pouches found through the run. Four slots is the maximum, which is why a build’s talismans are a real trade-off rather than a checklist. Talismans apply their effect continuously with no FP cost.

mechanic:torrent.name: Torrent
mechanic:torrent.description: Torrent is the spectral steed summoned with the Spectral Steed Whistle. He can double jump and is much faster than running, which makes open-world travel and many field bosses easier. Torrent is banned inside most legacy dungeons and boss arenas and cannot be used in co-op.

mechanic:two-handing.name: Two-handing
mechanic:two-handing.description: Holding a weapon in both hands multiplies your effective Strength by one and a half, rounded down. That raises both the Strength scaling of the weapon and your effective Strength for meeting its requirement, letting a lower-Strength build wield heavy armaments. It does not change Dexterity, Intelligence, Faith or Arcane.

mechanic:upgrades.name: Upgrades & smithing
mechanic:upgrades.description: Regular armaments upgrade to plus twenty-five with Smithing Stones and somber armaments to plus ten with Somber Smithing Stones. The final step of either track needs an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone from a late-game or optional boss. Spirit Ashes upgrade the same way with Grave Glovewort and Great Grave Glovewort.

mechanic:weapon-scaling.name: Weapon scaling
mechanic:weapon-scaling.description: Every weapon scales its attack rating with one or more stats, shown as a letter grade from E up to S. Levelling the stats the weapon actually uses, and upgrading the weapon, raises that contribution. A weapon with high base damage and poor scaling wants minimum stats, while an S-scaling weapon rewards heavy investment.

mechanic:whetblades.name: Whetblades
mechanic:whetblades.description: A Whetblade unlocks extra affinity choices when you apply an Ash of War, regardless of the Ash you use. The Iron Whetblade gives Heavy, Keen and Quality; Glintstone gives Magic and Cold; Red-Hot gives Fire and Flame Art; Sanctified gives Sacred; and the Black Whetblade gives Blood, Poison and Occult.

mechanic:wondrous-physick.name: Wondrous Physick
mechanic:wondrous-physick.description: The Flask of Wondrous Physick holds two Crystal Tears that you choose and mix at a Site of Grace. Drinking it applies both effects at once and the flask refills whenever you rest, so it is a free burst buff each attempt. Tears range from flat stat boosts to the famous Cerulean Hidden Tear that removes FP costs.

merchant:blackguard-big-boggart.name: Blackguard Big Boggart
merchant:blackguard-big-boggart.description: Never met someone with a taste for prawns I couldn't trust.

sections.heading: Questline (3 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Liurnia of the Lakes (Boilprawn Shack)] Blackguard Big Boggart — Liurnia of the Lakes (Boilprawn Shack) 2. [Altus Plateau] Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau 3. [Altus Plateau] Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau

questSteps.title: Blackguard Big Boggart — Liurnia of the Lakes (Boilprawn Shack)
questSteps.text: Head north-west from the Site of Grace to find Rya the Scout inside a gazebo and talk to her. Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select Give me the necklace and then Deal to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. After purchasing the item, he'll start selling an infinite supply of Boiled Prawns.

questSteps.title: Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau
questSteps.text: After resting at a Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, Boggart will move to the outer moat along the northern wall of Leyndell, Royal Capital in the Capital Outskirts (due west from the Capital Rampart Site of Grace). You may now purchase an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs. Exhaust Boggart's dialogue about Dung Eater. After freeing Dung Eater from his cell in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds, Boggart will have some additional dialogue.

questSteps.title: Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau
questSteps.text: After hearing Boggart's final piece of dialogue about Dung Eater, warning you that Dung Eater is lurking nearby, reload the area to find Boggart bound to a chair. Speak to him to trigger an invasion from Dung Eater. Defeat Dung Eater and return to Boggart, who is now dead. Loot his equipment, as well as the Seedbed Curse.

merchant:brother-corhyn.name: Brother Corhyn
merchant:brother-corhyn.description: I teach incantations, the strength granted us by the Two Fingers, and explore the secrets of the Golden Order. So that one day, if a Tarnished of the Roundtable Hold should become Elden Lord, I might counsel them, ensuring order regains its proper form, righting rule over men.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Corhyn can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold, where he will offer to teach you several Incantations. His shop inventory can be increased by giving him prayerbooks.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After reaching Altus Plateau, Corhyn will express an interest in searching for Goldmask.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Altus Plateau
questSteps.text: Corhyn can be found north of the the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace. Talking to him here after finding Goldmask will allow you to reveal Goldmask's location to him.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Altus Plateau (Forest-Spanning Greatbridge)
questSteps.text: Corhyn will now appear next to Goldmask. The pair will now travel together.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Leyndell, Royal Capital
questSteps.text: Corhyn and Goldmask can be found near the colosseum. Corhyn will express frustration at Goldmask's current obsession with Radagon. After using Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue past the lift near Erdtree Sanctuary, talk to Goldmask to reveal Radagon's secret and then talk to Corhyn.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Mountaintops of the Giants
questSteps.text: Corhyn and Goldmask will move to the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins. Corhyn can be offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, which will affect the end of his questline. If offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, Corhyn will remain in this location after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade after Goldmask leaves. After reloading the area, he will have disappeared, leaving behind his flail, robe, and bell bearing.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
questSteps.text: If Corhyn was not offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, he will appear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, close to the giant Bolt of Gransax after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. After exhausting his dialogue and resting at a Site of Grace, he will be gone.

questSteps.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle
questSteps.text: Gostoc can be found in the gatehouse to the left of the main gate. He will offer you the choice of taking the main gate or using the side entrance. Choosing "No, I'll use the main entrance" will cause the main gate to open when you approach it. This will not prevent you from taking the side entrance, however.

questSteps.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Upon entering a dark room in the western section of the castle, Gostoc will close the door, locking you in with a Banished Knight enemy. To leave, grab the Rusty Key and return to the door to open it. If you die in this room, you can return to it and loot the item without being locked in again. *(Optional)* Gostoc will now appear in several locations around the dungeon. Speaking to him in one of these locations for the first time will reward you with a Grace Mimic. The locations are as follows: Stormveil Cliffside.

questSteps.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle (Godrick's arena)
questSteps.text: After defeating Godrick the Grafted, Gostoc will appear in the room. After exhausting his dialogue his shop will be open once again. He will also stop stealing your Runes if you skipped the previous part.

questSteps.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle (Throne Room)
questSteps.text: After completing Nepheli Loux's questline, Gostoc will appear in the back of the throne room. After exhausting his dialogue, his shop will become available again, now with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone available to purchase.

merchant:gatekeeper-gostoc.description: Gostoc is a servant working in Stormveil Castle, in the role of gatekeeper.

merchant:gowry.name: Gowry
merchant:gowry.description: The rotting sickness that afflicts Millicent has no cure. When the Erdtree flourished, even the demigods could not stave off its effects, despite their nigh godhood.

sections.text: 1. [Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)] Meet Gowry at his shack in Sellia 2. [Caelid (Swamp of Aeonia)] Bring Gowry the Unalloyed Gold Needle 3.
