questSteps.title: Meet Gowry at his shack in Sellia
questSteps.text: Gowry can be found in his shack near the entrance to Sellia. He will request that you find an Unalloyed Gold Needle in the swamp and bring it to him in exchange for a secret about Sellia.

questSteps.title: Bring Gowry the Unalloyed Gold Needle
questSteps.text: Travel to the Swamp of Aeonia and defeat Commander O'Neil to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle.

questSteps.title: Return after Millicent’s line concludes
questSteps.text: If you aided Millicent, Gowry will lament her decision to remove the Unalloyed Gold Needle. You may now permanently kill him to obtain the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing. If you killed Millicent in Elphael, Gowry will already be dead, and the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing can be looted from his corpse.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
questSteps.text: Give the Needle to Gowry. Reload the area and speak to him to obtain the repaired Needle.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Church of the Plague)
questSteps.text: Travel to the Church of the Plague and give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle. If you immediately go back to Gowry after this point you can unlock additional dialogue and unlock his shop. Alternately, if you reload the area and speak to Millicent in the church once again, the next time you visit Gowry's Shack Gowry will be absent and Millicent will be there in his place.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* After giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis, return to Gowry and speak to him again. He will now have Pest Threads in his shop inventory. Purchase the spell to unlock additional dialogue about Millicent and Malenia.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
questSteps.text: Once Millicent arrives in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, return to Gowry to hear additional dialogue. He will ask you help the sisters defeat Millicent.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
questSteps.text: Complete the final part of Millicent's questline, by using one of the summon signs to either aid Millicent or defeat her.

merchant:knight-bernahl.description: Let me ask you something Are you here in the Lands Between to take up the fight? Does your faith in the guidance of grace hold firm, despite the collapse of the Golden Order?

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Limgrave (Warmaster's Shack)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Speaking to Bernahl unlocks the option to purchase Ashes of War from him, regardless of the answer to his question.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
questSteps.text: Speaking with Tanith and selecting "Join Volcano Manor" to receive the Drawing-Room Key, Bernahl will relocate to the eastern quarter of the manor, where Rya the Scout is also found.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
questSteps.text: After assassinating Old Knight Istvan, as commissioned in the first Letter from Volcano Manor, speaking to Bernahl unlocks the option to purchase the Ashes of War he used to sell in Limgrave and two new additions, Eruption and Assassin's Gambit.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
questSteps.text: After assassinating Rileigh the Idle, as commissioned in the second Letter from Volcano Manor, speaking to Bernahl prompts him to give the Letter to Bernahl to the Tarnished, inviting him to join forces against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm at the Fortified Manor of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Leyndell, Royal Capital (Fortified Manor, First Floor)
questSteps.location: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Fortified Manor, First Floor)
questSteps.text: Interacting with the invasion sign before the corpse holding Alberich's Set allows the Tarnished to fight alongside Bernahl against Vargram and Wilhelm. This assassination will reward the Tarnished with Vargram's Raging Wolf Set.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
questSteps.text: With the task fulfilled, returning to Bernahl prompts him to give Gelmir's Fury to the Tarnished. This will also unlock his summon sign in Crumbling Farum Azula.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
questSteps.text: After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, exhausting Bernahl's dialogue triggers his departure from Volcano Manor. His shop will still be accessible via the "Sword of Bernahl" left on his chair.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Crumbling Farum Azula (Dragon Temple Transept)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* If the Tarnished and Bernahl hunted down Vargram and Wilhelm in Leyndell, the recusant's summon sign will appear outside the Dragon Temple, to aid his brother in arms against the Godskin Duo.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Crumbling Farum Azula (Besides the Great Bridge)
questSteps.location: Crumbling Farum Azula (Besides the Great Bridge)
questSteps.text: Following the path to the north from the Great Bridge, Bernhal will invade the Tarnished before the tower with the chest containing the Old Lord's Talisman. When defeated, he drops the Blasphemous Claw.

questSteps.title: Survive Patches’s ambush in Murkwater Cave
questSteps.text: Pass through the golden fog into the boss room and loot the Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers from the treasure chest to trigger Patches to jump down from above. After reducing his health to 50%, he will stop attacking and grant the Grovel for Mercy gesture. He will now become available as a merchant after reloading the area. Continuing to attack him will cause him to become hostile again. If he gets your health low enough, he will grant the Extreme Repentance gesture. Using this will cause him to stop attacking again. *(Optional)* There will be another chest in his room after returning.

questSteps.title: Forgive Patches and open his shop
questSteps.text: Patches can be found in the entrance corridor after entering Tanith's service. After completing Tanith's first request, Patches will give you a request to kill Great-Horned Tragoth. Tragoth can be found in the Magma Wyrm Makar boss room in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Kill him and then return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue, then rest at a Site of Grace and speak to him again to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue.

questSteps.title: Find Patches again at Volcano Manor
questSteps.text: After you join the manor he relocates there as a vendor.

questSteps.title: Finish the Volcano Manor contracts
questSteps.text: The named contract targets must be done before Rykard; Patches’s own arc needs them complete.

questSteps.title: Find Patches wounded at the Shaded Castle
questSteps.text: Patches can be found in the hallway leading to Elemer of the Briar. Talk to him to receive the Dancer's Castanets. Offer the Dancer's Castanets to Tanith in Rykard's boss room. She will refuse them, however they will be removed from your inventory.

questSteps.title: Take Patches’s Dancer’s Castanets
questSteps.text: He asks you to carry them back to Lady Tanith at the manor.

questSteps.title: Patches — *(Optional)* Liurnia of the Lakes
questSteps.text: Patches can be found near the Scenic Isle Site of Grace. He will discuss Rya and the Abductor Virgin below the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Clearing the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber and returning to Patches will unlock new dialogue, as well as the Calm Down! gesture if not received in the previous step.

questSteps.title: Patches — *(Optional)* Mt. Gelmir
questSteps.text: From the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, go west past the siege tower and then north. Patches will advise you to follow a path of Glowstones leading to a ledge, which Patches will then kick you off.

questSteps.title: Patches — Murkwater Cave
questSteps.text: Return to Murkwater Cave and enter the boss room. Open the chest to trigger another fight with Patches. Attack him once to make him stop attacking, and he will give the Patches' Crouch gesture.

merchant:preceptor-seluvis.description: I don't know what it is the mistress sees in a provincial Tarnished like you, but since we have the misfortune of serving the same Lady, I ask that you kindly try not to drag us all down with you.

questSteps.title: Enter Ranni’s service and meet Seluvis at Seluvis’s Rise
questSteps.text: Three Sisters, after Caria Manor. He sells sorceries and wants a puppet errand.

questSteps.title: Take Seluvis’s potion and choose a target
questSteps.text: Visit Seluvis's Rise, south of Ranni's Rise, and speak to Seluvis. Agree to his request to obtain Seluvis's Potion.

questSteps.title: Buy out his puppet stock before Nokron
questSteps.text: If Ranni is not given the Amber Draught, Seluvis will die in the same way after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 1
questSteps.text: Follow Ranni the Witch's questline and join her service in Ranni's Rise. Speak to the projections of Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis, and then speak to Ranni once again.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:
questSteps.location: Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:
questSteps.text: Give Nepheli Loux the potion. In order to do this, you must have defeated the Omenkiller in the Village of the Albinaurics and Nepheli must be in the lower level of Roundtable Hold. You will obtain Nepheli Loux Puppet from Pidia, Carian Servant at the end of his questline. Give Dung Eater the potion. In order to do this, you must have obtained a Seedbed Curse, freed Dung Eater from his gaol, defeated his dark spirit in the Capital Outskirts, and made sure Dung Eater has returned to his gaol. You will be able to obtain Dung Eater Puppet from Seluvis after this.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 4
questSteps.text: Return to Seluvis and exhaust his dialogue, regardless of the option chosen in the previous step. His shop inventory will now be available.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 5
questSteps.text: Travel to the ruins north-east of Ranni's Rise and pass through the illusory floor. Go down the steps into the cellar and interact with the message saying "Seluvis' puppet. Do not touch."

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 6
questSteps.text: Return to Seluvis and select the "About your chambers" dialogue option. You will now be able to buy puppets from Seluvis in return for Starlight Shards. Buy any one of these puppets to continue.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 7
questSteps.text: Speak to Seluvis again and select the "About the scheme" dialogue option.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 8
questSteps.text: Obtain the Amber Starlight from Altus Plateau. This can be found in a small grotto north-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, north of the giant staircase that leads to the Tree Sentinel boss fight.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 9
questSteps.text: Return to Seluvis and select the "Give Amber Starlight" dialogue option to obtain the Magic Scorpion Charm.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 10
questSteps.text: Reload the area and speak to Seluvis to obtain the Amber Draught.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 11
questSteps.text: You may attempt to give the Amber Draught to Ranni. Doing so will lock Ranni's questline, and it can only be resumed by seeking Absolution at the Church of Vows. Talking to her three times after trying to give her the draught will cause her to instantly kill you.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 12
questSteps.text: Seluvis will now be dead. His Bell bearing and armour set can be looted from his body, which can also be interacted with to access the puppet shop. Pidia will also die at this stage.

merchant:sorceress-sellen.name: Sorceress Sellen

sections.heading: Questline (12 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Waypoint Ruins] Free Sellen from the Waypoint Ruins 2. Find Azur, the Primeval Sorcerer 3. Find Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway 4. Report both primeval sorcerers to Sellen 5. [Witchbane Ruins] Find Sellen’s true body at Witchbane Ruins 6. [Three Sisters] Revive Sellen in the Three Sisters puppet 7. Meet Witch-Hunter Jerren at Raya Lucaria 8. [Waypoint Ruins] Side with Sellen 9. Or side with Jerren 10. [Academy of Raya Lucaria] Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria 11. [Academy of Raya Lucaria] Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria 12.

questSteps.title: Free Sellen from the Waypoint Ruins
questSteps.text: Sellen can be found in the cellar of Waypoint Ruins after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head. Talk to Sellen and then select "I wish to learn glintstone sorceries" to receive the "Nod in Thought" Gesture, and to unlock her sorcery shop. *(Optional)* If the Radahn Festival has not commenced, Sellen will have dialogue about it if you have Seluvis's Introduction in your inventory. This is obtained by progressing Blaidd the Half-Wolf's questline and speaking to Seluvis about Nokron prior to initiating the Festival.

questSteps.title: Find Azur, the Primeval Sorcerer
questSteps.text: Mt. Gelmir, sealed cave behind the Hermit Village. Sellen’s first master.

questSteps.title: Find Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway
questSteps.text: Caelid. Break the illusory wall; the second primeval sorcerer.

questSteps.title: Report both primeval sorcerers to Sellen
questSteps.text: Tell her of Azur and Lusat and she asks you to meet her at the academy.

questSteps.title: Find Sellen’s true body at Witchbane Ruins
questSteps.text: After Starscourge Radahn has been defeated, talk to Sellen to learn that her true body is in Witchbane Ruins. Travel there and speak to the shackled Sellen to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone. Reload the area and return to find Castellan Jerren. In order for him to appear, you must have spoken to him in Redmane Castle after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

questSteps.title: Revive Sellen in the Three Sisters puppet
questSteps.text: Travel to the Three Sisters and go to the ruined structure north-east of Ranni's Rise. Roll or attack the ground to reveal a hidden staircase leading to a basement full of immobile puppets. Pass through the illusory wall on the far end of the room to find a puppet duplicate of Sellen. Interact with the puppet to insert Sellen's Primal Glintstone, resurrecting Sellen in her new body.

questSteps.title: Meet Witch-Hunter Jerren at Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: Jerren waits in the Debate Parlor, hunting the witch. Which side you take is final.

questSteps.title: Side with Sellen
questSteps.text: Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur, located beyond the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir, to obtain Comet Azur. Return to Sellen and select the "Show Azur's Sorcery" dialogue option. After listening to this dialogue, select the "Tell me your story" option, and then select "Let us journey together". Next, select "I have a favor to ask" to obtain the Sellian Sealbreaker. The Sellian Sealbreaker can be used to open a sealed tunnel in Sellia Hideaway, behind which is Primeval Sorcerer Lusat. Interact with him to receive Stars of Ruin.

questSteps.title: Or side with Jerren
questSteps.text: Take the Witch-Hunter’s side; Sellen is lost, and her spells and bell bearing go with her.

questSteps.title: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: There will now be two summon signs outside the door to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library; one red and one gold. To progress Sellen's questline, select the gold summon sign. You will be summoned as a co-operator to assist Sellen in defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren. Defeat Jerren to receive the Eccentric's Set. This step can only be completed if Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated.

questSteps.title: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: After defeating Jerren, Sellen can be found where Rennala is usually based. Speak to her to receive the Glintstone Kris. If you have not done so already, find Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway and speak to Sellen to select "Lusat's location" and receive Starlight Shards. It is also possible to obtain Azur and Lusat's armour sets by returning to their respective locations at this point.

questSteps.title: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: Reload the area after telling Sellen about Lusat. Sellen, now in the form of a Graven Mass, can be found to the side of the room. The Witch's Glintstone Crown can be obtained here. It is still possible to purchase sorceries from her and to offer her scrolls.

sections.text: 1. [Village of the Albinaurics] Albus — Village of the Albinaurics

questSteps.title: Albus — Village of the Albinaurics
questSteps.text: Albus can be found, disguised as a pot, at the top of the slope past the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, near the Depraved Perfumer. Roll or attack the pot to break the illusion and reveal Albus. Exhaust his dialogue to obtain the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), which can be shown to Latenna the Albinauric at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack in order to progress her questline.

npc:alexander.location: Stuck in the hole south of Stormhill.
npc:alexander.description: I am Alexander, also known as the Iron Fist. And as you can see, I'm stuck here.

questSteps.title: Blackguard Big Boggart — Liurnia of the Lakes (Boilprawn Shack)
questSteps.text: Head north-west from the Site of Grace to find Rya the Scout inside a gazebo and talk to her. Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select Give me the necklace and then Deal to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. After purchasing the item, he'll start selling an infinite supply of Boiled Prawns.

questSteps.title: Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau
questSteps.text: After resting at a Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, Boggart will move to the outer moat along the northern wall of Leyndell, Royal Capital in the Capital Outskirts (due west from the Capital Rampart Site of Grace). You may now purchase an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs. Exhaust Boggart's dialogue about Dung Eater. After freeing Dung Eater from his cell in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds, Boggart will have some additional dialogue.

questSteps.title: Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau
questSteps.text: After hearing Boggart's final piece of dialogue about Dung Eater, warning you that Dung Eater is lurking nearby, reload the area to find Boggart bound to a chair. Speak to him to trigger an invasion from Dung Eater. Defeat Dung Eater and return to Boggart, who is now dead. Loot his equipment, as well as the Seedbed Curse.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Limgrave (Mistwood Ruins)
questSteps.text: Blaidd can be heard howling in Mistwood. After hearing the howl, speak to Merchant Kalé and select "About the howling in Mistwood." This will unlock the "Finger Snap" gesture. Use Finger Snap at the Mistwood Ruins near the ruined tower adjacent to the slumbering Runebear to cause Blaidd to jump down. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Limgrave (Forlorn Hound Evergaol)
questSteps.text: Enter the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in Limgrave and defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. Blaidd will be available as a summonable cooperator during this fight. After defeating Darriwil, Blaidd appears outside the Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Speak with him to earn a Somber Smithing Stone [2].

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Liurnia of the Lakes (Ranni's Rise)
questSteps.text: After entering Ranni's service, a projection of Blaidd appears in Ranni's Rise and offers dialogue. This step is skipped if Starscourge Radahn has already been defeated.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Siofra River
questSteps.text: Blaidd moves to the base of an enormous ruined bridge on the bank of the Siofra River, located between the Siofra River Bank and Worshipper's Woods Sites of Grace. He will suggest asking Preceptor Seluvis about how to reach Nokron, Eternal City. This step is skipped if Starscourge Radahn has already been defeated. (Optional) After speaking to Seluvis about Nokron and then speaking to Sorceress Sellen, return to Blaidd and exhaust his dialogue. He will move to Redmane Castle afterwards.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Caelid (Redmane Castle)
questSteps.text: Blaidd will appear in the Redmane Castle Plaza when the Radahn Festival begins. He also appears as an optional summon in the fight against Starscourge Radahn.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Caelid (Wailing Dunes)
questSteps.text: (Optional) After defeating Radahn, speak to Blaidd next to the Starscourge Radahn Site of Grace. He will mark the location of the *Starfall Crater*—entrance to Nokron, Eternal City—on your map.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Limgrave (Forlorn Hound Evergaol)
questSteps.text: (Optional) Interact with the Forlorn Hound Evergaol to speak to Blaidd. Either choose to release him or leave him.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Liurnia of the Lakes (Three Sisters)
questSteps.text: After giving Ranni the Dark Moon Ring, Blaidd will appear as a hostile NPC outside Ranni's Rise, surrounded by the bodies of slain Black Knife Assassins. Defeat him to receive his armor and weapon.

questSteps.title: Blaidd — Liurnia of the Lakes (Kingsrealm Ruins)
questSteps.text: (Optional) Speak to War Counselor Iji to deliver the news of Blaidd's death.

sections.text: 1. [*(Optional)* Limgrave] Help Yura against Bloody Finger Nerijus 2. [Mountaintops of the Giants] Help him again at the Liurnia invasion 3. [Altus Plateau] Find Yura wounded at the Second Church of Marika 4. Find Shabriri wearing Yura’s body at Zamor Ruins 5. [Liurnia of the Lakes] Bloody Finger Hunter Yura — Liurnia of the Lakes

questSteps.title: Help Yura against Bloody Finger Nerijus
questSteps.text: The following two steps can be completed in either order. His dialogue will vary depending on where he is met first. Yura can be found under a fallen Azula ruin near the Seaside Ruins site of grace, southwest of Agheel Lake. Exhaust his dialogue and his summon sign will appear in Agheel Lake to assist against Flying Dragon Agheel. Speak to him again after defeating Agheel for further dialogue. Enter the Murkwater River, the ravine north of Agheel Lake, and head towards Murkwater Cave. Bloody Finger Nerijus will invade you. After fighting Nerijus for a while, Yura appears to assist you.

questSteps.title: Help him again at the Liurnia invasion
questSteps.text: Once you travel to the Mountaintops of the Giants, Yura's quest will be locked regardless of which steps have been completed. Shabriri will be waiting near the Zamor Ruins site of grace, in possession of Yura's reanimated body. The Nagakiba can be found on the ground in whichever location he would have been at, depending on how far into his questline you have progressed.

questSteps.title: Find Yura wounded at the Second Church of Marika
questSteps.text: Travel to the Second Church of Marika, located northwest of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace, where Yura lies on the ground. Speak to him, and then pick up the Nagakiba. Shortly after, Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger will invade. Defeat her to receive Eleonora's Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear.

questSteps.title: Find Shabriri wearing Yura’s body at Zamor Ruins
questSteps.text: The Mountaintops. Yura is gone; Shabriri offers the Frenzied Flame path. Kill Shabriri for Yura’s set.

questSteps.title: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura — Liurnia of the Lakes
questSteps.text: A red summon sign can be found northeast of the Raya Lucaria Main Gate. Interact with it to assist Yura in defeating Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin. After defeating the foe, Yura can be found on the bridge near where the summon sign was. Speak to him to receive a Smithing Stone [5].

questSteps.title: Free Boc from the illusory tree in Limgrave
questSteps.text: Boc can be found in the form of a small tree near Gatefront Ruins. He will call out until you attack or roll into the tree, reversing the illusion and causing him to transform back.

questSteps.title: Meet Boc at the Coastal Cave entrance
questSteps.text: Boc can be found lying on the ground beside the Site of Grace at the start of the dungeon. Defeating the Demi-Human Chief dual boss of the area will reward you with the Sewing Needle, which can be given to Boc.

questSteps.title: Give Boc the Gold Sewing Needle
questSteps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (East Raya Lucaria Gate)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Boc can be given the Gold Sewing Needle, which allows him to alter Demigod equipment. He can be given the item in subsequent steps of his questline instead if this step is missed.

questSteps.title: Hear Boc doubt his looks in Leyndell
questSteps.text: If Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated, Boc will ask for a Larval Tear. Giving him a Larval Tear will move him to Raya Lucaria Grand Library. He will appear kneeling on the ground in human form, unresponsive. Upon reloading the area, he will be dead. Refusing to give him a Larval Tear will unlock the dialogue option "What do you really think?". Selecting this option will cause him to die just outside Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Instead of selecting either option, using Prattling Pate "You're Beautiful" in front of him will prevent him from dying.

questSteps.title: Reassure Boc with the Prattling Pate “You’re Beautiful”
questSteps.text: The pate keeps him content as your seamster. This is the good end for the line.

questSteps.title: Or send Boc to seek rebirth
questSteps.text: Giving him a Larval Tear ends the seamster line and leaves him changed. The two outcomes are exclusive.

questSteps.title: Boc the Seamster — Liurnia of the Lakes (Lake-facing Cliffs)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Boc will be next to the Site of Grace. He will offer to make alterations to your equipment free of charge.

questSteps.title: Boc the Seamster — Altus Plateau (Altus Highway Junction)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Boc will ask if he can call you Lord at this point if he has already been given the Gold Sewing Needle. Agreeing will unlock the "My Lord" gesture.

npc:boc-s-mother.name: Boc's Mother
npc:boc-s-mother.description: Boc's mother was a highly skilled demi-human seamstress whose dedication to her craft left a lasting impact on her son.

npc:brother-corhyn.name: Brother Corhyn
npc:brother-corhyn.description: I teach incantations, the strength granted us by the Two Fingers, and explore the secrets of the Golden Order. So that one day, if a Tarnished of the Roundtable Hold should become Elden Lord, I might counsel them, ensuring order regains its proper form, righting rule over men.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Corhyn can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold, where he will offer to teach you several Incantations. His shop inventory can be increased by giving him prayerbooks.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After reaching Altus Plateau, Corhyn will express an interest in searching for Goldmask.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Altus Plateau
questSteps.text: Corhyn can be found north of the the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace. Talking to him here after finding Goldmask will allow you to reveal Goldmask's location to him.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Altus Plateau (Forest-Spanning Greatbridge)
questSteps.text: Corhyn will now appear next to Goldmask. The pair will now travel together.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Leyndell, Royal Capital
questSteps.text: Corhyn and Goldmask can be found near the colosseum. Corhyn will express frustration at Goldmask's current obsession with Radagon. After using Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue past the lift near Erdtree Sanctuary, talk to Goldmask to reveal Radagon's secret and then talk to Corhyn.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Mountaintops of the Giants
questSteps.text: Corhyn and Goldmask will move to the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins. Corhyn can be offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, which will affect the end of his questline. If offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, Corhyn will remain in this location after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade after Goldmask leaves. After reloading the area, he will have disappeared, leaving behind his flail, robe, and bell bearing.

questSteps.title: Brother Corhyn — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
questSteps.text: If Corhyn was not offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, he will appear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, close to the giant Bolt of Gransax after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. After exhausting his dialogue and resting at a Site of Grace, he will be gone.

questSteps.title: Meet D at Summonwater Village
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* D can first be encountered close to Saintsbridge in Limgrave. He will warn you about Summonwater Village, which is overrun by Those Who Live in Death, including a Tibia Mariner. *(Optional)* After defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village, D will appear appear in the village and offer to introduce you to Gurranq.

questSteps.title: Speak with D at the Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: D will appear in Roundtable Hold regardless of whether he was encountered in Limgrave. If you have at least one Deathroot and did not complete step 1, he will offer to introduce you to Gurranq. D will begin selling Incantations after you have met Gurranq. He will also become available as a cooperator in Black Knight Catacombs as well as against the Tibia Mariner in Liurnia of the Lakes. After progressing Fia's questline, the Weathered Dagger can be given to D. After reloading the area, Fia can be found standing over D's corpse in a previously inaccessible room in Roundtable Hold.

questSteps.title: Decide whether to hand D the Weathered Dagger
questSteps.text: Fia’s dagger. Giving it to D advances Fia but costs D his life.

questSteps.title: Meet D’s brother in Nokron / Deeproot
questSteps.text: The surviving twin inherits D’s armour and hunts Fia.

questSteps.title: Talk to Dung Eater at the Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After touching any Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, the Dung Eater will appear in the western quarter of the Roundtable Hold, past Gideon's study. Talk to him with at least one Seedbed Curse in inventory to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "There's something you should know" to warn you of the danger of the new arrival.

questSteps.title: Open his cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
questSteps.text: (Optional) If you don't intend to follow his questline, you can select Administer Seluvis' Potion to turn the Dung Eater into a puppet. After his screams have ceased, you're free to kill him to collect his loot without failing the Preceptor's questline. After collecting all five Seedbed Curses, return to him and select Use the Seedbed Curse, then collect the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse from his body. Reloading the area, you'll be able to collect the Omen Set too.

questSteps.title: Defeat him at the Leyndell moat invasion
questSteps.text: Visit the moat to the south-east below the capital's ramparts to meet again with Boggart, who now sells an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs too. Talk to him and select About the Dung Eater. Reload the area to find Boggart moribund and, after talking to him, collect Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball, and Blackguard's Iron Mask from his cadaver. Shortly after, the Dung Eater will invade you and, once defeated, will drop his Sword of Milos.

questSteps.title: Collect five Seedbed Curses
questSteps.text: Drop down the open grate to the left exiting the room and follow the path past the Miranda Flowers to reach the Dung Eater's cell, which is guarded by a Large Fingercreeper hidden underground and some smaller ones hanging from the ceiling. Open the cell and talk to him, selecting Leave your gaol!.

questSteps.title: Give him the Seedbed Curses for the Mending Rune
questSteps.text: Hand over five curses and he relents, giving the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.

questSteps.title: Or pour Seluvis’s potion into him
questSteps.text: The puppet fork. It forecloses the Fell Curse rune but yields the Dung Eater puppet.

questSteps.title: Use the Fell Curse rune after the Elden Beast
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* The Dung Eater can now be summoned to aid you against Mohg, the Omen.

Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select Give me the necklace and then Deal to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. questSteps.text: The Dung Eater will have now returned to the Hold. Talking to him, he'll instruct you to defile his corpse with the Seedbed Curse. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "About the spirits' voices".

questSteps.text: Gostoc can be found in the gatehouse to the left of the main gate. He will offer you the choice of taking the main gate or using the side entrance. Choosing "No, I'll use the main entrance" will cause the main gate to open when you approach it. This will not prevent you from taking the side entrance, however.

questSteps.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Upon entering a dark room in the western section of the castle, Gostoc will close the door, locking you in with a Banished Knight enemy. To leave, grab the Rusty Key and return to the door to open it. If you die in this room, you can return to it and loot the item without being locked in again. *(Optional)* Gostoc will now appear in several locations around the dungeon. Speaking to him in one of these locations for the first time will reward you with a Grace Mimic. The locations are as follows: Stormveil Cliffside.

questSteps.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle (Godrick's arena)
questSteps.text: After defeating Godrick the Grafted, Gostoc will appear in the room. After exhausting his dialogue his shop will be open once again. He will also stop stealing your Runes if you skipped the previous part.

questSteps.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle (Throne Room)
questSteps.text: After completing Nepheli Loux's questline, Gostoc will appear in the back of the throne room. After exhausting his dialogue, his shop will become available again, now with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone available to purchase.

npc:gowry.name: Gowry
npc:gowry.description: The rotting sickness that afflicts Millicent has no cure. When the Erdtree flourished, even the demigods could not stave off its effects, despite their nigh godhood.

questSteps.title: Meet Gowry at his shack in Sellia
questSteps.text: Gowry can be found in his shack near the entrance to Sellia. He will request that you find an Unalloyed Gold Needle in the swamp and bring it to him in exchange for a secret about Sellia.

questSteps.title: Bring Gowry the Unalloyed Gold Needle
questSteps.text: Travel to the Swamp of Aeonia and defeat Commander O'Neil to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle.

questSteps.title: Return after Millicent’s line concludes
questSteps.text: If you aided Millicent, Gowry will lament her decision to remove the Unalloyed Gold Needle. You may now permanently kill him to obtain the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing. If you killed Millicent in Elphael, Gowry will already be dead, and the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing can be looted from his corpse.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
questSteps.text: Give the Needle to Gowry. Reload the area and speak to him to obtain the repaired Needle.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Church of the Plague)
questSteps.text: Travel to the Church of the Plague and give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle. If you immediately go back to Gowry after this point you can unlock additional dialogue and unlock his shop. Alternately, if you reload the area and speak to Millicent in the church once again, the next time you visit Gowry's Shack Gowry will be absent and Millicent will be there in his place.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* After giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis, return to Gowry and speak to him again. He will now have Pest Threads in his shop inventory. Purchase the spell to unlock additional dialogue about Millicent and Malenia.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
questSteps.text: Once Millicent arrives in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, return to Gowry to hear additional dialogue. He will ask you help the sisters defeat Millicent.

questSteps.title: Gowry — Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
questSteps.text: Complete the final part of Millicent's questline, by using one of the summon signs to either aid Millicent or defeat her.

questSteps.title: Reach the Bestial Sanctum and meet Gurranq
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Speak to D, Hunter of the Dead, after obtaining a Deathroot and he will advise you to visit Gurranq. This can either be done at the start of D's questline in Limgrave, or in Roundtable Hold.

questSteps.title: Feed him Deathroot from the Tibia Mariners and elsewhere
questSteps.text: Travel to the Bestial Sanctum at the north-eastern point of Caelid. The sending gate marked on your map by D if you showed him a Deathroot will lead you straight there. Speak to Gurranq. If you have at least one Deathroot, Gurranq will give you a Clawmark Seal and Beast Eye. The Beast Eye will notify you whenever you are close to another Deathroot.

questSteps.title: Finish the Deathroot and face him
questSteps.text: After giving him the ninth Deathroot, he will give you an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone before disappearing.

questSteps.title: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman — step 3
questSteps.text: Hand over each Deathroot you find to Gurranq in exchange for rewards. After you have given him four Deathroot, reload the area and Gurranq will attack you. After depleting 30% of Gurranq's health, he will be subdued- speak to him and reload the area so that he returns to his original position.

questSteps.title: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman — Gurranq will reappear at the end of Crumbling Farum Azula, under the name Beast Clergyman. After reducing his health to 50% he will enter phase 2, under the name Maliketh, the Black Blade.
questSteps.location: Gurranq will reappear at the end of Crumbling Farum Azula, under the name Beast Clergyman. After reducing his health to 50% he will enter phase 2, under the name Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Likewise, killing Gurranq in the Bestial Sanctum will not affect the fight against Maliketh. Maliketh will have unique dialogue if you complete Gurranq's questline before fighting him in Crumbling Farum Azula.

sections.heading: Questline (7 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Jagged Peak] Find Igon on the path up the Jagged Peak 2. Meet him again at the peak’s edge 3. Summon Igon at the Bayle fog gate 4. Kill Bayle the Dread 5. questSteps.title: Find Igon on the path up the Jagged Peak
questSteps.text: After Bayle the Dread appears in his arena, Igon can be summoned to fight him. His summon sign is right in front of the fog wall (on your very first fight against Bayle, the summon sign won't appear until the boss spawns).

questSteps.title: Meet him again at the peak’s edge
questSteps.text: He is spent but still points you at Bayle. His summon sign appears once the boss does.

questSteps.title: Summon Igon at the Bayle fog gate
questSteps.text: The sign is inside the arena to the left. Summoning him is optional for the kill but required for his set and bell bearing.

questSteps.title: Kill Bayle the Dread
questSteps.text: Bayle drops the Heart of Bayle; Igon’s revenge is fulfilled if he was summoned.

questSteps.title: Take Igon’s Harpoon where he fell
questSteps.text: After the fight, collect his harpoon and the Dragon Hunter’s Great Katana from the summit.

questSteps.title: Igon — Gravesite Plain
questSteps.text: Find Igon by following his screams; he is on the floor near the Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace outside the Dragon's Pit. Talk to him until you exhaust his dialogue.

questSteps.title: Igon — Foot of the Jagged Peak
questSteps.text: After climbing the Jagged Peak and defeating the Jagged Peak Drake he starts screaming again, he is in the middle of the road that advances to the next area. Exhaust his dialogue until he gives you Igon's Furled Finger and asks you to summon him.

questSteps.text: Interacting with the invasion sign before the corpse holding Alberich's Set allows the Tarnished to fight alongside Bernahl against Vargram and Wilhelm. This assassination will reward the Tarnished with Vargram's Raging Wolf Set.

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)

questSteps.title: Knight Bernahl — Crumbling Farum Azula (Dragon Temple Transept)

questSteps.location: Crumbling Farum Azula (Besides the Great Bridge)

questSteps.title: Meet Diallos at the Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: (Optional) Diallos can be found in Roundtable Hold upon the player's first visit. He will ask you to look out for his servant, Lanya, who has gone missing.

questSteps.title: Hear him out about Lanya
questSteps.text: He is searching for the servant he lost and does not know where she has gone.

questSteps.title: Find Diallos at the Village of the Albinaurics
questSteps.text: Liurnia. He has followed a lead and is out of his depth.

questSteps.title: Follow him to Jarburg
questSteps.text: After progressing the Jar-Bairn's questline, Diallos will relocate to Jarburg in Liurnia of the Lakes. After resting at a Site of Grace five times, return to Jarburg to find Diallos dying. Speak to him and then reload the area to obtain Diallos's Mask and Hoslow's Petal Whip.

questSteps.title: Help defend Jarburg from the poachers
questSteps.text: Diallos stands with the jars against the night raid.

questSteps.title: Find Diallos wounded and take his mask

questSteps.title: Knight Diallos — Roundtable Hold

questSteps.title: Knight Diallos — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor}
questSteps.text: After joining the Recusants, Diallos will appear in the drawing room in Volcano Manor. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy or completing one of Tanith's requests, speak to Diallos again and exhaust his dialogue.

npc:lacrima.name: Lacrima
npc:lacrima.description: Lacrima is a faerie cat that appears in stories shared by glintstone sorcerers at Raya Lucaria.

npc:lanya.name: Lanya
npc:lanya.description: She is a servant of House Hoslow and childhood companion of Diallos Hoslow. Described by Diallos as being "fickle as the wind," she has a habit of running off to unknown places, frequently requiring him to search for her whereabouts. She would eventually meet her fate in the middle of one of her disappearances, having been murdered by an unspecified Recusant of Volcano Manor, and her body was left in a pool of blood at the northern edge of Academy Gate Town.

questSteps.title: Melina — Stranded Graveyard
questSteps.text: After fighting the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, Melina and Torrent appear during a cutscene. Melina grants the Flask of Crimson Tears and Flask of Cerulean Tears before departing.

questSteps.title: Melina — Sites of Grace (Limgrave)
questSteps.text: After leaving the Stranded Graveyard, activate and rest at either the Agheel Lake North or Gatefront Ruins Sites of Grace. A cutscene will play and Melina will offer an accord. Alternatively, activate at any two Sites of Grace in the overworld and then rest at one of the following eight Sites of Grace: Agheel Lake North, Agheel Lake South, Bridge of Sacrifice, Church of Elleh, Gatefront Ruins, Seaside Ruins, Stormhill Shack, or Third Church of Marika. *(Optional)* If you refuse her accord, you cannot enter Leyndell, Royal Capital, even with two Great Runes.

questSteps.title: Melina — *(Optional)* Sites of Grace
questSteps.text: Melina may appear when you rest at any Site of Grace, offering the dialogue options "The Rays of Grace" and "Melina's Goal". Note: these options will no longer be available once you progress to the next step. Melina offers to share the words of Queen Marika when the player rests at one of the following Sites of Grace: Church of Pilgrimage, First Church of Marika, Grand Lift of Dectus, Minor Erdtree Church, Outer Wall Battleground, Queen's Bedchamber, and Third Church of Marika. Select "Talk to Melina" and accept to hear them.

questSteps.title: Melina — Sites of Grace
questSteps.text: Rest at any Site of Grace outside Limgrave or fight Margit, the Fell Omen at least once to trigger another conversation in which Melina extends an invitation to the Roundtable Hold. Accepting this invite is mandatory for accessing Leyndell, Royal Capital later in the game.

questSteps.title: Melina — *(Optional)* Sites of Grace
questSteps.text: After progressing Boc the Seamster's questline, Melina may appear to discuss him. If Boc moves to the East Raya Lucaria Gate, Melina will appear there to ask about him. If Boc moves to the Altus Highway Junction, Melina will appear there to ask about him again.

questSteps.title: Melina — *(Optional)* Sites of Grace (Altus Plateau or Capital Outskirts)
questSteps.location: *(Optional)* Sites of Grace (Altus Plateau or Capital Outskirts)
questSteps.text: Speak to Melina at any Site of Grace on the Altus Plateau or in the Capital Outskirts. This step is missed if the player enters Leyndell, Royal Capital.

questSteps.title: Melina — Leyndell, Royal Capital
questSteps.text: Resting at a Site of Grace in Leyndell will trigger another interaction with Melina, after which she will leave you. Her dialogue options at various Sites of Grace will be temporarily unavailable. Defeat Morgott, the Omen King. *(Optional)* Melina may be summoned as a cooperator by activating her summon sign outside Morgott's boss room. Approach the entrance to the Erdtree, turn back, and rest at the Elden Throne Site of Grace. Melina will appear and, after some dialogue, give you the Rold Medallion.

questSteps.title: Melina — *(Ending A)* Mountaintops of the Giants
questSteps.text: After defeating the Fire Giant and resting at the Forge of the Giants, you may talk to Melina. Speak to her and respond "I'm Ready" to commit the cardinal sin. Melina awakens the Giants' Flame, becomes its kindling, and burns the Erdtree. The player collapses and awakens in Crumbling Farum Azula. Note: this ends Melina's questline, as her spirit. You will not be able to hear any dialogue you may have missed.

questSteps.title: Melina — *(Ending B)* Frenzied Flame Proscription
questSteps.text: Visit the Frenzied Flame Proscription and interact with the Three Fingers. Melina will appear at the next Site of Grace you rest at and will leave you permanently. Note: this action cannot be reversed by using Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows or inserting Miquella's Needle at Dragonlord Placidusax. You will not be able to hear any dialogue you may have missed. Note: you will gain the option "Listen to the flames" when resting at the Forge of the Giants Site of Grace, allowing progression to Crumbling Farum Azula.

questSteps.title: Get the Unalloyed Gold Needle from Commander O’Neil
questSteps.location: Caelid (Swamp of Aeonia and Gowry's Shack)
questSteps.text: Defeat Commander O'Niel to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle and bring it to Gowry. Reload the area and speak to Gowry again to obtain the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle.

questSteps.title: Cure Millicent at the Church of the Plague
questSteps.text: Give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle, then rest at the Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.

questSteps.title: Meet Millicent at Erdtree-Gazing Hill
questSteps.text: Find Millicent on a hill north of the Erdtree Gazing Hill Site of Grace. Go to the Shaded Castle and find the Valkyrie's Prosthesis in a treasure chest. Return to Millicent and give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis. Millicent will now be available as a summon for the following bosses: Godskin Apostle (Windmill Heights), Draconic Tree Sentinel (Capital Outskirts), Black Blade Kindred (Forbidden Lands).

questSteps.title: Bring her the Valkyrie’s Prosthesis
questSteps.text: After defeating the Godskin Apostle, reload and speak to Millicent near the Site of Grace of the battle and exhaust her dialogue.

questSteps.title: Aid her at Dominula and the Godskin Apostle
questSteps.text: Windmill Village. Her gold summon sign sits by the Godskin Apostle; fight beside her, then talk to her.

questSteps.title: Meet Millicent at the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins
questSteps.text: Find Millicent beside the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.

questSteps.title: Meet Millicent at the Elphael Prayer Room
questSteps.text: Find Millicent next to the Prayer Room Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue. *(Optional)* Speaking to Gowry at this point will cause him to provide new dialogue explaining the next part of the questline.

questSteps.title: Aid Millicent at Elphael (gold sign)
questSteps.text: After defeating the Putrid Tree Spirit there will be two summon signs on the right ledge above the Scarlet Rot pool, both very close to each other. Selecting the gold summon sign will send you into Millicent's world to help her fight off her four sisters: Mary, Eldest Sister; Maureen, Second Sister; Amy, Third Sister; Polyanna, Youngest Sister. Doing so will reward you with the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia. After the fight, find Millicent lying beside the poison pool and speak to her to end her quest.

questSteps.title: Challenge Millicent at Elphael (red sign)
questSteps.text: The red summon sign makes her an enemy. You get her prosthesis; you lose the needle and the insignia.

questSteps.title: Millicent — Caelid (Swamp of Aeonia)
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Millicent can invade in the south-eastern part of the Swamp of Aeonia.

questSteps.title: Millicent — Caelid (Gowry's Shack)
questSteps.text: Return to Gowry's Shack and exhaust Millicent's dialogue.

npc:miquella-of-the-haligtree.name: Miquella of the Haligtree
npc:miquella-of-the-haligtree.description: Miquella the Kind, also known as Miquella of the Haligtree, Empyrean Miquella, and the Unalloyed, is a Remembrance Boss. He is an Empyrean and a son of Queen Marika the Eternal and King Consort Radagon. He is the older twin brother of Malenia, and together they are known as the Twin Prodigies (天賦の双子, Tenpu no Futago). His other self is St. Trina, whom he divested and cast into the depths of the Stone Coffin Fissure. He is encountered at the Gate of Divinity atop Enir-Ilim in the Realm of Shadow, where he fights alongside Radahn, Consort of Miquella.

questSteps.title: Survive Patches’s ambush in Murkwater Cave
questSteps.text: Pass through the golden fog into the boss room and loot the Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers from the treasure chest to trigger Patches to jump down from above. After reducing his health to 50%, he will stop attacking and grant the Grovel for Mercy gesture. He will now become available as a merchant after reloading the area. Continuing to attack him will cause him to become hostile again. If he gets your health low enough, he will grant the Extreme Repentance gesture. Using this will cause him to stop attacking again. *(Optional)* There will be another chest in his room after returning.

questSteps.title: Forgive Patches and open his shop
questSteps.text: Patches can be found in the entrance corridor after entering Tanith's service. After completing Tanith's first request, Patches will give you a request to kill Great-Horned Tragoth. Tragoth can be found in the Magma Wyrm Makar boss room in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Kill him and then return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue, then rest at a Site of Grace and speak to him again to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue.

questSteps.title: Find Patches again at Volcano Manor
questSteps.text: After you join the manor he relocates there as a vendor.

questSteps.title: Finish the Volcano Manor contracts
questSteps.text: The named contract targets must be done before Rykard; Patches’s own arc needs them complete.

questSteps.title: Find Patches wounded at the Shaded Castle
questSteps.text: Patches can be found in the hallway leading to Elemer of the Briar. Talk to him to receive the Dancer's Castanets. Offer the Dancer's Castanets to Tanith in Rykard's boss room. She will refuse them, however they will be removed from your inventory.

questSteps.title: Take Patches’s Dancer’s Castanets
questSteps.text: He asks you to carry them back to Lady Tanith at the manor.

questSteps.title: Patches — *(Optional)* Liurnia of the Lakes
questSteps.text: Patches can be found near the Scenic Isle Site of Grace. He will discuss Rya and the Abductor Virgin below the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Clearing the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber and returning to Patches will unlock new dialogue, as well as the Calm Down! gesture if not received in the previous step.

questSteps.title: Patches — *(Optional)* Mt. Gelmir
questSteps.text: From the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, go west past the siege tower and then north. Patches will advise you to follow a path of Glowstones leading to a ledge, which Patches will then kick you off.

questSteps.title: Patches — Murkwater Cave
questSteps.text: Return to Murkwater Cave and enter the boss room. Open the chest to trigger another fight with Patches. Attack him once to make him stop attacking, and he will give the Patches' Crouch gesture.

questSteps.title: Pidia Carian Servant — Carian Manor
questSteps.text: If Ranni the Witch has not been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player can find Pidia on the second floor of the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace. However, he can only be reached from the building's rooftop. To gain access to him, the player must travel to the Three Sisters and follow the clifftop above Caria Manor southwest. Once there, the player can descend several platforms in order to safely reach the Manor rooftop below. When first talking with Pidia, he will offer to sell you a number of rare items from his storeroom.

questSteps.title: Pidia Carian Servant — Carian Manor
questSteps.text: If Ranni the Witch has been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player will hear Pidia crying out in pain when approaching his location. Upon reaching him, the player will find Pidia lying dead, surrounded by the puppet soldiers he once maintained. The player can loot Pidia's Bell Bearing from his corpse, as well as one of two puppets depending upon certain conditions. If the player has already given Seluvis' Potion to Nepheli Loux, Pidia will drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet.

npc:preceptor-seluvis.description: I don't know what it is the mistress sees in a provincial Tarnished like you, but since we have the misfortune of serving the same Lady, I ask that you kindly try not to drag us all down with you.

questSteps.title: Enter Ranni’s service and meet Seluvis at Seluvis’s Rise
questSteps.text: Three Sisters, after Caria Manor. He sells sorceries and wants a puppet errand.

questSteps.title: Take Seluvis’s potion and choose a target
questSteps.text: Visit Seluvis's Rise, south of Ranni's Rise, and speak to Seluvis. Agree to his request to obtain Seluvis's Potion.

questSteps.title: Buy out his puppet stock before Nokron
questSteps.text: If Ranni is not given the Amber Draught, Seluvis will die in the same way after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 1
questSteps.text: Follow Ranni the Witch's questline and join her service in Ranni's Rise. Speak to the projections of Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis, and then speak to Ranni once again.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:
questSteps.location: Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:
questSteps.text: Give Nepheli Loux the potion. In order to do this, you must have defeated the Omenkiller in the Village of the Albinaurics and Nepheli must be in the lower level of Roundtable Hold. You will obtain Nepheli Loux Puppet from Pidia, Carian Servant at the end of his questline. Give Dung Eater the potion. In order to do this, you must have obtained a Seedbed Curse, freed Dung Eater from his gaol, defeated his dark spirit in the Capital Outskirts, and made sure Dung Eater has returned to his gaol. You will be able to obtain Dung Eater Puppet from Seluvis after this.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 4
questSteps.text: Return to Seluvis and exhaust his dialogue, regardless of the option chosen in the previous step. His shop inventory will now be available.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 5
questSteps.text: Travel to the ruins north-east of Ranni's Rise and pass through the illusory floor. Go down the steps into the cellar and interact with the message saying "Seluvis' puppet. Do not touch."

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 6
questSteps.text: Return to Seluvis and select the "About your chambers" dialogue option. You will now be able to buy puppets from Seluvis in return for Starlight Shards. Buy any one of these puppets to continue.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 7
questSteps.text: Speak to Seluvis again and select the "About the scheme" dialogue option.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 8
questSteps.text: Obtain the Amber Starlight from Altus Plateau. This can be found in a small grotto north-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, north of the giant staircase that leads to the Tree Sentinel boss fight.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 9
questSteps.text: Return to Seluvis and select the "Give Amber Starlight" dialogue option to obtain the Magic Scorpion Charm.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 10
questSteps.text: Reload the area and speak to Seluvis to obtain the Amber Draught.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 11
questSteps.text: You may attempt to give the Amber Draught to Ranni. Doing so will lock Ranni's questline, and it can only be resumed by seeking Absolution at the Church of Vows. Talking to her three times after trying to give her the draught will cause her to instantly kill you.

questSteps.title: Preceptor Seluvis — step 12
questSteps.text: Seluvis will now be dead. His Bell bearing and armour set can be looted from his body, which can also be interacted with to access the puppet shop. Pidia will also die at this stage.

npc:puppet-master.description: Female human NPC who may have been involved in the death of Pidia, Carian Servant.

npc:queen-marika.name: Queen Marika
npc:queen-marika.description: Now, Queen Marika the Eternal is nowhere to be found, and in the Night of the Black Knives Godwyn the Golden was first to perish. Soon, Marika's offspring, demigods all, claimed the shards of the Elden Ring. The mad taint of their newfound strength triggered the Shattering.

npc:queen-marika-the-eternal.name: Queen Marika the Eternal
npc:queen-marika-the-eternal.description: Queen Marika the Eternal is the central character in the world of Elden Ring. She is the divine ruler of the Lands Between and the current vessel of the Elden Ring, a god in truth. She grew the towering Erdtree, concealed the Realm of Shadow, and established the Golden Order. By the time of the game's events, she has long vanished from public view, though her influence persists through the Grace of Gold. Her Demigod offspring became shardbearers when they claimed Great Runes that dispersed when she shattered the Elden Ring.

npc:ranni-the-witch.name: Ranni the Witch
npc:ranni-the-witch.description: I am the witch Ranni. I stole Death long ago, and search now for the dark path.

sections.heading: Questline (15 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Ranni's Rise] Enter Ranni’s service at Ranni’s Rise 2. [Caelid] Open Nokron — defeat Starscourge Radahn 3. [Nokron, Eternal City] Retrieve the Fingerslayer Blade 4. [Three Sisters] Invert the Carian Study Hall 5. [Lake of Rot] Kill Astel and place the Dark Moon Ring 6. Finish the Elden Lord path, then summon Ranni 7. Find Blaidd at Ranni’s Rise 8. Hear Iji’s last counsel 9. [*(Optional)* Church of Elleh] Ranni The Witch — *(Optional)* Church of Elleh 10. [Caria Manor] Ranni The Witch — Caria Manor 11. [Ainsel River Main] Ranni The Witch — Ainsel River Main 12.

questSteps.title: Enter Ranni’s service at Ranni’s Rise
questSteps.text: Ranni can next be encountered on the top floor of her Rise in the Three Sisters. This stage varies depending on whether you have met her before, defeated Starscourge Radahn, or given Sorcerer Rogier the Black Knifeprint. Agree to become one of Ranni's vassals, and then head back down the tower to speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis. After speaking to all three, return to Ranni and speak to her again. After this point, if you return to Ranni, she will be sleeping and non-responsive. *(Optional)* Administer Preceptor Seluvis's Amber Draught to Ranni. She will awaken.

questSteps.title: Open Nokron — defeat Starscourge Radahn
questSteps.text: Defeat Starscourge Radahn to resume the movement of the stars.

questSteps.title: Retrieve the Fingerslayer Blade
questSteps.text: Nokron can only be accessed via the *Starfall Crater* in east Limgrave after defeating Starscourge Radahn. Proceed through the area to obtain the Fingerslayer Blade, which is in a chest northeast of the Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace.

questSteps.title: Invert the Carian Study Hall
questSteps.text: Travel to Ranni's Rise and deliver the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required to progress Fia, Deathbed Companion's questline. However, it is *not* necessary to complete Ranni's quest. WARNING: This will permanently end Preceptor Seluvis and Pidia, Carian Servant's quest. Travel to Renna's Rise, which unseals after Ranni departs with the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the Sending Gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.

questSteps.title: Kill Astel and place the Dark Moon Ring
questSteps.text: Ride the Transportation Coffin at the Grand Cloister. Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void and then travel up the lift. However, this lift remains locked until the player obtains the Dark Moon Ring.

questSteps.title: Finish the Elden Lord path, then summon Ranni
questSteps.text: Forge → Farum → Ashen Capital → Elden Beast. Use Ranni’s summon sign after the fight.

questSteps.title: Find Blaidd at Ranni’s Rise
questSteps.text: Once the ring is placed, Blaidd is waiting — and no longer himself. This is the loose end of her service.

questSteps.title: Hear Iji’s last counsel
questSteps.text: The smith in the Three Sisters knows what became of Blaidd, and what Ranni chose. His story ends here too.

questSteps.title: Ranni The Witch — *(Optional)* Church of Elleh
questSteps.text: After meeting Melina and obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle, use Torrent at least once. After that, rest on any Site of Grace. Then, fast travel to the Church of Elleh Site of Grace and find Ranni (using the pseudonym "Renna the Witch") sitting on a broken wall. Exhaust her dialogue to receive the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes for free. If you miss this step, these items will be available for purchase at the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold— 200 runes for the Lone Wolf Ashes and 1,000 runes for the Spirit Calling Bell respectively.

questSteps.title: Ranni The Witch — Caria Manor
questSteps.text: Traverse Caria Manor in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes. Defeat the apparition of Royal Knight Loretta at the Royal Moongazing Grounds, which unlocks the path to Three Sisters behind her.

questSteps.title: Ranni The Witch — Ainsel River Main
questSteps.text: Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.

questSteps.title: Ranni The Witch — Nokstella, Eternal City
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline. Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key.

questSteps.title: Ranni The Witch — Academy of Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: Defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Unlock the chest behind Rennala and obtain the Dark Moon Ring.

questSteps.title: Ranni The Witch — Moonlight Altar
questSteps.text: Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again, and she will disappear, bequeathing the Dark Moon Greatsword.

questSteps.title: Ranni The Witch — Stone Platform
questSteps.text: After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign beside Fractured Marika. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending. WARNING: Ranni's summon sign will not appear if the player has met with the Three Fingers. This can be undone by defeating both Malenia, Goddess of Rot and Dragonlord Placidusax, and using Miquella's Needle in the latter's boss arena at Crumbling Farum Azula.

npc:rauh-goddess-statue.name: Rauh Goddess Statue
npc:rauh-goddess-statue.description: All information about the statues and the unseen character they depict is conjectural, based on visual details and contextual clues. Characteristics thumb|Hornsent pray to the statue Statues of a mysterious woman with a great octagonal crown are prominently featured throughout the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, a land blessed by the primordial Crucible of life. Both the hornsent and Kindred of Rot offer their prayers to this goddess-like figure.

npc:roderika.description: Everyone who came with me. They crossed the sea for me. They fought, for me. Heh... Only to have their arms taken. Their legs taken. Even their heads...taken. Taken and stuck to the spider.

questSteps.title: Meet Roderika at the Stormhill Shack
questSteps.text: Roderika can be found in Stormhill Shack in Stormhill, provided you have not defeated Godrick the Grafted or touched a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. Exhaust her dialogue to obtain both the "Sitting Sideways" Gesture and Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.

questSteps.title: Recover the Chrysalids’ Memento from Stormveil
questSteps.text: In an adjoining courtyard to the large hall containing a Grafted Scion in Stormveil Castle, pick up the Chrysalids' Memento.

questSteps.title: Give Roderika the memento
questSteps.text: Roderika can be found by the fireplace in the central room. Talk to her to obtain a Golden Seed once she arrives. Note: if you defeated Godrick or rest at a Site of Grace in Liurnia without speaking to Roderika in Stormhill Shack, she will move to Roundtable Hold on her own, and will leave the Golden Seed on the ground in the shack.

questSteps.title: Ask Hewg to take Roderika on
questSteps.text: Reload the area and Roderika will be sitting opposite Hewg. It is now possible to upgrade Spirit Ashes by speaking to her.

questSteps.title: Unlock spirit tuning with Roderika
questSteps.text: She can now upgrade your spirit ashes while Hewg keeps forging. The line is complete.

questSteps.title: Roderika — *(Optional)* Stormhill Shack
questSteps.text: Deliver the Crysalids' Memento to Roderika in Stormhill Shack and exhaust her dialogue to get her to move to Roundtable Hold.

questSteps.title: Roderika — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Speak to Roderika, and then speak to Smithing Master Hewg and select "About Roderika".

questSteps.title: Roderika — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Return to Roderika and speak to her to tell her what Hewg said.

questSteps.title: Roderika — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Return to Hewg and select "About Roderika" again, followed by "Would you watch over Roderika?" and finally "It's what she wants".

questSteps.title: Roderika — *(optional)* Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Upgrade a Spirit Ash to at least +4 and talk to her to receive the "Curtsy" Gesture.

questSteps.title: Roderika — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After burning the Erdtree, return to the Roundtable Hold, speak to Hewg, and select "Let's talk a while". You may then select the dialogue option "Why are you still making weapons?" After talking to Roderika and selecting "About Hewg", return to Hewg and select "What happened to her?"

questSteps.title: Roderika — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, speak to Hewg and select "About yourself", and then speak to Roderika.

sections.text: 1. Meet Hyetta or Shabriri 2. [*(Optional)* Leyndell, Ashen Capital] Reach the Forsaken Depths under Leyndell 3. [Frenzied Flame Proscription] Take the Frenzied Flame (breaks the quest) 4. Beat the Elden Beast and do not use a Mending Rune 5. [Mountaintops of the Giants] Shabriri — Mountaintops of the Giants

questSteps.title: Meet Hyetta or Shabriri
questSteps.text: Hyetta starts at the Lake-Facing Cliffs grape line. Shabriri appears later on the mountain.

questSteps.title: Reach the Forsaken Depths under Leyndell
questSteps.text: Shabriri will be available as a cooperator to assist with the fight against Godfrey, First Elden Lord at the Elden Throne if the player has not used Miquella's Needle.

questSteps.title: Take the Frenzied Flame
questSteps.text: Travel to the Frenzied Flame Proscription through the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and Cathedral of the Forsaken. Remove all of your armor and interact with the door on the lowest floor for a cutscene in which the Three Fingers embrace you. This can be done regardless of whether you have met Shabriri already. Doing so will cause Shabriri to disappear from his previous location.

questSteps.title: Beat the Elden Beast and do not use a Mending Rune
questSteps.text: The cutscene changes if the flame is still in you.

questSteps.title: Shabriri — Mountaintops of the Giants
questSteps.text: Shabriri can be found by the Zamor Ruins Site of Grace near the beginning of the Mountaintops of the Giants area. Exhaust his dialogue to unlock new dialogue from Melina when resting at a Site of Grace.

npc:sir-ansbach.name: Sir Ansbach
npc:sir-ansbach.description: Formerly the feared commander of the Pureblood Knights in service of Lord Mohg, Ansbach is one of the compatriots of Needle Knight Leda who followed Miquella into the Realm of Shadow.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* If you visit Roundtable Hold before defeating a shardbearer, Gideon can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold. After exhausting his dialogue he will move to his study.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: After defeating a shardbearer and speaking to Finger Reader Enia, Gideon will welcome you as a member of Roundtable Hold, and will offer you information on Godrick the Grafted, Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, Starscourge Radahn, Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, and Morgott, the Omen King. He can also discuss Nepheli Loux if you have spoken to her.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* If you obtain either half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, Ensha will ambush you the next time you return to Roundtable Hold. After defeating him, speak to Gideon to learn the location of the other half. *(Optional)* If you have obtained Seluvis's Potion, you may give it to Gideon to dispose of it. This will remove it from your inventory, preventing you from obtaining Nepheli Loux Puppet or Dung Eater Puppet.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Resting at any Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital will cause Gideon to receive new dialogue about the unlocated Demigods.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Gideon will now offer rewards in exchange for meeting certain requirements: Black Flame's Protection: activate a Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree. Lord's Divine Fortification: defeat Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Fevor's Cookbook 3: activate a Site of Grace in Mohgwyn Palace. Law of Causality: defeat Mohg, Lord of Blood.

questSteps.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
questSteps.text: Gideon will be present in the Erdtree Sanctuary as a boss encounter after you have defeated Maliketh, the Black Blade. Any previous parts of his questline will now be locked, however the rewards from the previous step can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks.

questSteps.title: Meet Rogier in Stormveil and again at the Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Meet him at Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick. Tell him that you have defeated Godrick and then ask about the corpse below Stormveil. Speak to Fia to learn about the Black Knifeprint.

questSteps.title: Bring him the Black Knifeprint from Black Knife Catacombs
questSteps.text: Obtain the Black Knifeprint from the wounded Black Knife Assassin in Black Knife Catacombs in Liurnia.

questSteps.title: Show the knifeprint to Ranni and enter her service
questSteps.text: This is the alternate door into the Age of Stars line; you can still serve her without it.

questSteps.title: Find Rogier’s body in Deeproot Depths and take his set
questSteps.text: Return to Roundtable Hold and speak to Rogier. He will tell you that his condition is worsening. Reload the area and Rogier will be unresponsive. Any unseen dialogue options will be locked and his shop will be unavailable. Reload the area again and Rogier will be dead, leaving behind his gear, bell bearing and a letter.

questSteps.title: Sorcerer Rogier — Stormveil Castle
questSteps.text: *(Optional)* Exhaust his dialogue in Stormveil Castle encounter. He can be found in the chapel past the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. Witness his bloodstain after killing the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the lower section of Stormveil Castle. Doing so before defeating Godrick will cause him to disappear from Stormveil, regardless of whether you have done step 1.

questSteps.title: Sorcerer Rogier — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Give Rogier the Black Knifeprint. *(Optional)* Ask Fia about Rogier. Reload the area and speak to Rogier. He will ask you to investigate Ranni.

questSteps.title: Sorcerer Rogier — Three Sisters (Ranni's Rise)
questSteps.text: Head to Ranni's Rise and speak to Ranni. She will be dismissive and ask you to leave.

questSteps.title: Sorcerer Rogier — Roundtable Hold
questSteps.text: Return to Roundtable Hold and tell Rogier about Ranni. He will ask that you enter her service to further the investigation.

questSteps.title: Sorcerer Rogier — Three Sisters (Ranni's Rise)
questSteps.text: Return to Ranni's Rise and agree to serve Ranni.

npc:sorcerer-thops.name: Sorcerer Thops
npc:sorcerer-thops.description: A former student of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, Thops was considered a "bluntstone", lacking any talent for sorcery, yet he looked up to Sorceress Sellen prior to her expulsion from the Academy.
