npc:sorceress-sellen.name: Sorceress Sellen

stats.Affiliation: Academy of Raya Lucaria (expelled) · Castellan Jerren · Preceptor Seluvis
stats.Status resist: Poison 100 · Scarlet Rot 100 · Bleed 100 · Sleep 999 · Madness 0 · Curse 999

npc:sorceress-sellen.description: She is initially found in Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave and is eager to share her glintstone sorceries.

questSteps.title: Free Sellen from the Waypoint Ruins
questSteps.text: Sellen can be found in the cellar of Waypoint Ruins after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head. Talk to Sellen and then select "I wish to learn glintstone sorceries" to receive the "Nod in Thought" Gesture, and to unlock her sorcery shop. *(Optional)* If the Radahn Festival has not commenced, Sellen will have dialogue about it if you have Seluvis's Introduction in your inventory. This is obtained by progressing Blaidd the Half-Wolf's questline and speaking to Seluvis about Nokron prior to initiating the Festival.

questSteps.title: Find Azur, the Primeval Sorcerer
questSteps.text: Mt. Gelmir, sealed cave behind the Hermit Village. Sellen’s first master.

questSteps.title: Find Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway
questSteps.text: Caelid. Break the illusory wall; the second primeval sorcerer.

questSteps.title: Report both primeval sorcerers to Sellen
questSteps.text: Tell her of Azur and Lusat and she asks you to meet her at the academy.

questSteps.title: Find Sellen’s true body at Witchbane Ruins
questSteps.text: After Starscourge Radahn has been defeated, talk to Sellen to learn that her true body is in Witchbane Ruins. Travel there and speak to the shackled Sellen to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone. Reload the area and return to find Castellan Jerren. In order for him to appear, you must have spoken to him in Redmane Castle after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

questSteps.title: Revive Sellen in the Three Sisters puppet
questSteps.text: Travel to the Three Sisters and go to the ruined structure north-east of Ranni's Rise. Roll or attack the ground to reveal a hidden staircase leading to a basement full of immobile puppets. Pass through the illusory wall on the far end of the room to find a puppet duplicate of Sellen. Interact with the puppet to insert Sellen's Primal Glintstone, resurrecting Sellen in her new body.

questSteps.title: Meet Witch-Hunter Jerren at Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: Jerren waits in the Debate Parlor, hunting the witch. Which side you take is final.

questSteps.title: Side with Sellen
questSteps.text: Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur, located beyond the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir, to obtain Comet Azur. Return to Sellen and select the "Show Azur's Sorcery" dialogue option. After listening to this dialogue, select the "Tell me your story" option, and then select "Let us journey together". Next, select "I have a favor to ask" to obtain the Sellian Sealbreaker. The Sellian Sealbreaker can be used to open a sealed tunnel in Sellia Hideaway, behind which is Primeval Sorcerer Lusat. Interact with him to receive Stars of Ruin.

questSteps.title: Or side with Jerren
questSteps.text: Take the Witch-Hunter’s side; Sellen is lost, and her spells and bell bearing go with her.

questSteps.title: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: There will now be two summon signs outside the door to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library; one red and one gold. To progress Sellen's questline, select the gold summon sign. You will be summoned as a co-operator to assist Sellen in defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren. Defeat Jerren to receive the Eccentric's Set. This step can only be completed if Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated.

questSteps.title: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: After defeating Jerren, Sellen can be found where Rennala is usually based. Speak to her to receive the Glintstone Kris. If you have not done so already, find Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway and speak to Sellen to select "Lusat's location" and receive Starlight Shards. It is also possible to obtain Azur and Lusat's armour sets by returning to their respective locations at this point.

questSteps.title: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria
questSteps.text: Reload the area after telling Sellen about Lusat. Sellen, now in the form of a Graven Mass, can be found to the side of the room. The Witch's Glintstone Crown can be obtained here. It is still possible to purchase sorceries from her and to offer her scrolls.

questSteps.title: Meet Thiollier at the Three-Path Cross
questSteps.text: Speak with Moore outside Belurat, Tower Settlement. Find and speak with Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace. Speak with Moore again and he will give you Black Syrup for Thiollier. Find Thiollier again and he will give you Thiollier's Concoction. After all this is done, approach the Shadow Keep, and you will get an ominous message on the screen. Find Thiollier once more, and after exhausting his dialogue, reload the area, and he'll state he is heading south.

questSteps.title: Find St. Trina’s Nectar in the Stone Coffin Fissure
questSteps.text: Make your way to the southernmost point of the Cerulean Coast, where you'll find a pit. When facing south towards the pit, turn to the right; there are steps leading into it. Follow the given path, and you'll come across the Stone Coffin Fissure. Beat the Putrescent Knight, a boss found at the end of this Legacy Dungeon, and in the corner of the arena, you'll find both the Garden of Deep Purple Site of Grace and Thiollier, in front of St. Trina. Exhaust Thiollier's Dialogue and then reset the area using the nearby Grace.

questSteps.title: Hear St. Trina at the Garden of Deep Purple
questSteps.text: Drink the nectar repeatedly to reach her voice. This is the St. Trina thread and explains Miquella’s fate.

questSteps.title: Choose Thiollier’s side at Enir-Ilim
questSteps.text: Thiollier will now be available to summon for the two final fights of the *Shadow of The Erdtree*'s story, where his quest finishes.

questSteps.text: Return to Varré to receive the Bloody Finger, then talk to him again to receive the Pureblood Knight's Medal.

sections.heading: Questline (7 steps)
sections.text: 1. [Limgrave (The First Step)] Talk to Varré at the First Step, then at Rose Church 2. Soak the cloth in maiden blood 3. [Mohgwyn Palace (Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance)] Use the medal to Mohgwyn 4. [Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)] White Mask Varré — Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake) 5. [Altus Plateau (Road of Iniquity Side Path)] White Mask Varré — Altus Plateau (Road of Iniquity Side Path) 6. [Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)] White Mask Varré — Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake) 7.

npc:winged-serpents.name: Winged Serpents
npc:winged-serpents.description: The winged serpents are characters in Shadow of the Erdtree.

npc:witch-hunter-jerren.name: Witch-Hunter Jerren
npc:witch-hunter-jerren.description: Brave champion, you have our gratitude

stats.Status resist: Poison 100 · Scarlet Rot 100 · Bleed 100 · Sleep 999 · Madness 0 · Curse 999

npc:yuri.name: Yuri
npc:yuri.description: Yuri, the treasured son of a renowned sorcerer, died at a young age and was laid to rest in the quiet cemetery beside the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

npcs:141400.name: Hornsent

sections.heading: Questline (4 steps)
sections.text: 1. Hornsent — step 1 2. Hornsent — step 2 3. Hornsent — step 3 4. Hornsent — step 4

questSteps.title: Hornsent — step 1
questSteps.text: Gravesite Plain

questSteps.title: Hornsent — step 2
questSteps.text: Scadu Altus

questSteps.title: Hornsent — step 3
questSteps.text: Shadow Keep

questSteps.title: Hornsent — step 4
questSteps.text: Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim

npcs:141400.description: The Hornsent were a polytheistic, deeply ascetic people who associated the spiral, the Crucible, and their tangled horns with the divine.

quest:albus-the-albinauric-step-1.name: Albus — Village of the Albinaurics
quest:albus-the-albinauric-step-1.description: Albus can be found, disguised as a pot, at the top of the slope past the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, near the Depraved Perfumer. Roll or attack the pot to break the illusion and reveal Albus. Exhaust his dialogue to obtain the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), which can be shown to Latenna the Albinauric at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack in order to progress her questline.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-1.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Limgrave (Stormhill)
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-1.description: *(Optional)* Alexander can first be found in Stormhill, stuck in a pothole atop a cliff southwest of the Saintsbridge Site of Grace. He will call out once you get close. After talking to him, agree to help him and then stand behind him and hit him. Once you have dealt sufficient damage, he will burst free of the hole. Exhaust his dialogue again to receive an Exhalted Flesh.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-2.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Limgrave (Gael Tunnel)
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-2.description: *(Optional)* Alexander can next be found near the Rear Gael Tunnel Site of Grace, accessible via the Limgrave entrance. By progressing through the dungeon from the Caelid entrance, you will be able to unlock the door blocking Alexander's path. Exhaust his dialogue to continue his questline.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-3.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Caelid (Redmane Castle)
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-3.description: *(Optional)* Alexander will be standing in the plaza as long as you have triggered the Radahn Festival. He is also available as a summon during the Starscourge Radahn boss fight.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-4.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Caelid (Redmane Castle) (step 4)
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-4.description: After defeating Starscourge Radahn, Alexander can be found near the Site of Grace in the Wailing Dunes. Exhaust his dialogue to progress his questline.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-5.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Liurnia of the Lakes
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-5.description: (Optional) Alexander will be in a pothole on the cliffs above Jarburg, south of the Artist's Shack (Liurnia of the lakes). He will once again ask you to hit him, however doing so will not free him. You must throw an Oil Pot at him, talk to him again, and then hit him several more times to free him. Speak to him again to receive three Exalted Flesh.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-6.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Mt Gelmir
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-6.description: Alexander can be found in a pool of lava south of Fort Laiedd, near a Magma Wyrm encounter. To speak to him without taking damage from the lava, ride Torrent to a sloped rock in front of him and dismount. Speak to him to receive the Jar helmet.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-7.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Mountaintops of the Giants
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-7.description: *(Optional)* Alexander can be summoned during the Fire Giant boss fight. His summon sign is just inside the arena.

quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-8.name: Alexander, Warrior Jar — Crumbling Farum Azula
quest:alexander-warrior-jar-step-8.description: Alexander will be standing on a floating platform close to the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace. He will request a duel. After defeating him, exhaust his dialogue and pick up Alexander's Innards and a Shard of Alexander. Alexander's Innards can be given to Jar-Bairn at the end of his own questline.

quest:alexander:complete.name: Alexander — duel in Farum Azula
related: Recover Alexander’s Innards where he fell
quest:alexander:complete.description: Finish the duel in Farum for the Shard of Alexander.

quest:alexander:festival.name: Alexander — met at the Radahn festival
quest:alexander:festival.description: Speak to him in the Redmane Castle plaza, then summon him for Starscourge Radahn.

quest:alexander:gael.name: Alexander — met near Gael Tunnel
related: Alexander — freed from the Limgrave hole
Fight beside him at the Redmane festival
quest:alexander:gael.description: He waits by the tunnel and asks you to meet him at the Redmane festival.

quest:alexander:met.name: Alexander — freed from the Limgrave hole
related: Find him again near Gael Tunnel in Caelid
quest:alexander:met.description: South of Stormhill. Hit the ground. Missable if you never crack it, but he can still show later.

quest:ansbach:concluded.name: Side with Ansbach at Enir-Ilim
related: Learn what Miquella did to Mohg
quest:ansbach:concluded.description: He can be summoned for the Leda fight and the Consort. Killing him loses his set and the summon.

quest:ansbach:met.name: Ansbach — freed in the Shadow Keep
related: Learn what Miquella did to Mohg

quest:ansbach:mohg.name: Learn what Miquella did to Mohg
related: Ansbach — freed in the Shadow Keep
quest:ansbach:mohg.description: Talk him through the charm and the withered arm. This unlocks the Leda alliance choice at the Sealing Tree.

quest:aureliette-step-1.name: Aureliette — step 1
quest:aureliette-step-1.description: When approaching Stargazers' Ruins, Aureliette's voice can be heard from inside the main building.

quest:aureliette-step-2.name: Aureliette — step 2
quest:aureliette-step-2.description: Use the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes obtained from Roderika, Spirit Tuner in front of Aureliette.

quest:aureliette-step-3.name: Aureliette — step 3
quest:aureliette-step-3.description: After a brief dialogue, she will disappear, and the seal blocking access to the cellar containing the Primal Glintstone Blade will be gone.

quest:blackguard-big-boggart-step-1.name: Blackguard Big Boggart — Liurnia of the Lakes (Boilprawn Shack)
quest:blackguard-big-boggart-step-1.description: Head north-west from the Site of Grace to find Rya the Scout inside a gazebo and talk to her. Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select Give me the necklace and then Deal to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. After purchasing the item, he'll start selling an infinite supply of Boiled Prawns. Purchase at least one to progress his questline: you'll receive the "Spread Out" gesture and, in turn, Boggart's summon sign will appear at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook to aid you against Magma Wyrm Makar.

quest:blackguard-big-boggart-step-2.name: Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau
quest:blackguard-big-boggart-step-2.description: After resting at a Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, Boggart will move to the outer moat along the northern wall of Leyndell, Royal Capital in the Capital Outskirts (due west from the Capital Rampart Site of Grace). You may now purchase an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs. Exhaust Boggart's dialogue about Dung Eater. After freeing Dung Eater from his cell in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds, Boggart will have some additional dialogue.

quest:blackguard-big-boggart-step-3.name: Blackguard Big Boggart — Altus Plateau (step 3)
quest:blackguard-big-boggart-step-3.description: After hearing Boggart's final piece of dialogue about Dung Eater, warning you that Dung Eater is lurking nearby, reload the area to find Boggart bound to a chair. Speak to him to trigger an invasion from Dung Eater. Defeat Dung Eater and return to Boggart, who is now dead. Loot his equipment, as well as the Seedbed Curse.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-1.name: Blaidd — Limgrave (Mistwood Ruins)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-1.description: Blaidd can be heard howling in Mistwood. After hearing the howl, speak to Merchant Kalé and select "About the howling in Mistwood." This will unlock the "Finger Snap" gesture. Use Finger Snap at the Mistwood Ruins near the ruined tower adjacent to the slumbering Runebear to cause Blaidd to jump down. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-2.name: Blaidd — Limgrave (Forlorn Hound Evergaol)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-2.description: Enter the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in Limgrave and defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. Blaidd will be available as a summonable cooperator during this fight. After defeating Darriwil, Blaidd appears outside the Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Speak with him to earn a Somber Smithing Stone [2].

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-3.name: Blaidd — Liurnia of the Lakes (Ranni's Rise)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-3.description: After entering Ranni's service, a projection of Blaidd appears in Ranni's Rise and offers dialogue. This step is skipped if Starscourge Radahn has already been defeated.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-4.name: Blaidd — Siofra River
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-4.description: Blaidd moves to the base of an enormous ruined bridge on the bank of the Siofra River, located between the Siofra River Bank and Worshipper's Woods Sites of Grace. He will suggest asking Preceptor Seluvis about how to reach Nokron, Eternal City. This step is skipped if Starscourge Radahn has already been defeated. (Optional) After speaking to Seluvis about Nokron and then speaking to Sorceress Sellen, return to Blaidd and exhaust his dialogue. He will move to Redmane Castle afterwards.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-5.name: Blaidd — Caelid (Redmane Castle)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-5.description: Blaidd will appear in the Redmane Castle Plaza when the Radahn Festival begins. He also appears as an optional summon in the fight against Starscourge Radahn.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-6.name: Blaidd — Caelid (Wailing Dunes)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-6.description: (Optional) After defeating Radahn, speak to Blaidd next to the Starscourge Radahn Site of Grace. He will mark the location of the *Starfall Crater*—entrance to Nokron, Eternal City—on your map.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-7.name: Blaidd — Limgrave (Forlorn Hound Evergaol) (step 7)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-7.description: (Optional) Interact with the Forlorn Hound Evergaol to speak to Blaidd. Either choose to release him or leave him.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-8.name: Blaidd — Liurnia of the Lakes (Three Sisters)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-8.description: After giving Ranni the Dark Moon Ring, Blaidd will appear as a hostile NPC outside Ranni's Rise, surrounded by the bodies of slain Black Knife Assassins. Defeat him to receive his armor and weapon.

quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-9.name: Blaidd — Liurnia of the Lakes (Kingsrealm Ruins)
quest:blaidd-the-half-wolf-step-9.description: (Optional) Speak to War Counselor Iji to deliver the news of Blaidd's death.

quest:bloody-finger-hunter-yura-step-2.name: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura — Liurnia of the Lakes
quest:bloody-finger-hunter-yura-step-2.description: A red summon sign can be found northeast of the Raya Lucaria Main Gate. Interact with it to assist Yura in defeating Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin. After defeating the foe, Yura can be found on the bridge near where the summon sign was. Speak to him to receive a Smithing Stone [5].

quest:bloody-finger-ravenmount-assassin-.name: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin — step 1
quest:bloody-finger-ravenmount-assassin-.description: Liurnia of the Lakes (Main Academy Gate)

quest:bloody-finger-ravenmount-assassin-.name: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin — step 2
quest:bloody-finger-ravenmount-assassin-.description: After defeating Bloody Finger Nerijus in Limgrave and talking with Bloody Finger Hunter Yura, the invasion sign of the Ravenmount Assassin will appear within the Academy of Raya Lucaria: upon defeating him, talk to Yura on the same bridge to receive a Smithing Stone [5] x1 from Yura, progressing his questline to Altus Plateau.

quest:boc:beautiful.name: Boc — reassured with the Prattling Pate
related: Boc — doubts his looks in Leyndell
Or send Boc to seek rebirth
quest:boc:beautiful.description: The pate keeps him content as your seamster. This is the good end for the line.

quest:boc:cave.name: Boc — met at the Coastal Cave
quest:boc:cave.description: Boc can be found lying on the ground beside the Site of Grace at the start of the dungeon. Defeating the Demi-Human Chief dual boss of the area will reward you with the Sewing Needle, which can be given to Boc.
related: Boc — freed from the illusory tree
Give Boc the Gold Sewing Needle

sections.heading: Wiki: Limgrave (Coastal Cave)
sections.text: Boc can be found lying on the ground beside the Site of Grace at the start of the dungeon. Defeating the Demi-Human Chief dual boss of the area will reward you with the Sewing Needle, which can be given to Boc.

quest:boc:doubt.name: Boc — doubts his looks in Leyndell
quest:boc:doubt.description: If Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated, Boc will ask for a Larval Tear. Giving him a Larval Tear will move him to Raya Lucaria Grand Library. He will appear kneeling on the ground in human form, unresponsive. Upon reloading the area, he will be dead. Refusing to give him a Larval Tear will unlock the dialogue option "What do you really think?". Selecting this option will cause him to die just outside Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Instead of selecting either option, using Prattling Pate "You're Beautiful" in front of him will prevent him from dying.
related: Reassure Boc with the Prattling Pate “You’re Beautiful”

sections.heading: Wiki: Leyndell, Royal Capital (East Capital Rampart)
sections.text: If Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated, Boc will ask for a Larval Tear. Giving him a Larval Tear will move him to Raya Lucaria Grand Library. He will appear kneeling on the ground in human form, unresponsive. Upon reloading the area, he will be dead. Refusing to give him a Larval Tear will unlock the dialogue option "What do you really think?". Selecting this option will cause him to die just outside Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Instead of selecting either option, using Prattling Pate "You're Beautiful" in front of him will prevent him from dying.

quest:boc:freed.name: Boc — freed from the illusory tree
quest:boc:freed.description: Boc can be found in the form of a small tree near Gatefront Ruins. He will call out until you attack or roll into the tree, reversing the illusion and causing him to transform back.
related: Meet Boc at the Coastal Cave entrance

sections.heading: Wiki: Limgrave
sections.text: Boc can be found in the form of a small tree near Gatefront Ruins. He will call out until you attack or roll into the tree, reversing the illusion and causing him to transform back.

quest:boc:needle.name: Boc — gold sewing needle given
quest:boc:needle.description: *(Optional)* Boc can be given the Gold Sewing Needle, which allows him to alter Demigod equipment. He can be given the item in subsequent steps of his questline instead if this step is missed.
quest:boc:needle.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (East Raya Lucaria Gate)
related: Hear Boc doubt his looks in Leyndell
Boc — met at the Coastal Cave

sections.heading: Wiki: Liurnia of the Lakes (East Raya Lucaria Gate)
sections.text: *(Optional)* Boc can be given the Gold Sewing Needle, which allows him to alter Demigod equipment. He can be given the item in subsequent steps of his questline instead if this step is missed.

quest:boc:rebirth.name: Boc — sent to seek rebirth
related: Boc — reassured with the Prattling Pate
quest:boc:rebirth.description: Giving him a Larval Tear ends the seamster line and leaves him changed. The two outcomes are exclusive.

quest:brother-corhyn-step-1.name: Brother Corhyn — Roundtable Hold
quest:brother-corhyn-step-1.description: Corhyn can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold, where he will offer to teach you several Incantations. His shop inventory can be increased by giving him prayerbooks.

quest:brother-corhyn-step-2.name: Brother Corhyn — Roundtable Hold (step 2)
quest:brother-corhyn-step-2.description: After reaching Altus Plateau, Corhyn will express an interest in searching for Goldmask.

quest:brother-corhyn-step-3.name: Brother Corhyn — Altus Plateau
quest:brother-corhyn-step-3.description: Corhyn can be found north of the the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace. Talking to him here after finding Goldmask will allow you to reveal Goldmask's location to him.

quest:brother-corhyn-step-4.name: Brother Corhyn — Altus Plateau (Forest-Spanning Greatbridge)
quest:brother-corhyn-step-4.description: Corhyn will now appear next to Goldmask. The pair will now travel together.

quest:brother-corhyn-step-5.name: Brother Corhyn — Leyndell, Royal Capital
quest:brother-corhyn-step-5.description: Corhyn and Goldmask can be found near the colosseum. Corhyn will express frustration at Goldmask's current obsession with Radagon. After using Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue past the lift near Erdtree Sanctuary, talk to Goldmask to reveal Radagon's secret and then talk to Corhyn.

quest:brother-corhyn-step-6.name: Brother Corhyn — Mountaintops of the Giants
quest:brother-corhyn-step-6.description: Corhyn and Goldmask will move to the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins. Corhyn can be offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, which will affect the end of his questline. If offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, Corhyn will remain in this location after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade after Goldmask leaves. After reloading the area, he will have disappeared, leaving behind his flail, robe, and bell bearing.

quest:brother-corhyn-step-7.name: Brother Corhyn — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
quest:brother-corhyn-step-7.description: If Corhyn was not offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, he will appear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, close to the giant Bolt of Gransax after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. After exhausting his dialogue and resting at a Site of Grace, he will be gone.

quest:castellan-edgar-step-1.name: Castellan Edgar — Castle Morne
quest:castellan-edgar-step-1.description: Edgar can be found atop a tower in Castle Morne. Showing him Irina's Letter prompts him to tell you about the legendary sword stolen by the Misbegotten and will make him available as a summonable ally against the Leonine Misbegotten boss.

quest:castellan-edgar-step-2.name: Castellan Edgar — Castle Morne (step 2)
quest:castellan-edgar-step-2.description: After defeating the Leonine Misbegotten, return to Edgar and exhaust his dialogue.

quest:castellan-edgar-step-3.name: Castellan Edgar — Weeping Peninsula (near Bridge of Sacrifice)
quest:castellan-edgar-step-3.description: Edgar will be standing over Irina's body. Exhaust his dialogue. If the player killed Irina, Edgar will be hostile.

quest:castellan-edgar-step-4.name: Castellan Edgar — Liurnia of the Lakes (Revenger's Shack)
quest:castellan-edgar-step-4.description: The bodies of slain Scaly Misbegotten form a trail to the Revenger's Shack. Edgar the Revenger invades as the player approaches the shack.

quest:castellan-jerren-step-1.name: Castellan Jerren — *(Optional)* Redmane Castle (before Radahn Festival)
quest:castellan-jerren-step-1.description: Jerren can be encountered in Redmane Castle before initiating the Radahn Festival, sitting on a chair inside the church just beyond the Redmane Castle Plaza. Speaking to him here will unlock some additional dialogue with War Counselor Iji.

quest:castellan-jerren-step-2.name: Castellan Jerren — Redmane Castle (Radahn Festival)
quest:castellan-jerren-step-2.description: When the Radahn Festival commences, Jerren can be found on a podium overlooking the plaza. Speak to him and select "Ready as I'll ever be" to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, wait for Jerren to finish speaking to receive the "Heartening Cry" Gesture. Next, go into the church behind Jerren and take the elevator down. Use the sending gate at the bottom of the elevator to reach the Wailing Dunes

quest:castellan-jerren-step-3.name: Castellan Jerren — Wailing Dunes
quest:castellan-jerren-step-3.description: Defeat Starscourge Radahn. *(Optional)* Castellan Jerren's summon sign will appear mid-fight during Radahn's second phase.

quest:castellan-jerren-step-4.name: Castellan Jerren — *(Optional)* Redmane Castle (after Radahn Festival)
quest:castellan-jerren-step-4.description: Jerren can be spoken to once more after the Radahn Festival, in the same location he was in before the festival. After exhausting his dialogue he will disappear.

quest:castellan-jerren-step-5.name: Castellan Jerren — Witchbane Ruins
quest:castellan-jerren-step-5.description: After following Sellen's questline up until she gives you Sellen's Primal Glintstone, reload and return to Witchbane Ruins to find Witch-Hunter Jerren. Exhaust his dialogue to progress to the next step.

quest:castellan-jerren-step-6.name: Castellan Jerren — Academy of Raya Lucaria
quest:castellan-jerren-step-6.description: After transplanting Sellen's Primal Glintstone into the puppet in the cellar beneath Three Sisters, there will be two summon signs outside the door to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. To progress Jerren's questline, interact with the red summon sign. You will be summoned to assist Jerren in defeating Sellen. Defeat Sellen to receive the Witch's Glintstone Crown and Sellen's Bell Bearing. After the fight, speak to Jerren, who will be just outside the room. Exhaust his dialogue to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

quest:corhyn:goldmask.name: Buy from Corhyn and find Goldmask
related: Learn the Law of Regression and read the statue
quest:corhyn:goldmask.description: Corhyn at the Roundtable Hold; Goldmask on the Altus highway. Tell Corhyn where Goldmask is.

quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-1.name: Count Ymir, High Priest — Cathedral of Manus Metyr
quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-1.description: Speak with Count Ymir to receive Hole-Laden Necklace and Ruins Map

quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-2.name: Count Ymir, High Priest — Finger Ruins of Rhia (or Dheo)
quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-2.description: Ring the bell to receive Crimson Seed Talisman +1

quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-3.name: Count Ymir, High Priest — Cathedral of Manus Metyr (step 3)
quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-3.description: Speak with Count Ymir to receive Ruins Map (2nd)

quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-4.name: Count Ymir, High Priest — Finger Ruins of Dheo (or Rhia)
quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-4.description: Ring the bell to receive Cerulean Seed Talisman +1

quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-5.name: Count Ymir, High Priest — Cathedral of Manus Metyr (step 5)
quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-5.description: Speak with Count Ymir to receive Beloved Stardust and Ruins Map (3rd) Rest Activate Ymir’s throne and descend the ladder

quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-6.name: Count Ymir, High Priest — Finger Ruins of Miyr
quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-6.description: Defeat Recusant Swordhand of Night Anna to receive Claws of Night Ring the bell Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers to receive Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-7.name: Count Ymir, High Priest — Cathedral of Manus Metyr (step 7)
quest:count-ymir-high-priest-step-7.description: Activate Ymir’s throne Defeat Swordhand of Night Jolán Defeat Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers to receive Maternal Staff, High Priest Set, and Ymir's Bell Bearing. Cherishing Fingers can now be found in the graveyard by taking the western exit of Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

quest:d-beholder-of-death-step-1.name: D, Beholder of Death — Nokron, Eternal City
quest:d-beholder-of-death-step-1.description: Devin can be found outside the Valiant Gargoyles' duo boss arena beyond Hallowhorn Grounds (north). He can be given the full Twinned Set if you obtained it at the end of D, Hunter of the Dead's questline. (Optional) He is available as a summon for the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss after being given the Twinned Set and reloading the area. If D, Beholder of Death, was given a Twinned Set that was obtained by directly killing D, Hunter of the Dead, then he will be hostile the next time the area is loaded.

quest:d-beholder-of-death-step-2.name: D, Beholder of Death — Deeproot Depths
quest:d-beholder-of-death-step-2.description: After completing Fia, Deathbed Companion's questline and obtaining the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince, D can be found standing over Fia's slain corpse. After reloading the area, he will be gone, and the Inseparable Sword and Twinned Set can be found nearby.

quest:d:brother.name: D's brother met in Deeproot
related: Use the Mending Rune after the Elden Beast
Decide whether to hand D the Weathered Dagger
quest:d:brother.description: The surviving twin inherits D’s Twinned Armor and hunts Fia. This is the fork against the Death-Prince line.

quest:d:dagger-choice.name: Decide whether to hand D the Weathered Dagger
related: Speak with D at the Roundtable Hold
Meet D’s brother in Nokron / Deeproot
quest:d:dagger-choice.description: Fia’s dagger. Giving it to D advances Fia but costs D his life.

quest:d:killed.name: D killed
quest:d:killed.description: D, Hunter of the Dead — Decide whether to hand D the Weathered Dagger

quest:d:met.name: Meet D at Summonwater Village
quest:d:met.description: *(Optional)* D can first be encountered close to Saintsbridge in Limgrave. He will warn you about Summonwater Village, which is overrun by Those Who Live in Death, including a Tibia Mariner. *(Optional)* After defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village, D will appear appear in the village and offer to introduce you to Gurranq.
related: Speak with D at the Roundtable Hold

sections.heading: Wiki: Limgrave
sections.text: *(Optional)* D can first be encountered close to Saintsbridge in Limgrave. He will warn you about Summonwater Village, which is overrun by Those Who Live in Death, including a Tibia Mariner. *(Optional)* After defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village, D will appear appear in the village and offer to introduce you to Gurranq.

quest:d:roundtable.name: Speak with D at the Roundtable Hold
quest:d:roundtable.description: D will appear in Roundtable Hold regardless of whether he was encountered in Limgrave. If you have at least one Deathroot and did not complete step 1, he will offer to introduce you to Gurranq. D will begin selling Incantations after you have met Gurranq. He will also become available as a cooperator in Black Knight Catacombs as well as against the Tibia Mariner in Liurnia of the Lakes. After progressing Fia's questline, the Weathered Dagger can be given to D. After reloading the area, Fia can be found standing over D's corpse in a previously inaccessible room in Roundtable Hold.
related: Decide whether to hand D the Weathered Dagger

sections.heading: Wiki: Roundtable Hold
sections.text: D will appear in Roundtable Hold regardless of whether he was encountered in Limgrave. If you have at least one Deathroot and did not complete step 1, he will offer to introduce you to Gurranq. D will begin selling Incantations after you have met Gurranq. He will also become available as a cooperator in Black Knight Catacombs as well as against the Tibia Mariner in Liurnia of the Lakes. After progressing Fia's questline, the Weathered Dagger can be given to D. After reloading the area, Fia can be found standing over D's corpse in a previously inaccessible room in Roundtable Hold.

quest:demi-human-boc-step-3.name: Boc the Seamster — Liurnia of the Lakes (Lake-facing Cliffs)
quest:demi-human-boc-step-3.description: *(Optional)* Boc will be next to the Site of Grace. He will offer to make alterations to your equipment free of charge.

quest:demi-human-boc-step-5.name: Boc the Seamster — Altus Plateau (Altus Highway Junction)
quest:demi-human-boc-step-5.description: *(Optional)* Boc will ask if he can call you Lord at this point if he has already been given the Gold Sewing Needle. Agreeing will unlock the "My Lord" gesture.

quest:diallos:concluded.name: Diallos — wounded at Jarburg
related: Diallos — Jarburg defended from the poachers
quest:diallos:concluded.description: Jar-Bairn gives you Diallos’s Mask; the knight’s story closes at Jarburg.

quest:diallos:jarburg.name: Diallos — reached Jarburg
quest:diallos:jarburg.description: After progressing the Jar-Bairn's questline, Diallos will relocate to Jarburg in Liurnia of the Lakes. After resting at a Site of Grace five times, return to Jarburg to find Diallos dying. Speak to him and then reload the area to obtain Diallos's Mask and Hoslow's Petal Whip.
related: Diallos — met at the Village of the Albinaurics
Help defend Jarburg from the poachers

sections.heading: Wiki: Liurnia of the Lakes (Jarburg)
sections.text: After progressing the Jar-Bairn's questline, Diallos will relocate to Jarburg in Liurnia of the Lakes. After resting at a Site of Grace five times, return to Jarburg to find Diallos dying. Speak to him and then reload the area to obtain Diallos's Mask and Hoslow's Petal Whip.

quest:diallos:lanya.name: Diallos — searching for Lanya
related: Find Diallos at the Village of the Albinaurics
quest:diallos:lanya.description: He is searching for the servant he lost and does not know where she has gone.

quest:diallos:met.name: Diallos — met at the Roundtable
quest:diallos:met.description: (Optional) Diallos can be found in Roundtable Hold upon the player's first visit. He will ask you to look out for his servant, Lanya, who has gone missing.

sections.heading: Wiki: Roundtable Hold
sections.text: (Optional) Diallos can be found in Roundtable Hold upon the player's first visit. He will ask you to look out for his servant, Lanya, who has gone missing.

quest:diallos:poachers.name: Diallos — Jarburg defended from the poachers
related: Find Diallos wounded and take his mask
quest:diallos:poachers.description: Diallos stands with the jars against the night raid.

quest:diallos:village.name: Diallos — met at the Village of the Albinaurics
quest:diallos:village.description: Liurnia. He has followed a lead and is out of his depth.

quest:dragon-communion-priestess-step-1.name: Dragon Communion Priestess — step 1
quest:dragon-communion-priestess-step-1.description: Optional: Meet at Grand Altar of Dragon Communion

quest:dragon-communion-priestess-step-3.name: Dragon Communion Priestess — step 3
quest:dragon-communion-priestess-step-3.description: Optional: Give or withhold Thiollier's Concoction

quest:dragon-communion-priestess-step-5.name: Dragon Communion Priestess — step 5
quest:dragon-communion-priestess-step-5.description: Return to Grand Altar of Dragon Communion

quest:dung-eater-step-1.name: Dung Eater — Liurnia of the Lakes (Laskyar Ruins)
quest:dung-eater-step-1.description: Head north-west from the Site of Grace to find Rya the Scout inside a gazebo and talk to her. Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select Give me the necklace and then Deal to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. After purchasing the item, he'll start selling an infinite supply of Boiled Prawns. Purchase at least one to progress his questline: you'll receive the "Spread Out" gesture and, in turn, Boggart's summon sign will appear at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook to aid you against Magma Wyrm Makar.

quest:dung-eater-step-5.name: Dung Eater — Leyndell, Royal Capital (Queen's Bed Chamber)
quest:dung-eater-step-5.description: *(Optional)* Alongside Melina, the Dung Eater can now be summoned to aid you against Morgott, the Omen King.

quest:dung-eater-step-6.name: Dung Eater — Roundtable Hold
quest:dung-eater-step-6.description: *(Optional)* The Dung Eater has disappeared from the Hold, leaving behind on his spot a message that reads: "I'll defile you next. Come to the outer moat." *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "About the spirits' voices" to express her relief for the Dung Eater's departure.

quest:dung-eater-step-8.name: Dung Eater — Roundtable Hold (step 8)
quest:dung-eater-step-8.description: The Dung Eater will have now returned to the Hold. Talking to him, he'll instruct you to defile his corpse with the Seedbed Curse. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "About the spirits' voices".

quest:dungeater:freed.name: Dung Eater — cell opened in the Shunning-Grounds
quest:dungeater:freed.description: (Optional) If you don't intend to follow his questline, you can select Administer Seluvis' Potion to turn the Dung Eater into a puppet. After his screams have ceased, you're free to kill him to collect his loot without failing the Preceptor's questline. After collecting all five Seedbed Curses, return to him and select Use the Seedbed Curse, then collect the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse from his body. Reloading the area, you'll be able to collect the Omen Set too.
related: Defeat him at the Leyndell moat invasion
Dung Eater — met at the Roundtable

sections.heading: Wiki: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Underground Roadside)
sections.text: (Optional) If you don't intend to follow his questline, you can select Administer Seluvis' Potion to turn the Dung Eater into a puppet. After his screams have ceased, you're free to kill him to collect his loot without failing the Preceptor's questline. After collecting all five Seedbed Curses, return to him and select Use the Seedbed Curse, then collect the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse from his body. Reloading the area, you'll be able to collect the Omen Set too.

quest:dungeater:invasion.name: Dung Eater — defeated at the Leyndell moat
quest:dungeater:invasion.description: Visit the moat to the south-east below the capital's ramparts to meet again with Boggart, who now sells an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs too. Talk to him and select About the Dung Eater. Reload the area to find Boggart moribund and, after talking to him, collect Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball, and Blackguard's Iron Mask from his cadaver. Shortly after, the Dung Eater will invade you and, once defeated, will drop his Sword of Milos.
related: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
Dung Eater — cell opened in the Shunning-Grounds

sections.heading: Wiki: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Outer Wall Battleground)
sections.text: Visit the moat to the south-east below the capital's ramparts to meet again with Boggart, who now sells an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs too. Talk to him and select About the Dung Eater. Reload the area to find Boggart moribund and, after talking to him, collect Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball, and Blackguard's Iron Mask from his cadaver. Shortly after, the Dung Eater will invade you and, once defeated, will drop his Sword of Milos.

quest:dungeater:met.name: Dung Eater — met at the Roundtable
quest:dungeater:met.description: After touching any Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, the Dung Eater will appear in the western quarter of the Roundtable Hold, past Gideon's study. Talk to him with at least one Seedbed Curse in inventory to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "There's something you should know" to warn you of the danger of the new arrival.
related: Open his cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

sections.heading: Wiki: Roundtable Hold
sections.text: After touching any Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, the Dung Eater will appear in the western quarter of the Roundtable Hold, past Gideon's study. Talk to him with at least one Seedbed Curse in inventory to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "There's something you should know" to warn you of the danger of the new arrival.

quest:dungeater:potioned.name: Dung Eater — made a Seluvis puppet
related: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
Use the Fell Curse rune after the Elden Beast
quest:dungeater:potioned.description: The puppet fork. It forecloses the Fell Curse rune but yields the Dung Eater puppet.

quest:edgar:letter.name: Edgar — Irina’s letter delivered
quest:edgar:letter.description: Find Castellan Edgar in Castle Morne and hand him Irina's Letter, before defeating the Leonine Misbegotten.
related: Irina — met below the Bridge of Sacrifice
Clear the Leonine Misbegotten from Castle Morne

sections.heading: Wiki: Castle Morne
sections.text: Find Castellan Edgar in Castle Morne and hand him Irina's Letter, before defeating the Leonine Misbegotten.

quest:edgar:revenger.name: Edgar the Revenger defeated
related: Recover the Shabriri Grape Edgar carried
quest:edgar:revenger.description: After Irina is found dead, Edgar invades you on the east Liurnia road. Missable if you never return.

quest:eleonora-violet-bloody-finger-step.name: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger — Altus Plateau (Altus Highway Junction)
quest:eleonora-violet-bloody-finger-step.description: After helping Yura defeat Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin at the Main Academy Gate of Raya Lucaria, you'll find him moribund inside the Second Church of Marika; exhausting his dialogues, he'll die leaving behind his Nagakiba (with the Ash of War: Piercing Fang). Shortly after, Eleonora will invade you: defeating her will award you with her Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear that counters Mohg, Lord of Blood's phase transitioning curse-attack.

quest:ensha-of-the-royal-remains-step-1.name: Ensha of the Royal Remains — Roundtable Hold
quest:ensha-of-the-royal-remains-step-1.description: Talk to him to receive the "What do you want?" Gesture.

quest:ensha-of-the-royal-remains-step-2.name: Ensha of the Royal Remains — Roundtable Hold (step 2)
quest:ensha-of-the-royal-remains-step-2.description: After retrieving the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) from Old Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics, or the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)from Castle Sol, Ensha will invade the player. Upon death, he drops the Clinging Bone and his Royal Remains Set can then be collected from his original spot outside Gideon's room. Afterwards, Gideon will have a new dialogue option About Ensha and, once exhausted, About the secret medallions.

quest:erdtree-burned.name: The Erdtree burned at the Forge of the Giants

quest:errant-sorcerer-wilhelm-step-1.name: Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
quest:errant-sorcerer-wilhelm-step-1.description: After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan and Rileigh the Idle under Tanith's request, talk to Recusant Bernahl in the eastern quarter of the manor to receive Letter to Bernhal, unlocking Wilhelm's invasion sign in Leyndell. Once Wilhelm and Vargram, the Raging Wolf are defeated, awarding you with the Raging Wolf Set, return to Bernhal to receive Gelmir's Fury.

quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-1.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion — Roundtable Hold
quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-1.description: Fia can be found in her room in Roundtable Hold. Initially she will be available to provide a Baldachin's Blessing. After Rogier comes to Roundtable Hold and discusses the Night of Black Knives, Fia will provide a Knifeprint Clue. The Black Knifeprint must be obtained and given to Rogier.

quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-2.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion — Roundtable Hold (step 2)
quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-2.description: After triggering the Radahn Festival, Fia will ask you to return the Weathered Dagger to its rightful owner. You must give this to D, Hunter of the Dead, and reload the area. Fia can now be found in a previously locked room, standing over D's corpse. Exhaust her dialogue and she will disappear.

quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-3.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion — Deeproot Depths
quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-3.description: While being held, choose "Talk in Secret" to learn about the Cursemark of Death.

quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-4.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion — Divine Tower of Liurnia
quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-4.description: In order to access the Divine Tower of Liurnia, you need to have progressed Ranni the Witch's quest and received the Carian Inverted Statue. Use the statue on the pedestal in the first room of the Carian Study Hall and progress through the area to the Divine Tower. Retrieve the Cursemark of Death from the top of the tower.

quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-5.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion — Deeproot Depths (step 5)
quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-5.description: Speak to Fia again and select "Talk in Secret" until you receive the option to hand Fia the Cursemark of Death. Exhaust her dialogue once again and reload the area to find her sleeping.

quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-6.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion — Deathbed Dream
quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-6.description: Interact with Fia's body to enter the Deathbed Dream. Defeat Lichdragon Fortissax to return to Deeproot Depths.

quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-7.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion — Deeproot Depths (step 7)
quest:fia-the-deathbed-companion-step-7.description: Loot the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from Fia's body. This will allow you to achieve the Age of Duskborn ending. Reload the area to find Fia dead, with D, Beholder of Death standing over her.

quest:fia:cursemark.name: Fia — Cursemark of Death given
related: Defeat Lichdragon Fortissax in her dream
quest:fia:cursemark.description: Across the coffin after Godwyn’s prince. Defend her from Lionel, pick the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.

quest:fia:dagger.name: Fia — Weathered Dagger decided
related: Ride the coffin down to the Deeproot Depths
quest:fia:dagger.description: Give it to D and Fia leaves the Roundtable; keep it and D lives. Either way she moves to the Deeproot Depths.

quest:fia:killed.name: Fia killed
quest:fia:killed.description: Age of the Duskborn — Get the Cursemark of Death

quest:fia:met.name: Fia — held at the Roundtable
quest:fia:met.description: Hold her, then follow D’s brother and the Cursemark path.

quest:finger-reader-enia-step-1.name: Finger Reader Enia — step 1
quest:finger-reader-enia-step-1.description: Enia can first be spoken to in Roundtable Hold, in the door west of the Table of Lost Grace, after defeating a Shardbearer. Exhaust her dialogue to unlock her two shop inventories.

quest:finger-reader-enia-step-2.name: Finger Reader Enia — After defeating two Shardbearers, speak to Enia again to receive a Talisman Pouch.
quest:finger-reader-enia-step-2.description: If you defeat Morgott, the Omen King before speaking to Enia during this step, the Talisman Pouch will be available to purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks.
quest:finger-reader-enia-step-2.location: After defeating two Shardbearers, speak to Enia again to receive a Talisman Pouch.

quest:finger-reader-enia-step-3.name: Finger Reader Enia — step 3
quest:finger-reader-enia-step-3.description: After defeating Morgott, the Omen King and attempting to access the Erdtree, speak to Enia again for some additional dialogue.

quest:finger-reader-enia-step-4.name: Finger Reader Enia — step 4
quest:finger-reader-enia-step-4.description: After gaining access to Crumbling Farum Azula, speak to Enia again for some additional dialogue.

quest:finger-reader-enia-step-5.name: Finger Reader Enia — step 5
quest:finger-reader-enia-step-5.description: Enia will narrate the cutscene that plays after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. She will now be dead upon returning to Roundtable Hold, however her shop inventories can still be accessed by interacting with her corpse.

quest:fire-knight-queelign-step-1.name: Fire Knight Queelign — Belurat, Tower Settlement or Church of the Crusade
quest:fire-knight-queelign-step-1.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement or Church of the Crusade

quest:fire-knight-queelign-step-2.name: Fire Knight Queelign — Belurat, Tower Settlement or Church of the Crusade (step 2)
quest:fire-knight-queelign-step-2.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement or Church of the Crusade

quest:fire-knight-queelign-step-3.name: Fire Knight Queelign — Prayer Room of Shadow Keep's Church District
quest:fire-knight-queelign-step-3.description: Exhaust dialogue and give either an Iris of Grace or an Iris of Occultation
quest:fire-knight-queelign-step-3.location: Prayer Room of Shadow Keep's Church District

quest:frenzy:taken.name: Frenzy taken
quest:frenzy:taken.description: Lord of Frenzied Flame — Take the Frenzied Flame

quest:freyja:concluded.name: Carry her alliance into Enir-Ilim
related: Find her in the Shadow Keep Specimen Storehouse
quest:freyja:concluded.description: She can be summoned for the Leda fights. Siding against Leda keeps her; siding with Leda forecloses her.

quest:freyja:keep.name: Find her in the Shadow Keep Specimen Storehouse
related: Freyja — met at the Three-Path Cross
quest:freyja:keep.description: She studies the jars and asks you to keep her counsel. Do not attack her; the Keep invitations decide who lives.

quest:freyja:met.name: Freyja — met at the Three-Path Cross
related: Find her in the Shadow Keep Specimen Storehouse

quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-1.name: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle
quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-1.description: Gostoc can be found in the gatehouse to the left of the main gate. He will offer you the choice of taking the main gate or using the side entrance. Choosing "No, I'll use the main entrance" will cause the main gate to open when you approach it. This will not prevent you from taking the side entrance, however.

quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-2.name: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle (step 2)
quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-2.description: *(Optional)* Upon entering a dark room in the western section of the castle, Gostoc will close the door, locking you in with a Banished Knight enemy. To leave, grab the Rusty Key and return to the door to open it. If you die in this room, you can return to it and loot the item without being locked in again. *(Optional)* Gostoc will now appear in several locations around the dungeon. Speaking to him in one of these locations for the first time will reward you with a Grace Mimic. The locations are as follows: Stormveil Cliffside.

quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-3.name: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle (Godrick's arena)
quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-3.description: After defeating Godrick the Grafted, Gostoc will appear in the room. After exhausting his dialogue his shop will be open once again. He will also stop stealing your Runes if you skipped the previous part.

quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-4.name: Gatekeeper Gostoc — Stormveil Castle (Throne Room)
quest:gatekeeper-gostoc-step-4.description: After completing Nepheli Loux's questline, Gostoc will appear in the back of the throne room. After exhausting his dialogue, his shop will become available again, now with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone available to purchase.

quest:goldmask:regression.name: Goldmask — Law of Regression read at the Erdtree statue
related: Take the Mending Rune of Perfect Order
Buy from Corhyn and find Goldmask
quest:goldmask:regression.description: Goldmask in Leyndell. Spell from the coliseum debate floor. See Radagon in the statue.

quest:gowry-step-3.name: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
quest:gowry-step-3.description: Give the Needle to Gowry. Reload the area and speak to him to obtain the repaired Needle.

quest:gowry-step-4.name: Gowry — Caelid (Church of the Plague)
quest:gowry-step-4.description: Travel to the Church of the Plague and give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle. If you immediately go back to Gowry after this point you can unlock additional dialogue and unlock his shop. Alternately, if you reload the area and speak to Millicent in the church once again, the next time you visit Gowry's Shack Gowry will be absent and Millicent will be there in his place.

quest:gowry-step-5.name: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery) (step 5)
quest:gowry-step-5.description: *(Optional)* After giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis, return to Gowry and speak to him again. He will now have Pest Threads in his shop inventory. Purchase the spell to unlock additional dialogue about Millicent and Malenia.

quest:gowry-step-6.name: Gowry — Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery) (step 6)
quest:gowry-step-6.description: Once Millicent arrives in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, return to Gowry to hear additional dialogue. He will ask you help the sisters defeat Millicent.

quest:gowry-step-7.name: Gowry — Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
quest:gowry-step-7.description: Complete the final part of Millicent's questline, by using one of the summon signs to either aid Millicent or defeat her.

quest:gowry:concluded.name: Gowry — true nature revealed after Millicent's line
quest:gowry:concluded.description: If you aided Millicent, Gowry will lament her decision to remove the Unalloyed Gold Needle. You may now permanently kill him to obtain the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing. If you killed Millicent in Elphael, Gowry will already be dead, and the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing can be looted from his corpse.

sections.heading: Wiki: Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
sections.text: If you aided Millicent, Gowry will lament her decision to remove the Unalloyed Gold Needle. You may now permanently kill him to obtain the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing. If you killed Millicent in Elphael, Gowry will already be dead, and the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing can be looted from his corpse.

quest:gowry:killed.name: Gowry killed
quest:gowry:killed.description: Gowry — Bring Gowry the Unalloyed Gold Needle

quest:gowry:met.name: Meet Gowry at his shack in Sellia
quest:gowry:met.description: Gowry can be found in his shack near the entrance to Sellia. He will request that you find an Unalloyed Gold Needle in the swamp and bring it to him in exchange for a secret about Sellia.
related: Bring Gowry the Unalloyed Gold Needle

sections.heading: Wiki: Caelid (Sellia, Town of Sorcery)
sections.text: Gowry can be found in his shack near the entrance to Sellia. He will request that you find an Unalloyed Gold Needle in the swamp and bring it to him in exchange for a secret about Sellia.

quest:great-horned-tragoth-step-1.name: Great Horned Tragoth — Multiple Locations
quest:great-horned-tragoth-step-1.description: Summon him at any location to receive the "Casual Greeting" Gesture.

quest:great-horned-tragoth-step-2.name: Great Horned Tragoth — Liurnia of the Lakes (Magma Wyrm)
quest:great-horned-tragoth-step-2.description: After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan under Tanith's request, talk to Patches the Untethered to receive Letter to Patches, unlocking Tragoth's invasion sign in Liurnia once Magma Wyrm Makar is defeated. Once the Great-Horned One is defeated, awarding you with the Bull-Goat Set, Rune Arc x1 and Furlcalling Finger Remedy x1, return to Patches twice to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick.

quest:gurranq-beast-clergyman-step-3.name: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman — step 3
quest:gurranq-beast-clergyman-step-3.description: Hand over each Deathroot you find to Gurranq in exchange for rewards. After you have given him four Deathroot, reload the area and Gurranq will attack you. After depleting 30% of Gurranq's health, he will be subdued- speak to him and reload the area so that he returns to his original position.

quest:gurranq-beast-clergyman-step-5.name: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman — Gurranq will reappear at the end of Crumbling Farum Azula, under the name Beast Clergyman. After reducing his health to 50% he will enter phase 2, under the name Maliketh, the Black Blade.
quest:gurranq-beast-clergyman-step-5.description: Maliketh can be fought before completing Gurranq's questline. Doing so will not affect the questline, and Gurranq will remain in the Bestail Sanctum even after Maliketh has been defeated. Likewise, killing Gurranq in the Bestial Sanctum will not affect the fight against Maliketh. Maliketh will have unique dialogue if you complete Gurranq's questline before fighting him in Crumbling Farum Azula.
quest:gurranq-beast-clergyman-step-5.location: Gurranq will reappear at the end of Crumbling Farum Azula, under the name Beast Clergyman. After reducing his health to 50% he will enter phase 2, under the name Maliketh, the Black Blade.

quest:gurranq:concluded.name: Finish the Deathroot and face him
quest:gurranq:concluded.description: After giving him the ninth Deathroot, he will give you an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone before disappearing.
related: Feed him Deathroot from the Tibia Mariners and elsewhere

sections.heading: Wiki: step
sections.text: After giving him the ninth Deathroot, he will give you an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone before disappearing.

quest:gurranq:deathroot.name: Feed him Deathroot from the Tibia Mariners and elsewhere
quest:gurranq:deathroot.description: Travel to the Bestial Sanctum at the north-eastern point of Caelid. The sending gate marked on your map by D if you showed him a Deathroot will lead you straight there. Speak to Gurranq. If you have at least one Deathroot, Gurranq will give you a Clawmark Seal and Beast Eye. The Beast Eye will notify you whenever you are close to another Deathroot.
related: Reach the Bestial Sanctum and meet Gurranq
Finish the Deathroot and face him

sections.heading: Wiki: step
sections.text: Travel to the Bestial Sanctum at the north-eastern point of Caelid. The sending gate marked on your map by D if you showed him a Deathroot will lead you straight there. Speak to Gurranq. If you have at least one Deathroot, Gurranq will give you a Clawmark Seal and Beast Eye. The Beast Eye will notify you whenever you are close to another Deathroot.

quest:gurranq:met.name: Reach the Bestial Sanctum and meet Gurranq
quest:gurranq:met.description: *(Optional)* Speak to D, Hunter of the Dead, after obtaining a Deathroot and he will advise you to visit Gurranq. This can either be done at the start of D's questline in Limgrave, or in Roundtable Hold.
related: Feed him Deathroot from the Tibia Mariners and elsewhere

sections.heading: Wiki: step
sections.text: *(Optional)* Speak to D, Hunter of the Dead, after obtaining a Deathroot and he will advise you to visit Gurranq. This can either be done at the start of D's questline in Limgrave, or in Roundtable Hold.

quest:hewg:roderika.name: Hewg — agrees to take Roderika on
quest:hewg:roderika.description: Reload the area and Roderika will be sitting opposite Hewg. It is now possible to upgrade Spirit Ashes by speaking to her.

sections.heading: Wiki: Roundtable Hold
sections.text: Reload the area and Roderika will be sitting opposite Hewg. It is now possible to upgrade Spirit Ashes by speaking to her.

quest:hornsent-grandam-step-1.name: Hornsent Grandam — Belurat, Tower Settlement
quest:hornsent-grandam-step-1.description: Locate Storeroom Key and use it to unlock the Storeroom (optional) Speak with Hornsent Grandam Defeat Divine Beast Dancing Lion to receive Divine Beast Head Speak with Hornsent Grandam while wearing Divine Beast Head Rest Speak with Hornsent Grandam to receive Scorpion Stew (optional) Speak with Hornsent Grandam to replenish Scorpion Stew

quest:hornsent-grandam-step-4.name: Hornsent Grandam — Belurat, Tower Settlement (step 4)
quest:hornsent-grandam-step-4.description: Speak with Hornsent Grandam to receive Gourmet Scorpion Stew

quest:hornsent:met.name: Hornsent — met at the Three-Path Cross

quest:hyetta:bellum.name: Hyetta — Fingerprint Grape at Bellum Church
related: Hyetta — grape at the Gate Town Bridge
Meet Hyetta at the Frenzied Flame Proscription
quest:hyetta:bellum.description: Defeat Festering Fingerprint Vyke near the Church of Inhibition for the Fingerprint Grape.

quest:hyetta:gatetown.name: Hyetta — grape at the Gate Town Bridge
related: Hyetta — grape at the Purified Ruins
Bring the Fingerprint Grape to Bellum Church
quest:hyetta:gatetown.description: The third grape is dropped by Edgar the Revenger when he invades near the Revenger’s Shack.

quest:hyetta:grapes.name: Hyetta — first Shabriri Grape given
related: Hyetta — met at the Lake-Facing Cliffs
Bring a Shabriri Grape to the Purified Ruins
quest:hyetta:grapes.description: At the Lake-Facing Cliffs. Tell her the grapes are human eyes when she asks.

quest:hyetta:maiden.name: Hyetta — maiden of the Three Fingers
related: Hyetta — Fingerprint Grape at Bellum Church
quest:hyetta:maiden.description: She reveals she is a maiden of the Three Fingers. Taking the flame commits the Frenzy ending.

quest:hyetta:met.name: Hyetta — met at the Lake-Facing Cliffs
related: Give her the first Shabriri Grape
quest:hyetta:met.description: Hyetta starts at the Lake-Facing Cliffs grape line. Shabriri appears later on the mountain.

quest:hyetta:purified.name: Hyetta — grape at the Purified Ruins
related: Bring a Shabriri Grape to the Gate Town Bridge
quest:hyetta:purified.description: South Liurnia. The second grape sits in the ruins’ hidden cellar behind the barrels.

quest:igon-step-1.name: Igon — Gravesite Plain
quest:igon-step-1.description: Find Igon by following his screams; he is on the floor near the Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace outside the Dragon's Pit. Talk to him until you exhaust his dialogue.

quest:igon-step-2.name: Igon — Foot of the Jagged Peak
quest:igon-step-2.description: After climbing the Jagged Peak and defeating the Jagged Peak Drake he starts screaming again, he is in the middle of the road that advances to the next area. Exhaust his dialogue until he gives you Igon's Furled Finger and asks you to summon him.

quest:igon:met.name: Igon — met on the road up the Jagged Peak
quest:igon:met.description: After Bayle the Dread appears in his arena, Igon can be summoned to fight him. His summon sign is right in front of the fog wall (on your very first fight against Bayle, the summon sign won't appear until the boss spawns).
related: Meet him again at the peak’s edge

sections.heading: Wiki: Jagged Peak
sections.text: After Bayle the Dread appears in his arena, Igon can be summoned to fight him. His summon sign is right in front of the fog wall (on your very first fight against Bayle, the summon sign won't appear until the boss spawns).

quest:igon:peak.name: Igon — met again at the peak
related: Igon — met on the road up the Jagged Peak
Summon Igon at the Bayle fog gate

quest:igon:summon.name: Igon — summoned at the Bayle fog gate
related: Igon — met again at the peak

quest:irina-of-morne-step-1.name: Irina — Weeping Peninsula (near Bridge of Sacrifice)
quest:irina-of-morne-step-1.description: Irina can be found sitting on a rock near the Bridge of Sacrifice. Talk to her and accept her request to receive Irina's Letter.

quest:irina:castle.name: Castle Morne — Leonine Misbegotten felled
related: Report back to Edgar and find Irina
quest:irina:castle.description: Deliver the letter before the boss. The Leonine drops the Grafted Blade Greatsword on the shore.

quest:irina:dead.name: Irina is found dead
related: Face Edgar the Revenger at the Revenger’s Shack
quest:irina:dead.description: Edgar speaks of returning to her; ride back to the Bridge of Sacrifice to see the outcome.

quest:irina:met.name: Irina — met below the Bridge of Sacrifice
quest:irina:met.description: Return to Irina after delivering the letter to find her corpse. If you defeated the Leonine Misbegotten, Edgar will also be here. If you rested at a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes after receiving Irina's Letter, Irina will die even if you have not done the Castle Morne segment of the questline.
related: Deliver the letter to Edgar at Castle Morne

sections.heading: Wiki: Weeping Peninsula (near Bridge of Sacrifice)
sections.text: Return to Irina after delivering the letter to find her corpse. If you defeated the Leonine Misbegotten, Edgar will also be here. If you rested at a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes after receiving Irina's Letter, Irina will die even if you have not done the Castle Morne segment of the questline.

quest:jar-bairn-step-1.name: Jar-Bairn — Jarburg
quest:jar-bairn-step-1.description: Jar-Bairn can be found sitting in front of a house north-west of the Site of Grace. Exhaust his dialogue and decide whether or not to accept his request- the decision does not affect the rest of the questline. After resting at a Site of Grace, speak to him again to exhaust his new dialogue.

quest:jar-bairn-step-2.name: Jar-Bairn — Jarburg (step 2)
quest:jar-bairn-step-2.description: If you have met Alexander, Warrior Jar, Jar-Bairn will have new dialogue after you rest at a Site of Grace again.

quest:jar-bairn-step-3.name: Jar-Bairn — Jarburg (step 3)
quest:jar-bairn-step-3.description: After reloading the area, speak to him again to receive dialogue about poachers. This dialogue becomes available after Knight Diallos has arrived at Volcano Manor.

quest:jar-bairn-step-4.name: Jar-Bairn — Jarburg (step 4)
quest:jar-bairn-step-4.description: After Knight Diallos has left Volcano Manor, return to Jarburg and speak to Jar-Bairn again.

quest:jar-bairn-step-5.name: Jar-Bairn — Jarburg (step 5)
quest:jar-bairn-step-5.description: Reload the area six times and speak to Jar-Bairn near the middle of the village. Speak to Diallos and then reload the area and speak to Jar-Bairn once more.

quest:jar-bairn-step-6.name: Jar-Bairn — Jarburg (step 6)
quest:jar-bairn-step-6.description: After defeating Alexander, Warrior Jar in Crumbling Farum Azula, return to Jarburg and give Jar-Bairn Alexander's Innards. Reload the area, and speak to Jar-Bairn again to receive his final dialogue.

quest:jarbairn:concluded.name: Jar-Bairn — vows to grow strong
quest:jarbairn:concluded.description: The nephew in Liurnia’s jar village vows to grow as strong as his uncle.

quest:jolan:met.name: Jolan, Swordhand of Night — met
related: Descend beneath the cathedral and defeat Metyr
Ymir — bell rung at the Finger Ruins of Dheo

quest:juno-hoslow-knight-of-blood-step-1.name: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
quest:juno-hoslow-knight-of-blood-step-1.description: After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan and Rileigh the Idle under Tanith's request, retrieve the Red Letter to unlock Juno Hoslow's invasion sign in the Mountaintops of the Giants. With Rileigh dead, you can also talk to Recusant Bernahl to receive the Letter to Bernahl, offering you to join him in his hunt against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

quest:juno-hoslow-knight-of-blood-step-2.name: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) (step 2)
quest:juno-hoslow-knight-of-blood-step-2.description: Once Juno is disposed of, return to Tanith to receive the Taker's Cameo: she'll now offer to transport you to the Audience Pathway Site of Grace by selecting See the Lord.

quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.name: Kenneth Haight, Limgrave Heir — Limgrave (near Third Church of Marika)
quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.description: Speak to Kenneth atop the ruin near the Third Church of Marika and agree to clear his fort.

quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.name: Kenneth Haight, Limgrave Heir — Fort Haight
quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.description: Kill the Godrick Knight in Fort Haight.

quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.name: Kenneth Haight, Limgrave Heir — Limgrave (near Third Church of Marika) (step 3)
quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.description: Return to Kenneth and receive an Erdsteel Dagger. Accept his offer to make you a knight.

quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.name: Kenneth Haight, Limgrave Heir — Fort Haight (step 4)
quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.description: Speak to Kenneth in Fort Haight.

quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.name: Kenneth Haight, Limgrave Heir — Stormveil Castle
quest:kenneth-haight-limgrave-heir-step-.description: Speak to Kenneth in Stormveil Castle, in the throne room beyond the Godrick the Grafted Site of Grace.

quest:kenneth:fort.name: Clear Fort Haight and meet Kenneth
related: Accept his knightly errand at Mistwood Ruins
quest:kenneth:fort.description: East Limgrave. Kill the Demi-Human Chief on the ramparts, then take the Bloody Slash ash and Kenneth’s request.

quest:kenneth:knighthood.name: Accept his knightly errand at Mistwood Ruins
related: Clear Fort Haight and meet Kenneth
Crown Nepheli at Stormveil with Kenneth as steward
quest:kenneth:knighthood.description: He asks you to find a worthy ruler for Limgrave. Nepheli Loux is that ruler.

quest:kenneth:ruler.name: Crown Nepheli at Stormveil with Kenneth as steward
related: Accept his knightly errand at Mistwood Ruins
quest:kenneth:ruler.description: After Morgott and after giving Nepheli the Stormhawk King ashes, return to the Stormveil throne room. Requires the Nepheli line, not Seluvis’s potion.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-1.name: Knight Bernahl — Limgrave (Warmaster's Shack)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-1.description: *(Optional)* Speaking to Bernahl unlocks the option to purchase Ashes of War from him, regardless of the answer to his question.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-2.name: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-2.description: Speaking with Tanith and selecting "Join Volcano Manor" to receive the Drawing-Room Key, Bernahl will relocate to the eastern quarter of the manor, where Rya the Scout is also found.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-3.name: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) (step 3)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-3.description: After assassinating Old Knight Istvan, as commissioned in the first Letter from Volcano Manor, speaking to Bernahl unlocks the option to purchase the Ashes of War he used to sell in Limgrave and two new additions, Eruption and Assassin's Gambit.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-4.name: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) (step 4)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-4.description: After assassinating Rileigh the Idle, as commissioned in the second Letter from Volcano Manor, speaking to Bernahl prompts him to give the Letter to Bernahl to the Tarnished, inviting him to join forces against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm at the Fortified Manor of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-5.name: Knight Bernahl — Leyndell, Royal Capital (Fortified Manor, First Floor)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-5.description: Interacting with the invasion sign before the corpse holding Alberich's Set allows the Tarnished to fight alongside Bernahl against Vargram and Wilhelm. This assassination will reward the Tarnished with Vargram's Raging Wolf Set.
quest:knight-bernahl-step-5.location: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Fortified Manor, First Floor)

quest:knight-bernahl-step-6.name: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) (step 6)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-6.description: With the task fulfilled, returning to Bernahl prompts him to give Gelmir's Fury to the Tarnished. This will also unlock his summon sign in Crumbling Farum Azula.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-7.name: Knight Bernahl — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) (step 7)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-7.description: After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, exhausting Bernahl's dialogue triggers his departure from Volcano Manor. His shop will still be accessible via the "Sword of Bernahl" left on his chair.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-8.name: Knight Bernahl — Crumbling Farum Azula (Dragon Temple Transept)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-8.description: *(Optional)* If the Tarnished and Bernahl hunted down Vargram and Wilhelm in Leyndell, the recusant's summon sign will appear outside the Dragon Temple, to aid his brother in arms against the Godskin Duo.

quest:knight-bernahl-step-9.name: Knight Bernahl — Crumbling Farum Azula (Besides the Great Bridge)
quest:knight-bernahl-step-9.description: Following the path to the north from the Great Bridge, Bernhal will invade the Tarnished before the tower with the chest containing the Old Lord's Talisman. When defeated, he drops the Blasphemous Claw.
quest:knight-bernahl-step-9.location: Crumbling Farum Azula (Besides the Great Bridge)

quest:knight-diallos-step-2.name: Knight Diallos — Liurnia of the Lakes (Academy Gate Town)
quest:knight-diallos-step-2.description: Diallos will appear in Liurnia of the Lakes, northwest of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue.
quest:knight-diallos-step-2.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Academy Gate Town)

quest:knight-diallos-step-3.name: Knight Diallos — Roundtable Hold
quest:knight-diallos-step-3.description: Diallos will return to Roundtable Hold. Speak to him to learn the location of Volcano Manor.

quest:knight-diallos-step-4.name: Knight Diallos — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor}
quest:knight-diallos-step-4.description: After joining the Recusants, Diallos will appear in the drawing room in Volcano Manor. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy or completing one of Tanith's requests, speak to Diallos again and exhaust his dialogue.

quest:latenna:concluded.name: Summon Latenna at the Apostate Derelict
quest:latenna:concluded.description: Travel to the Apostate Derelict in the northernmost part of the Consecrated Snowfields and approach the giant Albinauric woman to summon Latenna. Exhaust Latenna's dialogue to obtain a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

sections.heading: Wiki: Consecrated Snowfields (Apostate Derelict)
sections.text: Travel to the Apostate Derelict in the northernmost part of the Consecrated Snowfields and approach the giant Albinauric woman to summon Latenna. Exhaust Latenna's dialogue to obtain a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

quest:latenna:met.name: Meet Latenna at the Slumbering Wolf’s Shack
quest:latenna:met.description: Latenna can be found at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack, accessible by clearing the Lakeside Crystal Cave. If you have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), obtained from Old Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics, she will die and you will be able to pick up Latenna the Albinauric (Spirit Ashes). If you have already obtained Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) from Castle Sol, Latenna will already be dead, and you can pick up her Spirit Ashes.
quest:latenna:met.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Slumbering Wolf's Shack)
related: Take Castle Sol for the medallion’s other half

sections.heading: Wiki: Liurnia of the Lakes (Slumbering Wolf's Shack)
sections.text: Latenna can be found at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack, accessible by clearing the Lakeside Crystal Cave. If you have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), obtained from Old Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics, she will die and you will be able to pick up Latenna the Albinauric (Spirit Ashes). If you have already obtained Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) from Castle Sol, Latenna will already be dead, and you can pick up her Spirit Ashes.

quest:leda:concluded.name: Leda — Enir-Ilim alliance resolved
quest:leda:concluded.description: Defeat both Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood. Then rest on the nearest Site of Grace. Leda will appear in front of Miquella's cocoon at Mohgywn Dynasty Mausoleum and urge to interact with it.
related: Leda — invitation window closed at the Sealing Tree

sections.heading: Wiki: step
sections.text: Defeat both Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood. Then rest on the nearest Site of Grace. Leda will appear in front of Miquella's cocoon at Mohgywn Dynasty Mausoleum and urge to interact with it.

quest:leda:highroad.name: Leda — met at the Highroad Cross
related: Leda — met at the Three-Path Cross
Enter the Shadow Keep and free Ansbach

quest:leda:invitations.name: Leda — Shadow Keep invitations cleared
related: Ansbach — freed in the Shadow Keep

quest:leda:invitations-locked.name: Leda — invitation window closed at the Sealing Tree
related: Side with your allies at Enir-Ilim

quest:leda:met.name: Leda — met at the Three-Path Cross
related: Clear Castle Ensis and meet them at the Highroad Cross

quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-1.name: Lightseeker Hyetta — Lake-Facing Cliffs (Liurnia of the Lakes)
