quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-1.description: Hyetta first appears near the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. Exhaust her dialogue, and she shall request a Shabriri Grape. Give her a Shabriri Grape, the nearest of which is south of Hyetta, found within the rear entrance to Stormveil Castle. However, the door is locked from the other side, accessible from the Stormveil Castle throne room.

quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-2.name: Lightseeker Hyetta — Purified Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes)
quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-2.description: Hyetta moves to a spot close to the Purified Ruins. She again asks for a Shabriri Grape, the closest of which is east of Hyetta's location, within the Purified Ruins. It is in a secret cellar, hidden beneath some wooden planks. Give her the Shabriri Grape and exhaust her dialogue.

quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-3.name: Lightseeker Hyetta — Gate Town Bridge (Liurnia of the Lakes)
quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-3.description: Hyetta will now appear just north of the Gate Town Bridge site of grace. She will ask for yet another Shabriri Grape. The final grape is dropped by Edgar the Revenger, who ambushes the player at the Revenger's Shack, found north of the Minor Erdtree in western Liurnia. After giving her the third grape, you will have the option to tell her that the grapes are human eyes. After hearing her dialogue following this revelation, reload the area and speak to her again in the same spot.
quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-3.location: Gate Town Bridge (Liurnia of the Lakes)

quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-4.name: Lightseeker Hyetta — Bellum Church (Bellum Highway)
quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-4.description: Hyetta is next found within the ruined Bellum Church, found along the Bellum Highway. After talking to her, she will ask you to bring her a special Fingerprint Grape. This item can be obtained by defeating Festering Fingerprint Vyke, who invades the player at the Church of Inhibition in eastern Liurnia. Bring Hyetta the grape and exhaust her dialogue.

quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-5.name: Lightseeker Hyetta — Frenzied Flame Proscription (Subterranean Shunning-Grounds)
quest:lightseeker-hyetta-step-5.description: Hyetta's final location is in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, deep below Leyndell, Royal Capital, at the bottom of the Frenzied Flame Proscription. A seal at the Cathedral of the Forsaken restricts access to this location, available only after defeating Morgott, the Omen King. Exhaust her dialogue until she instructs you to unequip all Armor and interact with the burnt door at the end of the hall, past where she stands. Remove all Armor and interact with the door to initiate a cutscene wherein the player meets the Three Fingers and inherits the Flame of Frenzy.

quest:melina-step-1.name: Melina — Stranded Graveyard
quest:melina-step-1.description: After fighting the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, Melina and Torrent appear during a cutscene. Melina grants the Flask of Crimson Tears and Flask of Cerulean Tears before departing.

quest:melina-step-2.name: Melina — Sites of Grace (Limgrave)
quest:melina-step-2.description: After leaving the Stranded Graveyard, activate and rest at either the Agheel Lake North or Gatefront Ruins Sites of Grace. A cutscene will play and Melina will offer an accord. Alternatively, activate at any two Sites of Grace in the overworld and then rest at one of the following eight Sites of Grace: Agheel Lake North, Agheel Lake South, Bridge of Sacrifice, Church of Elleh, Gatefront Ruins, Seaside Ruins, Stormhill Shack, or Third Church of Marika. *(Optional)* If you refuse her accord, you cannot enter Leyndell, Royal Capital, even with two Great Runes.

quest:melina-step-3.name: Melina — *(Optional)* Sites of Grace
quest:melina-step-3.description: Melina may appear when you rest at any Site of Grace, offering the dialogue options "The Rays of Grace" and "Melina's Goal". Note: these options will no longer be available once you progress to the next step. Melina offers to share the words of Queen Marika when the player rests at one of the following Sites of Grace: Church of Pilgrimage, First Church of Marika, Grand Lift of Dectus, Minor Erdtree Church, Outer Wall Battleground, Queen's Bedchamber, and Third Church of Marika. Select "Talk to Melina" and accept to hear them.

quest:melina-step-4.name: Melina — Sites of Grace
quest:melina-step-4.description: Rest at any Site of Grace outside Limgrave or fight Margit, the Fell Omen at least once to trigger another conversation in which Melina extends an invitation to the Roundtable Hold. Accepting this invite is mandatory for accessing Leyndell, Royal Capital later in the game.

quest:melina-step-5.name: Melina — *(Optional)* Sites of Grace (step 5)
quest:melina-step-5.description: After progressing Boc the Seamster's questline, Melina may appear to discuss him. If Boc moves to the East Raya Lucaria Gate, Melina will appear there to ask about him. If Boc moves to the Altus Highway Junction, Melina will appear there to ask about him again.

quest:melina-step-6.name: Melina — *(Optional)* Sites of Grace (Altus Plateau or Capital Outskirts)
quest:melina-step-6.description: Speak to Melina at any Site of Grace on the Altus Plateau or in the Capital Outskirts. This step is missed if the player enters Leyndell, Royal Capital.
quest:melina-step-6.location: *(Optional)* Sites of Grace (Altus Plateau or Capital Outskirts)

quest:melina-step-7.name: Melina — Leyndell, Royal Capital
quest:melina-step-7.description: Resting at a Site of Grace in Leyndell will trigger another interaction with Melina, after which she will leave you. Her dialogue options at various Sites of Grace will be temporarily unavailable. Defeat Morgott, the Omen King. *(Optional)* Melina may be summoned as a cooperator by activating her summon sign outside Morgott's boss room. Approach the entrance to the Erdtree, turn back, and rest at the Elden Throne Site of Grace. Melina will appear and, after some dialogue, give you the Rold Medallion.

quest:melina-step-8.name: Melina — *(Ending A)* Mountaintops of the Giants
quest:melina-step-8.description: After defeating the Fire Giant and resting at the Forge of the Giants, you may talk to Melina. Speak to her and respond "I'm Ready" to commit the cardinal sin. Melina awakens the Giants' Flame, becomes its kindling, and burns the Erdtree. The player collapses and awakens in Crumbling Farum Azula. Note: this ends Melina's questline, as her spirit. You will not be able to hear any dialogue you may have missed.

quest:melina-step-9.name: Melina — *(Ending B)* Frenzied Flame Proscription
quest:melina-step-9.description: Visit the Frenzied Flame Proscription and interact with the Three Fingers. Melina will appear at the next Site of Grace you rest at and will leave you permanently. Note: this action cannot be reversed by using Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows or inserting Miquella's Needle at Dragonlord Placidusax. You will not be able to hear any dialogue you may have missed. Note: you will gain the option "Listen to the flames" when resting at the Forge of the Giants Site of Grace, allowing progression to Crumbling Farum Azula. This unlocks an additional cutscene in the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.

quest:millicent-step-1.name: Millicent — Caelid (Swamp of Aeonia)
quest:millicent-step-1.description: *(Optional)* Millicent can invade in the south-eastern part of the Swamp of Aeonia.

quest:millicent-step-4.name: Millicent — Caelid (Gowry's Shack)
quest:millicent-step-4.description: Return to Gowry's Shack and exhaust Millicent's dialogue.

quest:millicent:aid.name: Millicent — aided at Elphael (gold sign)
quest:millicent:aid.description: After defeating the Putrid Tree Spirit there will be two summon signs on the right ledge above the Scarlet Rot pool, both very close to each other. Selecting the gold summon sign will send you into Millicent's world to help her fight off her four sisters: Mary, Eldest Sister; Maureen, Second Sister; Amy, Third Sister; Polyanna, Youngest Sister. Doing so will reward you with the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia. After the fight, find Millicent lying beside the poison pool and speak to her to end her quest.
related: Millicent — met at the Elphael Prayer Room

sections.heading: Wiki: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
sections.text: After defeating the Putrid Tree Spirit there will be two summon signs on the right ledge above the Scarlet Rot pool, both very close to each other. Selecting the gold summon sign will send you into Millicent's world to help her fight off her four sisters: Mary, Eldest Sister; Maureen, Second Sister; Amy, Third Sister; Polyanna, Youngest Sister. Doing so will reward you with the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia. After the fight, find Millicent lying beside the poison pool and speak to her to end her quest.

quest:millicent:altus.name: Millicent — met at Erdtree-Gazing Hill
quest:millicent:altus.description: Find Millicent on a hill north of the Erdtree Gazing Hill Site of Grace. Go to the Shaded Castle and find the Valkyrie's Prosthesis in a treasure chest. Return to Millicent and give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis. Millicent will now be available as a summon for the following bosses: Godskin Apostle (Windmill Heights), Draconic Tree Sentinel (Capital Outskirts), Black Blade Kindred (Forbidden Lands).
related: Millicent — cured at the Church of the Plague

sections.heading: Wiki: Altus Plateau (Erdtree-Gazing Hill Ruins)
sections.text: Find Millicent on a hill north of the Erdtree Gazing Hill Site of Grace. Go to the Shaded Castle and find the Valkyrie's Prosthesis in a treasure chest. Return to Millicent and give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis. Millicent will now be available as a summon for the following bosses: Godskin Apostle (Windmill Heights), Draconic Tree Sentinel (Capital Outskirts), Black Blade Kindred (Forbidden Lands).

quest:millicent:betrayed.name: Millicent — challenged at Elphael (red sign)
quest:millicent:betrayed.description: The red summon sign makes her an enemy. You get her prosthesis; you lose the needle and the insignia.

quest:millicent:cured.name: Millicent — cured at the Church of the Plague
quest:millicent:cured.description: Give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle, then rest at the Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.

sections.heading: Wiki: Caelid (Church of the Plague)
sections.text: Give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle, then rest at the Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.

quest:millicent:elphael.name: Millicent — met at the Elphael Prayer Room
quest:millicent:elphael.description: Find Millicent next to the Prayer Room Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue. *(Optional)* Speaking to Gowry at this point will cause him to provide new dialogue explaining the next part of the questline.
related: Millicent — met at the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins

sections.heading: Wiki: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
sections.text: Find Millicent next to the Prayer Room Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue. *(Optional)* Speaking to Gowry at this point will cause him to provide new dialogue explaining the next part of the questline.

quest:millicent:godskin.name: Millicent — aided at Dominula
related: Meet Millicent at the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins
quest:millicent:godskin.description: Windmill Village. Her gold summon sign sits by the Godskin Apostle; fight beside her, then talk to her.

quest:millicent:mountains.name: Millicent — met at the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins
quest:millicent:mountains.description: Find Millicent beside the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.
related: Meet Millicent at the Elphael Prayer Room

sections.heading: Wiki: Mountaintops of the Giants
sections.text: Find Millicent beside the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.

quest:millicent:needle.name: Millicent — unalloyed needle
quest:millicent:needle.description: Travel to the Swamp of Aeonia and defeat Commander O'Neil to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
related: Cure Millicent at the Church of the Plague

sections.heading: Wiki: Caelid (Swamp of Aeonia)
sections.text: Travel to the Swamp of Aeonia and defeat Commander O'Neil to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle.

sections.heading: Wiki: Caelid (Swamp of Aeonia and Gowry's Shack)
sections.text: Defeat Commander O'Niel to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle and bring it to Gowry. Reload the area and speak to Gowry again to obtain the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle.

quest:millicent:prosthesis.name: Millicent — Valkyrie’s Prosthesis given
quest:millicent:prosthesis.description: After defeating the Godskin Apostle, reload and speak to Millicent near the Site of Grace of the battle and exhaust her dialogue.
related: Aid her at Dominula and the Godskin Apostle

sections.heading: Wiki: Altus Plateau (Dominula, Windmill Village)
sections.text: After defeating the Godskin Apostle, reload and speak to Millicent near the Site of Grace of the battle and exhaust her dialogue.

quest:moore-step-1.name: Moore — Main Gate Cross, Gravesite Plain

quest:moore-step-3.name: Moore — Main Gate Cross, Gravesite Plain (step 3)
quest:moore-step-3.description: Talk to Moore to decide his fate

quest:moore-step-4.name: Moore — Church of the Crusade or Enir-Ilim
quest:moore-step-4.location: Church of the Crusade or Enir-Ilim

quest:moore-step-5.name: Moore — Pillar Path Cross, Gravesite Plain

quest:moore-step-6.name: Moore — Main Gate Cross, Gravesite Plain (step 6)
quest:moore-step-6.description: Talk to Moore to receive Black Syrup

quest:moore-step-7.name: Moore — Realm of Shadow
quest:moore-step-7.description: Talk to 5 Forager Brood to receive Forager Brood Cookbook 1-3, 5, 6

quest:moore-step-8.name: Moore — Church of the Crusade, Scadu Altus
quest:moore-step-8.description: Use a Sunwarmth Stone on the Forager Brood Rest and return to receive Forager Brood Cookbook 4
quest:moore-step-8.location: Church of the Crusade, Scadu Altus

quest:moore-step-9.name: Moore — Main Gate Cross, Gravesite Plain (step 9)
quest:moore-step-9.description: Talk to Moore to receive Forager Brood Cookbook 7

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-1.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Limgrave (Stormhill Shack)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-1.description: Talk with Roderika, receiving the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes, and give her the Chrysalids' Memento retrieved from Godrick's grafting grounds in Stormveil Castle to have her move to the Roundtable Hold. Otherwise, just entering Liurnia of the Lakes is enough to trigger this passage and, while the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes will be lost, the Golden Seed you'd have received at the Hold can instead be found in her spot at the shack.

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-2.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Roundtable Hold
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-2.description: Talk with Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing and exhaust his dialogues to have him move inside his study guarded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Talk with Hewg selecting About Roderika, then speak to her selecting Tell her what the blacksmith said and finally return to the smithing master selecting About Roderika -> Would you watch over Roderika? -> It's what she wants. Roderika becoming a Spirit Tuner under Hewg's wing is necessary to complete step #7.

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-3.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Limgrave (Liftside Chamber)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-3.description: Past the first two Stormhawks, Nepheli can be found in a small room on the path leading to the Secluded Cell Site of Grace. Exhaust her dialogue to unlock her summon sign outside the fog gate of Godrick the Grafted. *(Optional)* Summoning her will unlock alternate dialogue in the next step of her questline.

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-4.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Roundtable Hold (step 4)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-4.description: Nepheli will be standing just outside Gideon's study. Talk to her to receive the Arsenal Charm. If you defeated Godrick without speaking to her in the previous step, she will not give the Arsenal Charm.

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-5.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Liurnia of the Lakes (Village of the Albinaurics)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-5.description: Nepheli can be found on the slope leading up to the village. Exhaust her dialogue to unlock her summon sign past the bridge leading to the Omenkiller Mini-Boss.
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-5.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Village of the Albinaurics)

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-6.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Liurnia of the Lakes (The Four Belfries)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-6.description: Use an Imbued Sword Key (one is found in the chest near the Site of Grace) at the Precipice of Anticipation's Sending Gate to return to the starting area of the game and, past the Grafted Scion, enter the previously closed door next to the Chapel of Anticipation to reach the rooftop where The Stormhawk King is found.
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-6.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (The Four Belfries)

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-7.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Roundtable Hold (step 7)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-7.description: With the Omenkiller defeated (regardless of whether you summoned her), she will return to the Roundtable Hold, relocating at the bottom of the stairs near Hewg. Talk to her, then speak with Gideon selecting Nepheli's despair and return to Nepheli to exhaust her dialogues.

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-8.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Limgrave (Godrick the Grafted)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-8.description: After defeating Morgott, the Omen King, return to the Godrick the Grafted Site of Grace and exhaust Gatekeeper Gostoc's dialogues, reloadig the area until he disappears from stomping on Godrick's corpse. Gostoc and Nepheli will now be found within the throne room of Stormveil Caste: exhaust her dialogues to receive Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone x1 and he too will now sell one for 20,000 Runes.

quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-9.name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior — Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Queen's Bed Chamber)
quest:nepheli-loux-warrior-step-9.description: *(Optional)* Nepheli's summon sign can be found outside the fog gate of Godfrey, First Elden Lord, alongside Shabriri's if the player has followed Hyetta and Yura's questlines.

quest:nepheli:despair.name: Nepheli — found in despair after the Omenkiller
related: Nepheli — spoken to at the Roundtable
quest:nepheli:despair.description: After the Village of the Albinaurics boss she sits near Hewg’s stairs. Tell Gideon about her.

quest:nepheli:met.name: Nepheli — met in Stormveil
related: Speak with her outside Gideon’s study
quest:nepheli:met.description: Side room past the early Stormhawks before the Liftside Chamber. Exhaust her dialogue and her summon sign appears for Godrick.

quest:nepheli:refused-potion.name: Nepheli — Seluvis potion refused
related: Nepheli — found in despair after the Omenkiller
Give her the Stormhawk King ashes
quest:nepheli:refused-potion.description: Seluvis asks you to test the potion on her. Giving it to her ends her line and makes her a puppet.

quest:nepheli:roundtable.name: Nepheli — spoken to at the Roundtable
related: Find her in despair after the Omenkiller
quest:nepheli:roundtable.description: Roundtable Hold, after Godrick. She gives the Arsenal Charm if you met her or summoned her for the fight.

quest:nepheli:ruler.name: Nepheli — crowned at Stormveil
quest:nepheli:ruler.description: She takes the throne with Kenneth Haight and rewards you with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

quest:nepheli:stormhawk.name: Nepheli — Stormhawk King ashes given
quest:nepheli:stormhawk.description: From the Chapel of Anticipation. Do this after Morgott and after speaking to Gideon.

quest:old-knight-istvan-step-1.name: Old Knight Istvan — Limgrave (Coastal Cave)
quest:old-knight-istvan-step-1.description: *(Optional)* Istvan can be summoned to aid you against the two Demi-Human Chiefs and their small army.

quest:old-knight-istvan-step-2.name: Old Knight Istvan — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
quest:old-knight-istvan-step-2.description: Talk to Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress selecting Join Volcano Manor to receive the Drawing-Room Key that opens the doors to the eastern quarter of the manor, where the is found. Upon collecting it, you'll be tasked with hunting down Istvan and the position of his invasion sign will be marked in red on the map. Once the Old Knight is defeated, awarding you with his Scale Set, return to Tanith to receive Magma Shot and collect the second to progress her questline.

quest:patches-step-2.name: Patches — *(Optional)* Liurnia of the Lakes
quest:patches-step-2.description: Patches can be found near the Scenic Isle Site of Grace. He will discuss Rya and the Abductor Virgin below the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Clearing the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber and returning to Patches will unlock new dialogue, as well as the Calm Down! gesture if not received in the previous step.

quest:patches-step-3.name: Patches — *(Optional)* Mt. Gelmir
quest:patches-step-3.description: From the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, go west past the siege tower and then north. Patches will advise you to follow a path of Glowstones leading to a ledge, which Patches will then kick you off.

quest:patches-step-6.name: Patches — Murkwater Cave
quest:patches-step-6.description: Return to Murkwater Cave and enter the boss room. Open the chest to trigger another fight with Patches. Attack him once to make him stop attacking, and he will give the Patches' Crouch gesture.

quest:patches:ambush.name: Patches — survived the Murkwater ambush
quest:patches:ambush.description: Pass through the golden fog into the boss room and loot the Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers from the treasure chest to trigger Patches to jump down from above. After reducing his health to 50%, he will stop attacking and grant the Grovel for Mercy gesture. He will now become available as a merchant after reloading the area. Continuing to attack him will cause him to become hostile again. If he gets your health low enough, he will grant the Extreme Repentance gesture. Using this will cause him to stop attacking again. *(Optional)* There will be another chest in his room after returning.
related: Forgive Patches and open his shop

sections.heading: Wiki: Murkwater Cave
sections.text: Pass through the golden fog into the boss room and loot the Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers from the treasure chest to trigger Patches to jump down from above. After reducing his health to 50%, he will stop attacking and grant the Grovel for Mercy gesture. He will now become available as a merchant after reloading the area. Continuing to attack him will cause him to become hostile again. If he gets your health low enough, he will grant the Extreme Repentance gesture. Using this will cause him to stop attacking again. *(Optional)* There will be another chest in his room after returning.

quest:patches:castanets.name: Patches — Dancer’s Castanets taken
related: Patches — found wounded at the Shaded Castle
quest:patches:castanets.description: He asks you to carry them back to Lady Tanith at the manor.

quest:patches:contracts.name: Patches — Volcano Manor contracts done
related: Patches — met again at Volcano Manor
Find Patches wounded at the Shaded Castle
quest:patches:contracts.description: The named contract targets must be done before Rykard; Patches’s own arc needs them complete.

quest:patches:forgiven.name: Patches — forgiven, shop opened
quest:patches:forgiven.description: Patches can be found in the entrance corridor after entering Tanith's service. After completing Tanith's first request, Patches will give you a request to kill Great-Horned Tragoth. Tragoth can be found in the Magma Wyrm Makar boss room in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Kill him and then return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue, then rest at a Site of Grace and speak to him again to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue.
related: Find Patches again at Volcano Manor

sections.heading: Wiki: Volcano Manor
sections.text: Patches can be found in the entrance corridor after entering Tanith's service. After completing Tanith's first request, Patches will give you a request to kill Great-Horned Tragoth. Tragoth can be found in the Magma Wyrm Makar boss room in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Kill him and then return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue, then rest at a Site of Grace and speak to him again to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue.

quest:patches:shaded.name: Patches — found wounded at the Shaded Castle
quest:patches:shaded.description: Patches can be found in the hallway leading to Elemer of the Briar. Talk to him to receive the Dancer's Castanets. Offer the Dancer's Castanets to Tanith in Rykard's boss room. She will refuse them, however they will be removed from your inventory.

sections.heading: Wiki: Shaded Castle
sections.text: Patches can be found in the hallway leading to Elemer of the Briar. Talk to him to receive the Dancer's Castanets. Offer the Dancer's Castanets to Tanith in Rykard's boss room. She will refuse them, however they will be removed from your inventory.

quest:patches:volcano.name: Patches — met again at Volcano Manor
quest:patches:volcano.description: After you join the manor he relocates there as a vendor.

quest:phillia-towering-little-sister-ste.name: Phillia, Towering Little Sister — Slumbering Wolf's Shack
quest:phillia-towering-little-sister-ste.description: Speak with Latenna the Albinauric and acquire Latenna the Albinauric (spirit ash).

quest:phillia-towering-little-sister-ste.name: Phillia, Towering Little Sister — Apostate Derelict
quest:phillia-towering-little-sister-ste.description: Bring Latenna the Albinauric to the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield.

quest:pidia-carian-servant-step-1.name: Pidia Carian Servant — Carian Manor
quest:pidia-carian-servant-step-1.description: If Ranni the Witch has not been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player can find Pidia on the second floor of the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace. However, he can only be reached from the building's rooftop. To gain access to him, the player must travel to the Three Sisters and follow the clifftop above Caria Manor southwest. Once there, the player can descend several platforms in order to safely reach the Manor rooftop below. When first talking with Pidia, he will offer to sell you a number of rare items from his storeroom.

quest:pidia-carian-servant-step-2.name: Pidia Carian Servant — Carian Manor (step 2)
quest:pidia-carian-servant-step-2.description: If Ranni the Witch has been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player will hear Pidia crying out in pain when approaching his location. Upon reaching him, the player will find Pidia lying dead, surrounded by the puppet soldiers he once maintained. The player can loot Pidia's Bell Bearing from his corpse, as well as one of two puppets depending upon certain conditions. If the player has already given Seluvis' Potion to Nepheli Loux, Pidia will drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-1.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 1
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-1.description: Follow Ranni the Witch's questline and join her service in Ranni's Rise. Speak to the projections of Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis, and then speak to Ranni once again.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-10.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 10
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-10.description: Reload the area and speak to Seluvis to obtain the Amber Draught.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-11.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 11
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-11.description: You may attempt to give the Amber Draught to Ranni. Doing so will lock Ranni's questline, and it can only be resumed by seeking Absolution at the Church of Vows. Talking to her three times after trying to give her the draught will cause her to instantly kill you.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-12.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 12
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-12.description: Seluvis will now be dead. His Bell bearing and armour set can be looted from his body, which can also be interacted with to access the puppet shop. Pidia will also die at this stage.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-3.name: Preceptor Seluvis — Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-3.description: Give Nepheli Loux the potion. In order to do this, you must have defeated the Omenkiller in the Village of the Albinaurics and Nepheli must be in the lower level of Roundtable Hold. You will obtain Nepheli Loux Puppet from Pidia, Carian Servant at the end of his questline. Give Dung Eater the potion. In order to do this, you must have obtained a Seedbed Curse, freed Dung Eater from his gaol, defeated his dark spirit in the Capital Outskirts, and made sure Dung Eater has returned to his gaol. You will be able to obtain Dung Eater Puppet from Seluvis after this.
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-3.location: Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-4.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 4
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-4.description: Return to Seluvis and exhaust his dialogue, regardless of the option chosen in the previous step. His shop inventory will now be available.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-5.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 5
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-5.description: Travel to the ruins north-east of Ranni's Rise and pass through the illusory floor. Go down the steps into the cellar and interact with the message saying "Seluvis' puppet. Do not touch."

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-6.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 6
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-6.description: Return to Seluvis and select the "About your chambers" dialogue option. You will now be able to buy puppets from Seluvis in return for Starlight Shards. Buy any one of these puppets to continue.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-7.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 7
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-7.description: Speak to Seluvis again and select the "About the scheme" dialogue option.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-8.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 8
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-8.description: Obtain the Amber Starlight from Altus Plateau. This can be found in a small grotto north-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, north of the giant staircase that leads to the Tree Sentinel boss fight.

quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-9.name: Preceptor Seluvis — step 9
quest:preceptor-seluvis-step-9.description: Return to Seluvis and select the "Give Amber Starlight" dialogue option to obtain the Magic Scorpion Charm.

quest:ranni-the-witch-step-1.name: Ranni the Witch — *(Optional)* Church of Elleh
quest:ranni-the-witch-step-1.description: After meeting Melina and obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle, use Torrent at least once. After that, rest on any Site of Grace. Then, fast travel to the Church of Elleh Site of Grace and find Ranni (using the pseudonym "Renna the Witch") sitting on a broken wall. Exhaust her dialogue to receive the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes for free. If you miss this step, these items will be available for purchase at the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold— 200 runes for the Lone Wolf Ashes and 1,000 runes for the Spirit Calling Bell respectively.

quest:ranni-the-witch-step-11.name: Ranni the Witch — Moonlight Altar
quest:ranni-the-witch-step-11.description: Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again, and she will disappear, bequeathing the Dark Moon Greatsword.

quest:ranni-the-witch-step-12.name: Ranni the Witch — Stone Platform
quest:ranni-the-witch-step-12.description: After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign beside Fractured Marika. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending. WARNING: Ranni's summon sign will not appear if the player has met with the Three Fingers. This can be undone by defeating both Malenia, Goddess of Rot and Dragonlord Placidusax, and using Miquella's Needle in the latter's boss arena at Crumbling Farum Azula.

quest:ranni-the-witch-step-2.name: Ranni the Witch — Caria Manor
quest:ranni-the-witch-step-2.description: Traverse Caria Manor in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes. Defeat the apparition of Royal Knight Loretta at the Royal Moongazing Grounds, which unlocks the path to Three Sisters behind her.

quest:ranni-the-witch-step-7.name: Ranni the Witch — Ainsel River Main
quest:ranni-the-witch-step-7.description: Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.

quest:ranni-the-witch-step-8.name: Ranni the Witch — Nokstella, Eternal City
quest:ranni-the-witch-step-8.description: *(Optional)* Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline. Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key.

quest:ranni-the-witch-step-9.name: Ranni the Witch — Academy of Raya Lucaria
quest:ranni-the-witch-step-9.description: Defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Unlock the chest behind Rennala and obtain the Dark Moon Ring.

quest:ranni:blaidd.name: Ranni — Blaidd met
quest:ranni:blaidd.description: Three Sisters, after Caria Manor. Speak to Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis in the towers; Iji and Blaidd are the ones who point you at Nokron and warn you off Seluvis.

quest:ranni:blaidd-fate.name: Ranni — Blaidd's fate at the Rise
related: Radagon of the Golden Order / Elden Beast
quest:ranni:blaidd-fate.description: Once the ring is placed, Blaidd is waiting — and no longer himself. This is the loose end of her service.

quest:ranni:festival.name: Ranni — Radahn festival opened Nokron
quest:ranni:festival.description: Redmane festival. Talk to Jerren or progress Ranni far enough that the festival is live.

quest:ranni:iji.name: Ranni — Iji counselled
quest:ranni:iji.description: Three Sisters, after Caria Manor. Speak to Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis in the towers; Iji and Blaidd are the ones who point you at Nokron and warn you off Seluvis.

quest:ranni:iji-fate.name: Ranni — Iji's last counsel
related: Ranni — Blaidd's fate at the Rise
quest:ranni:iji-fate.description: The smith in the Three Sisters knows what became of Blaidd, and what Ranni chose. His story ends here too.

quest:ranni:nokron.name: Ranni — Fingerslayer Blade recovered
quest:ranni:nokron.description: Night’s Sacred Ground in Nokron. Give it to Ranni, never to Seluvis.

quest:ranni:ring.name: Ranni — Dark Moon Ring placed
quest:ranni:ring.description: Ride the Transportation Coffin at the Grand Cloister. Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void and then travel up the lift. However, this lift remains locked until the player obtains the Dark Moon Ring.
related: Finish the Elden Lord path, then summon Ranni

sections.heading: Wiki: Lake of Rot
sections.text: Ride the Transportation Coffin at the Grand Cloister. Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void and then travel up the lift. However, this lift remains locked until the player obtains the Dark Moon Ring.

quest:ranni:service.name: Ranni — entered her service
quest:ranni:service.description: Ranni can next be encountered on the top floor of her Rise in the Three Sisters. This stage varies depending on whether you have met her before, defeated Starscourge Radahn, or given Sorcerer Rogier the Black Knifeprint. Agree to become one of Ranni's vassals, and then head back down the tower to speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis. After speaking to all three, return to Ranni and speak to her again. After this point, if you return to Ranni, she will be sleeping and non-responsive. *(Optional)* Administer Preceptor Seluvis's Amber Draught to Ranni. She will awaken.

sections.heading: Wiki: Ranni's Rise
sections.text: Ranni can next be encountered on the top floor of her Rise in the Three Sisters. This stage varies depending on whether you have met her before, defeated Starscourge Radahn, or given Sorcerer Rogier the Black Knifeprint. Agree to become one of Ranni's vassals, and then head back down the tower to speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis. After speaking to all three, return to Ranni and speak to her again. After this point, if you return to Ranni, she will be sleeping and non-responsive. *(Optional)* Administer Preceptor Seluvis's Amber Draught to Ranni. She will awaken.

quest:ranni:statue.name: Ranni — Carian Study Hall inverted
quest:ranni:statue.description: Travel to Ranni's Rise and deliver the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required to progress Fia, Deathbed Companion's questline. However, it is *not* necessary to complete Ranni's quest. WARNING: This will permanently end Preceptor Seluvis and Pidia, Carian Servant's quest. Travel to Renna's Rise, which unseals after Ranni departs with the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the Sending Gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
related: Kill Astel and place the Dark Moon Ring

sections.heading: Wiki: Three Sisters
sections.text: Travel to Ranni's Rise and deliver the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required to progress Fia, Deathbed Companion's questline. However, it is *not* necessary to complete Ranni's quest. WARNING: This will permanently end Preceptor Seluvis and Pidia, Carian Servant's quest. Travel to Renna's Rise, which unseals after Ranni departs with the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the Sending Gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.

quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-1.name: Redeemer Guilbert — Dragon-Burnt Ruins
quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-1.description: First conversion with Guilbert south of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave.

quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-2.name: Redeemer Guilbert — Erdtree-Gazing Evergaol (now Forlorn Hound Evergaol)
quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-2.description: Defeat Crucible Knight Floh. *(Optional)* Summon Mercenary Swordsman from his gold summon sign.

quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-3.name: Redeemer Guilbert — Dragon-Burnt Ruins (step 3)
quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-3.description: Second conversation with Guilbert, which changes based on choices.

quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-4.name: Redeemer Guilbert — Stormveil Castle
quest:redeemer-guilbert-step-4.description: Guilbert will stand in the throne room. There is no direct information about what he would do here. *(Optional?)* Receive a nameless Key Item from Guilbert? Give it to Roundtable Knight Vyke to receive Neutralizing Boluses and enable his summon sign for Godrick the Grafted. Defeat Godrick the Grafted. *(Optional)* Summon Guilbert from his gold summon sign and defeat Godrick the Grafted.

quest:rileigh-the-idle-step-1.name: Rileigh the Idle — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
quest:rileigh-the-idle-step-1.description: After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan under Tanith's request, retrieve the second Letter from Volcano Manor to unlock Rileigh's invasion sign in Altus Plateau. With Istvan dead, you can also talk to Patches the Untethered to receive Letter to Patches, tasking you with killing Great Horned Tragoth in Liurnia of the Lakes.

quest:rileigh-the-idle-step-2.name: Rileigh the Idle — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) (step 2)
quest:rileigh-the-idle-step-2.description: Once Rileigh is disposed of, return to Tanith to receive the Serpentbone Blade: the Red Letter will now appear, targetting Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood in the Mountaintops of the Giants. You can also visit Recusant Bernhal to receive the Letter to Bernahl, offering you to join him in his hunt against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

quest:roderika-step-10.name: Roderika — Roundtable Hold (step 10)
quest:roderika-step-10.description: After burning the Erdtree, return to the Roundtable Hold, speak to Hewg, and select "Let's talk a while". You may then select the dialogue option "Why are you still making weapons?" After talking to Roderika and selecting "About Hewg", return to Hewg and select "What happened to her?"

quest:roderika-step-11.name: Roderika — Roundtable Hold (step 11)
quest:roderika-step-11.description: After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, speak to Hewg and select "About yourself", and then speak to Roderika.

quest:roderika-step-3.name: Roderika — *(Optional)* Stormhill Shack
quest:roderika-step-3.description: Deliver the Crysalids' Memento to Roderika in Stormhill Shack and exhaust her dialogue to get her to move to Roundtable Hold.

quest:roderika-step-5.name: Roderika — Roundtable Hold
quest:roderika-step-5.description: Speak to Roderika, and then speak to Smithing Master Hewg and select "About Roderika".

quest:roderika-step-6.name: Roderika — Roundtable Hold (step 6)
quest:roderika-step-6.description: Return to Roderika and speak to her to tell her what Hewg said.

quest:roderika-step-7.name: Roderika — Roundtable Hold (step 7)
quest:roderika-step-7.description: Return to Hewg and select "About Roderika" again, followed by "Would you watch over Roderika?" and finally "It's what she wants".

quest:roderika-step-9.name: Roderika — *(optional)* Roundtable Hold
quest:roderika-step-9.description: Upgrade a Spirit Ash to at least +4 and talk to her to receive the "Curtsy" Gesture.

quest:roderika:given.name: Roderika — memento delivered
quest:roderika:given.description: Roderika can be found by the fireplace in the central room. Talk to her to obtain a Golden Seed once she arrives. Note: if you defeated Godrick or rest at a Site of Grace in Liurnia without speaking to Roderika in Stormhill Shack, she will move to Roundtable Hold on her own, and will leave the Golden Seed on the ground in the shack.
related: Ask Hewg to take Roderika on

sections.heading: Wiki: Roundtable Hold
sections.text: Roderika can be found by the fireplace in the central room. Talk to her to obtain a Golden Seed once she arrives. Note: if you defeated Godrick or rest at a Site of Grace in Liurnia without speaking to Roderika in Stormhill Shack, she will move to Roundtable Hold on her own, and will leave the Golden Seed on the ground in the shack.

quest:roderika:memento.name: Roderika — Chrysalids’ Memento recovered
quest:roderika:memento.description: In an adjoining courtyard to the large hall containing a Grafted Scion in Stormveil Castle, pick up the Chrysalids' Memento.
related: Roderika — met at the Stormhill Shack

sections.heading: Wiki: *(Optional)* Stormveil Castle
sections.text: In an adjoining courtyard to the large hall containing a Grafted Scion in Stormveil Castle, pick up the Chrysalids' Memento.

quest:roderika:met.name: Roderika — met at the Stormhill Shack
quest:roderika:met.description: Roderika can be found in Stormhill Shack in Stormhill, provided you have not defeated Godrick the Grafted or touched a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. Exhaust her dialogue to obtain both the "Sitting Sideways" Gesture and Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.
related: Recover the Chrysalids’ Memento from Stormveil

sections.heading: Wiki: *(Optional)* Stormhill Shack
sections.text: Roderika can be found in Stormhill Shack in Stormhill, provided you have not defeated Godrick the Grafted or touched a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. Exhaust her dialogue to obtain both the "Sitting Sideways" Gesture and Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.

quest:roderika:tuner.name: Roderika — spirit tuning unlocked
related: Hewg — agrees to take Roderika on
quest:roderika:tuner.description: She can now upgrade your spirit ashes while Hewg keeps forging. The line is complete.

quest:rogier:concluded.name: Find Rogier’s body in Deeproot Depths and take his set
quest:rogier:concluded.description: Return to Roundtable Hold and speak to Rogier. He will tell you that his condition is worsening. Reload the area and Rogier will be unresponsive. Any unseen dialogue options will be locked and his shop will be unavailable. Reload the area again and Rogier will be dead, leaving behind his gear, bell bearing and a letter.

sections.heading: Wiki: Roundtable Hold
sections.text: Return to Roundtable Hold and speak to Rogier. He will tell you that his condition is worsening. Reload the area and Rogier will be unresponsive. Any unseen dialogue options will be locked and his shop will be unavailable. Reload the area again and Rogier will be dead, leaving behind his gear, bell bearing and a letter.

quest:rogier:knifeprint.name: Rogier knifeprint
quest:rogier:knifeprint.description: Sorcerer Rogier — Bring him the Black Knifeprint from Black Knife Catacombs

quest:rogier:met.name: Meet Rogier in Stormveil and again at the Roundtable Hold
quest:rogier:met.description: Meet him at Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick. Tell him that you have defeated Godrick and then ask about the corpse below Stormveil. Speak to Fia to learn about the Black Knifeprint.
related: Bring him the Black Knifeprint from Black Knife Catacombs

sections.heading: Wiki: Roundtable Hold
sections.text: Meet him at Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick. Tell him that you have defeated Godrick and then ask about the corpse below Stormveil. Speak to Fia to learn about the Black Knifeprint.

quest:rya-the-scout-step-1.name: Rya the Scout — *(Optional)* Liurnia of the Lakes
quest:rya-the-scout-step-1.description: Rya can be found in a folly north of the Laskyar Ruins. Speak to her and exhaust her dialogue, then travel to Boilprawn Shack and purchase Rya's Necklace from Blackguard Big Boggart. Return to Rya and hand over the necklace to receive an Invitation to Volcano Manor. It is not possible to kill her in this location, as she is protected by a barrier.

quest:rya-the-scout-step-2.name: Rya the Scout — *(Optional)* Altus Plateau
quest:rya-the-scout-step-2.description: If the previous step was completed, Rya will be waiting at Lux Ruins in Altus Plateau. Speak to her and she will offer to transport you to Volcano Manor. It is not possible to kill her in this location, as she is protected by a barrier.

quest:rya-the-scout-step-3.name: Rya the Scout — Volcano Manor
quest:rya-the-scout-step-3.description: Rya can now be found in the Volcano Manor drawing room after joining the Recusants. After defeating Old Knight Istvan and receiving the reward from Tanith, talk to Rya in the drawing room, then reload the area and enter the previously locked room across the corridor from the drawing room to find Rya in serpent form. Exhaust her dialogue.

quest:rya-the-scout-step-4.name: Rya the Scout — Volcano Manor (step 4)
quest:rya-the-scout-step-4.description: After defeating Rileigh the Idle and receiving the reward from Tanith, speak to Rya in the same room as the previous step. Go into the room next to this and pass through the illusory wall at the back, then follow the path to the prison Town Church Site of Grace. Rest at the Site of Grace, then return to Rya and speak to her once again.

quest:rya-the-scout-step-5.name: Rya the Scout — Volcano Manor (step 5)
quest:rya-the-scout-step-5.description: After defeating the Godskin Noble boss in Volcano Manor, obtain the Serpent's Amnion and give it to Rya. *(Optional)* Speak to Tanith to obtain the Tonic of Forgetfulness.

quest:rya-the-scout-step-6.name: Rya the Scout — Volcano Manor (step 6)
quest:rya-the-scout-step-6.description: Rya can now be found in a small room above the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, past an Iron Virgin. You now have three options to resolve this questline. If you received the Tonic of Forgetfulness, you may offer it to her, causing her to fall asleep. After killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to the Volcano Manor drawing room and speak to her. Reload the area and return to where she was to obtain Daedicar's Woe. If you choose to kill her, you will obtain Daedicar's Woe.

quest:rya:amnion.name: Rya — Serpent’s Amnion
related: Choose to spare or tell Zorayas the truth after Rykard
quest:rya:amnion.description: She learns she is the serpent’s daughter. Amnion from the manor’s upper level.

quest:rya:concluded.name: Rya — aftermath chosen
quest:rya:concluded.description: Killing Rykard without finishing her beats can strand her in the manor.

quest:rya:killed.name: Rya killed
quest:rya:killed.description: Rya / Zorayas — Give Zorayas the Serpent’s Amnion

quest:rya:manor.name: Rya — joined Volcano Manor
quest:rya:manor.description: Do Lady Tanith’s contracts to earn access upstairs.

quest:rya:necklace.name: Rya — necklace recovered
related: Accept the invitation and join Volcano Manor
quest:rya:necklace.description: Blackguard Big Boggart in the marsh has it. Return it and she invites you to Volcano Manor.

quest:sellen:azur.name: Sellen — Azur found
related: Sellen — freed from the Waypoint Ruins
Find Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway
quest:sellen:azur.description: Mt. Gelmir, sealed cave behind the Hermit Village. Sellen’s first master.

quest:sellen:freed.name: Sellen — freed from the Waypoint Ruins
quest:sellen:freed.description: Sellen can be found in the cellar of Waypoint Ruins after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head. Talk to Sellen and then select "I wish to learn glintstone sorceries" to receive the "Nod in Thought" Gesture, and to unlock her sorcery shop. *(Optional)* If the Radahn Festival has not commenced, Sellen will have dialogue about it if you have Seluvis's Introduction in your inventory. This is obtained by progressing Blaidd the Half-Wolf's questline and speaking to Seluvis about Nokron prior to initiating the Festival.

sections.heading: Wiki: Waypoint Ruins
sections.text: Sellen can be found in the cellar of Waypoint Ruins after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head. Talk to Sellen and then select "I wish to learn glintstone sorceries" to receive the "Nod in Thought" Gesture, and to unlock her sorcery shop. *(Optional)* If the Radahn Festival has not commenced, Sellen will have dialogue about it if you have Seluvis's Introduction in your inventory. This is obtained by progressing Blaidd the Half-Wolf's questline and speaking to Seluvis about Nokron prior to initiating the Festival.

quest:sellen:jerren.name: Sellen — Witch-Hunter Jerren met
related: Sellen — revived in the Three Sisters puppet
quest:sellen:jerren.description: Jerren waits in the Debate Parlor, hunting the witch. Which side you take is final.

quest:sellen:jerren-side.name: Sellen — sided with Jerren
related: Sellen — sided with her against Jerren
quest:sellen:jerren-side.description: Take the Witch-Hunter’s side; Sellen is lost, and her spells and bell bearing go with her.

quest:sellen:lusat.name: Sellen — Lusat found
related: Report both primeval sorcerers to Sellen
quest:sellen:lusat.description: Caelid. Break the illusory wall; the second primeval sorcerer.

quest:sellen:primal-glintstone.name: Sellen — revived in the Three Sisters puppet
quest:sellen:primal-glintstone.description: Travel to the Three Sisters and go to the ruined structure north-east of Ranni's Rise. Roll or attack the ground to reveal a hidden staircase leading to a basement full of immobile puppets. Pass through the illusory wall on the far end of the room to find a puppet duplicate of Sellen. Interact with the puppet to insert Sellen's Primal Glintstone, resurrecting Sellen in her new body.
related: Sellen — true body found at Witchbane Ruins
Meet Witch-Hunter Jerren at Raya Lucaria

sections.heading: Wiki: Three Sisters
sections.text: Travel to the Three Sisters and go to the ruined structure north-east of Ranni's Rise. Roll or attack the ground to reveal a hidden staircase leading to a basement full of immobile puppets. Pass through the illusory wall on the far end of the room to find a puppet duplicate of Sellen. Interact with the puppet to insert Sellen's Primal Glintstone, resurrecting Sellen in her new body.

quest:sellen:primers.name: Sellen — both primeval sorcerers reported
related: Find Sellen’s true body at Witchbane Ruins
quest:sellen:primers.description: Tell her of Azur and Lusat and she asks you to meet her at the academy.

quest:sellen:side.name: Sellen — sided with her against Jerren
quest:sellen:side.description: Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur, located beyond the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir, to obtain Comet Azur. Return to Sellen and select the "Show Azur's Sorcery" dialogue option. After listening to this dialogue, select the "Tell me your story" option, and then select "Let us journey together". Next, select "I have a favor to ask" to obtain the Sellian Sealbreaker. The Sellian Sealbreaker can be used to open a sealed tunnel in Sellia Hideaway, behind which is Primeval Sorcerer Lusat. Interact with him to receive Stars of Ruin.

sections.heading: Wiki: Waypoint Ruins
sections.text: Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur, located beyond the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir, to obtain Comet Azur. Return to Sellen and select the "Show Azur's Sorcery" dialogue option. After listening to this dialogue, select the "Tell me your story" option, and then select "Let us journey together". Next, select "I have a favor to ask" to obtain the Sellian Sealbreaker. The Sellian Sealbreaker can be used to open a sealed tunnel in Sellia Hideaway, behind which is Primeval Sorcerer Lusat. Interact with him to receive Stars of Ruin.

quest:sellen:witchbane.name: Sellen — true body found at Witchbane Ruins
quest:sellen:witchbane.description: After Starscourge Radahn has been defeated, talk to Sellen to learn that her true body is in Witchbane Ruins. Travel there and speak to the shackled Sellen to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone. Reload the area and return to find Castellan Jerren. In order for him to appear, you must have spoken to him in Redmane Castle after defeating Starscourge Radahn.
related: Revive Sellen in the Three Sisters puppet

sections.heading: Wiki: Witchbane Ruins
sections.text: After Starscourge Radahn has been defeated, talk to Sellen to learn that her true body is in Witchbane Ruins. Travel there and speak to the shackled Sellen to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone. Reload the area and return to find Castellan Jerren. In order for him to appear, you must have spoken to him in Redmane Castle after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

quest:seluvis:concluded.name: Buy out his puppet stock before Nokron
quest:seluvis:concluded.description: If Ranni is not given the Amber Draught, Seluvis will die in the same way after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.
related: Take Seluvis’s potion and choose a target

sections.heading: Wiki: step
sections.text: If Ranni is not given the Amber Draught, Seluvis will die in the same way after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.

quest:seluvis:met.name: Enter Ranni’s service and meet Seluvis at Seluvis’s Rise
related: Take Seluvis’s potion and choose a target
quest:seluvis:met.description: Three Sisters, after Caria Manor. He sells sorceries and wants a puppet errand.

quest:seluvis:potion.name: Take Seluvis’s potion and choose a target
quest:seluvis:potion.description: Visit Seluvis's Rise, south of Ranni's Rise, and speak to Seluvis. Agree to his request to obtain Seluvis's Potion.
related: Enter Ranni’s service and meet Seluvis at Seluvis’s Rise
Buy out his puppet stock before Nokron

sections.heading: Wiki: step
sections.text: Visit Seluvis's Rise, south of Ranni's Rise, and speak to Seluvis. Agree to his request to obtain Seluvis's Potion.

quest:shabriri-step-1.name: Shabriri — Mountaintops of the Giants
quest:shabriri-step-1.description: Shabriri can be found by the Zamor Ruins Site of Grace near the beginning of the Mountaintops of the Giants area. Exhaust his dialogue to unlock new dialogue from Melina when resting at a Site of Grace.

quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold
quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.description: *(Optional)* If you visit Roundtable Hold before defeating a shardbearer, Gideon can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold. After exhausting his dialogue he will move to his study.

quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold (step 2)
quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.description: After defeating a shardbearer and speaking to Finger Reader Enia, Gideon will welcome you as a member of Roundtable Hold, and will offer you information on Godrick the Grafted, Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, Starscourge Radahn, Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, and Morgott, the Omen King. He can also discuss Nepheli Loux if you have spoken to her.

quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold (step 3)
quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.description: *(Optional)* If you obtain either half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, Ensha will ambush you the next time you return to Roundtable Hold. After defeating him, speak to Gideon to learn the location of the other half. *(Optional)* If you have obtained Seluvis's Potion, you may give it to Gideon to dispose of it. This will remove it from your inventory, preventing you from obtaining Nepheli Loux Puppet or Dung Eater Puppet.

quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold (step 4)
quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.description: Resting at any Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital will cause Gideon to receive new dialogue about the unlocated Demigods.

quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Roundtable Hold (step 5)
quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.description: Gideon will now offer rewards in exchange for meeting certain requirements: Black Flame's Protection: activate a Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree. Lord's Divine Fortification: defeat Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Fevor's Cookbook 3: activate a Site of Grace in Mohgwyn Palace. Law of Causality: defeat Mohg, Lord of Blood.

quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
quest:sir-gideon-ofnir-the-all-knowing-s.description: Gideon will be present in the Erdtree Sanctuary as a boss encounter after you have defeated Maliketh, the Black Blade. Any previous parts of his questline will now be locked, however the rewards from the previous step can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks.

quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-2.name: Smithing Master Hewg — Once Roderika arrives at the Roundtable Hold, speak to Hewg and select the "About Roderika" dialogue option.
quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-2.description: Return to Roderika and tell her what Hewg said. Return to Hewg and select "About Roderika" again, followed by "Would you watch over Roderika?" and finally "It's what she wants". Reload the area. Roderika moves, seated across from Hewg, now offers spirit tuning services.
quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-2.location: Once Roderika arrives at the Roundtable Hold, speak to Hewg and select the "About Roderika" dialogue option.

quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-3.name: Smithing Master Hewg — step 3
quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-3.description: Upon reaching the Forge of the Giants, return and talk for advice.

quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-4.name: Smithing Master Hewg — After burning the Erdtree, return to the Roundtable Hold and select "Let's talk a while". You may then select the dialogue option "Why are you still making weapons?"
quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-4.description: After talking to Roderika and selecting "About Hewg", return to Hewg and select "What happened to her?"
quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-4.location: After burning the Erdtree, return to the Roundtable Hold and select "Let's talk a while". You may then select the dialogue option "Why are you still making weapons?"

quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-5.name: Smithing Master Hewg — step 5
quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-5.description: After defeating the Godskin Duo, return to Roundtable Hold and speak to Hewg and select "About the god-slaying weapon".

quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-6.name: Smithing Master Hewg — step 6
quest:smithing-master-hewg-step-6.description: After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, return to Hewg and select "About yourself".

quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-1.name: Sorcerer Rogier — Stormveil Castle
quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-1.description: *(Optional)* Exhaust his dialogue in Stormveil Castle encounter. He can be found in the chapel past the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. Witness his bloodstain after killing the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the lower section of Stormveil Castle. Doing so before defeating Godrick will cause him to disappear from Stormveil, regardless of whether you have done step 1.

quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-4.name: Sorcerer Rogier — Roundtable Hold
quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-4.description: Give Rogier the Black Knifeprint. *(Optional)* Ask Fia about Rogier. Reload the area and speak to Rogier. He will ask you to investigate Ranni.

quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-5.name: Sorcerer Rogier — Three Sisters (Ranni's Rise)
quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-5.description: Head to Ranni's Rise and speak to Ranni. She will be dismissive and ask you to leave.

quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-6.name: Sorcerer Rogier — Roundtable Hold (step 6)
quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-6.description: Return to Roundtable Hold and tell Rogier about Ranni. He will ask that you enter her service to further the investigation.

quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-7.name: Sorcerer Rogier — Three Sisters (Ranni's Rise) (step 7)
quest:sorcerer-rogier-step-7.description: Return to Ranni's Rise and agree to serve Ranni.

quest:sorcerer-thops-step-1.name: Sorcerer Thops — Church of Irith
quest:sorcerer-thops-step-1.description: Thops can be found at the Church of Irith in Liurnia of the Lakes. Speak to him and agree to donate 10 Runes to unlock his shop.

quest:sorcerer-thops-step-2.name: Sorcerer Thops — Church of Irith (step 2)
quest:sorcerer-thops-step-2.description: After obtaining the Academy Glintstone Key from within the Academy of Raya Lucaria, return to Thops and hand it to him in order to receive the "Erudition" Gesture. Note that he will not accept the Academy Glintstone Key found near Glintstone Dragon Smarag in north-western Liurnia, as this one is required for you to gain entry to the Academy.

quest:sorcerer-thops-step-3.name: Sorcerer Thops — Academy of Raya Lucaria
quest:sorcerer-thops-step-3.description: Thops's corpse can be found sitting at a desk outside the room containing the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace. Loot his body to obtain Thops's Barrier, an Academy Glintstone Staff, and Thops's Bell Bearing. Ash of War: Thops's Barrier can now be obtained from a scarab at the Church of Irith.

quest:sorceress-sellen-step-5.name: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria
quest:sorceress-sellen-step-5.description: There will now be two summon signs outside the door to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library; one red and one gold. To progress Sellen's questline, select the gold summon sign. You will be summoned as a co-operator to assist Sellen in defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren. Defeat Jerren to receive the Eccentric's Set. This step can only be completed if Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated.

quest:sorceress-sellen-step-6.name: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria (step 6)
quest:sorceress-sellen-step-6.description: After defeating Jerren, Sellen can be found where Rennala is usually based. Speak to her to receive the Glintstone Kris. If you have not done so already, find Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway and speak to Sellen to select "Lusat's location" and receive Starlight Shards. It is also possible to obtain Azur and Lusat's armour sets by returning to their respective locations at this point.

quest:sorceress-sellen-step-7.name: Sorceress Sellen — Academy of Raya Lucaria (step 7)
quest:sorceress-sellen-step-7.description: Reload the area after telling Sellen about Lusat. Sellen, now in the form of a Graven Mass, can be found to the side of the room. The Witch's Glintstone Crown can be obtained here. It is still possible to purchase sorceries from her and to offer her scrolls.

quest:st-trina-step-1.name: St. Trina — Scadu Altus
quest:st-trina-step-1.description: Approach the Shadow Keep until Miquella's Great Rune breaks, dispelling his seal on the Stone Coffin Fissure.

quest:st-trina-step-3.name: St. Trina — Gate of Divinity
quest:st-trina-step-3.description: Defeat Miquella the Kind and Radahn, Consort of Miquella

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 1
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: Go into the corridor to the right of Tanith and open the first door on the left. Pick up the Letter from Volcano Manor on the table as well as the Recusant Finger.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 2
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: Travel to the entrance to the colosseum in Stormhill and interact with the invasion sign to fight Old Knight Istvan. After defeating him, report back to Tanith to obtain Magma Shot.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 3
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: Go back to the drawing room and pick up the Letter from Volcano Manor. Travel to Altus Plateau and find an invasion sign at the bottom of the gorge leading to Shaded Castle. Interact with the sign to fight Rileigh the Idle. After defeating him, talk to Tanith to obtain the Serpentbone Blade.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 4
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: *(Optional)* If you have advanced Rya's questline and met her in serpent form, and rested at a Site of Grace in the main dungeon area of Volcano Manor, speak to Tanith to obtain the Tonic of Forgetfulness. This step will be locked if you kill Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood, before giving Rya the Serpent's Amnion.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 5
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: Pick up the Red Letter from the drawing room, and travel to the Shack of the Lofty in the Mountaintops of the Giants. Interact with the invasion sign to fight Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood. Report back to Tanith to obtain the Taker's Cameo.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 6
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: Tanith will now offer to send you directly to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, bypassing the rest of the Volcano Manor. Defeat Rykard and return to Tanith and exhaust her dialogue.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 7
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: Travel to the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace to find Tanith eating the remains of Rykard.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 8
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: *(Optional)* After obtaining the Dancer's Castanets from Patches in Shaded Castle, offer them to Tanith. There is no reward for doing so, however the Dancer's Castanets will be removed from your inventory.

quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress — step 9
quest:tanith-volcano-manor-proprietress-.description: *(Optional)* Attacking Tanith will cause her to die in a single hit. You will then be invaded by Tanith's Knight. Defeating the knight will reward you with Aspects of the Crucible: Breath and the Consort's Set.

quest:tanith:concluded.name: Tanith — final request heard
quest:tanith:concluded.description: She asks you to devour the god together. Refuse and she leaves; strike her and she stays by his corpse.

quest:tanith:contracts.name: Tanith — first contract taken
related: Complete the named contracts (Istvan, Rileigh, Hoslow)
quest:tanith:contracts.description: Inside the manor, Lady Tanith hands you invasion contracts against the Erdtree’s servants.

quest:tanith:targets.name: Tanith — named contracts complete
related: Take the Drawing-Room Key and search the manor
quest:tanith:targets.description: Each is a red summon sign in the world. Finishing them opens the drawing room and Tanith’s reward.

quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-1.name: The Noble Goldmask — Altus Plateau (Forest-Spanning Greatbridge)
quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-1.description: Goldmask can be found at the end of the broken bridge, facing the Erdtree. Interact with him to progress.

quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-2.name: The Noble Goldmask — Altus Plateau (near Altus Highway Junction)
quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-2.description: Speak to Corhyn to reveal Goldmask's location.

quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-3.name: The Noble Goldmask — Altus Plateau (Forest-Spanning Greatbridge) (step 3)
quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-3.description: Return to the bridge and exhaust Corhyn's dialogue.

quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-4.name: The Noble Goldmask — Leyndell, Royal Capital
quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-4.description: Goldmask and Corhyn can be found near the colosseum. Corhyn will express frustration at Goldmask's current obsession with Radagon. After using Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue past the lift near Erdtree Sanctuary, talk to Goldmask to reveal Radagon's secret and then talk to Corhyn.

quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-5.name: The Noble Goldmask — Mountaintops of the Giants
quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-5.description: Goldmask and Corhyn will move to the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins.

quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-6.name: The Noble Goldmask — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
quest:the-noble-goldmask-step-6.description: After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, Goldmask's corpse can be found on a slope near the colosseum. Loot his corpse to receive the Mending Rune of Perfect Order, which will unlock the option to complete the Age of Order ending. After reloading the area, return to Goldmask's corpse to retrieve Goldmask's Rags, Gold Bracelets, and Gold Waistwrap.

quest:thiollier:concluded.name: Choose Thiollier’s side at Enir-Ilim
quest:thiollier:concluded.description: Thiollier will now be available to summon for the two final fights of the *Shadow of The Erdtree*'s story, where his quest finishes.
related: Hear St. Trina at the Garden of Deep Purple

sections.heading: Wiki: Enir-Ilim
sections.text: Thiollier will now be available to summon for the two final fights of the *Shadow of The Erdtree*'s story, where his quest finishes.

quest:thiollier:met.name: Thiollier — met at the Three-Path Cross
quest:thiollier:met.description: Speak with Moore outside Belurat, Tower Settlement. Find and speak with Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace. Speak with Moore again and he will give you Black Syrup for Thiollier. Find Thiollier again and he will give you Thiollier's Concoction. After all this is done, approach the Shadow Keep, and you will get an ominous message on the screen. Find Thiollier once more, and after exhausting his dialogue, reload the area, and he'll state he is heading south.
related: Find St. Trina’s Nectar in the Stone Coffin Fissure

sections.heading: Wiki: Gravesite Plain
sections.text: Speak with Moore outside Belurat, Tower Settlement. Find and speak with Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace. Speak with Moore again and he will give you Black Syrup for Thiollier. Find Thiollier again and he will give you Thiollier's Concoction. After all this is done, approach the Shadow Keep, and you will get an ominous message on the screen. Find Thiollier once more, and after exhausting his dialogue, reload the area, and he'll state he is heading south.

quest:thiollier:nectar.name: Find St. Trina’s Nectar in the Stone Coffin Fissure
quest:thiollier:nectar.description: Defeat Putrescent Knight Imbibe St. Trina's nectar and die Imbibe her nectar and die Imbibe her nectar and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Speak with Thiollier
related: Thiollier — met at the Three-Path Cross
Hear St. Trina at the Garden of Deep Purple

sections.heading: Wiki: Garden of Deep Purple
sections.text: Defeat Putrescent Knight Imbibe St. Trina's nectar and die Imbibe her nectar and die Imbibe her nectar and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Speak with Thiollier

sections.heading: Wiki: Stone Coffin Fissure
sections.text: Make your way to the southernmost point of the Cerulean Coast, where you'll find a pit. When facing south towards the pit, turn to the right; there are steps leading into it. Follow the given path, and you'll come across the Stone Coffin Fissure. Beat the Putrescent Knight, a boss found at the end of this Legacy Dungeon, and in the corner of the arena, you'll find both the Garden of Deep Purple Site of Grace and Thiollier, in front of St. Trina. Exhaust Thiollier's Dialogue and then reset the area using the nearby Grace.

quest:thiollier:sttrina.name: Hear St. Trina at the Garden of Deep Purple
related: Find St. Trina’s Nectar in the Stone Coffin Fissure

sections.heading: Wiki: Garden of Deep Purple
sections.text: Collect St. Trina's Blossom

quest:thops:barrier.name: Thops — body found at Raya Lucaria
related: Find a second Academy Glintstone Key
quest:thops:barrier.description: He enters the academy and does not come out. Loot Thops’s Barrier and his bell bearing.

quest:thops:key.name: Find a second Academy Glintstone Key
related: Meet Thops at the Church of Irith
Find Thops’s body at Raya Lucaria
quest:thops:key.description: One key is on the corpse behind the academy (Smarag); give it to Thops.

quest:thops:killed.name: Thops killed
quest:thops:killed.description: Thops — Find a second Academy Glintstone Key

quest:thops:met.name: Meet Thops at the Church of Irith
related: Find a second Academy Glintstone Key
quest:thops:met.description: Liurnia, south of the academy. He is locked out and asks for a Glintstone Key.

quest:vargram-the-raging-wolf-step-1.name: Vargram the Raging Wolf — Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
quest:vargram-the-raging-wolf-step-1.description: After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan and Rileigh the Idle under Tanith's request, talk to Recusant Bernahl in the eastern quarter of the manor to receive Letter to Bernhal, unlocking Vargram's invasion sign in Leyndell. Once the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm are defeated, awarding you with the Raging Wolf Set, return to Bernhal to receive Gelmir's Fury.

quest:varre:cloth.name: Varré — cloth soaked in maiden blood
related: Varré / Rose Church ignored or killed
quest:varre:cloth.description: Church of Inhibition Eochaid corpse, or your own finger maiden at the beginning if you never used her.

quest:varre:killed.name: Varre killed
quest:varre:killed.description: White Mask Varré — Use the medal to Mohgwyn

quest:varre:met.name: Varre met
quest:varre:met.description: White Mask Varré — Talk to Varré at the First Step, then at Rose Church

quest:volcano-manor-apparition-step-1.name: Volcano Manor Apparition — Volcano Manor ( Volcano Manor)
quest:volcano-manor-apparition-step-1.description: Reload the area three times. Speak with Volcano Manor Apparition to gain a clue about the Serpent-Hunter

quest:volcano-manor-apparition-step-2.name: Volcano Manor Apparition — Volcano Manor (Lord's Chamber / Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy)
quest:volcano-manor-apparition-step-2.description: Confront and defeat Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
quest:volcano-manor-apparition-step-2.location: Volcano Manor (Lord's Chamber / Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy)

quest:volcano-manor-apparition-step-3.name: Volcano Manor Apparition — Volcano Manor ( Volcano Manor) (step 3)
quest:volcano-manor-apparition-step-3.description: Return to loot the "My Thanks" gesture where the Volcano Manor Apparition knelt

quest:wandering-merchant-step-3.name: Wandering Merchant — step 3
quest:wandering-merchant-step-3.description: Interact with the Great Site of Grace

quest:war-counselor-iji-step-1.name: War Counselor Iji — Speak to Iji at Road to the Manor, past Kingsrealm Ruins.
quest:war-counselor-iji-step-1.description: If Blaidd’s quest is active, choose “Blaidd sent me” to unlock a new shop item.
quest:war-counselor-iji-step-1.location: Speak to Iji at Road to the Manor, past Kingsrealm Ruins.

quest:war-counselor-iji-step-2.name: War Counselor Iji — After entering Ranni’s service, speak to his projection at Ranni's Rise.
quest:war-counselor-iji-step-2.description: Optional: Ask about Blaidd or Jerren after progressing Ranni’s questline.
quest:war-counselor-iji-step-2.location: After entering Ranni’s service, speak to his projection at Ranni's Rise.

quest:war-counselor-iji-step-3.name: War Counselor Iji — step 3
quest:war-counselor-iji-step-3.description: After Radahn’s defeat, revisit Iji for information about Nokron.

quest:war-counselor-iji-step-4.name: War Counselor Iji — step 4
quest:war-counselor-iji-step-4.description: After giving Ranni the Dark Moon Ring, defeat Blaidd and return to Iji.

quest:war-counselor-iji-step-5.name: War Counselor Iji — step 5
quest:war-counselor-iji-step-5.description: Reload the area to find Iji slain. Collect his helm and bell bearing.

quest:white-mask-varr-step-2.name: White Mask Varré — Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)
quest:white-mask-varr-step-2.description: As he moves at the entrance of the Rose Church after speaking with Enia, talk to him, selecting They didn't seem right, and exhaust his dialogues to receive Festering Bloody Finger x5.
quest:white-mask-varr-step-2.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)

quest:white-mask-varr-step-3.name: White Mask Varré — Altus Plateau (Road of Iniquity Side Path)
quest:white-mask-varr-step-3.description: Interact with the invasion sign of Magnus the Beast Claw, found at the Writheblood Ruins south-west of the Site of Grace, and either defeat him or simply invade him three times. Invading actual players with the Festering Bloody Fingers three times is also enough to progress Varré's questline.
quest:white-mask-varr-step-3.location: Altus Plateau (Road of Iniquity Side Path)

quest:white-mask-varr-step-4.name: White Mask Varré — Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake) (step 4)
quest:white-mask-varr-step-4.description: Return to Varré to receive the Lord of Blood's Favor, which needs to be coated in a maiden's blood. The followings options are available: The corpse of your Finger Maiden in the Chapel of Anticipation, which requires using an Imbued Sword Key at the Four Bellfries of Liurnia. Vyke's Finger Maiden in the Church of Inhibition of Liurnia. Killing Irina of Morne or, if already deceased, Lightseeker Hyetta at any of their locations.
quest:white-mask-varr-step-4.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)

quest:white-mask-varr-step-5.name: White Mask Varré — Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake) (step 5)
quest:white-mask-varr-step-5.description: Return to Varré to receive the Bloody Finger, then talk to him again to receive the Pureblood Knight's Medal.
quest:white-mask-varr-step-5.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)
