quest:ymir:dheo.name: Ymir — bell rung at the Finger Ruins of Dheo
related: Ymir — bell rung at the Finger Ruins of Rhia

quest:ymir:met.name: Ymir — met at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr
related: Ring the bell at the Finger Ruins of Rhia

quest:ymir:rhia.name: Ymir — bell rung at the Finger Ruins of Rhia
related: Ymir — met at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr
Ring the bell at the Finger Ruins of Dheo

quest:yura:altus.name: Yura — met at the Second Church of Marika
quest:yura:altus.description: Travel to the Second Church of Marika, located northwest of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace, where Yura lies on the ground. Speak to him, and then pick up the Nagakiba. Shortly after, Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger will invade. Defeat her to receive Eleonora's Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear.
related: Yura — Nagakiba gifted after the Liurnia invasion
Find Shabriri wearing Yura’s body at Zamor Ruins

sections.heading: Wiki: Altus Plateau
sections.text: Travel to the Second Church of Marika, located northwest of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace, where Yura lies on the ground. Speak to him, and then pick up the Nagakiba. Shortly after, Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger will invade. Defeat her to receive Eleonora's Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear.

quest:yura:killed.name: Yura killed
quest:yura:killed.description: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura — Find Yura wounded at the Second Church of Marika

quest:yura:nagakiba.name: Yura — Nagakiba gifted after the Liurnia invasion
quest:yura:nagakiba.description: Once you travel to the Mountaintops of the Giants, Yura's quest will be locked regardless of which steps have been completed. Shabriri will be waiting near the Zamor Ruins site of grace, in possession of Yura's reanimated body. The Nagakiba can be found on the ground in whichever location he would have been at, depending on how far into his questline you have progressed.
related: Find Yura wounded at the Second Church of Marika
Help Yura against Bloody Finger Nerijus

sections.heading: Wiki: Mountaintops of the Giants
sections.text: Once you travel to the Mountaintops of the Giants, Yura's quest will be locked regardless of which steps have been completed. Shabriri will be waiting near the Zamor Ruins site of grace, in possession of Yura's reanimated body. The Nagakiba can be found on the ground in whichever location he would have been at, depending on how far into his questline you have progressed.

quest:yura:nerijus.name: Help Yura against Bloody Finger Nerijus
quest:yura:nerijus.description: The following two steps can be completed in either order. His dialogue will vary depending on where he is met first. Yura can be found under a fallen Azula ruin near the Seaside Ruins site of grace, southwest of Agheel Lake. Exhaust his dialogue and his summon sign will appear in Agheel Lake to assist against Flying Dragon Agheel. Speak to him again after defeating Agheel for further dialogue. Enter the Murkwater River, the ravine north of Agheel Lake, and head towards Murkwater Cave. Bloody Finger Nerijus will invade you. After fighting Nerijus for a while, Yura appears to assist you.
related: Help him again at the Liurnia invasion

sections.heading: Wiki: *(Optional)* Limgrave
sections.text: The following two steps can be completed in either order. His dialogue will vary depending on where he is met first. Yura can be found under a fallen Azula ruin near the Seaside Ruins site of grace, southwest of Agheel Lake. Exhaust his dialogue and his summon sign will appear in Agheel Lake to assist against Flying Dragon Agheel. Speak to him again after defeating Agheel for further dialogue. Enter the Murkwater River, the ravine north of Agheel Lake, and head towards Murkwater Cave. Bloody Finger Nerijus will invade you. After fighting Nerijus for a while, Yura appears to assist you.

quest:yura:shabriri.name: Find Shabriri wearing Yura’s body at Zamor Ruins
related: Yura — met at the Second Church of Marika
quest:yura:shabriri.description: The Mountaintops. Yura is gone; Shabriri offers the Frenzied Flame path. Kill Shabriri for Yura’s set.

region:abandoned-ailing-village.name: Abandoned Ailing Village
region:abandoned-ailing-village.description: Abandoned Ailing Village is a Landmark located in Gravesite Plain.

region:abandoned-church.name: Abandoned Church
region:abandoned-church.description: A ruined Church lies within the forbidden Abyssal Woods, an area touched by the Frenzied Flame.

region:abyssal-woods.name: Abyssal Woods
region:abyssal-woods.description: Below the rest of the Realm of Shadow, hidden under a sprawling canopy that blots out the light of the sky, a thick swampy woodland corrupted by Madness.

sections.text: Divided Falls · Abyssal Woods · Woodland Trail · Forsaken Graveyard · Church Ruins

region:academy-gate-town.description: A sprawling township to the south-east of Academy of Raya Lucaria, currently sinking into the lake.

region:academy-of-raya-lucaria.name: Academy of Raya Lucaria
region:academy-of-raya-lucaria.description: The Academy of Raya Lucaria is a both a faction, and a legacy dungeon located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (4)
sections.text: Raya Lucaria Grand Library · Debate Parlor · Church of the Cuckoo · Schoolhouse Classroom

region:agheel-lake.name: Agheel Lake
region:agheel-lake.description: Agheel Lake in Limgrave is a shallow lake named for Flying Dragon Agheel.

region:ailing-village.name: Ailing Village
region:ailing-village.description: A small settlement on the Weeping Peninsula, due north of Castle Morne.

region:ainsel-river.name: Ainsel River
region:ainsel-river.description: One of the two great rivers that flow beneath the Lands Between.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (5)
sections.text: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella · Ainsel River Well Depths · Ainsel River Sluice Gate · Ainsel River Downstream · Astel, Naturalborn of the Void

region:ainsel-river-well.name: Ainsel River Well
region:ainsel-river-well.description: A structure in eastern Liurnia, containing a lift which leads to the subterranean Ainsel River.

region:albinauric-rise.name: Albinauric Rise
region:albinauric-rise.description: A sorcerer's rise on the east side of Consecrated Snowfield, the Albinauric Rise was the tower of an Albinauric who studied the Primeval Current.

region:albinauric-s-shack.name: Albinauric's Shack
region:albinauric-s-shack.description: The Albinauric's Shack rests upon a hill on the northwestern edge of the Scaduview.

region:altus.name: Altus Plateau
region:altus.description: The Altus Plateau is a northwestern region of the Lands Between.

region:altus-bear-woods.name: Altus, Bear Woods
region:altus-bear-woods.description: They are hulking beasts that may charge when provoked.

region:ancestral-woods.name: Ancestral Woods
region:ancestral-woods.description: The Ancestral Woods is a forest of great petrified trees and underground ruins along the Siofra River, populated by the Ancestral Followers.

region:ancient-ruins-of-rauh.name: Ancient Ruins of Rauh
region:ancient-ruins-of-rauh.description: It features numerous waterfalls and pools where Dewgems grow in abundance, and its paved roadways are bisected by irrigation channels.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (6)
sections.text: Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway · Church of the Bud · Church of the Bud, Main Entrance · Rauh Ancient Ruins, West · Rauh Ancient Ruins, East · Viaduct Minor Tower

region:ancient-ruins-under-stair.name: Ancient Ruins, Under-Stair
region:ancient-ruins-under-stair.description: The ancient ruins are enormous megastructures scattered throughout and incorporated into the Lands Between.

region:apostate-derelict.name: Apostate Derelict
region:apostate-derelict.description: A ruined church at the northernmost point of Consecrated Snowfield, beyond the Wandering Mausoleum.

region:artist-s-shack-limgrave.name: Artist's Shack (Limgrave)
region:artist-s-shack-limgrave.description: The Artist's Shack is located to the north-west of Mistwood.

region:artist-s-shack-liurnia.name: Artist's Shack (Liurnia)
region:artist-s-shack-liurnia.description: A small shack on the eastern side of Liurnia, north-west of Carian Study Hall.

region:astel-naturalborn-of-the-void-gra.name: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void (grace)
region:astel-naturalborn-of-the-void-gra.description: Tiny stars fill a grand subterranean cavern downstream the Ainsel River, which serves as the boss room for Astel, Naturalborn of the Void.

region:baldachin.name: Baldachin
region:baldachin.description: The Baldachin is a hidden temple that resembles a bedchamber.

region:bellum-church.name: Bellum Church
region:bellum-church.description: A church built on the side of the highway leading to the Grand Lift of Dectus, the entrance to Altus Plateau.

region:bellum-highway.name: Bellum Highway
region:bellum-highway.description: A highway in the northern region of Liurnia, stretching from the Grand Lift of Dectus to the eastern gate of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (4)
sections.text: East Raya Lucaria Gate · Bellum Church · Church of Inhibition · Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts

region:bestial-sanctum.name: Bestial Sanctum
region:bestial-sanctum.description: An ancient structure on the northernmost tip of Caelid.

region:boilprawn-shack.name: Boilprawn Shack
region:boilprawn-shack.description: An isolated shack standing on its own in the lake, north-west of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace.

region:bonny-village.name: Bonny Village
region:bonny-village.description: The Bonny Village is located in eastern Scadu Altus, accessible through the fissure in the Moorth Ruins.

region:bridge-of-sacrifice.name: Bridge of Sacrifice
region:bridge-of-sacrifice.description: A short, heavily fortified bridge connecting mainland Limgrave to the Weeping Peninsula to the south.

region:caelid.name: Caelid
region:caelid.description: A wasteland on the southeastern tip of the Lands Between, plagued by Scarlet Rot and inhabited by all manner of malformed creatures.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (25)
sections.text: Minor Erdtree Catacombs · Caelid Catacombs · War,Dead Catacombs · Abandoned Cave · Gaol Cave · Gael Tunnel · Rear Gael Tunnel Entrance · Sellia Crystal Tunnel · Smoldering Church · Rotview Balcony · Fort Gael North · Caelem Ruins

region:caelid-colosseum.name: Caelid Colosseum
region:caelid-colosseum.description: An old Colosseum located in northern Caelid, accessed from the Siofra River via the Deep Siofra Well, then traveling north through a ravine.

region:caelid-minor-erdtree.name: Caelid Minor Erdtree
region:caelid-minor-erdtree.description: A Minor Erdtree in north-western Caelid.

region:caelid-waypoint-ruins.name: Caelid Waypoint Ruins
region:caelid-waypoint-ruins.description: A ruin in western Caelid, west of the Swamp of Aeonia.

region:callu-baptismal-church.name: Callu Baptismal Church
region:callu-baptismal-church.description: A church on the Weeping Peninsula, on the southern side of the Ailing Village.

region:capital-outskirts.name: Capital Outskirts

region:minor-erdtree-limgrave.description: Towering over the Mistwood, this golden tree is one of the few not protected by an Erdtree Avatar.

region:minor-erdtree-mountaintops-of-the.description: A dead Minor Erdtree in central Mountaintops of the Giants, little more than a stump.

region:minor-erdtree-mt-gelmir.name: Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir)
region:minor-erdtree-mt-gelmir.description: A burnt, shrivelled Minor Erdtree on the north-eastern side of Mt.

region:minor-erdtree-weeping-peninsula.name: Minor Erdtree (Weeping Peninsula)
region:minor-erdtree-weeping-peninsula.description: A Minor Erdtree on a raised ridge in the Weeping Peninsula, south of the Church of Pilgrimage.

region:minor-erdtree-west-liurnia.name: Minor Erdtree (West Liurnia)
region:minor-erdtree-west-liurnia.description: A Minor Erdtree in the west of Liurnia, protected by Erdtree Guardians and an Erdtree Avatar.

region:minor-erdtrees.name: Minor Erdtrees
region:minor-erdtrees.description: The Erdtree's offspring sprouted from its fabled Golden Seeds, scattered across the Lands Between when it sensed the end of its life for the first time.

region:miquella-s-cross.name: Miquella's Cross
region:miquella-s-cross.description: There are 13 sites across the Land of Shadow where Miquella of the Haligtree discarded parts of himself in his quest to sever ties with the Golden Order and attain godhood. A single Scadutree Fragment can be found at each cross.

region:mirage-rise.name: Mirage Rise
region:mirage-rise.description: A sorcerer's rise in Altus Plateau, in the valley south-west of the Minor Erdtree.

region:mistwood.name: Mistwood
region:mistwood.description: The Mistwood is a dense forest in eastern Limgrave.

region:mistwood-ruins.name: Mistwood Ruins
region:mistwood-ruins.description: A ruin deep within the Mistwood, currently inhabited by a Runebear.

region:mohgwyn-palace.name: Mohgwyn Palace
region:mohgwyn-palace.description: An island in the underground Siofra River, far to the east of Nokron, Eternal City.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (4)
sections.text: Cocoon of the Empyrean · Palace Approach Ledge,Road · Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance · Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint

region:moonfolk-ruins.name: Moonfolk Ruins
region:moonfolk-ruins.description: A ruined complex built on the Moonlight Altar, just north of the Deep Ainsel Well.

region:mountaintops.name: Mountaintops of the Giants
region:mountaintops.description: The giant's forge could contain a volcano.

region:mt-gelmir.name: Mt. Gelmir
region:mt-gelmir.description: A volcano in western Altus Plateau, which houses the Volcano Manor at its summit.

sections.text: Wyndham Catacombs · Gelmir Hero's Grave · Seethewater Cave · Volcano Cave · Seethewater Terminus · Craftman's Shack · Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite · Road of Iniquity · Seethewater River · Primeval Sorcerer Azur · First Mt. Gelmir Campsite · Bridge of Iniquity

region:nameless-eternal-city.name: Nameless Eternal City
region:nameless-eternal-city.description: Unlike its sister cities, the nameless Eternal City lacks a false night sky.

region:nameless-mausoleums.name: Nameless Mausoleums
region:nameless-mausoleums.description: Nameless Mausoleums are recurring Landmarks in Shadow of the Erdtree.

region:northern-nameless-mausoleum.name: Northern Nameless Mausoleum
region:northern-nameless-mausoleum.description: The Northern Nameless Mausoleum stands atop a plateau at the Rauh Base.

region:oridys-s-rise.name: Oridys's Rise
region:oridys-s-rise.description: A sorcerer's rise on the eastern side of the Weeping Peninsula.

region:palace-approach-ledge-road.name: Palace Approach Ledge-Road
region:palace-approach-ledge-road.description: The Palace Approach Ledge-Road is found beneath a set of ancient ruins at the Mohgwyn Palace on the Siofra River.

region:perfumer-s-ruins.name: Perfumer's Ruins
region:perfumer-s-ruins.description: A cluster of ruins in south-western Altus Plateau, occupied by Perfumers, an Omenkiller, and a large number of Miranda Blooms.

region:pillar-path-cross.name: Pillar Path Cross
region:pillar-path-cross.description: On his pilgrimage through the Land of Shadow, Miquella the Kind shed part of himself on the Pillar Path in eastern Gravesite Plain.

region:prayer-room.name: Prayer Room
region:prayer-room.description: It connects Miquella's Haligtree with Ephael, Brace of the Haligtree.

region:prospect-town.name: Prospect Town
region:prospect-town.description: The hornsent inhabitants became bloodfiends after accepting the Formless Mother as their savior.

region:purified-ruins.name: Purified Ruins
region:purified-ruins.description: A cluster of ruined buildings occupied by Raya Lucaria's army.

region:rabbath-s-rise.name: Rabbath's Rise
region:rabbath-s-rise.description: Rabbath's Rise is found in the eastern Scadu Altus, near the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and below the Shaman Village.

region:ranni-s-rise.name: Ranni's Rise
region:ranni-s-rise.description: The dwelling place of Ranni the Witch in the Three Sisters region of Liurnia beyond Caria Manor.

region:rauh-base.name: Rauh Base
region:rauh-base.description: This area of the map is revealed by Map: Rauh Ruins.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (5)
sections.text: Scorpion River Catacombs · Taylew's Ruined Forge · Temple Town Ruins · Ravine North · Ancient Ruins Base

region:rauh-base-bear-woods.name: Rauh Base, Bear Woods
region:rauh-base-bear-woods.description: The Rauh Base is a peripheral region adjoining the Scadu Altus within the *Shadow of the Erdtree* expansion.

region:raya-lucaria-grand-library.name: Raya Lucaria Grand Library
region:raya-lucaria-grand-library.description: Situated at one of the Academy of Raya Lucaria's highest points, the Raya Lucaria Grand Library was the hub of knowledge in Liurnia of the Lakes during the age of the Erdtree.

region:renna-s-rise.name: Renna's Rise
region:renna-s-rise.description: The northernmost tower of the Three Sisters, located beyond the Caria Manor.

region:rest-of-the-dread-dragon.name: Rest of the Dread Dragon
region:rest-of-the-dread-dragon.description: The Rest of the Dread Dragon is the final Site of Grace on the Jagged Peak, situated in the summit clearing after the defeat of Bayle the Dread.

region:revenger-s-shack.name: Revenger's Shack
region:revenger-s-shack.description: A small shack on the west side of Liurnia, north of the Minor Erdtree.

region:rose-church.name: Rose Church
region:rose-church.description: An old church on an island in Liurnia of the Lakes, south of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

region:roundtable-hold.name: Roundtable Hold
region:roundtable-hold.description: Entry to Roundtable Hold is locked until the player receives an invitation from Melina, achieved by resting at a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes or Caelid, or by defeating Margit, the Fell Omen. Afterward, the Roundtable Hold can be accessed via fast travel from the map.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (1)
sections.text: Table of Lost Grace

region:royal-colosseum.name: Royal Colosseum
region:royal-colosseum.description: A colosseum located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

region:ruins-of-unte.name: Ruins of Unte
region:ruins-of-unte.description: Furnace Golems braved the Recluses' River to assault the Ruins of Unte during the Crusade, destroying the hornsent settlement.

region:run-down-traveler-s-rest.name: Run-Down Traveler's Rest
region:run-down-traveler-s-rest.description: Run-Down Traveler's Rest is a small, lonely shack on a cliff in the Gravesite Plain, on the southwestern bank of the Ellac River.

region:saintsbridge.name: Saintsbridge
region:saintsbridge.description: Saintsbridge is a long stone bridge spanning the Murkwater River, connecting Stormhill to northeastern Limgrave.

region:scadu-altus.name: Scadu Altus
region:scadu-altus.description: The Scadu Altus is a plateau at the center of the Realm of Shadow, occupied by the army of Messmer the Impaler.

region:scadutree-base.name: Scadutree Base
region:scadutree-base.description: This grace is revealed after the Scadutree Avatar is defeated.

region:scadutree-chalice.name: Scadutree Chalice
region:scadutree-chalice.description: The Scadutree Chalice lies behind a massive black gate on the northwestern tip of the Scaduview.

region:scaduview.name: Scaduview
region:scaduview.description: This area of the map is revealed by Map: Scadu Altus.

sections.heading: Sites of Grace (6)
sections.text: Scaduview · Shadow Keep, Back Gate · Hinterland · Scadutree Base · Fingerstone Hill · Hinterland Bridge

region:scorched-ruins.name: Scorched Ruins
region:scorched-ruins.description: The Scorched Ruins was a hornsent settlement located on the Gravesite Plain, northeast of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.

region:sea-of-fog.name: Sea of Fog
region:sea-of-fog.description: The Sea of Fog is a vast body of water separating the Lands Between from other lands.

region:second-church-of-marika.name: Second Church of Marika
region:second-church-of-marika.description: A crumbling church in central Altus Plateau.

region:sellia-gateway.name: Sellia Gateway
region:sellia-gateway.description: A gate that stands at the southern entrance to Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

region:sellia-town-of-sorcery.name: Sellia, Town of Sorcery
region:sellia-town-of-sorcery.description: A town in Caelid on the eastern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia.

region:seluvis-s-rise.name: Seluvis's Rise
region:seluvis-s-rise.description: The southernmost tower in the Three Sisters, beyond the Caria Manor.

region:sending-gate.name: Sending Gate
region:sending-gate.description: Sending Gates are teleporters that transport the player to another location.

region:shack-of-the-lofty.name: Shack of the Lofty
region:shack-of-the-lofty.description: A small shack north-west of the Stargazers' Ruins in Mountaintops of the Giants.

region:shack-of-the-rotting.name: Shack of the Rotting
region:shack-of-the-rotting.description: A small, run-down shack on the western side of Caelid, overlooking the rot-stricken region.

region:shadow.name: Realm of Shadow
region:shadow.description: Incantation originating from Scadutree avatars. Creates a hail of golden projectiles which are fired toward foes after a brief delay. This incantation channels the force of the Scadutree's power, and its gold is accompanied by shadow.

stats.Effect: Fires a hail of golden projectiles toward foes

region:shadow-keep-church-district.name: Shadow Keep, Church District
region:shadow-keep-church-district.description: This area of the map is revealed by Map: Scadu Altus.

sections.text: Church District Entrance · Sunken Chapel · Tree,Worship Passage · Tree,Worship Sanctum

region:shaman-village.name: Shaman Village
region:shaman-village.description: The Shaman Village is a tranquil hamlet hidden in the Scaduview, nestled among lush vegetation and vibrant, multicolored flowers.

region:siofra-river.name: Siofra River
region:siofra-river.description: A mystical underground region filled with its own set of skies and stars. Beware, it is teeming with creatures big and small alike

sections.text: Siofra River Bank · Worshippers' Woods · Below the Well · Siofra River Well Depths

region:sites-of-grace.name: Sites of Grace
region:sites-of-grace.description: They serve as resting points where players can fast-travel and manage various aspects of their character. Resting at these locations has multiple effects and provides options to customize and progress.

region:slumbering-wolf-s-shack.name: Slumbering Wolf's Shack
region:slumbering-wolf-s-shack.description: A shack built on a small plateau jutting from the southern cliffs of Liurnia.

region:smoldering-church.name: Smoldering Church
region:smoldering-church.description: A perpetually burning church on the border between Limgrave and Caelid.

region:southern-nameless-mausoleum.name: Southern Nameless Mausoleum
region:southern-nameless-mausoleum.description: The Southern Nameless Mausoleum can be found on a small island off the Cerulean Coast.

region:southern-shore.name: Southern Shore
region:southern-shore.description:
The southern coast of the Gravesite Plain includes the following subregions:
- Cerulean Coast
- Charo's Hidden Grave
- Foot of the Jagged Peak
- Jagged Peak
- Stone Coffin Fissure

region:specimen-storehouse.name: Specimen Storehouse
region:specimen-storehouse.description: This area of the map is revealed by Map: Scadu Altus.

region:starfall-crater.name: Starfall Crater
region:starfall-crater.description: Nokron, the upper Eternal City section of the Siofra River, becomes accessible after defeating Starscourge Radahn at the Wailing Dunes.

region:stargazer-s-ruins.name: Stargazer's Ruins
region:stargazer-s-ruins.description: A ruined settlement in the western Mountaintops of the Giants, seemingly once inhabited by ancient astrologers.

region:stone-platform.name: Stone Platform
region:stone-platform.description: The Stone Platform inside the Erdtree is a flat, circular surface encircled by dense fog and sparsely covered with saplings, tree roots, and metallic gold leaves.

sections.text: Fractured Marika

region:stormcaller-church.name: Stormcaller Church
region:stormcaller-church.description: A church in central Altus Plateau, south of Sainted Hero's Grave.

region:stormgate.name: Stormgate
region:stormgate.description: Stormgate is located in the southern part of Stormhill, north of Gatefront Ruins.

region:stormhill.name: Stormhill
region:stormhill.description: Situated in the northwestern portion of Limgrave, Stormhill is perpetually wrapped in strong winds and littered with ancient and fallen ruins.

sections.text: Margit, the Fell Omen · Castleward Tunnel · Deathtouched Catacombs · Limgrave Tower Bridge · Divine Tower of Limgrave · Stormhill Shack · Warmaster's Shack · Saintsbridge

region:stormhill-shack.name: Stormhill Shack
region:stormhill-shack.description: Stormhill Shack is a small wooden shack in Stormhill, north of Stormgate.

region:street-of-sages-ruins.name: Street of Sages Ruins
region:street-of-sages-ruins.description: A sprawling ruin in the northern section of the Swamp of Aeonia, populated by worshippers of the Scarlet Rot.

region:summonwater-village.name: Summonwater Village
region:summonwater-village.description: Summonwater Village is a seemingly abandoned settlement in the eastern region of Limgrave.

region:suppressing-pillar.name: Suppressing Pillar
region:suppressing-pillar.description: The Suppressing Pillar is the center of the Lands Between.

region:swamp-lookout-tower.name: Swamp Lookout Tower
region:swamp-lookout-tower.description: A crumbling Lookout Tower perched on the cliffs southwest of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, overlooking the Swamp of Aeonia.

region:swamp-of-aeonia.name: Swamp of Aeonia
region:swamp-of-aeonia.description: Before it was the scarlet rot Swamp of Aeonia, the heart of Caelid contained the Street of Sages, a western extension of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, where great sorcerers practiced Gravity Sorcery.

sections.text: Aeonia Swamp Shore · Astray from Caelid Highway North · Heart of Aeonia · Inner Aeonia

region:temple-of-eiglay.name: Temple of Eiglay
region:temple-of-eiglay.description: The old church attached to the Volcano Manor on Mt.

region:temple-quarter.name: Temple Quarter
region:temple-quarter.description: A ruined temple complex half-sunken in the lake, south-west of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

region:temple-town-ruins.name: Temple Town Ruins
region:temple-town-ruins.description: Temple Town was a walled hornsent settlement at the Rauh Base that flourished in antiquity.

region:testu-s-rise.name: Testu's Rise
region:testu-s-rise.description: A sorcerer's rise on a small island north of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

region:the-four-belfries.name: The Four Belfries
region:the-four-belfries.description: The Four Belfries sit atop a hill in western Liurnia of the Lakes, north of the Minor Erdtree and south of Caria Manor.

region:the-pit.name: The Pit
region:the-pit.description: It is a bottomless pit that instantly kills anything that falls into it and is the only one of its kind amongst the surface world of the Lands Between, as every other lethal fall is either tied to coastal waters or mountainous cliffs.

region:third-church-of-marika.name: Third Church of Marika
region:third-church-of-marika.description: The Third Church of Marika is located in the eastern portion of Limgrave, just north of Mistwood.

region:three-path-cross.name: Three-Path Cross
region:three-path-cross.description: Three of Miquella's Followers have gathered around Miquella's Cross: Needle Knight Leda, Redmane Freyja, and the Hornsent.

region:three-sisters.name: Three Sisters
region:three-sisters.description: A region on Caria Manor's grounds, only accessible by traversing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta.

region:tombsward.name: Tombsward
region:tombsward.description: A cave drenched in poison and teeming with vermin.

region:tombsward-ruins.name: Tombsward Ruins
region:tombsward-ruins.description: The Tombsward Ruins are a crumbling stone structure located in the western Tombsward region of the Weeping Peninsula.

region:tower-of-return.name: Tower of Return
region:tower-of-return.description: A dilapidated watchtower occupied by Godrick's forces.

region:uld-palace-ruins.name: Uld Palace Ruins
region:uld-palace-ruins.description: A labyrinth of ancient dynastic ruins in the northeastern region of Liurnia of the Lakes, dotted with broken statues and columns.

region:village-of-flies.name: Village of Flies
region:village-of-flies.description: Located downstream of the Recluses' River on the Scadu Altus, this hornsent village succumbed to the fly sickness.

region:village-of-the-albinaurics.name: Village of the Albinaurics
region:village-of-the-albinaurics.description: A secluded Albinauric settlement built into the cliffs beneath a plateau in Liurnia.

region:village-windmill-pasture.name: Village Windmill Pasture
region:village-windmill-pasture.description: The Village Windmill Pasture sits just west of Dominula, Windmill Village.

region:volcano-manor-request-istvan.name: Volcano Manor Request: Istvan
region:volcano-manor-request-istvan.description: During the Shattering, the Volcano Manor was the home of Praetor Rykard and his Recusant, fierce warriors who waged war against the Erdtree.

region:volcano-manor-request-juno-hoslow.name: Volcano Manor Request: Juno Hoslow
region:volcano-manor-request-juno-hoslow.description: During the Shattering, the Volcano Manor was the home of Praetor Rykard and his Recusant, fierce warriors who waged war against the Erdtree.

region:volcano-manor-request-rileigh.name: Volcano Manor Request: Rileigh
region:volcano-manor-request-rileigh.description: During the Shattering, the Volcano Manor was the home of Praetor Rykard and his Recusant, fierce warriors who waged war against the Erdtree.

region:volcano-manor-request-tragoth.name: Volcano Manor Request: Tragoth
region:volcano-manor-request-tragoth.description: During the Shattering, the Volcano Manor was the home of Praetor Rykard and his Recusant, fierce warriors who waged war against the Erdtree.

region:volcano-manor-request-vargram.name: Volcano Manor Request: Vargram
region:volcano-manor-request-vargram.description: During the Shattering, the Volcano Manor was the home of Praetor Rykard and his Recusant, fierce warriors who waged war against the Erdtree.

region:wailing-dunes.name: Wailing Dunes
region:wailing-dunes.description: A vast expanse of sand on the eastern coast of Caelid.

region:wailing-dunes-south.name: Wailing Dunes South
region:wailing-dunes-south.description: A vast expanse of sand on the eastern coast of Caelid.

region:warmaster-s-shack.name: Warmaster's Shack
region:warmaster-s-shack.description: Warmaster's Shack is a small hut in the woods north of Stormgate.

region:weeping.name: Weeping Peninsula
region:weeping.description: The Weeping Peninsula is a crescent-shaped landmass at the southernmost tip of the Lands Between.

region:west-windmill-pasture.name: West Windmill Pasture
region:west-windmill-pasture.description: A windmill standing on the cliffs in the north-west of Altus Plateau.

region:western-nameless-mausoleum.description: A Nameless Mausoleum in the western corner of Gravesite Plain.

region:whipping-hut.name: Whipping Hut
region:whipping-hut.description: A lone ruined hut located east of Bonny Village in the Scadu Altus region.

region:witchbane-ruins.name: Witchbane Ruins
region:witchbane-ruins.description: A ruined structure just south of the Fourth Church of Marika on the Weeping Peninsula, in the middle of a poison pool.

region:woodfolk-ruins.name: Woodfolk Ruins
region:woodfolk-ruins.description: A ruined settlement in the deep woods that surround the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau.

region:yelough-anix-ruins.name: Yelough Anix Ruins
region:yelough-anix-ruins.description: A ruined settlement on the western border of the Consecrated Snowfield.

region:zamor-ruins.name: Zamor Ruins
region:zamor-ruins.description: The ruins of an ancient settlement inhabited by the Zamor Knights, who once challenged the Fire Giants.
